# Objetivo

Este notebook busca entender, paso a paso, como difieren las tarjetas que usan
QR respecto de las tarjetas BIP en el panel agregado a nivel `id_tarjeta`.

Caveat central: `id_tarjeta` es una unidad operacional y se usa como proxy de
usuario. Una misma persona podria tener mas de una tarjeta, por lo que las
comparaciones BIP vs QR deben leerse como diferencias entre tarjetas/poblaciones
observadas, no necesariamente entre personas unicas.

Este notebook se construira celda a celda. El primer bloque responde solo la
pregunta de composicion.

def apply_plot_theme() -> None:
    sns.set_theme(
        context="notebook",
        style="whitegrid",
        rc={
            "figure.facecolor": FIG_BG,
            "axes.facecolor": AX_BG,
            "savefig.facecolor": FIG_BG,
            "axes.edgecolor": MUTED_TEXT,
            "axes.labelcolor": TEXT_COLOR,
            "xtick.color": TEXT_COLOR,
            "ytick.color": TEXT_COLOR,
            "text.color": TEXT_COLOR,
            "grid.color": GRID_COLOR,
            "grid.linewidth": 0.8,
            "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
        },
    )
    plt.rcParams.update(
        {
            "figure.dpi": 140,
            "savefig.dpi": 180,
            "axes.spines.top": False,
            "axes.spines.right": False,
            "axes.grid": True,
            "font.size": 10.5,
            "axes.titlesize": 13,
            "axes.titleweight": "bold",
            "axes.labelsize": 10.5,
            "legend.frameon": False,
        }
    )


def style_axis(ax, *, grid_axis: str = "x") -> None:
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
    ax.grid(False)
    if grid_axis in {"x", "both"}:
        ax.grid(axis="x", color=GRID_COLOR, alpha=0.8, linewidth=0.8)
    if grid_axis in {"y", "both"}:
        ax.grid(axis="y", color=GRID_COLOR, alpha=0.8, linewidth=0.8)
    for side in ["left", "bottom"]:
        ax.spines[side].set_color(MUTED_TEXT)
        ax.spines[side].set_linewidth(0.9)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_COLOR)
    ax.xaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_COLOR)
    ax.yaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_COLOR)


def add_figure_title(
    fig,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    *,
    y: float = 0.98,
    subtitle_gap: float = 0.055,
) -> None:
    fig.suptitle(title, fontsize=16, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, y=y)
    if subtitle is not None:
        fig.text(
            0.5,
            y - subtitle_gap,
            subtitle,
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=10.5,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
        )

def add_payment_group(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return lf.with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("is_qr") == 1)
        .then(pl.lit("QR"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("BIP"))
        .alias("payment_group")
    )


def add_presence_cohort(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return lf.with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("share_trips_2025") <= 0)
        .then(pl.lit("only_2024"))
        .when(pl.col("share_trips_2025") >= 1)
        .then(pl.lit("only_2025"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("both_years"))
        .alias("presence_cohort")
    )


def fmt_int(value: float | int) -> str:
    return f"{int(value):,}".replace(",", ".")


def composition_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    lf_payment = add_payment_group(lf)
    totals = lf_payment.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("total_cards"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("total_trips"),
        ]
    ).collect().row(0, named=True)

    return (
        lf_payment.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").mean().alias("mean_trips_per_card"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_trips_per_card"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(totals["total_cards"]).alias("total_cards"),
                pl.lit(totals["total_trips"]).alias("total_trips"),
                (pl.col("n_cards") / totals["total_cards"]).alias("card_share"),
                (pl.col("n_trips") / totals["total_trips"]).alias("trip_share"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("trip_share") - pl.col("card_share")).alias("trip_minus_card_share"))
        .sort("payment_group")
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                "card_share",
                "n_trips",
                "trip_share",
                "trip_minus_card_share",
                "mean_trips_per_card",
                "median_trips_per_card",
                "total_cards",
                "total_trips",
            ]
        )
        .collect()
    )


def cohort_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    lf_cohort = add_presence_cohort(add_payment_group(lf))
    return (
        lf_cohort.group_by(["payment_group", "presence_cohort"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
                pl.col("share_trips_2025").median().alias("share_trips_2025_median"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards").sum().over("payment_group")).alias(
                    "card_share_within_payment"
                ),
                (pl.col("n_trips") / pl.col("n_trips").sum().over("payment_group")).alias(
                    "trip_share_within_payment"
                ),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "presence_cohort",
                "n_cards",
                "card_share_within_payment",
                "n_trips",
                "trip_share_within_payment",
                "share_trips_2025_median",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["payment_group", "presence_cohort"])
        .collect()
    )


def first_seen_month_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    panel_path: Path,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
            ]
        )
        .unique()
    )
    first_seen_lf = (
        pl.scan_parquet(str(panel_path))
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "first_trip_ts",
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .filter(pl.col("first_trip_ts").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(
            pl.date(
                pl.col("first_trip_ts").dt.year(),
                pl.col("first_trip_ts").dt.month(),
                pl.lit(1),
            ).alias("first_seen_month")
        )
        .group_by(["payment_group", "first_seen_month"])
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards"))
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.col("n_cards").sum().over("payment_group").alias("n_cards_payment"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards_payment")).alias("share_within_payment"))
        .with_columns(pl.col("first_seen_month").dt.strftime("%Y-%m").alias("first_seen_month_label"))
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "first_seen_month",
                "first_seen_month_label",
                "n_cards",
                "n_cards_payment",
                "share_within_payment",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["payment_group", "first_seen_month"])
    )
    return first_seen_lf.collect()


def observed_exposure_summary_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    panel_path: Path,
    observed_weeks: list[str],
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    week_index = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "first_seen_week": observed_weeks,
            "first_seen_week_index": list(range(1, len(observed_weeks) + 1)),
        }
    ).lazy()
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
                pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Float64).alias("n_viajes"),
            ]
        )
        .unique()
    )
    return (
        pl.scan_parquet(str(panel_path))
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "first_trip_ts",
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .filter(pl.col("first_trip_ts").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(pl.col("first_trip_ts").dt.strftime("%G-W%V").alias("first_seen_week"))
        .join(week_index, on="first_seen_week", how="left")
        .filter(pl.col("first_seen_week_index").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(
            (pl.lit(len(observed_weeks)) - pl.col("first_seen_week_index") + 1)
            .cast(pl.Int16)
            .alias("observed_weeks_available")
        )
        .group_by(["payment_group", "observed_weeks_available"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").quantile(0.25).alias("p25_trips_per_card"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_trips_per_card"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").quantile(0.75).alias("p75_trips_per_card"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "observed_weeks_available",
                "n_cards",
                "p25_trips_per_card",
                "median_trips_per_card",
                "p75_trips_per_card",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["payment_group", "observed_weeks_available"])
        .collect()
    )


def adjusted_activity_summary_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    panel_path: Path,
    observed_weeks: list[str],
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    week_index = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "first_seen_week": observed_weeks,
            "first_seen_week_index": list(range(1, len(observed_weeks) + 1)),
        }
    ).lazy()
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
                pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Float64).alias("n_viajes"),
                pl.col("n_semanas_activas").cast(pl.Float64).alias("n_semanas_activas"),
            ]
        )
        .unique()
    )
    base = (
        pl.scan_parquet(str(panel_path))
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "first_trip_ts",
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .filter(pl.col("first_trip_ts").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(pl.col("first_trip_ts").dt.strftime("%G-W%V").alias("first_seen_week"))
        .join(week_index, on="first_seen_week", how="left")
        .filter(pl.col("first_seen_week_index").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(
            (pl.lit(len(observed_weeks)) - pl.col("first_seen_week_index") + 1)
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .alias("observed_weeks_available")
        )
        .filter((pl.col("observed_weeks_available") > 0) & (pl.col("n_semanas_activas") > 0))
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("n_viajes") / pl.col("observed_weeks_available")).alias(
                    "trips_per_observed_week"
                ),
                (pl.col("n_viajes") / pl.col("n_semanas_activas")).alias(
                    "trips_per_active_week"
                ),
                pl.col("n_semanas_activas").alias("active_weeks"),
            ]
        )
    )

    metric_specs = [
        ("trips_per_observed_week", "Viajes por semana observada", 1),
        ("trips_per_active_week", "Viajes por semana activa", 2),
        ("active_weeks", "Semanas activas", 3),
    ]
    frames = []
    for metric, metric_label, metric_order in metric_specs:
        frames.append(
            base.group_by("payment_group")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col(metric).quantile(0.25).alias("p25"),
                    pl.col(metric).median().alias("median"),
                    pl.col(metric).quantile(0.75).alias("p75"),
                ]
            )
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                    pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                    pl.lit(metric).alias("metric"),
                    pl.lit(metric_label).alias("metric_label"),
                    pl.lit(metric_order).alias("metric_order"),
                ]
            )
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(frames)
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "metric",
                "metric_label",
                "metric_order",
                "n_cards",
                "p25",
                "median",
                "p75",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["metric_order", "payment_group"])
        .collect()
    )


def _gini_nonnegative(values: np.ndarray) -> float:
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    values = values[np.isfinite(values) & (values >= 0)]
    if len(values) == 0 or values.sum() <= 0:
        return np.nan

    sorted_values = np.sort(values)
    n = len(sorted_values)
    ranks = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    return float((2 * np.sum(ranks * sorted_values) / (n * sorted_values.sum())) - ((n + 1) / n))


def card_trip_concentration_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
    *,
    top_fracs: tuple[float, ...] = (0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20),
    n_lorenz_points: int = 201,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    cards = (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .select(
            [
                "payment_group",
                pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Float64).alias("n_viajes"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )

    summary_rows = []
    curve_frames = []
    grid = np.linspace(0, 1, n_lorenz_points)

    for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
        values = cards.loc[cards["payment_group"] == group, "n_viajes"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        values = values[np.isfinite(values) & (values >= 0)]
        n_cards = len(values)
        total_trips = values.sum()

        if n_cards == 0 or total_trips <= 0:
            continue

        sorted_values = np.sort(values)
        cum_cards = np.arange(1, n_cards + 1) / n_cards
        cum_trips = np.cumsum(sorted_values) / total_trips
        sampled_trips = np.interp(grid, np.r_[0, cum_cards], np.r_[0, cum_trips])

        curve_frames.append(
            pd.DataFrame(
                {
                    "universe": universe,
                    "universe_label": label,
                    "payment_group": group,
                    "cum_card_share": grid,
                    "cum_trip_share": sampled_trips,
                }
            )
        )

        descending_values = sorted_values[::-1]
        row = {
            "universe": universe,
            "universe_label": label,
            "payment_group": group,
            "n_cards": n_cards,
            "n_trips": int(total_trips),
            "gini_trips_per_card": _gini_nonnegative(values),
            "median_trips_per_card": float(np.median(values)),
            "p90_trips_per_card": float(np.quantile(values, 0.90)),
            "p99_trips_per_card": float(np.quantile(values, 0.99)),
        }
        for frac in top_fracs:
            top_n = max(1, int(np.ceil(n_cards * frac)))
            row[f"share_trips_top_{int(round(frac * 100))}pct"] = float(
                descending_values[:top_n].sum() / total_trips
            )
        summary_rows.append(row)

    return pd.DataFrame(summary_rows), pd.concat(curve_frames, ignore_index=True)


def card_persistence_summary_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
    *,
    top_share: float = 0.20,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    base = (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_viajes") * pl.col("share_trips_2025"))
            .round()
            .cast(pl.Int64)
            .alias("n_trips_2025")
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Int64) - pl.col("n_trips_2025")).alias(
                "n_trips_2024"
            )
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") == 0)
            .then(pl.lit("only_2025"))
            .when(pl.col("n_trips_2025") == 0)
            .then(pl.lit("only_2024"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("both_years"))
            .alias("presence_cohort")
        )
    )

    group_summary = (
        base.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                (pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0).sum().alias("n_cards_2024"),
                (
                    (pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0)
                    & (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0)
                )
                .sum()
                .alias("n_cards_reobserved_2025"),
                (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0).sum().alias("n_cards_2025"),
                pl.col("n_trips_2025").sum().alias("n_trips_2025"),
                pl.when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "both_years")
                .then(pl.col("n_trips_2025"))
                .otherwise(0)
                .sum()
                .alias("n_trips_2025_recurrent"),
                pl.when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "only_2025")
                .then(pl.col("n_trips_2025"))
                .otherwise(0)
                .sum()
                .alias("n_trips_2025_only_2025"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col("n_cards_reobserved_2025") / pl.col("n_cards_2024")
                ).alias("share_cards_2024_reobserved_2025"),
                (
                    pl.col("n_trips_2025_recurrent") / pl.col("n_trips_2025")
                ).alias("share_trips_2025_recurrent"),
                (
                    pl.col("n_trips_2025_only_2025") / pl.col("n_trips_2025")
                ).alias("share_trips_2025_only_2025"),
            ]
        )
    )

    recurrent = (
        base.filter(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "both_years")
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.col("n_trips_2024")
                .rank(method="min", descending=True)
                .over("payment_group")
                .alias("rank_2024"),
                pl.col("n_trips_2025")
                .rank(method="min", descending=True)
                .over("payment_group")
                .alias("rank_2025"),
                pl.len().over("payment_group").alias("n_recurrent_for_ranking"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col("rank_2024")
                    <= (pl.col("n_recurrent_for_ranking") * top_share).ceil()
                ).alias("is_top_2024"),
                (
                    pl.col("rank_2025")
                    <= (pl.col("n_recurrent_for_ranking") * top_share).ceil()
                ).alias("is_top_2025"),
            ]
        )
    )

    top_summary = (
        recurrent.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards_recurrent_for_ranking"),
                pl.col("is_top_2024").sum().alias("n_top_2024"),
                (pl.col("is_top_2024") & pl.col("is_top_2025"))
                .sum()
                .alias("n_top_2024_retained_2025"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col("n_top_2024") / pl.col("n_cards_recurrent_for_ranking")
                ).alias("actual_top_2024_share"),
                (
                    pl.col("n_top_2024_retained_2025") / pl.col("n_top_2024")
                ).alias("share_top_2024_retained_2025"),
            ]
        )
    )

    return (
        group_summary.join(top_summary, on="payment_group", how="left")
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(top_share).alias("nominal_top_share"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards_2024",
                "n_cards_reobserved_2025",
                "share_cards_2024_reobserved_2025",
                "n_cards_2025",
                "n_cards_recurrent_for_ranking",
                "nominal_top_share",
                "actual_top_2024_share",
                "n_top_2024",
                "n_top_2024_retained_2025",
                "share_top_2024_retained_2025",
                "n_trips_2025",
                "n_trips_2025_recurrent",
                "share_trips_2025_recurrent",
                "n_trips_2025_only_2025",
                "share_trips_2025_only_2025",
            ]
        )
        .sort("payment_group")
        .collect()
    )


def card_continuity_by_2024_activity_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    base = (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .filter(pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0)
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0).alias("is_reobserved_2025"),
                pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024")
                .cast(pl.Utf8)
                .alias("active_weeks_2024_label"),
                pl.when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 2)
                .then(pl.lit("1-2"))
                .when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 5)
                .then(pl.lit("3-5"))
                .when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 10)
                .then(pl.lit("6-10"))
                .otherwise(pl.lit("11+"))
                .alias("trips_2024_bin"),
                pl.when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 2)
                .then(pl.lit(1))
                .when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 5)
                .then(pl.lit(2))
                .when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 10)
                .then(pl.lit(3))
                .otherwise(pl.lit(4))
                .cast(pl.Int8)
                .alias("trips_2024_bin_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

    week_summary = (
        base.group_by(["payment_group", "n_active_weeks_2024", "active_weeks_2024_label"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards_2024"),
                pl.col("is_reobserved_2025").sum().alias("n_reobserved_2025"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit("active_weeks_2024").alias("dimension"),
                pl.lit("Semanas activas en 2024").alias("dimension_label"),
                pl.lit(1).cast(pl.Int8).alias("dimension_order"),
                pl.col("active_weeks_2024_label").alias("activity_level"),
                pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024").cast(pl.Int8).alias("level_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

    trip_summary = (
        base.group_by(["payment_group", "trips_2024_bin", "trips_2024_bin_order"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards_2024"),
                pl.col("is_reobserved_2025").sum().alias("n_reobserved_2025"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit("trips_2024").alias("dimension"),
                pl.lit("Viajes en 2024").alias("dimension_label"),
                pl.lit(2).cast(pl.Int8).alias("dimension_order"),
                pl.col("trips_2024_bin").alias("activity_level"),
                pl.col("trips_2024_bin_order").alias("level_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

    return (
        pl.concat([week_summary, trip_summary], how="diagonal_relaxed")
        .with_columns(
            (
                pl.col("n_reobserved_2025") / pl.col("n_cards_2024")
            ).alias("share_reobserved_2025")
        )
        .select(
            [
                "dimension",
                "dimension_label",
                "dimension_order",
                "activity_level",
                "level_order",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards_2024",
                "n_reobserved_2025",
                "share_reobserved_2025",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["dimension_order", "level_order", "payment_group"])
        .collect()
    )


def prepare_valid_card_panel(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return (
        add_payment_group(
            lf.filter(
                (pl.col("target_conflict_flag") == 0)
                & (pl.col("n_tipo_pago_observed") == 1)
                & (pl.col("n_viajes") > 0)
                & pl.col("is_qr").is_in([0, 1])
                & pl.col("share_trips_2025").is_not_null()
            )
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_viajes") * pl.col("share_trips_2025"))
            .round()
            .cast(pl.Int64)
            .alias("n_trips_2025")
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Int64) - pl.col("n_trips_2025")).alias(
                "n_trips_2024"
            )
        )
        .with_columns(
            (
                (pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0)
                & (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0)
            ).alias("is_recurrent")
        )
    )


def active_weeks_by_year_from_trip_paths(
    trip_paths: list[Path],
) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    if not trip_paths:
        raise ValueError("Se requiere al menos un archivo semanal de viajes.")

    weekly_presence = []
    for path in trip_paths:
        week_label = path.stem.replace("viajes_con_te_calculado_", "")
        year = int(week_label.split("-")[0])
        weekly_presence.append(
            pl.scan_parquet(path)
            .select(pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"))
            .unique()
            .with_columns(pl.lit(year).cast(pl.Int16).alias("year"))
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(weekly_presence)
        .group_by("id_tarjeta")
        .agg(
            [
                (pl.col("year") == 2024).sum().alias("n_active_weeks_2024"),
                (pl.col("year") == 2025).sum().alias("n_active_weeks_2025"),
            ]
        )
    )


def card_universe_coverage_summary(
    universe_specs: list[tuple[str, str, int, pl.LazyFrame]],
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    broad_lf = min(universe_specs, key=lambda spec: spec[2])[3]
    broad_totals = broad_lf.group_by("payment_group").agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards_broad"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips_broad"),
        ]
    )

    frames = []
    for universe, universe_label, universe_order, universe_lf in universe_specs:
        frames.append(
            universe_lf.group_by("payment_group")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
                ]
            )
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                    pl.lit(universe_label).alias("universe_label"),
                    pl.lit(universe_order).alias("universe_order"),
                ]
            )
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(frames)
        .join(broad_totals, on="payment_group", how="left")
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards_broad")).alias(
                    "share_of_broad_cards"
                ),
                (pl.col("n_trips") / pl.col("n_trips_broad")).alias(
                    "share_of_broad_trips"
                ),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "universe_order",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                "share_of_broad_cards",
                "n_trips",
                "share_of_broad_trips",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["universe_order", "payment_group"])
        .collect()
    )


def intensity_universe_summary_for_lazyframes(
    universe_specs: list[tuple[str, str, int, pl.LazyFrame]],
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    frames = []
    for universe, universe_label, universe_order, universe_lf in universe_specs:
        frames.append(
            universe_lf.with_columns(
                (
                    pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Float64)
                    / pl.col("n_semanas_activas").cast(pl.Float64)
                ).alias("trips_per_active_week")
            )
            .group_by("payment_group")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_trips"),
                    pl.col("n_dias_activos").median().alias("median_active_days"),
                    pl.col("n_semanas_activas").median().alias("median_active_weeks"),
                    pl.col("trips_per_active_week")
                    .median()
                    .alias("median_trips_per_active_week"),
                ]
            )
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                    pl.lit(universe_label).alias("universe_label"),
                    pl.lit(universe_order).alias("universe_order"),
                ]
            )
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(frames)
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "universe_order",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                "median_trips",
                "median_active_days",
                "median_active_weeks",
                "median_trips_per_active_week",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["universe_order", "payment_group"])
        .collect()
    )


def intensity_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    aggs = [pl.len().alias("n_cards")]
    for var, _ in INTENSITY_VARS:
        aggs.extend(
            [
                pl.col(var).mean().alias(f"{var}__mean"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.10).alias(f"{var}__p10"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.25).alias(f"{var}__p25"),
                pl.col(var).median().alias(f"{var}__median"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.75).alias(f"{var}__p75"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.90).alias(f"{var}__p90"),
            ]
        )
    metric_cols = [
        col
        for var, _ in INTENSITY_VARS
        for col in [
            f"{var}__mean",
            f"{var}__p10",
            f"{var}__p25",
            f"{var}__median",
            f"{var}__p75",
            f"{var}__p90",
        ]
    ]

    return (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(aggs)
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(["universe", "universe_label", "payment_group", "n_cards", *metric_cols])
        .sort("payment_group")
        .collect()
    )


def intensity_summary_long(summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame):
        wide = summary_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        wide = summary_df.copy()

    rows = []
    for _, row in wide.iterrows():
        for var, label in INTENSITY_VARS:
            rows.append(
                {
                    "universe": row["universe"],
                    "universe_label": row["universe_label"],
                    "payment_group": row["payment_group"],
                    "variable": var,
                    "label": label,
                    "n_cards": row["n_cards"],
                    "mean": row[f"{var}__mean"],
                    "p10": row[f"{var}__p10"],
                    "p25": row[f"{var}__p25"],
                    "median": row[f"{var}__median"],
                    "p75": row[f"{var}__p75"],
                    "p90": row[f"{var}__p90"],
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

            f"{var}__mean",
            f"{var}__p25",

    return (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .group_by("payment_group")

def regularity_summary_long(summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:

        wide = summary_df.copy()

                    "variable": var,

def regularity_sample_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    *,
    sample_per_group: int = REGULARITY_SAMPLE_PER_GROUP,
    seed: int = 20260611,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .select(["payment_group", "n_viajes", "n_dias_activos"])
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_viajes") / pl.col("n_dias_activos")).alias("viajes_por_dia_activo"))
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    samples = []
    for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
        group_df = df[df["payment_group"] == group]
        n = min(sample_per_group, len(group_df))
        samples.append(group_df.sample(n=n, random_state=seed))
    return pd.concat(samples, ignore_index=True)


def regularity_thresholds_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    lf_regularity = add_payment_group(lf).with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_viajes") / pl.col("n_dias_activos")).alias("viajes_por_dia_activo")
    )

    return (
        lf_regularity.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                (pl.col("n_dias_activos") <= 3).cast(pl.Float64).mean().alias("share_days_le_3"),
                (pl.col("n_dias_activos") <= 5).cast(pl.Float64).mean().alias("share_days_le_5"),
                (pl.col("n_dias_activos") >= 10).cast(pl.Float64).mean().alias("share_days_ge_10"),
                (pl.col("n_dias_activos") >= 20).cast(pl.Float64).mean().alias("share_days_ge_20"),
                (pl.col("viajes_por_dia_activo") >= 3)
                .cast(pl.Float64)
                .mean()
                .alias("share_trips_per_active_day_ge_3"),
                (pl.col("viajes_por_dia_activo") >= 4)
                .cast(pl.Float64)
                .mean()
                .alias("share_trips_per_active_day_ge_4"),
                pl.col("n_dias_activos").median().alias("median_active_days"),
                pl.col("viajes_por_dia_activo").median().alias("median_trips_per_active_day"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                "median_active_days",
                "median_trips_per_active_day",
                *REGULARITY_THRESHOLD_LABELS.keys(),
            ]
        )
        .sort("payment_group")
        .collect()
    )


def regularity_ecdf_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lf_regularity = add_payment_group(lf).with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_viajes") / pl.col("n_dias_activos")).alias("viajes_por_dia_activo")
    )

    frames = []
    for metric, metric_label, bin_width in REGULARITY_ECDF_METRICS:
        if bin_width is None:
            value_expr = pl.col(metric).cast(pl.Float64)
        else:
            value_expr = ((pl.col(metric) / bin_width).round(0) * bin_width).cast(pl.Float64)

        metric_counts = (
            lf_regularity.select(["payment_group", metric])
            .with_columns(value_expr.alias("value"))
            .filter(pl.col("value").is_not_null())
            .group_by(["payment_group", "value"])
            .agg(pl.len().alias("n"))
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        metric_counts["universe"] = universe
        metric_counts["universe_label"] = label
        metric_counts["metric"] = metric
        metric_counts["metric_label"] = metric_label
        metric_counts = metric_counts.sort_values(["payment_group", "value"])
        metric_counts["cum_n"] = metric_counts.groupby("payment_group")["n"].cumsum()
        metric_counts["total_n"] = metric_counts.groupby("payment_group")["n"].transform("sum")
        metric_counts["cum_share"] = metric_counts["cum_n"] / metric_counts["total_n"]
        frames.append(metric_counts)

    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)


def timing_summary_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    aggs = [pl.len().alias("n_cards")]
    for source_col, alias, _ in TIMING_DENSITY_VARS:
        aggs.extend(
            [
                pl.col(source_col).mean().alias(f"{alias}__mean"),
                pl.col(source_col).quantile(0.25).alias(f"{alias}__p25"),
                pl.col(source_col).median().alias(f"{alias}__median"),
                pl.col(source_col).quantile(0.75).alias(f"{alias}__p75"),
            ]
        )
    for var, _ in TIMING_SHARE_VARS:
        aggs.extend(
            [
                pl.col(var).mean().alias(f"{var}__mean"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.25).alias(f"{var}__p25"),
                pl.col(var).median().alias(f"{var}__median"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.75).alias(f"{var}__p75"),
            ]
        )

    metric_cols = [
        col
        for _, alias, _ in TIMING_DENSITY_VARS
        for col in [f"{alias}__mean", f"{alias}__p25", f"{alias}__median", f"{alias}__p75"]
    ] + [
        col
        for var, _ in TIMING_SHARE_VARS
        for col in [f"{var}__mean", f"{var}__p25", f"{var}__median", f"{var}__p75"]
    ]

    return (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(aggs)
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(["universe", "universe_label", "payment_group", "n_cards", *metric_cols])
        .sort("payment_group")
        .collect()
    )


def timing_density_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
    *,
    bin_width: float = 0.25,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lf_payment = add_payment_group(lf)
    frames = []
    for source_col, alias, metric_label in TIMING_DENSITY_VARS:
        density = (
            lf_payment.select(["payment_group", pl.col(source_col).cast(pl.Float64).alias("hour")])
            .filter(pl.col("hour").is_not_null() & pl.col("hour").is_between(0, 23, closed="both"))
            .with_columns(((pl.col("hour") / bin_width).round(0) * bin_width).alias("hour_bin"))
            .group_by(["payment_group", "hour_bin"])
            .agg(pl.len().alias("n"))
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        density["universe"] = universe
        density["universe_label"] = label
        density["metric"] = alias
        density["metric_label"] = metric_label
        density["total_n"] = density.groupby("payment_group")["n"].transform("sum")
        density["share"] = density["n"] / density["total_n"]
        density["density"] = density["share"] / bin_width
        frames.append(density)

    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)


def decimal_hour_from_datetime(expr: pl.Expr) -> pl.Expr:
    return (
        expr.dt.hour().cast(pl.Float64)
        + expr.dt.minute().cast(pl.Float64) / 60.0
        + expr.dt.second().cast(pl.Float64) / 3600.0
    )


def trip_hourly_distribution_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    trip_paths: list[Path],
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
            ]
        )
    )
    trips_lf = (
        pl.scan_parquet([str(path) for path in trip_paths])
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                pl.col("tiempo_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Datetime, strict=False).alias("start_ts"),
                pl.col("tiempo_fin_viaje")
                .cast(pl.Utf8)
                .str.strptime(pl.Datetime, strict=False)
                .alias("end_ts"),
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
    )

    frames = []
    for ts_col, metric, metric_label in [
        ("start_ts", "start_hour", "Hora de inicio"),
        ("end_ts", "end_hour", "Hora de fin"),
    ]:
        frames.append(
            trips_lf.select(
                [
                    "payment_group",
                    decimal_hour_from_datetime(pl.col(ts_col)).alias("hour"),
                ]
            )
            .filter((pl.col("hour").is_not_null()) & (pl.col("hour") >= 0) & (pl.col("hour") < 24))
            .with_columns(pl.col("hour").floor().cast(pl.Int8).alias("hour_int"))
            .group_by(["payment_group", "hour_int"])
            .agg(pl.len().alias("n_trips"))
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(metric).alias("metric"),
                    pl.lit(metric_label).alias("metric_label"),
                ]
            )
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(frames)
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.col("n_trips").sum().over(["metric", "payment_group"]).alias("total_trips"),
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_trips") / pl.col("total_trips")).alias("trip_share"))
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "metric",
                "metric_label",
                "payment_group",
                "hour_int",
                "n_trips",
                "total_trips",
                "trip_share",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["metric", "payment_group", "hour_int"])
        .collect()
    )


def trip_hourly_card_exposure_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    trip_paths: list[Path],
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
            ]
        )
    )
    trips_lf = (
        pl.scan_parquet([str(path) for path in trip_paths])
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                pl.col("tiempo_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Datetime, strict=False).alias("start_ts"),
                pl.col("tiempo_fin_viaje")
                .cast(pl.Utf8)
                .str.strptime(pl.Datetime, strict=False)
                .alias("end_ts"),
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
    )
    denominators = (
        trips_lf.select(["payment_group", "id_tarjeta"])
        .unique()
        .group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards_observed"))
    )

    frames = []
    for ts_col, metric, metric_label in [
        ("start_ts", "start_hour", "Hora de inicio"),
        ("end_ts", "end_hour", "Hora de fin"),
    ]:
        frames.append(
            trips_lf.select(
                [
                    "payment_group",
                    "id_tarjeta",
                    decimal_hour_from_datetime(pl.col(ts_col)).alias("hour"),
                ]
            )
            .filter((pl.col("hour").is_not_null()) & (pl.col("hour") >= 0) & (pl.col("hour") < 24))
            .with_columns(pl.col("hour").floor().cast(pl.Int8).alias("hour_int"))
            .select(["payment_group", "id_tarjeta", "hour_int"])
            .unique()
            .group_by(["payment_group", "hour_int"])
            .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards_with_trip"))
            .join(denominators, on="payment_group", how="left")
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(metric).alias("metric"),
                    pl.lit(metric_label).alias("metric_label"),
                ]
            )
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(frames)
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_cards_with_trip") / pl.col("n_cards_observed")).alias("card_share"))
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "metric",
                "metric_label",
                "payment_group",
                "hour_int",
                "n_cards_with_trip",
                "n_cards_observed",
                "card_share",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["metric", "payment_group", "hour_int"])
        .collect()
    )


def trip_weekday_distribution_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    trip_paths: list[Path],
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
            ]
        )
    )
    trips_lf = (
        pl.scan_parquet([str(path) for path in trip_paths])
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                pl.col("fecha").cast(pl.Date).alias("trip_date"),
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .filter(pl.col("trip_date").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(pl.col("trip_date").dt.weekday().cast(pl.Int8).alias("weekday"))
    )
    denominators = (
        trips_lf.select(["payment_group", "id_tarjeta"])
        .unique()
        .group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards_observed"))
    )
    trip_share = (
        trips_lf.group_by(["payment_group", "weekday"])
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n_trips"))
        .with_columns(pl.col("n_trips").sum().over("payment_group").alias("total_trips"))
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_trips") / pl.col("total_trips")).alias("value"))
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit("trip_share").alias("metric"),
                pl.lit("Share de viajes").alias("metric_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(["payment_group", "weekday", "metric", "metric_label", "value", "n_trips", "total_trips"])
    )
    card_exposure = (
        trips_lf.select(["payment_group", "id_tarjeta", "weekday"])
        .unique()
        .group_by(["payment_group", "weekday"])
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards_with_trip"))
        .join(denominators, on="payment_group", how="left")
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_cards_with_trip") / pl.col("n_cards_observed")).alias("value"))
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit("card_exposure").alias("metric"),
                pl.lit("Tarjetas activas").alias("metric_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "payment_group",
                "weekday",
                "metric",
                "metric_label",
                "value",
                "n_cards_with_trip",
                "n_cards_observed",
            ]
        )
    )

    return (
        pl.concat([trip_share, card_exposure], how="diagonal")
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.col("weekday")
                .replace_strict(WEEKDAY_LABELS, return_dtype=pl.Utf8)
                .alias("weekday_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "metric",
                "metric_label",
                "payment_group",
                "weekday",
                "weekday_label",
                "value",
                "n_trips",
                "total_trips",
                "n_cards_with_trip",
                "n_cards_observed",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["metric", "payment_group", "weekday"])
        .collect()
    )

    if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame):
        wide = summary_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        wide = summary_df.copy()

    rows = []
    for _, row in wide.iterrows():
        for var, label in TIMING_SHARE_VARS:
            rows.append(
                {
                    "universe": row["universe"],
                    "universe_label": row["universe_label"],
                    "payment_group": row["payment_group"],
                    "variable": var,
                    "label": label,
                    "n_cards": row["n_cards"],
                    "mean": row[f"{var}__mean"],
                    "p25": row[f"{var}__p25"],
                    "median": row[f"{var}__median"],
                    "p75": row[f"{var}__p75"],
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def modal_percentile_diagnostic_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    aggs = [pl.len().alias("n_cards")]
    percentile_specs = [
        (0.10, "p10"),
        (0.25, "p25"),
        (0.50, "p50"),
        (0.75, "p75"),
        (0.90, "p90"),
        (0.95, "p95"),
        (0.99, "p99"),
    ]

    for var, _ in MODAL_PROFILE_VARS:
        aggs.extend(
            [
                pl.col(var).eq(0).mean().alias(f"{var}__share_zero"),
                pl.col(var).eq(1).mean().alias(f"{var}__share_one"),
            ]
        )
        for quantile, suffix in percentile_specs:
            aggs.append(pl.col(var).quantile(quantile).alias(f"{var}__{suffix}"))

    metric_cols = [
        col
        for var, _ in MODAL_PROFILE_VARS
        for col in [
            f"{var}__share_zero",
            f"{var}__p10",
            f"{var}__p25",
            f"{var}__p50",
            f"{var}__p75",
            f"{var}__p90",
            f"{var}__p95",
            f"{var}__p99",
            f"{var}__share_one",
        ]
    ]

    return (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(aggs)
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(["universe", "universe_label", "payment_group", "n_cards", *metric_cols])
        .sort("payment_group")
        .collect()
    )

def modal_thresholds_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus").ge(0.80).mean().alias("solo_bus_ge_80"),
                pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro").ge(0.80).mean().alias("solo_metro_ge_80"),
                pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus").eq(0).mean().alias("metro_bus_eq_0"),
                pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus").ge(0.20).mean().alias("metro_bus_ge_20"),
                pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus").ge(0.50).mean().alias("metro_bus_ge_50"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                *MODAL_THRESHOLD_LABELS.keys(),
            ]
        )
        .sort("payment_group")
        .collect()
    )


def modal_share_pivot(summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame, metric: str = "mean") -> pd.DataFrame:
    plot_df = modal_summary_long(summary_df)
    label_order = [label for _, label in MODAL_PROFILE_VARS]
    pivot = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="label",
            columns="payment_group",
            values=metric,
            aggfunc="first",
        )
        .reindex(index=label_order, columns=PAYMENT_ORDER)
    )
    return pivot


def territorial_macrozone_expr(prefix: str) -> pl.Expr:
    expr = None
    for suffix, label in MACROZONE_LEVELS:
        cond = pl.col(f"{prefix}{suffix}") == 1
        if expr is None:
            expr = pl.when(cond).then(pl.lit(label))
        else:
            expr = expr.when(cond).then(pl.lit(label))
    return expr.otherwise(None)


def territorial_coverage_support_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    total_cards = int(lf.select(pl.len()).collect().item())
    global_qr_share = float(lf.select(pl.col("is_qr").mean()).collect().item())
    rows = []

    for geography_key, geography_label, zone_col, _ in TERRITORIAL_GEOGRAPHIES:
        by_payment = (
            add_payment_group(lf)
            .group_by("payment_group")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards_group"),
                    pl.col(zone_col).is_not_null().sum().alias("n_cards_with_zone"),
                    pl.col(zone_col).is_not_null().mean().alias("coverage_rate"),
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
            .set_index("payment_group")
        )

        support = (
            lf.select(pl.col(zone_col).cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zone_id"))
            .filter(pl.col("zone_id").is_not_null())
            .group_by("zone_id")
            .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards_zone"))
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )

        cards_with_zone = int(support["n_cards_zone"].sum()) if not support.empty else 0
        n_zones = int(len(support))
        qr_with_zone = int(by_payment.loc["QR", "n_cards_with_zone"]) if "QR" in by_payment.index else 0
        qr_share_with_zone = qr_with_zone / cards_with_zone if cards_with_zone > 0 else np.nan

        rows.append(
            {
                "universe": universe,
                "universe_label": label,
                "geography": geography_label,
                "zone_col": zone_col,
                "n_cards_total": total_cards,
                "global_qr_share": global_qr_share,
                "n_cards_with_zone": cards_with_zone,
                "coverage_total": cards_with_zone / total_cards if total_cards > 0 else np.nan,
                "coverage_bip": float(by_payment.loc["BIP", "coverage_rate"]) if "BIP" in by_payment.index else np.nan,
                "coverage_qr": float(by_payment.loc["QR", "coverage_rate"]) if "QR" in by_payment.index else np.nan,
                "coverage_gap_qr_minus_bip_pp": (
                    float(by_payment.loc["QR", "coverage_rate"] - by_payment.loc["BIP", "coverage_rate"]) * 100
                    if {"BIP", "QR"}.issubset(by_payment.index)
                    else np.nan
                ),
                "qr_share_with_zone": qr_share_with_zone,
                "qr_share_with_zone_minus_global_pp": (
                    (qr_share_with_zone - global_qr_share) * 100
                    if not np.isnan(qr_share_with_zone)
                    else np.nan
                ),
                "n_zones_used": n_zones,
                "cards_per_zone_p25": float(support["n_cards_zone"].quantile(0.25)) if n_zones > 0 else np.nan,
                "cards_per_zone_p50": float(support["n_cards_zone"].quantile(0.50)) if n_zones > 0 else np.nan,
                "cards_per_zone_p75": float(support["n_cards_zone"].quantile(0.75)) if n_zones > 0 else np.nan,
                "cards_per_zone_p90": float(support["n_cards_zone"].quantile(0.90)) if n_zones > 0 else np.nan,
                "cards_per_zone_max": int(support["n_cards_zone"].max()) if n_zones > 0 else 0,
            }
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def territorial_support_thresholds_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []

    for geography_key, geography_label, zone_col, _ in TERRITORIAL_GEOGRAPHIES:
        support = (
            lf.select(pl.col(zone_col).cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zone_id"))
            .filter(pl.col("zone_id").is_not_null())
            .group_by("zone_id")
            .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards_zone"))
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )

        if support.empty:
            for threshold in TERRITORIAL_SUPPORT_THRESHOLDS:
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "universe": universe,
                        "universe_label": label,
                        "geography": geography_label,
                        "support_threshold": threshold,
                        "n_zones_retained": 0,
                        "share_zones_retained": np.nan,
                        "n_cards_retained": 0,
                        "share_cards_retained": np.nan,
                    }
                )
            continue

        n_zones_total = int(len(support))
        n_cards_total = int(support["n_cards_zone"].sum())
        for threshold in TERRITORIAL_SUPPORT_THRESHOLDS:
            retained = support[support["n_cards_zone"] >= threshold]
            n_zones_retained = int(len(retained))
            n_cards_retained = int(retained["n_cards_zone"].sum()) if n_zones_retained > 0 else 0
            rows.append(
                {
                    "universe": universe,
                    "universe_label": label,
                    "geography": geography_label,
                    "support_threshold": threshold,
                    "n_zones_retained": n_zones_retained,
                    "share_zones_retained": n_zones_retained / n_zones_total,
                    "n_cards_retained": n_cards_retained,
                    "share_cards_retained": n_cards_retained / n_cards_total,
                }
            )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def territorial_macrozone_summary_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    frames = []

    for geography_key, geography_label, _, macro_prefix in TERRITORIAL_GEOGRAPHIES:
        macro_expr = territorial_macrozone_expr(macro_prefix).alias("macrozone")
        lf_geo = lf.with_columns(macro_expr).filter(pl.col("macrozone").is_not_null())
        global_qr_share_geo = float(lf_geo.select(pl.col("is_qr").mean()).collect().item())

        df_geo = (
            lf_geo.group_by("macrozone")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
                ]
            )
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                    pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                    pl.lit(geography_key).alias("geography_key"),
                    pl.lit(geography_label).alias("geography"),
                    pl.lit(global_qr_share_geo).alias("global_qr_share_geo"),
                ]
            )
            .with_columns(
                [
                    (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards").sum()).alias("card_share_geography"),
                    ((pl.col("qr_share") - pl.col("global_qr_share_geo")) * 100).alias("delta_pp"),
                ]
            )
            .select(
                [
                    "universe",
                    "universe_label",
                    "geography_key",
                    "geography",
                    "macrozone",
                    "n_cards",
                    "card_share_geography",
                    "qr_share",
                    "global_qr_share_geo",
                    "delta_pp",
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        frames.append(df_geo)

    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)


def load_zona777_geometries(path: Path = ZONAS777_SHP) -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    gdf = gpd.read_file(path)
    if "ZONA777" not in gdf.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"El shapefile no contiene columna ZONA777: {path}")

    keep_cols = [col for col in ["ZONA777", "NMACROZONA", "MACROZONA", "COMUNA", "geometry"] if col in gdf.columns]
    gdf = gdf[keep_cols].copy()
    gdf["zone_id"] = pd.to_numeric(gdf["ZONA777"], errors="coerce")
    gdf = gdf.dropna(subset=["zone_id"]).copy()
    gdf["zone_id"] = gdf["zone_id"].astype("int64")

    if gdf.crs is None:
        gdf = gdf.set_crs("EPSG:32719", allow_override=True)

    # Algunas versiones del shape contienen piezas repetidas por zona.
    return gdf.dissolve(by="zone_id", as_index=False)


def territorial_zone_summary_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    *,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
    geography_key: str,
    geography_label: str,
    zone_col: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lf_zone = (
        lf.select(
            [
                pl.col(zone_col).cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zone_id"),
                pl.col("is_qr").cast(pl.Int64).alias("is_qr"),
            ]
        )
        .filter(pl.col("zone_id").is_not_null())
    )
    global_qr_share_geo = float(lf_zone.select(pl.col("is_qr").mean()).collect().item())

    return (
        lf_zone.group_by("zone_id")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("is_qr").sum().alias("n_qr"),
                pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share_zona"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(geography_key).alias("geography_key"),
                pl.lit(geography_label).alias("geography"),
                pl.lit(zone_col).alias("zone_col"),
                pl.lit(global_qr_share_geo).alias("global_qr_share_geo"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(((pl.col("qr_share_zona") - pl.col("global_qr_share_geo")) * 100).alias("delta_pp"))
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "geography_key",
                "geography",
                "zone_col",
                "zone_id",
                "n_cards",
                "n_qr",
                "qr_share_zona",
                "global_qr_share_geo",
                "delta_pp",
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )


def prepare_zone_map_data(
    zone_summary: pd.DataFrame,
    geometries: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
) -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    gdf = geometries.merge(zone_summary, on="zone_id", how="left")
    gdf["n_cards"] = gdf["n_cards"].fillna(0).astype("int64")
    gdf["n_qr"] = gdf["n_qr"].fillna(0).astype("int64")
    return gdf


def build_residence_origin_zone_comparison(
    residence_summary: pd.DataFrame,
    origin_summary: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    residence = residence_summary[
        ["zone_id", "n_cards", "n_qr", "qr_share_zona", "global_qr_share_geo", "delta_pp"]
    ].rename(
        columns={
            "n_cards": "n_cards_residence",
            "n_qr": "n_qr_residence",
            "qr_share_zona": "qr_share_residence",
            "global_qr_share_geo": "global_qr_share_residence",
            "delta_pp": "delta_residence_pp",
        }
    )
    origin = origin_summary[
        ["zone_id", "n_cards", "n_qr", "qr_share_zona", "global_qr_share_geo", "delta_pp"]
    ].rename(
        columns={
            "n_cards": "n_cards_origin",
            "n_qr": "n_qr_origin",
            "qr_share_zona": "qr_share_origin",
            "global_qr_share_geo": "global_qr_share_origin",
            "delta_pp": "delta_origin_pp",
        }
    )

    comparison = residence.merge(origin, on="zone_id", how="inner")
    comparison["support_min"] = comparison[["n_cards_residence", "n_cards_origin"]].min(axis=1)
    comparison["support_total"] = comparison["n_cards_residence"] + comparison["n_cards_origin"]
    comparison["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"] = (
        comparison["delta_origin_pp"] - comparison["delta_residence_pp"]
    )
    comparison["abs_origin_minus_residence_pp"] = comparison["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].abs()
    return comparison


def prepare_residence_origin_difference_map_data(
    comparison_df: pd.DataFrame,
    geometries: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
) -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    keep_cols = [
        "zone_id",
        "n_cards_residence",
        "n_qr_residence",
        "qr_share_residence",
        "global_qr_share_residence",
        "n_cards_origin",
        "n_qr_origin",
        "qr_share_origin",
        "global_qr_share_origin",
        "support_min",
        "delta_residence_pp",
        "delta_origin_pp",
        "delta_origin_minus_residence_pp",
        "abs_origin_minus_residence_pp",
    ]
    gdf = geometries.merge(comparison_df[keep_cols], on="zone_id", how="left")
    for col in ["n_cards_residence", "n_qr_residence", "n_cards_origin", "n_qr_origin", "support_min"]:
        gdf[col] = gdf[col].fillna(0).astype("int64")
    return gdf


def plot_composition_donuts(
    composition_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.5, 5.2),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(composition_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = composition_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = composition_df.copy()

    plot_df = plot_df.set_index("payment_group").loc[PAYMENT_ORDER]
    panels = [
        ("card_share", "n_cards", "Tarjetas"),
        ("trip_share", "n_trips", "Viajes"),
    ]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    wedgeprops = {"width": 0.40, "edgecolor": FIG_BG, "linewidth": 4}

    for ax, (share_col, count_col, panel_title) in zip(axes, panels):
        ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
        shares = plot_df[share_col].to_numpy()
        counts = plot_df[count_col].to_numpy()
        colors = [PAYMENT_COLORS[group] for group in PAYMENT_ORDER]

        wedges, _ = ax.pie(
            shares,
            startangle=90,
            counterclock=False,
            colors=colors,
            wedgeprops=wedgeprops,
        )

        for wedge, group, share, count in zip(wedges, PAYMENT_ORDER, shares, counts):
            angle = np.deg2rad((wedge.theta1 + wedge.theta2) / 2)
            x, y = 0.76 * np.cos(angle), 0.76 * np.sin(angle)
            ax.text(
                x,
                y,
                f"{group}\n{share:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="center",
                color="white",
                fontsize=10.5,
                fontweight="bold",
            )
            x2, y2 = 1.22 * np.cos(angle), 1.22 * np.sin(angle)
            ax.text(
                x2,
                y2,
                f"n={fmt_int(count)}",
                ha="center",
                va="center",
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                fontsize=9,
                fontweight="bold",
            )

        ax.text(
            0,
            0,
            panel_title,
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=13,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
        )
        ax.set_title(f"Share de {panel_title.lower()}", pad=12, color=TEXT_COLOR)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98, subtitle_gap=0.08)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.05, right=0.95, top=0.78, bottom=0.07, wspace=0.28)
    plt.show()


def plot_first_seen_month_distribution(
    first_seen_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (7.2, 4.4),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(first_seen_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = first_seen_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = first_seen_df.copy()

    plot_df["first_seen_month"] = pd.to_datetime(plot_df["first_seen_month"])
    month_order = sorted(plot_df["first_seen_month"].dropna().unique())
    month_labels = [pd.Timestamp(month).strftime("%Y-%m") for month in month_order]
    x = np.arange(len(month_order))
    width = 0.34

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

    for idx, group in enumerate(PAYMENT_ORDER):
        group_df = (
            plot_df.loc[plot_df["payment_group"] == group]
            .set_index("first_seen_month")
            .reindex(month_order)
        )
        values = group_df["share_within_payment"].fillna(0).to_numpy()
        counts = group_df["n_cards"].fillna(0).to_numpy()
        offset = (idx - 0.5) * width
        bars = ax.bar(
            x + offset,
            values,
            width=width,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
            alpha=0.92,
            label=group,
        )
        for bar, value, count in zip(bars, values, counts):
            if count <= 0:
                continue
            ax.text(
                bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
                bar.get_height() + 0.012,
                f"{value:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=9,
                fontweight="bold",
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
            )

    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(month_labels)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    ax.set_ylim(0, min(1.0, max(0.12, plot_df["share_within_payment"].max() * 1.18)))
    ax.set_xlabel("Mes de primera aparicion observada")
    ax.set_ylabel("% dentro de cada grupo de pago")
    ax.legend(loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.18), ncol=2)
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.11, right=0.98, top=0.82, bottom=0.25)
    plt.show()

def plot_adjusted_activity_summary(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.0, 4.4),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = summary_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = summary_df.copy()

    metrics = (
        plot_df[["metric", "metric_label", "metric_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("metric_order")
    )
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(metrics), figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    if len(metrics) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    y_positions = {"BIP": 1, "QR": 0}
    y_labels = ["QR", "BIP"]

    for ax, (_, metric_row) in zip(axes, metrics.iterrows()):
        metric_df = plot_df.loc[plot_df["metric"] == metric_row["metric"]].copy()
        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            row = metric_df.loc[metric_df["payment_group"] == group]
            if row.empty:
                continue
            row = row.iloc[0]
            y = y_positions[group]
            ax.hlines(
                y,
                row["p25"],
                row["p75"],
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                linewidth=4,
                alpha=0.35,
            )
            ax.scatter(
                row["median"],
                y,
                s=70,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                edgecolor="white",
                linewidth=1.0,
                zorder=3,
                label=group,
            )
            ax.text(
                row["median"],
                y + 0.12,
                f"{row['median']:.1f}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=9,
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
            )

        ax.set_title(metric_row["metric_label"], color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
        ax.set_yticklabels(y_labels)
        ax.set_ylim(-0.45, 1.45)
        ax.set_xlabel("Valor por tarjeta")

    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.07, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.18, wspace=0.35)
    plt.show()
