        recurrent,
        height=0.56,
        color=COHORT_COLORS["both_years"],
        label="Reobservadas",
    )
    ax.barh(
        y,
        only_2025,
        left=recurrent,
        height=0.56,
        color=COHORT_COLORS["only_2025"],
        label="Solo 2025",
    )
    for idx, (recurrent_value, only_value) in enumerate(zip(recurrent, only_2025)):
        ax.text(
            recurrent_value / 2,
            idx,
            f"{recurrent_value:.1%}",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=8.8,
            color="white",
            fontweight="bold",
        )
        ax.text(
            recurrent_value + only_value / 2,
            idx,
            f"{only_value:.1%}",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=8.8,
            color="white",
            fontweight="bold",
        )
    ax.set_title("Viajes observados en 2025", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels(PAYMENT_ORDER)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    ax.legend(loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.17), ncol=2, frameon=False)

    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.06, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.24, wspace=0.38)
    plt.show()


def plot_card_continuity_by_2024_activity(
    continuity_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str = "Continuidad observada segun actividad en 2024",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.0, 4.4),
) -> None:
    plot_df = (
        continuity_df.to_pandas()
        if isinstance(continuity_df, pl.DataFrame)
        else continuity_df.copy()
    )
    dimensions = (
        plot_df[["dimension", "dimension_label", "dimension_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("dimension_order")
    )

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(dimensions), figsize=figsize, sharey=True)
    axes = np.atleast_1d(axes)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, dimension_row in zip(axes, dimensions.itertuples(index=False)):
        panel = plot_df.loc[plot_df["dimension"].eq(dimension_row.dimension)].copy()
        level_order = (
            panel[["activity_level", "level_order"]]
            .drop_duplicates()
            .sort_values("level_order")
        )
        x_labels = level_order["activity_level"].tolist()
        x = np.arange(len(x_labels))

        for payment_group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            values = (
                panel.loc[panel["payment_group"].eq(payment_group)]
                .set_index("activity_level")
                .reindex(x_labels)["share_reobserved_2025"]
                .to_numpy(dtype=float)
            )
            ax.plot(
                x,
                values,
                marker="o",
                markersize=5.5,
                linewidth=2.1,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
                label=payment_group,
            )

        ax.set_title(dimension_row.dimension_label, color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels)
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Tarjetas reobservadas en 2025")
    axes[-1].legend(loc="lower right", frameon=False)
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.09, right=0.98, top=0.80, bottom=0.16, wspace=0.22)
    plt.show()


def plot_intensity_dumbbells(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    metric: str = "median",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.5, 5.6),
) -> None:
    plot_df = intensity_summary_long(summary_df)
    label_order = [label for _, label in INTENSITY_VARS]
    pivot = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="label",
            columns="payment_group",
            values=metric,
            aggfunc="first",
        )
        .reindex(index=label_order, columns=PAYMENT_ORDER)
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y_positions = np.arange(len(label_order))[::-1] * 1.25
    max_value = float(np.nanmax(pivot.to_numpy()))
    label_pad = max(max_value * 0.05, 0.7)

    for idx, label in enumerate(label_order):
        y = y_positions[idx]
        bip_value = pivot.loc[label, "BIP"]
        qr_value = pivot.loc[label, "QR"]
        same_value = np.isclose(bip_value, qr_value)

        ax.plot(
            [bip_value, qr_value],
            [y, y],
            color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
            linewidth=4.0,
            alpha=0.72,
            zorder=1,
        )
        ax.scatter(
            [bip_value, qr_value],
            [y + (0.06 if same_value else 0), y - (0.06 if same_value else 0)],
            s=98,
            color=[PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
            edgecolor="white",
            linewidth=1.4,
            zorder=3,
        )

        for value, group, y_shift in [
            (bip_value, "BIP", 0.20 if same_value else 0.18),
            (qr_value, "QR", -0.22 if same_value else 0.18),
        ]:
            ax.text(
                value,
                y + y_shift,
                f"{value:.0f}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom" if y_shift > 0 else "top",
                fontsize=9.5,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                fontweight="bold",
            )

    ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
    ax.set_yticklabels(label_order)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.50, y_positions.max() + 0.70)
    ax.set_xlim(left=0, right=max_value + label_pad)
    ax.set_xlabel("Valor mediano por tarjeta")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    ax.legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(98),
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.28),
        ncol=2,
    )

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.965)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.16, right=0.96, top=0.78, bottom=0.22)
    plt.show()


def plot_intensity_by_universe(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.8, 7.0),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = summary_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = summary_df.copy()

    metric_specs = [
        ("median_trips", "Viajes"),
        ("median_active_days", "Dias activos"),
        ("median_active_weeks", "Semanas activas"),
        ("median_trips_per_active_week", "Viajes por semana activa"),
    ]
    universe_order = (
        plot_df[["universe_label", "universe_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("universe_order")["universe_label"]
        .tolist()
    )
    y_positions = np.arange(len(universe_order))[::-1]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, (metric, panel_title) in zip(axes.flat, metric_specs):
        panel_max = float(plot_df[metric].max())
        x_margin = max(panel_max * 0.08, 0.45)

        for y, universe_label in zip(y_positions, universe_order):
            rows = plot_df.loc[plot_df["universe_label"] == universe_label].set_index(
                "payment_group"
            )
            bip_value = float(rows.loc["BIP", metric])
            qr_value = float(rows.loc["QR", metric])
            same_value = np.isclose(bip_value, qr_value)

            ax.hlines(
                y,
                min(bip_value, qr_value),
                max(bip_value, qr_value),
                color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
                linewidth=4.0,
                alpha=0.72,
                zorder=1,
            )
            ax.scatter(
                [bip_value, qr_value],
                [y + (0.05 if same_value else 0), y - (0.05 if same_value else 0)],
                s=82,
                color=[PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
                edgecolor="white",
                linewidth=1.2,
                zorder=3,
            )
            for value, group, y_shift in [
                (bip_value, "BIP", 0.17),
                (qr_value, "QR", -0.20 if same_value else 0.17),
            ]:
                ax.text(
                    value,
                    y + y_shift,
                    f"{value:.1f}",
                    ha="center",
                    va="bottom" if y_shift > 0 else "top",
                    fontsize=8.8,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    fontweight="bold",
                )

        ax.set_title(panel_title, color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
        ax.set_yticklabels(universe_order)
        ax.set_xlim(0, panel_max + x_margin)
        ax.set_ylim(-0.45, y_positions.max() + 0.45)
        ax.set_xlabel("Mediana por tarjeta")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    handles = payment_legend_handles(80)
    fig.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.01),
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.84, bottom=0.12, wspace=0.24, hspace=0.42)
    plt.show()


def plot_intensity_percentile_profiles(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.5, 4.6),
) -> None:
    plot_df = intensity_summary_long(summary_df)
    percentiles = [
        ("p25", "p25"),
        ("median", "p50"),
        ("p75", "p75"),
        ("p90", "p90"),
    ]
    label_order = [label for _, label in INTENSITY_VARS]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(label_order), figsize=figsize, sharey=False)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    if len(label_order) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    for ax, label in zip(axes, label_order):
        panel = plot_df[plot_df["label"] == label]
        x = np.arange(len(percentiles))

        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            values = [
                panel.loc[panel["payment_group"] == group, col].iloc[0]
                for col, _ in percentiles
            ]
            ax.plot(
                x,
                values,
                marker="o",
                linewidth=2.8,
                markersize=7.5,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                label=group,
            )

            label_x_shift = -4 if group == "BIP" else 4
            label_ha = "right" if group == "BIP" else "left"
            for xx, value in zip(x, values):
                ax.annotate(
                    f"{value:.0f}",
                    xy=(xx, value),
                    xytext=(label_x_shift, 8),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha=label_ha,
                    va="bottom",
                    fontsize=8.5,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    fontweight="bold",
                )

        ax.set_title(label, fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=12)
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels([name for _, name in percentiles])
        ax.set_xlabel("Percentil")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Valor por tarjeta")
    fig.legend(handles=payment_legend_handles(80), loc="lower center", ncol=2, frameon=False)

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98, subtitle_gap=0.08)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.07, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.24, wspace=0.25)
    plt.show()


def plot_regularidad_ecdf(
    ecdf_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.5, 5.2),
) -> None:
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize, sharey=True)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, (metric, metric_label, _) in zip(axes, REGULARITY_ECDF_METRICS):
        panel = ecdf_df[ecdf_df["metric"] == metric].copy()
        x_max_candidates = panel.loc[panel["cum_share"] <= 0.995, "value"]
        x_max = x_max_candidates.max() if len(x_max_candidates) else panel["value"].max()
        x_max = max(float(x_max) * 1.05, 1.0)

        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            group_df = panel[panel["payment_group"] == group].sort_values("value")
            ax.step(
                group_df["value"],
                group_df["cum_share"],
                where="post",
                linewidth=2.7,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                label=group,
            )

            median_row = group_df[group_df["cum_share"] >= 0.5].head(1)
            if not median_row.empty:
                median_x = float(median_row["value"].iloc[0])
                ax.scatter(
                    [median_x],
                    [0.5],
                    s=62,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    edgecolor=AX_BG,
                    linewidth=1.2,
                    zorder=4,
                )
                ax.annotate(
                    f"mediana {median_x:.1f}",
                    xy=(median_x, 0.5),
                    xytext=(8, 8 if group == "BIP" else -14),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha="left",
                    va="center",
                    fontsize=8.5,
                    fontweight="bold",
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                )

        ax.axhline(0.5, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=1.0, linestyle="--", alpha=0.8)
        ax.axhline(0.75, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=0.9, linestyle=":", alpha=0.75)
        ax.text(
            x_max,
            0.505,
            "50%",
            ha="right",
            va="bottom",
            fontsize=8.5,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
        )
        ax.text(
            x_max,
            0.755,
            "75%",
            ha="right",
            va="bottom",
            fontsize=8.5,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
        )

        ax.set_title(metric_label, fontsize=12.5, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=12)
        ax.set_xlabel(metric_label)
        ax.set_xlim(0, x_max)
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1.01)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1))
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Share acumulado de tarjetas")
    axes[1].legend(handles=payment_legend_handles(70), loc="lower right", frameon=False)
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.76, bottom=0.18, wspace=0.16)
    plt.show()


def plot_regularidad_ecdf_universe_comparison(
    ecdf_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    universe_labels: tuple[str, str] = ("Amplio", "Repetido"),
    title: str = "Regularidad: universo amplio versus repetido",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.8, 7.8),
) -> None:
    plot_df = ecdf_df.loc[
        ecdf_df["universe_label"].isin(universe_labels)
    ].copy()
    if plot_df.empty:
        raise ValueError("No hay datos para los universos solicitados.")

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        len(REGULARITY_ECDF_METRICS),
        len(universe_labels),
        figsize=figsize,
        sharey=True,
        squeeze=False,
    )
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for row_idx, (metric, metric_label, _) in enumerate(REGULARITY_ECDF_METRICS):
        metric_df = plot_df.loc[plot_df["metric"].eq(metric)].copy()
        x_max_candidates = metric_df.loc[metric_df["cum_share"] <= 0.995, "value"]
        x_max = (
            x_max_candidates.max()
            if len(x_max_candidates)
            else metric_df["value"].max()
        )
        x_max = max(float(x_max) * 1.05, 1.0)

        for col_idx, universe_label in enumerate(universe_labels):
            ax = axes[row_idx, col_idx]
            panel = metric_df.loc[
                metric_df["universe_label"].eq(universe_label)
            ]

            for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
                group_df = panel.loc[
                    panel["payment_group"].eq(group)
                ].sort_values("value")
                ax.step(
                    group_df["value"],
                    group_df["cum_share"],
                    where="post",
                    linewidth=2.5,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                )

                median_row = group_df.loc[group_df["cum_share"] >= 0.5].head(1)
                if not median_row.empty:
                    median_x = float(median_row["value"].iloc[0])
                    ax.scatter(
                        [median_x],
                        [0.5],
                        s=55,
                        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                        edgecolor=AX_BG,
                        linewidth=1.1,
                        zorder=4,
                    )
                    ax.annotate(
                        f"{median_x:.1f}",
                        xy=(median_x, 0.5),
                        xytext=(7, 8 if group == "BIP" else -13),
                        textcoords="offset points",
                        ha="left",
                        va="center",
                        fontsize=8.3,
                        fontweight="bold",
                        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    )

            ax.axhline(
                0.5,
                color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
                linewidth=1.0,
                linestyle="--",
                alpha=0.8,
            )
            ax.axhline(
                0.75,
                color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
                linewidth=0.9,
                linestyle=":",
                alpha=0.75,
            )
            if row_idx == 0:
                ax.set_title(
                    universe_label,
                    fontsize=12.5,
                    fontweight="bold",
                    color=TEXT_COLOR,
                    pad=10,
                )
            ax.set_xlabel(metric_label)
            ax.set_xlim(0, x_max)
            ax.set_ylim(0, 1.01)
            ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1))
            style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

        axes[row_idx, 0].set_ylabel(
            f"{metric_label}\nShare acumulado de tarjetas"
        )

    fig.legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(70),
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.985)
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.10,
        right=0.98,
        top=0.88,
        bottom=0.12,
        wspace=0.14,
        hspace=0.34,
    )
    plt.show()

def plot_active_days_per_week_conditioned(
    profile_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    universe_labels: tuple[str, str] = ("Amplio", "Repetido"),
    title: str = "Dias activos por semana, a igual numero de semanas activas",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.2, 4.6),
) -> None:
    plot_df = profile_df.to_pandas() if isinstance(profile_df, pl.DataFrame) else profile_df.copy()
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(universe_labels), figsize=figsize, sharey=True)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    if len(universe_labels) == 1:
        axes = np.array([axes])

    for ax, universe_label in zip(axes, universe_labels):
        panel = plot_df.loc[plot_df["universe_label"].eq(universe_label)].copy()
        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            group_df = panel.loc[panel["payment_group"].eq(group)].sort_values(
                "n_active_weeks_observed"
            )
            ax.plot(
                group_df["n_active_weeks_observed"],
                group_df["median_active_days_per_week"],
                marker="o",
                markersize=6.5,
                linewidth=2.5,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                label=group,
            )

        ax.set_title(
            universe_label,
            fontsize=12.3,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=10,
        )
        ax.set_xticks(range(1, 9))
        ax.set_xlim(0.7, 8.3)
        ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
        ax.set_xlabel("Numero total de semanas activas observadas")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Mediana de dias activos por semana activa")
    fig.legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(75),
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.01),
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.09, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.16)
    plt.show()


def plot_regularity_threshold_heatmap(
    threshold_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.5, 3.8),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(threshold_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = threshold_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = threshold_df.copy()

    share_cols = list(REGULARITY_THRESHOLD_LABELS.keys())
    heat = (
        plot_df.set_index("payment_group")
        .reindex(PAYMENT_ORDER)[share_cols]
        .rename(columns=REGULARITY_THRESHOLD_LABELS)
    )
    annot = heat.applymap(lambda value: f"{value:.1%}")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    cmap = sns.light_palette(PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], as_cmap=True)
    sns.heatmap(
        heat,
        annot=annot,
        fmt="",
        cmap=cmap,
        vmin=0,
        vmax=max(0.60, float(np.nanmax(heat.to_numpy()))),
        cbar=False,
        linewidths=1.5,
        linecolor=FIG_BG,
        ax=ax,
        annot_kws={"fontsize": 9, "fontweight": "bold", "color": TEXT_COLOR},
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    ax.set_xticklabels(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0, ha="center", fontsize=8.8)
    ax.set_yticklabels(ax.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=10.5)
    ax.tick_params(length=0)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
    for side in ["top", "right", "left", "bottom"]:
        ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98, subtitle_gap=0.08)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.10, right=0.98, top=0.72, bottom=0.16)
    plt.show()


def plot_timing_density(
    density_df: pd.DataFrame,
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.5, 5.0),
) -> None:
    summary = summary_df.to_pandas() if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame) else summary_df.copy()
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize, sharey=False)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    hour_grid = np.round(np.arange(0, 23.0001, 0.25), 2)

    for ax, (_, alias, metric_label) in zip(axes, TIMING_DENSITY_VARS):
        panel = density_df[density_df["metric"] == alias].copy()
        panel_y_max = float(panel["density"].max())
        label_y_positions = {
            "BIP": panel_y_max * 1.18,
            "QR": panel_y_max * 1.07,
        }
        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            group_density = (
                panel.loc[panel["payment_group"] == group, ["hour_bin", "density"]]
                .set_index("hour_bin")
                .reindex(hour_grid, fill_value=0)
                .reset_index()
            )
            x = group_density["hour_bin"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            y = group_density["density"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            ax.fill_between(
                x,
                y,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                alpha=0.18,
                linewidth=0,
                zorder=1,
            )
            ax.plot(
                x,
                y,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                linewidth=2.5,
                label=group,
                zorder=2,
            )

            median_value = float(
                summary.loc[summary["payment_group"] == group, f"{alias}__median"].iloc[0]
            )
            label_shift = -8 if group == "BIP" else 8
            label_ha = "right" if group == "BIP" else "left"
            ax.axvline(
                median_value,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                linewidth=1.5,
                linestyle="--",
                alpha=0.80,
                zorder=3,
            )
            ax.annotate(
                f"mediana {median_value:.1f}",
                xy=(median_value, label_y_positions[group]),
                xytext=(label_shift, 0),
                textcoords="offset points",
                ha=label_ha,
                va="center",
                fontsize=8.5,
                fontweight="bold",
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
            )

        ax.set_title(metric_label, fontsize=12.5, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=12)
        ax.set_xlabel("Hora del dia")
        ax.set_xlim(0, 23)
        ax.set_ylim(0, panel_y_max * 1.30)
        ax.set_xticks([0, 6, 12, 18, 23])
        ax.set_xticklabels(["00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00", "23:00"])
        ax.set_ylabel("Densidad relativa")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    axes[1].legend(handles=payment_legend_handles(70), loc="upper left", frameon=False)
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.98,
        0.035,
        "Nota: distribuciones agregadas en bins de 15 minutos; calculadas con todas las tarjetas.",
        ha="right",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.5,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.76, bottom=0.18, wspace=0.18)
    plt.show()


def plot_trip_hourly_distribution(
    hourly_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (12.0, 5.0),
) -> None:
    plot_df = hourly_df.to_pandas() if isinstance(hourly_df, pl.DataFrame) else hourly_df.copy()
    hours = np.arange(24)
    bar_width = 0.34
    offsets = {"BIP": -bar_width / 2, "QR": bar_width / 2}
    global_ymax = max(0.01, float(plot_df["trip_share"].max()) * 1.28)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize, sharey=True)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, metric in zip(axes, ["start_hour", "end_hour"]):
        panel = plot_df[plot_df["metric"] == metric].copy()
        metric_label = panel["metric_label"].iloc[0]

        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            group_series = (
                panel.loc[panel["payment_group"] == group, ["hour_int", "trip_share"]]
                .set_index("hour_int")
                .reindex(hours, fill_value=0.0)["trip_share"]
                .to_numpy(dtype=float)
            )
            ax.bar(
                hours + 0.5 + offsets[group],
                group_series,
                width=bar_width,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                alpha=0.34,
                edgecolor="none",
                zorder=1,
            )
            smoothed = gaussian_filter1d(group_series, sigma=1.0, mode="nearest")
            ax.plot(
                hours + 0.5,
                smoothed,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                linewidth=2.8,
                solid_capstyle="round",
                label=group,
                zorder=3,
            )

        ax.set_title(metric_label, fontsize=12.5, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=12)
        ax.set_xlabel("Hora del dia")
        ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
        ax.set_ylim(0, global_ymax)
        ax.set_xticks([0, 6, 12, 18, 24])
        ax.set_xticklabels(["00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00", "24:00"])
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0, decimals=0))
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Share de viajes dentro del grupo")
    axes[1].legend(handles=payment_legend_handles(70), loc="upper left", frameon=False)
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.98,
        0.035,
        (
            "Nota: barras = share de viajes por hora dentro de cada grupo; curva = suavizado. "
            "Calculado a nivel viaje con parquets disponibles, restringido al universo de tarjetas del panel base."
        ),
        ha="right",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.5,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.76, bottom=0.18, wspace=0.18)
    plt.show()

def plot_timing_share_dumbbells(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    metric: str = "mean",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.5, 5.2),
) -> None:
    plot_df = timing_share_summary_long(summary_df)
    label_order = [label for _, label in TIMING_SHARE_VARS]
    pivot = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="label",
            columns="payment_group",
            values=metric,
            aggfunc="first",
        )
        .reindex(index=label_order, columns=PAYMENT_ORDER)
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y_positions = np.arange(len(label_order))[::-1]
    max_value = float(np.nanmax(pivot.to_numpy()))
    x_max = min(1.0, max(0.35, max_value + 0.18))
    diff_label_x = x_max * 0.98

    for y, label in zip(y_positions, label_order):
        bip_value = float(pivot.loc[label, "BIP"])
        qr_value = float(pivot.loc[label, "QR"])
        ax.hlines(
            y,
            min(bip_value, qr_value),
            max(bip_value, qr_value),
            color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
            linewidth=3,
            alpha=0.8,
            zorder=1,
        )

        for group, value in [("BIP", bip_value), ("QR", qr_value)]:
            ax.scatter(
                value,
                y,
                s=82,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                edgecolor=AX_BG,
                linewidth=1.1,
                zorder=3,
            )
            label_shift = 12 if group == "BIP" else -14
            label_va = "bottom" if group == "BIP" else "top"
            ax.annotate(
                f"{value:.1%}",
                xy=(value, y),
                xytext=(0, label_shift),
                textcoords="offset points",
                ha="center",
                va=label_va,
                fontsize=8.8,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                fontweight="bold",
            )

        diff_pp = (qr_value - bip_value) * 100
        ax.text(
            diff_label_x,
            y,
            f"QR - BIP: {diff_pp:+.1f} pp",
            ha="right",
            va="center",
            fontsize=9,
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            fontweight="bold",
        )

    ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
    ax.set_yticklabels(label_order)
    ax.set_xlabel("Share promedio por tarjeta")
    ax.set_xlim(0, x_max)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.45, len(label_order) - 0.55)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1))
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    ax.legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(70),
        loc="upper right",
        bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 1.12),
        ncol=2,
    )

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.23, right=0.96, top=0.76, bottom=0.16)
    plt.show()

def plot_modal_profile_butterfly(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    metric: str = "mean",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.3, 5.2),
) -> None:
    label_order = [label for _, label in MODAL_PROFILE_VARS]
    pivot = modal_share_pivot(summary_df, metric=metric)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y_positions = np.arange(len(label_order))[::-1]
    max_value = float(np.nanmax(pivot.to_numpy()))
    x_max = max(0.35, max_value + 0.08)

    for y, label in zip(y_positions, label_order):
        bip_value = float(pivot.loc[label, "BIP"])
        qr_value = float(pivot.loc[label, "QR"])

        ax.barh(
            y,
            -bip_value,
            height=0.44,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
            alpha=0.88,
            zorder=2,
        )
        ax.barh(
            y,
            qr_value,
            height=0.44,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            alpha=0.88,
            zorder=2,
        )

        ax.text(
            -bip_value - x_max * 0.03,
            y,
            f"{bip_value:.1%}",
            ha="right",
            va="center",
            fontsize=9,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
            fontweight="bold",
        )
        ax.text(
            qr_value + x_max * 0.03,
            y,
            f"{qr_value:.1%}",
            ha="left",
            va="center",
            fontsize=9,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            fontweight="bold",
        )

    ax.axvline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.9)
    ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
    ax.set_yticklabels(label_order)
    ax.set_xlim(-x_max, x_max)
    tick_values = np.linspace(-x_max, x_max, 7)
    ax.set_xticks(tick_values)
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{abs(v):.0%}" for v in tick_values])
    ax.set_xlabel("Share promedio por tarjeta")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    ax.text(
        0.25,
        1.03,
        "BIP",
        transform=ax.transAxes,
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
        fontsize=11,
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
        fontweight="bold",
    )
    ax.text(
        0.75,
        1.03,
        "QR",
        transform=ax.transAxes,
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
        fontsize=11,
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
        fontweight="bold",
    )

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.98,
        0.04,
        "Nota: cada lado muestra el share promedio por tarjeta; 'Metro + bus' refiere a viajes con ambos modos en el mismo viaje.",
        ha="right",
        va="center",

def _waffle_counts(values: np.ndarray, n_tiles: int = 100) -> np.ndarray:
    scaled = values / values.sum() * n_tiles
    base = np.floor(scaled).astype(int)
    remainder = n_tiles - base.sum()
    if remainder > 0:
        order = np.argsort(-(scaled - base))
        base[order[:remainder]] += 1
    elif remainder < 0:
        order = np.argsort(scaled - base)
        for idx in order[:abs(remainder)]:
            if base[idx] > 0:
                base[idx] -= 1
    return base


def plot_modal_profile_waffle(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    metric: str = "mean",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.6, 5.8),
    n_cols: int = 10,
) -> None:
    label_order = [label for _, label in MODAL_PROFILE_VARS]
    pivot = modal_share_pivot(summary_df, metric=metric)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, group in zip(axes, PAYMENT_ORDER):
        shares = pivot[group].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        shares = shares / shares.sum()
        counts = _waffle_counts(shares, n_tiles=100)
        tiles = []
        for label, count in zip(label_order, counts):
            tiles.extend([label] * count)

        for idx, label in enumerate(tiles):
            row = idx // n_cols
            col = idx % n_cols
            x = col
            y = 9 - row
            ax.add_patch(
                Rectangle(
                    (x, y),
                    0.92,
                    0.92,
                    facecolor=MODAL_COLORS[label],
                    edgecolor=AX_BG,
                    linewidth=1.2,
                )
            )

        ax.set_xlim(0, n_cols)
        ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.set_yticks([])
        ax.set_title(group, fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=8)
        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        for spine in ax.spines.values():
            spine.set_visible(False)

        y_text = -0.65
        for label in label_order:
            value = float(pivot.loc[label, group])
            ax.text(
                n_cols / 2,
                y_text,
                f"{label}: {value:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="top",
                fontsize=9,
                color=MODAL_COLORS[label],
                fontweight="bold",
            )
            y_text -= 0.55

    legend_handles = [
        plt.Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            marker="s",
            linestyle="",
            markerfacecolor=MODAL_COLORS[label],
            markeredgecolor=MODAL_COLORS[label],
            markersize=10,
            label=label,
        )
        for label in label_order
    ]

    fig.legend(
        handles=legend_handles,
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.05),
        ncol=3,
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.98,
        0.02,
        "Cada panel usa 100 celdas y muestra la composicion modal promedio dentro de cada grupo.",
        ha="right",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.5,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.10, right=0.90, top=0.78, bottom=0.24, wspace=0.18)
    plt.show()

def plot_regularidad_raincloud(
    sample_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.5, 5.8),
    seed: int = 20260611,
) -> None:
    plot_df = sample_df.copy()
    metrics = [
        ("n_dias_activos", "Dias activos", "Regularidad temporal"),
        ("viajes_por_dia_activo", "Viajes por dia activo", "Concentracion de uso"),
    ]
    positions = {"BIP": 1.15, "QR": 0.0}
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    dark_bg = "#050505"
    dark_text = "#B9B9B9"
    dark_grid = "#E6E6E6"
    dark_colors = {"BIP": "#00A6A6", "QR": "#FF8C1A"}

    def draw_density(ax, values: np.ndarray, *, y_base: float, color: str, x_grid: np.ndarray, jitter: float) -> None:
        kde_values = values + rng.normal(0, jitter, size=len(values))
        kde_values = kde_values[(kde_values >= x_grid.min()) & (kde_values <= x_grid.max())]
        if len(np.unique(np.round(kde_values, 4))) < 2:
            return
        density = gaussian_kde(kde_values, bw_method=0.25)(x_grid)
        density = density / density.max() * 0.42
        ax.fill_between(x_grid, y_base, y_base + density, color=color, alpha=0.95, linewidth=0, zorder=2)

    def draw_dot_stack(
        ax,
        values: np.ndarray,
        *,
        y_base: float,
        color: str,
        x_min: float,
        x_max: float,
        bins: int,
    ) -> None:
        counts, edges = np.histogram(values, bins=bins, range=(x_min, x_max))
        centers = (edges[:-1] + edges[1:]) / 2
        max_stack = 8
        dot_step = 0.036
        scale = max(1, counts.max() / max_stack)
        xs = []
        ys = []
        for center, count, left, right in zip(centers, counts, edges[:-1], edges[1:]):
            n_dots = min(max_stack, int(np.ceil(count / scale)))
            if n_dots <= 0:
                continue
            bin_width = right - left
            xs.extend(center + rng.uniform(-0.18, 0.18, size=n_dots) * bin_width)
            ys.extend(y_base - 0.06 - np.arange(n_dots) * dot_step)
        ax.scatter(xs, ys, s=12, color=color, alpha=0.62, edgecolors="none", zorder=3)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize, sharey=True)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(dark_bg)

    for ax, (metric, xlabel, panel_title) in zip(axes, metrics):
        metric_values = plot_df[metric].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
        x_min = 0.0
        x_max = max(np.nanpercentile(metric_values, 99.5) * 1.05, 1.0)
        x_grid = np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 320)
        bins = 70 if metric == "n_dias_activos" else 64
        jitter = 0.08 if metric == "n_dias_activos" else 0.018

        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            color = dark_colors[group]
            values = (
                plot_df.loc[plot_df["payment_group"] == group, metric]
                .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
                .dropna()
                .to_numpy()
            )
            values = values[(values >= x_min) & (values <= x_max)]
            y = positions[group]

            ax.hlines(y, x_min, x_max, color=dark_grid, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.65, zorder=1)
            draw_density(ax, values, y_base=y, color=color, x_grid=x_grid, jitter=jitter)
            draw_dot_stack(ax, values, y_base=y, color=color, x_min=x_min, x_max=x_max, bins=bins)

            median = np.nanmedian(values)
            ax.scatter(
                median,
                y,
                s=72,
                color=color,
                edgecolor=dark_bg,
                linewidth=1.3,
                zorder=5,
            )
            ax.vlines(median, y - 0.42, y + 0.43, color=color, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7, zorder=2)
            ax.text(
                median,
                y + 0.49,
                f"mediana {median:.1f}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=8.8,
                color=color,
                fontweight="bold",
            )

        ax.set_title(panel_title, fontsize=13.5, fontweight="bold", color="white", pad=14)
        ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
        ax.set_xlim(0, x_max)
        ax.set_ylim(-0.58, 1.72)
        ax.set_yticks([positions[group] for group in PAYMENT_ORDER])
        ax.set_yticklabels(PAYMENT_ORDER)
        ax.set_facecolor(dark_bg)
        ax.grid(axis="x", color=dark_grid, alpha=0.45, linewidth=1.0)
        ax.grid(axis="y", color=dark_grid, alpha=0.45, linewidth=1.0)
        for side in ["top", "right", "left", "bottom"]:
            ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)
        ax.tick_params(axis="x", colors=dark_text)
        ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors=dark_text, labelsize=11)
        ax.xaxis.label.set_color(dark_text)
        ax.yaxis.label.set_color(dark_text)

    fig.suptitle(title, fontsize=17, fontweight="bold", color="white", y=0.98)
    if subtitle is not None:
        fig.text(0.5, 0.91, subtitle, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, color=dark_text)
    fig.text(
        0.98,
        0.045,
        "Nota: muestra balanceada BIP/QR; ejes recortados al p99.5 para evitar compresion por colas.",
        ha="right",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.5,
        color="#7F7F7F",
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.16, wspace=0.16)
    plt.show()

    label_order = [label for _, label in REGULARITY_VARS]
    pivot = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="label",
            columns="payment_group",
            values=metric,
            aggfunc="first",
        )
        .reindex(index=label_order, columns=PAYMENT_ORDER)
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y_positions = np.arange(len(label_order))[::-1]

    for idx, label in enumerate(label_order):
        y = y_positions[idx]
        bip_value = pivot.loc[label, "BIP"]
        qr_value = pivot.loc[label, "QR"]
        diff = qr_value - bip_value
        same_value = np.isclose(bip_value, qr_value)

        ax.plot(
            [bip_value, qr_value],
            [y, y],
            color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
            linewidth=3.3,
            alpha=0.72,
            zorder=1,
        )
        ax.scatter(
            [bip_value, qr_value],
            [y + (0.04 if same_value else 0), y - (0.04 if same_value else 0)],
            s=78,
            color=[PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
            edgecolor="white",
            linewidth=1.2,
            zorder=3,
        )

        ax.text(
            1.02,
            y,
            f"QR - BIP: {diff:+.3f}",
            ha="left",
            va="center",
            fontsize=8.7,
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            fontweight="bold",
        )

    ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
    ax.set_yticklabels(label_order)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1.17)
    ax.set_xlabel("Mediana por tarjeta")
    ax.legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(78),
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.12),
        ncol=2,
    )
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.24, right=0.84, top=0.88, bottom=0.12)
    plt.show()

def plot_cohort_stacked_bars(

) -> None:
