```{python}
        plot_df = cohort_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = cohort_df.copy()

    pivot = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="payment_group",
            columns="presence_cohort",
            values="card_share_within_payment",
            aggfunc="sum",
            fill_value=0,
        )
        .reindex(index=PAYMENT_ORDER, columns=COHORT_ORDER, fill_value=0)
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y = np.arange(len(PAYMENT_ORDER))
    left = np.zeros(len(PAYMENT_ORDER))

    for cohort in COHORT_ORDER:
        values = pivot[cohort].to_numpy()
        ax.barh(
            y,
            values,
            left=left,
            height=0.58,
            color=COHORT_COLORS[cohort],
            label=COHORT_LABELS[cohort],
            edgecolor=FIG_BG,
            linewidth=1.2,
        )
        for idx, value in enumerate(values):
            if value >= 0.07:
                ax.text(
                    left[idx] + value / 2,
                    y[idx],
                    f"{value:.1%}",
                    ha="center",
                    va="center",
                    fontsize=9,
                    color="white",
                    fontweight="bold",
                )
        left += values

    qr_only_2025 = pivot.loc["QR", "only_2025"]
    bip_only_2025 = pivot.loc["BIP", "only_2025"]
    diff = qr_only_2025 - bip_only_2025

    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels(PAYMENT_ORDER)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    ax.set_xlabel("Share de tarjetas dentro de cada grupo de pago")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            f"Share solo 2025: QR {qr_only_2025:.1%} vs BIP {bip_only_2025:.1%} "
            f"(diferencia {diff:+.1%})."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98, subtitle_gap=0.08)
    ax.legend(
        loc="upper center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.38),
        ncol=3,
        title="Cohorte observada",
        title_fontsize=9.5,
        fontsize=9.5,
        handlelength=1.8,
        columnspacing=1.2,
    )

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.12, right=0.96, top=0.62, bottom=0.20)
    plt.show()


def plot_payment_composition_by_presence_trajectory(
    cohort_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str = "Composicion por medio de pago dentro de cada trayectoria",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.2, 4.8),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(cohort_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = cohort_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = cohort_df.copy()

    counts = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="presence_cohort",
            columns="payment_group",
            values="n_cards",
            aggfunc="sum",
            fill_value=0,
        )
        .reindex(index=COHORT_ORDER, columns=PAYMENT_ORDER, fill_value=0)
    )
    shares = counts.div(counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y = np.arange(len(COHORT_ORDER))
    left = np.zeros(len(COHORT_ORDER))

    for payment_group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
        values = shares[payment_group].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        ax.barh(
            y,
            values,
            left=left,
            height=0.58,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
            label=payment_group,
            edgecolor=FIG_BG,
            linewidth=1.2,
        )
        for idx, value in enumerate(values):
            ax.text(
                left[idx] + value / 2,
                y[idx],
                f"{value:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="center",
                fontsize=9.2,
                color="white",
                fontweight="bold",
            )
        left += values

    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels([COHORT_LABELS[cohort] for cohort in COHORT_ORDER])
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    ax.set_xlabel("Porcentaje de tarjetas dentro de cada trayectoria")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    ax.legend(
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.02),
        ncol=2,
        title="Medio de pago",
        title_fontsize=9.5,
        fontsize=9.5,
    )

    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.97)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.17, right=0.97, top=0.74, bottom=0.16)
    plt.show()


def plot_territorial_macrozone_sanity(
    macro_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (12.8, 5.8),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(macro_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = macro_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = macro_df.copy()

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize, sharex=True)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    x_max = max(0.30, max(plot_df["qr_share"].max(), plot_df["global_qr_share_geo"].max()) * 1.62)
    geography_order = [label for _, label, _, _ in TERRITORIAL_GEOGRAPHIES]

    for ax, geography_label in zip(axes, geography_order):
        geo_df = plot_df.loc[plot_df["geography"] == geography_label].copy()
        geo_df = geo_df.sort_values("qr_share", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
        y_positions = np.arange(len(geo_df))[::-1]
        ref_share = float(geo_df["global_qr_share_geo"].iloc[0])

        ax.axvline(ref_share, color=MUTED_TEXT, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.3, alpha=0.9, zorder=1)

        for y, (_, row) in zip(y_positions, geo_df.iterrows()):
            zone_share = row["qr_share"]
            delta_pp = row["delta_pp"]
            point_color = PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"] if delta_pp >= 0 else PAYMENT_LIGHT["BIP"]

            ax.plot(
                [ref_share, zone_share],
                [y, y],
                color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
                linewidth=3.3,
                alpha=0.78,
                zorder=2,
            )
            ax.scatter(
                zone_share,
                y,
                s=88,
                color=point_color,
                edgecolor="white",
                linewidth=1.1,
                zorder=3,
            )
            ax.text(
                min(zone_share + x_max * 0.015, x_max * 0.82),
                y,
                f"{zone_share:.1%} ({delta_pp:+.1f} pp)",
                ha="left",
                va="center",
                fontsize=8.5,
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
                fontweight="bold",
                clip_on=True,
            )

        ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
        ax.set_yticklabels(geo_df["macrozone"].tolist())
        ax.set_title(
            f"{geography_label}\nQR global observado: {ref_share:.1%}",
            fontsize=12.8,
            fontweight="bold",
            pad=12,
        )
        ax.set_xlim(0, x_max)
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
        ax.set_xlabel("Share QR dentro de la macrozona")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Macrozona")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("")
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.13, right=0.97, top=0.80, bottom=0.14, wspace=0.42)
    plt.show()


def plot_residence_choropleths(
    map_gdf: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    geography_name: str = "residencia",
    zone_col_label: str = "zona_hogar",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (12.8, 6.5),
) -> None:
    plot_gdf = map_gdf.copy()
    supported = plot_gdf.loc[plot_gdf["n_cards"] >= min_n].copy()
    low_support = plot_gdf.loc[plot_gdf["n_cards"] < min_n].copy()

    if supported.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No hay zonas con n_cards >= {min_n}")

    global_qr_share = float(supported["global_qr_share_geo"].dropna().iloc[0])
    share_vmax = max(global_qr_share * 1.85, float(supported["qr_share_zona"].quantile(0.98)))
    delta_abs = max(5.0, float(supported["delta_pp"].abs().quantile(0.98)))

    share_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
        "qr_share_residence",
        [AX_BG, "#F1C3B5", PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], "#8E3828"],
    )
    delta_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
        "qr_delta_residence",
        [PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], AX_BG, PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
    )
    share_norm = Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=share_vmax)
    delta_norm = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-delta_abs, vcenter=0, vmax=delta_abs)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    panels = [
        (
            "qr_share_zona",
            f"Share QR por zona de {geography_name}",
            share_cmap,
            share_norm,
            lambda cbar: cbar.ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0)),
            "Share QR",
        ),
        (
            "delta_pp",
            f"Diferencia vs QR global ({global_qr_share:.1%})",
            delta_cmap,
            delta_norm,
            None,
            "QR - global (pp)",
        ),
    ]

    for ax, (column, panel_title, cmap, norm, cbar_formatter, cbar_label) in zip(axes, panels):
        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

        if not low_support.empty:
            low_support.plot(
                ax=ax,
                color="#EFE8DB",
                edgecolor="#CFC6B8",
                linewidth=0.12,
                hatch="////",
                zorder=1,
            )

        supported.plot(
            ax=ax,
            column=column,
            cmap=cmap,
            norm=norm,
            edgecolor="#F8F3E8",
            linewidth=0.08,
            zorder=2,
        )

        ax.set_title(panel_title, fontsize=12.8, fontweight="bold", pad=12, color=TEXT_COLOR)
        ax.set_axis_off()

        sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap, norm=norm)
        sm.set_array([])
        cbar = fig.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, fraction=0.040, pad=0.015)
        cbar.outline.set_visible(False)
        cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=8.5, colors=MUTED_TEXT, length=0)
        cbar.set_label(cbar_label, color=MUTED_TEXT, fontsize=9)
        if cbar_formatter is not None:
            cbar_formatter(cbar)

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            f"Unidad: tarjetas con {zone_col_label}. Zonas con menos de {fmt_int(min_n)} tarjetas "
            "se muestran achuradas para evitar interpretar ruido local."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)

    hatch_handle = Patch(
        facecolor="#EFE8DB",
        edgecolor="#8E877A",
        hatch="////",
        label=f"< {fmt_int(min_n)} tarjetas",
    )
    fig.legend(
        handles=[hatch_handle],
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.075),
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=9.5,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.035,
        "Nota: colores calculados solo en zonas con soporte suficiente; zonas achuradas permanecen visibles como contexto territorial.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.6,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.03, right=0.96, top=0.78, bottom=0.14, wspace=0.08)
    plt.show()


def plot_residence_origin_delta_scatter(
    comparison_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int = TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N,
    title: str = "Residencia vs origen habitual: diferencia territorial QR",
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    label_top_n: int = 7,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (8.8, 7.2),
) -> None:
    plot_df = (
        comparison_df.loc[comparison_df["support_min"] >= min_n]
        .dropna(subset=["delta_residence_pp", "delta_origin_pp", "delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"])
        .copy()
    )
    if plot_df.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No hay zonas con soporte minimo >= {fmt_int(min_n)} en ambas geografias.")

    x_col = "delta_residence_pp"
    y_col = "delta_origin_pp"
    diff_col = "delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"

    xy_values = plot_df[[x_col, y_col]].to_numpy().ravel()
    lim = max(6.0, float(np.nanquantile(np.abs(xy_values), 0.99)) + 0.8)
    lim = float(np.ceil(lim))
    diff_abs = max(2.0, float(np.nanquantile(plot_df[diff_col].abs(), 0.98)))

    support_cap = max(float(plot_df["support_min"].quantile(0.95)), float(min_n))
    marker_sizes = 26 + 120 * np.sqrt(np.clip(plot_df["support_min"] / support_cap, 0, 1))

    delta_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
        "residence_origin_delta",
        [PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], AX_BG, PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
    )
    delta_norm = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-diff_abs, vcenter=0, vmax=diff_abs)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

    ax.axhline(0, color="#C8BFB1", linewidth=1.0, linestyle=":", zorder=1)
    ax.axvline(0, color="#C8BFB1", linewidth=1.0, linestyle=":", zorder=1)
    ax.plot([-lim, lim], [-lim, lim], color="#8E877A", linewidth=1.2, linestyle="--", zorder=2)

    scatter = ax.scatter(
        plot_df[x_col],
        plot_df[y_col],
        c=plot_df[diff_col],
        cmap=delta_cmap,
        norm=delta_norm,
        s=marker_sizes,
        alpha=0.82,
        edgecolors="#F8F3E8",
        linewidths=0.55,
        zorder=3,
    )

    label_df = plot_df.nlargest(label_top_n, "abs_origin_minus_residence_pp")
    for _, row in label_df.iterrows():
        ha = "left" if row[y_col] >= row[x_col] else "right"
        dx = 0.18 if ha == "left" else -0.18
        dy = 0.16
        if row[x_col] > lim - 1.0:
            ha = "right"
            dx = -0.18
        elif row[x_col] < -lim + 1.0:
            ha = "left"
            dx = 0.18
        va = "center"
        if row[y_col] > lim - 0.8:
            va = "top"
            dy = -0.18
        elif row[y_col] < -lim + 0.8:
            va = "bottom"
            dy = 0.18
        ax.text(
            np.clip(row[x_col] + dx, -lim + 0.35, lim - 0.35),
            np.clip(row[y_col] + dy, -lim + 0.35, lim - 0.35),
            f"Z{int(row['zone_id'])}",
            ha=ha,
            va=va,
            fontsize=8.5,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            zorder=4,
        )

    corner_kwargs = dict(fontsize=8.7, color=MUTED_TEXT, alpha=0.9)
    ax.text(-lim * 0.95, lim * 0.88, "Origen alto\nresidencia baja", ha="left", va="top", **corner_kwargs)
    ax.text(lim * 0.95, -lim * 0.88, "Residencia alta\norigen bajo", ha="right", va="bottom", **corner_kwargs)
    ax.text(lim * 0.95, lim * 0.88, "Alta en ambas", ha="right", va="top", **corner_kwargs)
    ax.text(-lim * 0.95, -lim * 0.88, "Baja en ambas", ha="left", va="bottom", **corner_kwargs)

    corr = float(plot_df[[x_col, y_col]].corr().iloc[0, 1])
    median_abs = float(plot_df["abs_origin_minus_residence_pp"].median())
    p90_abs = float(plot_df["abs_origin_minus_residence_pp"].quantile(0.90))
    summary_text = (
        f"zonas: {fmt_int(len(plot_df))}\n"
        f"r: {corr:.2f}\n"
        f"mediana |cambio|: {median_abs:.1f} pp\n"
        f"p90 |cambio|: {p90_abs:.1f} pp"
    )
    ax.text(
        0.035,
        0.045,
        summary_text,
        transform=ax.transAxes,
        ha="left",
        va="bottom",
        fontsize=8.8,
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.35", facecolor="#F8F3E8", edgecolor="#D8CFC0", linewidth=0.8),
    )

    ax.set_xlim(-lim, lim)
    ax.set_ylim(-lim, lim)
    ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:+.0f}"))
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda y, _: f"{y:+.0f}"))
    ax.set_xlabel("QR vs global por residencia (pp)")
    ax.set_ylabel("QR vs global por origen habitual (pp)")
    style_axis(ax)

    cbar = fig.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax, fraction=0.045, pad=0.03)
    cbar.outline.set_visible(False)
    cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=8.5, colors=MUTED_TEXT, length=0)
    cbar.set_label("Origen - residencia (pp)", color=MUTED_TEXT, fontsize=9)

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            f"Cada punto es una zona con al menos {fmt_int(min_n)} tarjetas en residencia y origen habitual. "
            "La diagonal indica que ambas geografias entregan el mismo delta QR."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.035,
        "Nota: eje X e Y son diferencias en puntos porcentuales contra el QR global de cada geografia; tamano del punto = soporte minimo entre ambas.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.5,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.12, right=0.88, top=0.80, bottom=0.13)
    plt.show()


def plot_residence_origin_difference_map(
    diff_gdf: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int = TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N,
    title: str = "Diferencia territorial: origen habitual menos residencia",
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.4, 7.0),
) -> None:
    plot_gdf = diff_gdf.copy()
    supported_mask = (
        (plot_gdf["support_min"] >= min_n)
        & plot_gdf["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].notna()
    )
    supported = plot_gdf.loc[supported_mask].copy()
    low_support = plot_gdf.loc[~supported_mask].copy()

    if supported.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No hay zonas con soporte minimo >= {fmt_int(min_n)} en ambas geografias.")

    delta_abs = max(2.0, float(supported["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].abs().quantile(0.98)))
    delta_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
        "origin_minus_residence_map",
        [PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], AX_BG, PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
    )
    delta_norm = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-delta_abs, vcenter=0, vmax=delta_abs)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

    if not low_support.empty:
        low_support.plot(
            ax=ax,
            color="#EFE8DB",
            edgecolor="#CFC6B8",
            linewidth=0.12,
            hatch="////",
            zorder=1,
        )

    supported.plot(
        ax=ax,
        column="delta_origin_minus_residence_pp",
        cmap=delta_cmap,
        norm=delta_norm,
        edgecolor="#F8F3E8",
        linewidth=0.08,
        zorder=2,
    )

    ax.set_axis_off()
    ax.set_title("Origen habitual - residencia (pp)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", pad=12, color=TEXT_COLOR)

    sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=delta_cmap, norm=delta_norm)
    sm.set_array([])
    cbar = fig.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, fraction=0.040, pad=0.015)
    cbar.outline.set_visible(False)
    cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=8.5, colors=MUTED_TEXT, length=0)
    cbar.set_label("Origen - residencia (pp)", color=MUTED_TEXT, fontsize=9)

    hatch_handle = Patch(
        facecolor="#EFE8DB",
        edgecolor="#8E877A",
        hatch="////",
        label=f"< {fmt_int(min_n)} tarjetas en alguna geografia",
    )
    fig.legend(
        handles=[hatch_handle],
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.075),
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=9.5,
    )

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            f"Rojo: QR pesa mas por origen habitual que por residencia; azul: QR pesa mas por residencia. "
            f"Solo se colorean zonas con al menos {fmt_int(min_n)} tarjetas en ambas geografias."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.035,
        "Nota: la metrica es (QR vs global por origen habitual) - (QR vs global por residencia), en puntos porcentuales.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.6,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.03, right=0.93, top=0.78, bottom=0.14)
    plt.show()


def _weighted_median(values: pd.Series, weights: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = values.notna() & weights.notna() & (weights > 0)
    if not valid.any():
        return np.nan

    sorted_df = (
        pd.DataFrame({"value": values[valid].to_numpy(), "weight": weights[valid].to_numpy()})
        .sort_values("value")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    cutoff = sorted_df["weight"].sum() / 2
    return float(sorted_df.loc[sorted_df["weight"].cumsum() >= cutoff, "value"].iloc[0])


def build_macrozone_residence_origin_change_summary(
    diff_gdf: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int = TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    supported = (
        diff_gdf.loc[
            (diff_gdf["support_min"] >= min_n)
            & diff_gdf["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].notna()
        ]
        .copy()
    )
    if supported.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No hay zonas con soporte minimo >= {fmt_int(min_n)} en ambas geografias.")

    macro_col = "MACROZONA" if "MACROZONA" in supported.columns else "NMACROZONA"
    supported["macrozone_label"] = supported[macro_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    numeric_macrozone = supported["macrozone_label"].str.replace(".", "", regex=False).str.isnumeric()
    supported.loc[numeric_macrozone, "macrozone_label"] = (
        "Macrozona " + supported.loc[numeric_macrozone, "macrozone_label"]
    )

    rows = []
    for macrozone, group in supported.groupby("macrozone_label", dropna=True):
        values = group["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"]
        weights = group["support_min"].astype(float)
        rows.append(
            {
                "macrozone": macrozone,
                "n_zones": int(len(group)),
                "support_min_sum": int(weights.sum()),
                "weighted_mean_delta_pp": float(np.average(values, weights=weights)),
                "weighted_median_delta_pp": _weighted_median(values, weights),
                "p25_delta_pp": float(values.quantile(0.25)),
                "p75_delta_pp": float(values.quantile(0.75)),
            }
        )

    return (
        pd.DataFrame(rows)
        .sort_values("weighted_mean_delta_pp")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )


def plot_macrozone_residence_origin_change(
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int = TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N,
    title: str = "Al cambiar de residencia a origen, que macrozonas ganan peso QR",
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.8, 5.6),
) -> None:
    plot_df = summary_df.copy().sort_values("weighted_mean_delta_pp")
    y = np.arange(len(plot_df))
    values = plot_df["weighted_mean_delta_pp"].to_numpy()
    medians = plot_df["weighted_median_delta_pp"].to_numpy()
    colors = np.where(values >= 0, PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"])
    edge_colors = np.where(values >= 0, "#9A3D2B", "#184B6C")
    max_abs = max(2.0, float(np.ceil(max(np.abs(values).max(), np.abs(medians).max()) + 0.8)))
    text_col_x = max_abs * 0.58

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

    bars = ax.barh(
        y,
        values,
        color=colors,
        edgecolor=edge_colors,
        linewidth=0.9,
        alpha=0.84,
        height=0.58,
    )
    ax.scatter(
        medians,
        y,
        s=78,
        facecolor=AX_BG,
        edgecolor=TEXT_COLOR,
        linewidth=1.5,
        zorder=4,
    )
    ax.axvline(0, color="#8E877A", linewidth=1.1, zorder=1)

    for bar, value, n_zones in zip(bars, values, plot_df["n_zones"]):
        zone_word = "zona" if int(n_zones) == 1 else "zonas"
        ax.text(
            text_col_x,
            bar.get_y() + bar.get_height() / 2,
            f"{value:+.1f} pp  ·  {fmt_int(n_zones)} {zone_word}",
            ha="left",
            va="center",
            fontsize=9.3,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"] if value >= 0 else PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
        )

    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels(plot_df["macrozone"], fontsize=11)
    ax.set_xlim(-max_abs, max_abs)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:+.0f}"))
    ax.set_xlabel("Origen habitual - residencia en delta QR (pp)")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    handles = [
        Patch(facecolor=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], edgecolor="#9A3D2B", label="QR pesa mas por origen"),
        Patch(facecolor=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], edgecolor="#184B6C", label="QR pesa mas por residencia"),
        plt.Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            marker="o",
            color="none",
            markerfacecolor=AX_BG,
            markeredgecolor=TEXT_COLOR,
            markeredgewidth=1.4,
            markersize=7.5,
            label="Mediana ponderada",
        ),
    ]
    ax.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="lower left",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0, 1.01),
        frameon=False,
        ncol=3,
        fontsize=9.3,
    )

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            "Barras = promedio ponderado por soporte minimo entre residencia y origen; "
            f"solo zonas con al menos {fmt_int(min_n)} tarjetas en ambas geografias."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.035,
        "Nota: valores positivos indican mayor peso QR al mirar origen habitual; valores negativos indican mayor peso QR al mirar residencia.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.6,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.18, right=0.91, top=0.74, bottom=0.15)
    plt.show()


def plot_macrozone_residence_origin_distribution(
    diff_gdf: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int = TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N,
    macrozone_order: list[str] | None = None,
    title: str = "Heterogeneidad interna del cambio residencia-origen",
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.2, 6.2),
) -> None:
    supported = (
        diff_gdf.loc[
            (diff_gdf["support_min"] >= min_n)
            & diff_gdf["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].notna()
        ]
        .copy()
    )
    if supported.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No hay zonas con soporte minimo >= {fmt_int(min_n)} en ambas geografias.")

    macro_col = "MACROZONA" if "MACROZONA" in supported.columns else "NMACROZONA"
    supported["macrozone_label"] = supported[macro_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    numeric_macrozone = supported["macrozone_label"].str.replace(".", "", regex=False).str.isnumeric()
    supported.loc[numeric_macrozone, "macrozone_label"] = (
        "Macrozona " + supported.loc[numeric_macrozone, "macrozone_label"]
    )

    if macrozone_order is None:
        macrozone_order = (
            supported.groupby("macrozone_label")["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"]
            .median()
            .sort_values()
            .index
            .tolist()
        )
    macrozone_order = [m for m in macrozone_order if m in set(supported["macrozone_label"])]

    rng = np.random.default_rng(20260613)
    delta = supported["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].to_numpy()
    max_abs = max(4.0, float(np.ceil(np.nanquantile(np.abs(delta), 0.99) + 0.8)))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

    summary_rows = []
    for y, macrozone in enumerate(macrozone_order):
        group = supported.loc[supported["macrozone_label"] == macrozone].copy()
        values = group["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].to_numpy()
        if values.size == 0:
            continue

        p10, p25, p50, p75, p90 = np.nanquantile(values, [0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90])
        summary_rows.append((macrozone, p50, len(group)))

        ax.hlines(y, p10, p90, color="#B9AEA2", linewidth=2.5, zorder=2)
        ax.add_patch(
            Rectangle(
                (p25, y - 0.20),
                max(p75 - p25, 0.03),
                0.40,
                facecolor="#EFE3D3",
                edgecolor="#8E877A",
                linewidth=0.9,
                zorder=3,
            )
        )
        ax.vlines(p50, y - 0.26, y + 0.26, color=TEXT_COLOR, linewidth=1.5, zorder=4)

        jitter = rng.uniform(-0.18, 0.18, size=len(group))
        point_colors = np.where(
            group["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].to_numpy() >= 0,
            PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
        )
        point_sizes = np.clip(np.sqrt(group["support_min"].to_numpy()) * 1.4, 12, 42)
        ax.scatter(
            group["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"],
            y + jitter,
            s=point_sizes,
            color=point_colors,
            alpha=0.32,
            edgecolor="white",
            linewidth=0.25,
            zorder=1,
        )

    ax.axvline(0, color="#8E877A", linewidth=1.1, linestyle="--", zorder=0)
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(macrozone_order)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(macrozone_order, fontsize=10.5)
    ax.set_xlim(-max_abs, max_abs * 1.35)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:+.0f}"))
    ax.set_xlabel("Origen habitual - residencia en delta QR (pp)")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    text_x = max_abs * 1.02
    for y, (_, median_value, n_zones) in enumerate(summary_rows):
        zone_word = "zona" if int(n_zones) == 1 else "zonas"
        ax.text(
            text_x,
            y,
            f"mediana {median_value:+.1f} pp · {fmt_int(n_zones)} {zone_word}",
            ha="left",
            va="center",
            fontsize=8.8,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
        )

    handles = [
        Patch(facecolor="#EFE3D3", edgecolor="#8E877A", label="IQR p25-p75"),
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color="#B9AEA2", linewidth=2.5, label="p10-p90"),
        plt.Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            marker="o",
            color="none",
            markerfacecolor=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            markeredgecolor="white",
            markersize=7,
            label="Zona con mayor QR por origen",
        ),
        plt.Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            marker="o",
            color="none",
            markerfacecolor=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
            markeredgecolor="white",
            markersize=7,
            label="Zona con mayor QR por residencia",
        ),
    ]
    ax.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="lower left",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0, 1.01),
        frameon=False,
        ncol=4,
        fontsize=8.8,
    )

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            "Cada punto es una zona; caja = IQR; linea = p10-p90. "
            f"Solo zonas con al menos {fmt_int(min_n)} tarjetas en ambas geografias."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.035,
        "Nota: valores positivos indican mayor peso QR por origen habitual; negativos indican mayor peso QR por residencia.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.6,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.16, right=0.88, top=0.76, bottom=0.14)
    plt.show()


def plot_top_residence_origin_changes(
    diff_gdf: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int = TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N,
    top_n: int = 15,
    title: str = "Zonas donde mas cambia la lectura territorial",
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.0, 7.2),
) -> None:
    supported = (
        diff_gdf.loc[
            (diff_gdf["support_min"] >= min_n)
            & diff_gdf["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].notna()
        ]
        .copy()
    )
    if supported.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No hay zonas con soporte minimo >= {fmt_int(min_n)} en ambas geografias.")

    plot_df = (
        supported.nlargest(top_n, "abs_origin_minus_residence_pp")
        .sort_values("delta_origin_minus_residence_pp")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    def _clean_label(value: object) -> str | None:
        if pd.isna(value):
            return None
        text = str(value).strip()
        if not text:
            return None
        # Avoid showing coded numeric fields as if they were interpretable labels.
        if text.replace(".", "", 1).isdigit():
            return None
        return text.title() if text else None

    labels = []
    for _, row in plot_df.iterrows():
        comuna = _clean_label(row.get("COMUNA"))
        macrozona = _clean_label(row.get("MACROZONA"))
        if macrozona is None:
            macrozona = _clean_label(row.get("NMACROZONA"))
        first_line = f"Z{int(row['zone_id'])}"
        if comuna:
            first_line = f"{first_line} · {comuna}"
        labels.append(f"{first_line}\n{macrozona}" if macrozona else first_line)

    values = plot_df["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].to_numpy()
    colors = np.where(values >= 0, PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"])
    edge_colors = np.where(values >= 0, "#9A3D2B", "#184B6C")
    y = np.arange(len(plot_df))
    max_abs = max(2.0, float(np.ceil(np.abs(values).max() + 0.8)))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

    bars = ax.barh(
        y,
        values,
        color=colors,
        edgecolor=edge_colors,
        linewidth=0.9,
        alpha=0.86,
        height=0.64,
    )
    ax.axvline(0, color="#8E877A", linewidth=1.1, zorder=1)

    for bar, value in zip(bars, values):
        label_x = value + (0.18 if value >= 0 else -0.18)
        ha = "left" if value >= 0 else "right"
        ax.text(
            label_x,
            bar.get_y() + bar.get_height() / 2,
            f"{value:+.1f} pp",
            ha=ha,
            va="center",
            fontsize=9,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
        )

    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=8.8)
    ax.set_xlim(-max_abs, max_abs)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:+.0f}"))
    ax.set_xlabel("Cambio en delta QR: origen habitual - residencia (pp)")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    handles = [
        Patch(facecolor=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], edgecolor="#9A3D2B", label="QR pesa mas por origen"),
        Patch(facecolor=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], edgecolor="#184B6C", label="QR pesa mas por residencia"),
    ]
    ax.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="lower left",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0, 1.01),
        frameon=False,
        ncol=2,
        fontsize=9.5,
    )

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            f"Ranking de las {top_n} zonas con mayor |origen habitual - residencia|, "
            f"usando solo zonas con al menos {fmt_int(min_n)} tarjetas en ambas geografias."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.035,
        "Nota: valores positivos indican mayor peso QR al mirar origen habitual; valores negativos indican mayor peso QR al mirar residencia.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.6,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.27, right=0.93, top=0.78, bottom=0.13)
    plt.show()


def build_residence_origin_sensitivity_compact(
    universes: list[dict],
    geometries: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int = TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    summary_rows = []
    macro_rows = []

    for universe in universes:
        lf_universe = pl.scan_parquet(universe["path"])
        residence_summary = territorial_zone_summary_for_lazyframe(
            lf_universe,
            universe=universe["universe"],
            label=universe["label"],
            geography_key="residence",
            geography_label="Residencia",
            zone_col="zona_hogar",
        )
        origin_summary = territorial_zone_summary_for_lazyframe(
            lf_universe,
            universe=universe["universe"],
            label=universe["label"],
            geography_key="origin",
            geography_label="Origen habitual",
            zone_col="origin_zone_top1",
        )
        comparison = build_residence_origin_zone_comparison(residence_summary, origin_summary)
        supported = comparison.loc[
            (comparison["support_min"] >= min_n)
            & comparison["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].notna()
        ].copy()

        if supported.empty:
            corr = np.nan
            median_abs = np.nan
            p90_abs = np.nan
            share_abs_gt_2pp = np.nan
            share_origin_gt_residence_2pp = np.nan
            share_residence_gt_origin_2pp = np.nan
        else:
            corr = supported["delta_residence_pp"].corr(supported["delta_origin_pp"])
            abs_change = supported["abs_origin_minus_residence_pp"]
            delta_change = supported["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"]
            median_abs = float(abs_change.median())
            p90_abs = float(abs_change.quantile(0.90))
            share_abs_gt_2pp = float((abs_change >= 2).mean())
            share_origin_gt_residence_2pp = float((delta_change >= 2).mean())
            share_residence_gt_origin_2pp = float((delta_change <= -2).mean())

            diff_gdf = prepare_residence_origin_difference_map_data(comparison, geometries)
            macro_summary = build_macrozone_residence_origin_change_summary(diff_gdf, min_n=min_n)
            macro_summary = macro_summary.assign(
                universe=universe["universe"],
                universe_label=universe["label"],
            )
            macro_rows.append(macro_summary)

        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "universe": universe["universe"],
                "universe_label": universe["label"],
                "min_n": min_n,
                "n_zones_compared": int(len(comparison)),
                "n_zones_supported": int(len(supported)),
                "share_zones_supported": (
                    float(len(supported) / len(comparison)) if len(comparison) else np.nan
                ),
                "corr_residence_origin_delta": corr,
                "median_abs_origin_minus_residence_pp": median_abs,
                "p90_abs_origin_minus_residence_pp": p90_abs,
                "share_abs_change_ge_2pp": share_abs_gt_2pp,
                "share_origin_ge_residence_2pp": share_origin_gt_residence_2pp,
                "share_residence_ge_origin_2pp": share_residence_gt_origin_2pp,
            }
        )

    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
    macro_df = pd.concat(macro_rows, ignore_index=True) if macro_rows else pd.DataFrame()
    return summary_df, macro_df


def plot_macrozone_sensitivity_heatmap(
    macro_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    universes: list[dict],
    title: str = "Sensibilidad del cambio residencia-origen por universo",
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.2, 4.9),
) -> None:
    if macro_df.empty:
        raise ValueError("macro_df esta vacio.")

    universe_order = [u["label"] for u in universes if u["label"] in set(macro_df["universe_label"])]
    macrozone_order = (
        macro_df.loc[macro_df["universe_label"] == universe_order[0]]
        .sort_values("weighted_mean_delta_pp")["macrozone"]
        .tolist()
        if universe_order
        else sorted(macro_df["macrozone"].unique())
    )
    pivot = (
        macro_df.pivot_table(
            index="universe_label",
            columns="macrozone",
            values="weighted_mean_delta_pp",
            aggfunc="first",
        )
        .reindex(index=universe_order, columns=macrozone_order)
    )

    max_abs = max(1.0, float(np.nanmax(np.abs(pivot.to_numpy()))))
    cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
        "macro_sens",
        [PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], "#F8F3E8", PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
    )
    norm = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-max_abs, vcenter=0, vmax=max_abs)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

    annot = pivot.applymap(lambda value: "" if pd.isna(value) else f"{value:+.1f}")
    sns.heatmap(
        pivot,
        ax=ax,
        cmap=cmap,
        norm=norm,
        annot=annot,
        fmt="",
        linewidths=1.6,
        linecolor=FIG_BG,
        cbar_kws={"label": "Origen - residencia (pp)"},
        annot_kws={"fontsize": 9.2, "fontweight": "bold", "color": TEXT_COLOR},
    )
    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=0, labelsize=9.2, colors=TEXT_COLOR)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", rotation=0, labelsize=9.2, colors=TEXT_COLOR)

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            "Cada celda es el promedio ponderado por soporte minimo. "
            "Rojo: QR pesa mas por origen; azul: QR pesa mas por residencia."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.035,
        f"Nota: solo zonas con al menos {fmt_int(TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N)} tarjetas en ambas geografias.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.6,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.19, right=0.94, top=0.70, bottom=0.19)
    plt.show()


def build_top_origin_zone_residence_mix(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    diff_gdf: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    min_n: int = TERRITORIAL_COMPARE_MIN_N,
    top_n: int = 15,
    top_k: int = 3,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    supported = diff_gdf.loc[
        (diff_gdf["support_min"] >= min_n)
        & diff_gdf["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"].notna()
    ].copy()
    if supported.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No hay zonas con soporte minimo >= {fmt_int(min_n)} en ambas geografias.")

    top_zones = (
        supported.nlargest(top_n, "abs_origin_minus_residence_pp")
        .copy()
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    top_zone_ids = [int(zone_id) for zone_id in top_zones["zone_id"].dropna().unique()]

    lf_top = (
        lf.select(
            [
                pl.col("origin_zone_top1").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("origin_zone"),
                pl.col("zona_hogar").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("home_zone"),
                pl.col("is_qr").cast(pl.Int64).alias("is_qr"),
                territorial_macrozone_expr("home_macro_").alias("home_macrozone"),
            ]
        )
        .filter(pl.col("origin_zone").is_in(top_zone_ids))
        .filter(pl.col("home_macrozone").is_not_null())
    )

    mix_df = (
        lf_top.group_by(["origin_zone", "home_macrozone"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("is_qr").sum().alias("n_qr"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards").sum().over("origin_zone")).alias(
                    "share_all_cards"
                ),
                (pl.col("n_qr") / pl.col("n_qr").sum().over("origin_zone")).alias(
                    "share_qr_cards"
                ),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )

    def _clean_label(value: object) -> str | None:
        if pd.isna(value):
            return None
        text = str(value).strip()
        if not text:
            return None
        if text.replace(".", "", 1).isdigit():
            return None
        return text.title()

    def _format_macro_mix(group: pd.DataFrame, share_col: str, n_col: str) -> str:
        if group.empty or group[share_col].isna().all():
            return "Sin datos"
        rows = group.sort_values(share_col, ascending=False).head(top_k)
        parts = []
        for _, row in rows.iterrows():
            parts.append(
                f"{row['home_macrozone']}: {row[share_col]:.1%} (n={fmt_int(row[n_col])})"
            )
        return "; ".join(parts)

    rows = []
    for _, zone in top_zones.iterrows():
        zone_id = int(zone["zone_id"])
        zone_mix = mix_df.loc[mix_df["origin_zone"] == zone_id].copy()
        comuna = _clean_label(zone.get("COMUNA"))
        macrozona = _clean_label(zone.get("MACROZONA"))
        if macrozona is None:
            macrozona = _clean_label(zone.get("NMACROZONA"))

        rows.append(
            {
                "zone_id": zone_id,
                "zone_label": f"Z{zone_id}" + (f" · {comuna}" if comuna else ""),
                "comuna": comuna,
                "macrozona": macrozona,
                "n_cards_origin": int(zone["n_cards_origin"]),
                "qr_share_origin": float(zone["qr_share_origin"]),
                "n_cards_residence": int(zone["n_cards_residence"]),
                "qr_share_residence": float(zone["qr_share_residence"]),
                "delta_origin_pp": float(zone["delta_origin_pp"]),
                "delta_residence_pp": float(zone["delta_residence_pp"]),
                "origin_minus_residence_pp": float(zone["delta_origin_minus_residence_pp"]),
                "top_home_macro_all_cards": _format_macro_mix(
                    zone_mix, "share_all_cards", "n_cards"
                ),
                "top_home_macro_qr_cards": _format_macro_mix(
                    zone_mix.loc[zone_mix["n_qr"] > 0], "share_qr_cards", "n_qr"
                ),
            }
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(
        "origin_minus_residence_pp", key=lambda s: s.abs(), ascending=False
    )
```

# Bloque 1 - Composicion BIP vs QR

## Pregunta

Cuantas tarjetas y viajes son BIP vs QR?

El objetivo es verificar si QR pesa distinto cuando miramos tarjetas que cuando
miramos viajes. Si QR tiene menor share en viajes que en tarjetas, eso sugiere
menor intensidad promedio de uso por tarjeta QR.

## 1.1 Tabla de composicion

```{python}
#| label: block1-composition-table
print("label: block1-composition-table")

composition = composition_for_lazyframe(lf_cards, "alta_n3", "Alta, n>=3").select(
    [
        "payment_group",
        "n_cards",
        "card_share",
        "n_trips",
        "trip_share",
        "trip_minus_card_share",
        "mean_trips_per_card",
        "median_trips_per_card",
    ]
)

composition
```

## 1.2 Visual: share de tarjetas vs share de viajes

```{python}
#| label: block1-composition-plot
print("label: block1-composition-plot")

plot_composition_donuts(
    composition,
    title="Composicion BIP vs QR: tarjetas y viajes",
)
```

## 1.3 Sensibilidad visual por universo

Esta celda replica la visualizacion anterior para los universos de sensibilidad.
Por defecto no se ejecuta para mantener el notebook liviano. Para activarla,
cambiar `RUN_SENS_GRAPHS = True` en la configuracion.

```{python}
#| label: block1-composition-sensitivity-plot
print("label: block1-composition-sensitivity-plot")

if RUN_SENS_GRAPHS:
    for universe in UNIVERSES:
        if universe["universe"] == "alta_n3":
            sens_composition = composition
        else:
            sens_composition = composition_for_lazyframe(
                pl.scan_parquet(universe["path"]),
                universe["universe"],
                universe["label"],
            ).select(composition.columns)

        plot_df = sens_composition.to_pandas().set_index("payment_group").loc[PAYMENT_ORDER]
        qr_card_share = plot_df.loc["QR", "card_share"]
        qr_trip_share = plot_df.loc["QR", "trip_share"]
        delta = qr_trip_share - qr_card_share

        plot_composition_donuts(
            sens_composition,
            title=f"Composicion BIP vs QR: {universe['label']}",
            subtitle=(
                f"QR representa {qr_card_share:.1%} de las tarjetas y {qr_trip_share:.1%} de los viajes "
                f"(diferencia viajes - tarjetas: {delta:+.1%})."
            ),
        )
else:
    print("Sensibilidad visual omitida. Activar con RUN_SENS_GRAPHS = True.")
```

creacion de tarjeta, sino como primera aparicion dentro del panel disponible.

Al comparar tarjetas con el mismo numero de semanas observadas disponibles, QR
no queda sistematicamente muy por debajo de BIP. La diferencia que persiste es
moderada y aparece con mas claridad en viajes por semana activa que en numero de
semanas activas. En otras palabras, QR no parece ser simplemente "mas nuevo";
tambien muestra una intensidad condicional algo menor cuando la tarjeta esta
activa.

# Bloque 2 - Cohorte temporal 2024 / 2025

## Pregunta

La clasificacion se deriva de `share_trips_2025`:

- `only_2024`: tarjetas con todos sus viajes observados en 2024.
- `both_years`: tarjetas con viajes observados en 2024 y 2025.
- `only_2025`: tarjetas con todos sus viajes observados en 2025.

Esta clasificacion describe presencia temporal de tarjetas, no adopcion
individual. Una tarjeta `only_2025` puede ser una nueva tarjeta, una tarjeta que
no aparece en la ventana 2024, o un usuario observado solo en 2025.

## 2.3 Persistencia e intensidad entre ventanas

con un grupo mas pequeno de tarjetas persistentes e intensivas?

Una tarjeta es `reobservada` si aparece tanto en la ventana 2024 como en la
ventana 2025. El top 20% se calcula, por grupo de pago, solo entre tarjetas
reobservadas y usando el numero de viajes de cada ventana. Los empates en el
umbral se conservan, por lo que el grupo efectivo puede superar levemente 20%.

`Solo 2025` significa que la tarjeta no fue observada en la ventana 2024. No
implica que sea una tarjeta nueva ni que una tarjeta ausente haya sido

## 2.4 Finding: persistencia observada

QR no muestra una base mas transitoria que BIP dentro de las ventanas
observadas. El 57,2% de las tarjetas QR de 2024 reaparece en 2025, frente al
41,6% de BIP, y las tarjetas reobservadas explican una proporcion similar de
los viajes de 2025 en ambos grupos: 47,3% en QR y 45,9% en BIP.

Entre las tarjetas presentes en ambas ventanas, la intensidad alta muestra
persistencia: 51,8% del top QR y 57,0% del top BIP de 2024 permanecen en el top
de 2025. BIP presenta algo mas de estabilidad, pero ambos medios combinan
renovacion de tarjetas con un nucleo intensivo persistente. La comparacion
describe presencia en las ventanas disponibles; no prueba uso continuo,
adopcion ni abandono entre ambas fechas.

## 3.6 Finding: menor intensidad observada en QR

Las tarjetas QR presentan menor intensidad observada que las BIP. La mediana es
de 8 versus 11 viajes y de 5 versus 6 dias activos, mientras que ambos grupos
registran una mediana de 3 semanas activas. La diferencia aparece, por tanto,
principalmente en la frecuencia de uso dentro de las semanas con actividad y
no en una ventana activa claramente mas corta.

La unidad de analisis es la tarjeta, no la persona. Una persona usuaria frecuente
de BIP puede probar QR durante pocos viajes y luego volver a su tarjeta BIP; en
los datos aparecerian una tarjeta QR de baja intensidad y otra BIP intensiva.
Por ello, la brecha observada puede combinar menor frecuencia de uso, prueba y
abandono, adopcion reciente o uso selectivo de QR. Sin vincular tarjetas de una
misma persona no es posible separar estos mecanismos. Ademas, el universo
`n>=3` excluye las pruebas de uno o dos viajes.

## 3.7 Construccion de universos de recurrencia

Se comparan tres universos anidados:

- **Amplio:** todas las tarjetas validas del panel interanual con al menos un
  viaje observado en alguna de las dos ventanas. No exige residencia de
  confianza alta ni un minimo adicional de viajes.
- **Recurrente:** tarjetas del universo amplio con al menos un viaje en la
  ventana 2024 y al menos uno en la ventana 2025. Mide reobservacion entre
  ventanas, no actividad continua durante el periodo intermedio.
- **Repetido:** tarjetas recurrentes con actividad en al menos 2 de las 4
  semanas observadas de 2024 y en al menos 2 de las 4 semanas observadas de
  2025. Es una sensibilidad que exige repeticion dentro de ambos anos.

Por construccion, `Repetido` es subconjunto de `Recurrente`, y `Recurrente` es
subconjunto de `Amplio`.

```{python}
#| label: block3-recurrent-universe-construction
print("label: block3-recurrent-universe-construction")

active_weeks_by_year = active_weeks_by_year_from_trip_paths(
    TRIP_PATHS
).collect()

lf_broad_cards = (
    prepare_valid_card_panel(pl.scan_parquet(INTERANNUAL_PANEL_PATH))
    .join(active_weeks_by_year.lazy(), on="id_tarjeta", how="left")
    .with_columns(
        [
            pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024").fill_null(0),
            pl.col("n_active_weeks_2025").fill_null(0),
        ]
    )
)
lf_recurrent_cards = lf_broad_cards.filter(pl.col("is_recurrent"))
lf_repeated_cards = lf_broad_cards.filter(
    (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024") >= 2)
    & (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2025") >= 2)
)

card_universe_specs = [
    ("broad", "Amplio", 1, lf_broad_cards),
    ("recurrent", "Recurrente", 2, lf_recurrent_cards),
    ("repeated", "Repetido", 3, lf_repeated_cards),
]

card_universe_coverage = card_universe_coverage_summary(card_universe_specs)
card_universe_coverage_display = (
    card_universe_coverage.select(
        [
            "universe_label",
            "payment_group",
            "n_cards",
            "share_of_broad_cards",
            "n_trips",
            "share_of_broad_trips",
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "universe_label": "universo",
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "share_of_broad_cards": "share_tarjetas_del_amplio",
            "n_trips": "viajes",
            "share_of_broad_trips": "share_viajes_del_amplio",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    card_universe_coverage_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "share_tarjetas_del_amplio": "{:.1%}",
            "viajes": fmt_int,
            "share_viajes_del_amplio": "{:.1%}",
        }
    )
)
```

## 3.9 Finding: menor intensidad, no menor persistencia

Los resultados distinguen persistencia entre ventanas de intensidad dentro de
ellas. Las tarjetas QR no presentan menor persistencia interanual: entre las
observadas en 2024, su proporcion reobservada en 2025 es incluso mayor que la de
BIP. Sin embargo, QR mantiene una intensidad inferior en los universos amplio,
recurrente y repetido.

En el universo repetido, ambos grupos alcanzan una mediana de 7 semanas activas,
pero QR registra menos viajes (29 versus 34), menos dias activos (16 versus 18)
y menos viajes por semana activa (4.5 versus 4.9). Por tanto, la menor intensidad
QR no se explica solamente por participar durante menos semanas. El bloque 4
descompone esta brecha entre dias usados dentro de las semanas activas, viajes
por dia activo y continuidad observada entre ventanas.

El aumento de las medianas al restringir el universo es mecanico, porque los
filtros seleccionan tarjetas con mayor actividad. El universo repetido funciona
como sensibilidad para tarjetas constantes, pero no reemplaza al universo amplio,
que conserva las experiencias exploratorias y de baja frecuencia.

## 3.10 Trayectorias de presencia entre ventanas

Los universos `Amplio`, `Recurrente` y `Repetido` son filtros anidados. En
cambio, las siguientes trayectorias son tres categorias mutuamente excluyentes
dentro del universo amplio:

- **Solo 2024:** tarjeta observada en 2024 y no reobservada en la ventana 2025.
  Es compatible con discontinuidad, pero no demuestra abandono.
- **Persistente:** el mismo `id_tarjeta` registra viajes en las ventanas 2024 y
  2025. Indica continuidad observada del identificador, no uso continuo ni
  fidelidad exclusiva al medio de pago.
- **Solo 2025:** tarjeta observada en 2025 y no observada en la ventana 2024.
  Es compatible con incorporacion reciente a QR, pero no demuestra una primera
  adopcion de la persona.

La definicion principal exige al menos una semana activa en la ventana
correspondiente. Como sensibilidad se repite la clasificacion exigiendo al menos
dos semanas activas: dos en 2024 para `Solo 2024`, dos en cada ano para
`Persistente` y dos en 2025 para `Solo 2025`. Las tarjetas que no satisfacen
estos criterios mas estrictos quedan fuera de esa sensibilidad.

### 3.10a Composicion y aporte de cada trayectoria

La tabla muestra cuanto pesa cada trayectoria entre las tarjetas y entre los
viajes de su medio de pago. Los shares de viajes se calculan por separado para
cada ventana.

```{python}
#| label: block3-presence-trajectory-composition
print("label: block3-presence-trajectory-composition")

presence_trajectory_base = add_presence_cohort(lf_broad_cards)

presence_trajectory_summary = (
    presence_trajectory_base.group_by(["payment_group", "presence_cohort"])
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("n_trips_2024").sum().alias("n_trips_2024"),
            pl.col("n_trips_2025").sum().alias("n_trips_2025"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        [
            (
                pl.col("n_cards")
                / pl.col("n_cards").sum().over("payment_group")
            ).alias("card_share_within_payment"),
            (
                pl.col("n_trips_2024")
                / pl.col("n_trips_2024").sum().over("payment_group")
            ).alias("trip_share_2024_within_payment"),
            (
                pl.col("n_trips_2025")
                / pl.col("n_trips_2025").sum().over("payment_group")
            ).alias("trip_share_2025_within_payment"),
            pl.when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "only_2024")
            .then(1)
            .when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "both_years")
            .then(2)
            .otherwise(3)
            .alias("cohort_order"),
        ]
    )
    .sort(["payment_group", "cohort_order"])
    .collect()
)

presence_trajectory_display = (
    presence_trajectory_summary.select(
        [
            "payment_group",
            "presence_cohort",
            "n_cards",
            "card_share_within_payment",

        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("presence_cohort").replace(COHORT_LABELS).alias("presence_cohort")

            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",

display(
```

### 3.10b Actividad dentro de cada ventana

Esta comparacion evita usar como evidencia la mayor actividad acumulada de la
categoria `Persistente`, que por definicion aparece en dos ventanas. En cada ano
se compara la actividad registrada solo dentro de esa ventana: `Solo 2024`
frente a `Persistente` en 2024, y `Persistente` frente a `Solo 2025` en 2025.

```{python}
#| label: block3-presence-trajectory-activity
print("label: block3-presence-trajectory-activity")

presence_activity_long = pl.concat(
    [
        presence_trajectory_base.filter(
            (pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0)
            & (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024") > 0)
        ).select(
            [
                "payment_group",
                "presence_cohort",
                pl.lit(2024).cast(pl.Int16).alias("year"),
                pl.col("n_trips_2024").alias("n_trips_year"),
                pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024").alias("n_active_weeks_year"),
            ]
        ),
        presence_trajectory_base.filter(
            (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0)
            & (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2025") > 0)
        ).select(
            [
                "payment_group",
                "presence_cohort",
                pl.lit(2025).cast(pl.Int16).alias("year"),
                pl.col("n_trips_2025").alias("n_trips_year"),
                pl.col("n_active_weeks_2025").alias("n_active_weeks_year"),
            ]
        ),
    ]
).with_columns(
    (
        pl.col("n_trips_year") / pl.col("n_active_weeks_year")
    ).alias("trips_per_active_week_year")
)

presence_trajectory_activity = (
    presence_activity_long.group_by(
        ["year", "payment_group", "presence_cohort"]
    )
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("n_trips_year").median().alias("median_trips_year"),
            pl.col("n_active_weeks_year").median().alias("median_active_weeks_year"),
            pl.col("trips_per_active_week_year")
            .median()
            .alias("median_trips_per_active_week_year"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "only_2024")
            .then(1)
            .when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "both_years")
            .then(2)
            .otherwise(3)
            .alias("cohort_order")
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("presence_cohort").replace(COHORT_LABELS)
    )
    .sort(["year", "payment_group", "cohort_order"])
    .collect()
)

presence_trajectory_activity_display = (
    presence_trajectory_activity.select(
        [
            "year",
            "payment_group",
            "presence_cohort",
            "n_cards",
            "median_trips_year",
            "median_active_weeks_year",
            "median_trips_per_active_week_year",
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "year": "ano",
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "presence_cohort": "trayectoria",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "median_trips_year": "mediana_viajes_ventana",
            "median_active_weeks_year": "mediana_semanas_activas_ventana",
            "median_trips_per_active_week_year": "mediana_viajes_semana_activa",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    presence_trajectory_activity_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "mediana_viajes_ventana": "{:.1f}",
            "mediana_semanas_activas_ventana": "{:.1f}",
            "mediana_viajes_semana_activa": "{:.1f}",
        }
    )
)
```

### 3.10c Sensibilidad a exigir dos semanas activas

La sensibilidad no redefine las tarjetas de una semana como otra trayectoria:
simplemente las excluye. Por eso deben compararse tanto los porcentajes como el
numero de tarjetas retenidas.

```{python}
#| label: block3-presence-trajectory-sensitivity
print("label: block3-presence-trajectory-sensitivity")

lf_presence_repeated = lf_broad_cards.filter(
    (
        (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024") >= 2)
        & (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2025") == 0)
    )
    | (
        (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024") >= 2)
        & (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2025") >= 2)
    )
    | (
        (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024") == 0)
        & (pl.col("n_active_weeks_2025") >= 2)
    )
)

presence_trajectory_standard = cohort_for_lazyframe(
    lf_broad_cards,
    "presence_1_week",
    "Al menos 1 semana",
).with_columns(pl.lit(1).alias("definition_order"))
presence_trajectory_repeated = cohort_for_lazyframe(
    lf_presence_repeated,
    "presence_2_weeks",
    "Al menos 2 semanas",
).with_columns(pl.lit(2).alias("definition_order"))

presence_trajectory_sensitivity = pl.concat(
    [presence_trajectory_standard, presence_trajectory_repeated]
).with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "only_2024")
        .then(1)
        .when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "both_years")
        .then(2)
        .otherwise(3)
        .alias("cohort_order")
).with_columns(
    pl.col("presence_cohort").replace(COHORT_LABELS)
).sort(["definition_order", "payment_group", "cohort_order"])

presence_trajectory_sensitivity_display = (
    presence_trajectory_sensitivity.select(
        [
            "universe_label",
            "payment_group",
            "presence_cohort",
            "n_cards",
            "card_share_within_payment",
            "n_trips",
            "trip_share_within_payment",
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "universe_label": "definicion",
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "presence_cohort": "trayectoria",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "card_share_within_payment": "share_tarjetas_grupo",
            "n_trips": "viajes_ambas_ventanas",
            "trip_share_within_payment": "share_viajes_grupo",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    presence_trajectory_sensitivity_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "share_tarjetas_grupo": "{:.1%}",
            "viajes_ambas_ventanas": fmt_int,
            "share_viajes_grupo": "{:.1%}",
        }
    )
)

plot_cohort_stacked_bars(
    presence_trajectory_repeated,
    title="Trayectorias con actividad repetida",
    subtitle="",
)
```

### 3.10d Finding: continuidad entre anos y actividad dentro de cada ventana

**QR no parece presentar mayor desaparicion entre anos.** Entre las tarjetas
presentes en 2024, los identificadores QR reaparecen en 2025 en mayor proporcion
que los BIP. Esta comparacion describe continuidad del `id_tarjeta`, no
permanencia o abandono de una persona.

**QR si concentra mas actividad breve dentro de cada ano.** Al exigir al menos
dos semanas activas, el filtro elimina proporcionalmente mas tarjetas QR. Es
decir, una parte mayor de sus identificadores aparece pocas semanas dentro de
cada ventana, aunque algunos vuelvan a observarse al ano siguiente.

**Las tarjetas persistentes son mas intensivas.** Tanto en BIP como en QR, los
identificadores presentes en ambos anos ya registraban mas viajes que los
observados en una sola ventana.

**La diferencia BIP-QR no desaparece entre las persistentes.** Incluso entre
identificadores presentes en ambos anos, QR registra una cantidad mediana de
viajes algo menor que BIP. En conjunto, QR combina mayor continuidad observada
entre anos con menor regularidad de uso dentro de cada ventana.

## 3.11 Distribucion acumulada de regularidad

La ECDF muestra, para cada valor del eje x, que proporcion acumulada de tarjetas
queda por debajo o igual a ese valor. Es util para comparar si QR concentra mas
masa en pocos dias activos o en cierto nivel de viajes por dia activo. Primero se
muestra cada universo por separado. Luego se comparan `Amplio` y `Repetido` con
escalas comunes para distinguir composicion general de actividad sostenida.

```{python}
#| label: block4-regularity-ecdf

}

)

for _, universe_label, _, _ in card_universe_specs:
```

## 3.12 Participacion dentro de las semanas activas

Pregunta: QR participa en menos dias dentro de las semanas en que esta presente,
aunque mantenga una cantidad similar de viajes por dia activo?

Para cada tarjeta se calculan dos componentes. `Dias activos por semana activa`
mide en cuantos dias aparece dentro de una semana en la que tuvo al menos un
viaje. `Viajes por dia activo` mide su intensidad una vez que aparece. La segunda
figura compara BIP y QR dentro del mismo numero total de semanas activas
observadas, evitando atribuir a regularidad una diferencia de exposicion.

```{python}
#| label: block4-within-week-regularity
print("label: block4-within-week-regularity")

within_week_summary_queries = []
within_week_profile_queries = []

for universe_key, universe_label, universe_order, universe_lf in card_universe_specs:
    within_week_base = (
        add_payment_group(universe_lf)
        .with_columns(
            (
                pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024")
                + pl.col("n_active_weeks_2025")
            )
            .cast(pl.Int16)
            .alias("n_active_weeks_observed")
        )
        .filter(
            (pl.col("n_active_weeks_observed") > 0)
            & (pl.col("n_dias_activos") > 0)
            & (pl.col("n_viajes") > 0)
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col("n_dias_activos")
                    / pl.col("n_active_weeks_observed")
                ).alias("active_days_per_week"),
                (
                    pl.col("n_viajes")
                    / pl.col("n_dias_activos")
                ).alias("trips_per_active_day"),
            ]
        )
    )

    within_week_summary_queries.append(
        within_week_base.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("active_days_per_week").quantile(0.25).alias("p25_active_days_per_week"),
                pl.col("active_days_per_week").median().alias("median_active_days_per_week"),
                pl.col("active_days_per_week").quantile(0.75).alias("p75_active_days_per_week"),
                pl.col("trips_per_active_day").quantile(0.25).alias("p25_trips_per_active_day"),
                pl.col("trips_per_active_day").median().alias("median_trips_per_active_day"),
                pl.col("trips_per_active_day").quantile(0.75).alias("p75_trips_per_active_day"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe_key).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(universe_label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(universe_order).alias("universe_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

    within_week_profile_queries.append(
        within_week_base.group_by(
            ["payment_group", "n_active_weeks_observed"]
        )
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("active_days_per_week")
                .median()
                .alias("median_active_days_per_week"),
                pl.col("trips_per_active_day")
                .median()
                .alias("median_trips_per_active_day"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe_key).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(universe_label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(universe_order).alias("universe_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

within_week_results = pl.collect_all(
    within_week_summary_queries + within_week_profile_queries
)
n_universes = len(card_universe_specs)
within_week_summary = pl.concat(within_week_results[:n_universes]).sort(
    ["universe_order", "payment_group"]
)
within_week_profile = pl.concat(within_week_results[n_universes:]).sort(
    ["universe_order", "n_active_weeks_observed", "payment_group"]
)

within_week_summary_display = (
    within_week_summary.select(
        [
            "universe_label",
            "payment_group",
            "n_cards",
            "p25_active_days_per_week",
            "median_active_days_per_week",
            "p75_active_days_per_week",
            "p25_trips_per_active_day",
            "median_trips_per_active_day",
            "p75_trips_per_active_day",
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "universe_label": "universo",
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "p25_active_days_per_week": "p25_dias_semana_activa",
            "median_active_days_per_week": "mediana_dias_semana_activa",
            "p75_active_days_per_week": "p75_dias_semana_activa",
            "p25_trips_per_active_day": "p25_viajes_dia_activo",
            "median_trips_per_active_day": "mediana_viajes_dia_activo",
            "p75_trips_per_active_day": "p75_viajes_dia_activo",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    within_week_summary_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "p25_dias_semana_activa": "{:.2f}",
            "mediana_dias_semana_activa": "{:.2f}",
            "p75_dias_semana_activa": "{:.2f}",
            "p25_viajes_dia_activo": "{:.2f}",
            "mediana_viajes_dia_activo": "{:.2f}",
            "p75_viajes_dia_activo": "{:.2f}",
        }
    )
)

plot_within_week_regularity_by_universe(within_week_summary)
```

```{python}
conditioned_main = within_week_profile.filter(
```
