```{python}
#| label: block10-bip-load-quintile-plots
print("label: block10-bip-load-quintile-plots")

def plot_bip_load_quintile_grid(
    quintile_summaries: dict[tuple[str, str], pd.DataFrame],
    *,
    metric_key: str,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str,
    x_label: str,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (13.2, 4.9),
) -> None:
    plot_frames = [quintile_summaries[(geo_prefix, metric_key)] for geo_prefix, _ in BIP_LOAD_GEOS]
    y_values = np.concatenate([df["qr_share"].to_numpy() for df in plot_frames])
    global_qr_share = float(plot_frames[0]["global_qr_share"].iloc[0])
    y_min = max(0.0, min(y_values.min(), global_qr_share) - 0.025)
    y_max = min(0.35, max(y_values.max(), global_qr_share) + 0.035)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(BIP_LOAD_GEOS), figsize=figsize, sharey=True)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    if len(BIP_LOAD_GEOS) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    for ax, (geo_prefix, geo_label) in zip(axes, BIP_LOAD_GEOS):
        df = quintile_summaries[(geo_prefix, metric_key)].sort_values("quintile_order").copy()
        x = np.arange(len(df))
        values = df["qr_share"].to_numpy()
        support_values = df["card_share"].to_numpy()

        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        ax.axhline(global_qr_share, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2, zorder=1)
        ax.plot(
            x,
            values,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            linewidth=2.4,
            marker="o",
            markersize=7.5,
            markeredgecolor="white",
            markeredgewidth=1.2,
            zorder=4,
        )
        ax.fill_between(x, global_qr_share, values, color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], alpha=0.13, zorder=2)

        for xi, value, n_cards in zip(x, values, df["n_cards"]):
            ax.text(
                xi,
                value + 0.004,
                f"{value:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=8.6,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
                fontweight="bold",
            )
            ax.text(
                xi,
                value - 0.011,
                f"n={fmt_int(n_cards)}",
                ha="center",
                va="top",
                fontsize=7.2,
                color=MUTED_TEXT,
            )

        diff_q5_q1 = (values[-1] - values[0]) * 100
        ax.text(
            0.98,
            0.92,
            f"Q5 - Q1: {diff_q5_q1:+.1f} pp",
            transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha="right",
            va="center",
            fontsize=9.2,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"] if diff_q5_q1 >= 0 else PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
            fontweight="bold",
        )
        ax.text(
            0.98,
            0.08,
            f"global {global_qr_share:.1%}",
            transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha="right",
            va="center",
            fontsize=8.2,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
            fontweight="bold",
            bbox={
                "boxstyle": "round,pad=0.18",
                "facecolor": AX_BG,
                "edgecolor": "none",
                "alpha": 0.88,
            },
        )

        ax.set_title(geo_label, fontsize=11.8, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(df[df["quintile_col"].iloc[0]].tolist(), fontsize=8.4)
        ax.set_ylim(y_min, y_max)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0, decimals=0))
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")
        ax.set_xlabel(x_label if geo_prefix == "origin_top1" else "")
        if ax is axes[0]:
            ax.set_ylabel("Share QR dentro del quintil")
        else:
            ax.spines["left"].set_visible(False)
            ax.tick_params(axis="y", left=False)

        for xi, support in zip(x, support_values):
            ax.add_patch(
                Rectangle(
                    (xi - 0.33, y_min),
                    0.66,
                    (y_max - y_min) * support * 0.55,
                    facecolor="#D7CBB8",
                    edgecolor="none",
                    alpha=0.30,
                    zorder=0,
                )
            )

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.045,
        "Nota: lineas calculadas a nivel tarjeta; barras tenues en el fondo indican soporte relativo de tarjetas por quintil.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.5,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.07, right=0.98, top=0.72, bottom=0.24, wspace=0.15)
    plt.show()


plot_bip_load_quintile_grid(
    bip_load_quintile_summaries,
    metric_key="dist_nearest_m",
    title="Adopcion QR por distancia a puntos de carga BIP",
    subtitle=(
        "Si QR sustituye friccion de carga, el share QR deberia subir en quintiles mas lejanos."
    ),
    x_label="Quintil de distancia al punto BIP mas cercano",
)

plot_bip_load_quintile_grid(
    bip_load_quintile_summaries,
    metric_key="density_km2",
    title="Adopcion QR por densidad de puntos de carga BIP",
    subtitle=(
        "Si QR sustituye baja oferta de carga, el share QR deberia ser mayor en quintiles de menor densidad."
    ),
    x_label="Quintil de densidad de puntos BIP",
)
```

**Finding descriptivo.** Con las metricas zonales disponibles, no aparece un gradiente claro que vincule adopcion QR con peor acceso fisico a puntos de carga BIP. Las medianas de distancia, densidad y numero de puntos son practicamente iguales entre BIP y QR en residencia, origen habitual y actividad habitual. Al ordenar las tarjetas por quintiles de distancia o densidad, el share QR tampoco aumenta de forma monotona en las zonas con menor disponibilidad o mayor distancia a carga BIP.

Esto no descarta que la friccion de carga BIP opere para subgrupos o zonas especificas, pero sugiere que, a esta escala territorial y con estas aproximaciones de acceso, la disponibilidad fisica de puntos BIP no parece ser un driver descriptivo principal de la adopcion QR. La lectura debe mantenerse como evidencia descriptiva: las variables se heredan desde zonas y la distancia se calcula desde centroides, no desde la ubicacion exacta ni desde las rutas efectivas de cada persona.

# Bloque 11 - Auditoria OSM: urbanidad, servicios y equipamiento disponible

## Pregunta

Que variables OSM tenemos realmente disponibles para aproximar urbanidad,
servicios, centralidad o equipamiento? Y con esas variables, que indices simples
seria metodologicamente defendible construir?

Antes de usar OSM como proxy de urbanidad conviene separar lo que OSM podria
contener en teoria de lo que la matriz trae hoy. En la matriz actual hay un
subconjunto acotado de densidades OSM estandarizadas (`_z`) para origen habitual
y actividad habitual. No hay, por ahora, un inventario amplio de comercio,
servicios o finanzas.

```{python}
    schema_names = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    rows = []
    for geo_prefix, geo_label, zone_col in OSM_GEOS:

                    "index_candidate": index_candidate,
```

```{python}
#| label: block11-osm-distribution-audit
print("label: block11-osm-distribution-audit")


def osm_zone_support_table(lf: pl.LazyFrame, metadata_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    schema_names = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    for row in metadata_df.itertuples(index=False):
        if row.zone_col not in schema_names:
            continue
        zone_values = (
            lf.select(
                [
                    pl.col(row.zone_col).cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zone_id"),
                    pl.col(row.variable).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).alias("value"),
                ]
            )
            .drop_nulls(["zone_id", "value"])
            .unique()
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            .dropna(subset=["value"])
        )
        rows.append(
            {
                "variable": row.variable,
                "n_zones_valid": int(len(zone_values)),
                "n_zones_z_positive": int((zone_values["value"] > 0).sum()),
                "share_zones_z_positive": float((zone_values["value"] > 0).mean()) if len(zone_values) else np.nan,
                "zone_p10_z": float(zone_values["value"].quantile(0.10)) if len(zone_values) else np.nan,
                "zone_p50_z": float(zone_values["value"].quantile(0.50)) if len(zone_values) else np.nan,
                "zone_p90_z": float(zone_values["value"].quantile(0.90)) if len(zone_values) else np.nan,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def osm_median_profile(summary_df: pd.DataFrame, metadata_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    meta_by_variable = metadata_df.set_index("variable")
    rows = []
    for variable in summary_df["variable"].drop_duplicates():
        part = summary_df.loc[summary_df["variable"] == variable].set_index("payment_group")
        if not set(PAYMENT_ORDER).issubset(part.index):
            continue
        meta = meta_by_variable.loc[variable]
        rows.append(
            {
                "geography_label": meta["geography_label"],
                "category": meta["category"],
                "variable_label": meta["variable_label"],
                "variable": variable,
                "median_bip_z": float(part.loc["BIP", "median"]),
                "median_qr_z": float(part.loc["QR", "median"]),
                "diff_qr_bip_z": float(part.loc["QR", "median"]) - float(part.loc["BIP", "median"]),
                "mean_bip_z": float(part.loc["BIP", "mean"]),
                "mean_qr_z": float(part.loc["QR", "mean"]),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


osm_summary = matrix_feature_summary_for_lazyframe(
    lf_cards,
    universe="alta_n3",
    label="Alta, n>=3",
    variables=OSM_PROFILE_VARS,
)
osm_zone_support = osm_zone_support_table(lf_cards, osm_variable_audit)
osm_median_summary = osm_median_profile(osm_summary, osm_variable_audit).merge(
    osm_zone_support,
    on="variable",
    how="left",
)

display(
    osm_median_summary[
        [
            "geography_label",
            "category",
            "variable_label",
            "median_bip_z",
            "median_qr_z",
            "diff_qr_bip_z",
            "mean_bip_z",
            "mean_qr_z",
            "n_zones_valid",
            "n_zones_z_positive",
            "share_zones_z_positive",
            "zone_p10_z",
            "zone_p50_z",
            "zone_p90_z",
        ]
    ].style.format(
        {
            "median_bip_z": "{:+.2f}",
            "median_qr_z": "{:+.2f}",
            "diff_qr_bip_z": "{:+.2f}",
            "mean_bip_z": "{:+.2f}",
            "mean_qr_z": "{:+.2f}",
            "n_zones_valid": fmt_int,
            "n_zones_z_positive": fmt_int,
            "share_zones_z_positive": "{:.1%}",
            "zone_p10_z": "{:+.2f}",
            "zone_p50_z": "{:+.2f}",
```

```{python}
#| label: block11-osm-correlation-audit
print("label: block11-osm-correlation-audit")

OSM_CORRELATION_VARS = [
    ("res_eod2012_income_percentile", "Ranking ingreso mediano residencial"),
    ("res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy", "Concentracion D+E proxy residencial"),
    ("res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro", "Educacion universitaria+ residencial"),
    ("res_age_share_25_44", "% poblacion 25-44 residencial"),
    ("res_age_share_60_mas", "% poblacion 60+ residencial"),
]

ORIGIN_MACROZONE_DUMMIES = [
    ("origin_top1_macro_centro", "Centro"),
    ("origin_top1_macro_oriente", "Oriente"),
    ("origin_top1_macro_poniente", "Poniente"),
    ("origin_top1_macro_norte", "Norte"),
    ("origin_top1_macro_sur", "Sur"),
    ("origin_top1_macro_suroriente", "Suroriente"),
    ("origin_top1_macro_externa_especial", "Externa / especial"),
]


def osm_correlation_table(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    schema_names = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    corr_vars = [col for col, _ in OSM_CORRELATION_VARS if col in schema_names]
    select_exprs = [
        pl.col(row.variable).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).alias(row.variable)
        for row in osm_variable_audit.itertuples(index=False)
    ]
    select_exprs.extend(
        [pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).alias(col) for col in corr_vars]
    )
    df = lf.select(select_exprs).collect().to_pandas().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    rows = []
    label_by_corr_var = dict(OSM_CORRELATION_VARS)
    label_by_osm_var = osm_variable_audit.set_index("variable")["variable_label"].to_dict()
    geo_by_osm_var = osm_variable_audit.set_index("variable")["geography_label"].to_dict()
    for osm_var in label_by_osm_var:
        for corr_var in corr_vars:
            pair = df[[osm_var, corr_var]].dropna()
            rows.append(
                {
                    "geography_label": geo_by_osm_var[osm_var],
                    "osm_variable": label_by_osm_var[osm_var],
                    "correlation_with": label_by_corr_var[corr_var],
                    "n": len(pair),
                    "pearson_r": float(pair[osm_var].corr(pair[corr_var], method="pearson")) if len(pair) >= 2 else np.nan,
                    "spearman_r": float(pair[osm_var].corr(pair[corr_var], method="spearman")) if len(pair) >= 2 else np.nan,
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def osm_origin_macrozone_spread(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    schema_names = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    origin_osm_vars = osm_variable_audit.loc[
        osm_variable_audit["geography"] == "origin_top1", "variable"
    ].tolist()
    dummy_cols = [col for col, _ in ORIGIN_MACROZONE_DUMMIES if col in schema_names]
    if not origin_osm_vars or not dummy_cols:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    df = (
        lf.select(
            [
                *[pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).alias(col) for col in origin_osm_vars],
                *[pl.col(col).cast(pl.Int8, strict=False).alias(col) for col in dummy_cols],
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
        .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    )
    dummy_label = dict(ORIGIN_MACROZONE_DUMMIES)
    df["origin_macrozone"] = np.nan
    for col in dummy_cols:
        df.loc[df[col] == 1, "origin_macrozone"] = dummy_label[col]
    df = df.dropna(subset=["origin_macrozone"]).copy()

    rows = []
    label_by_osm_var = osm_variable_audit.set_index("variable")["variable_label"].to_dict()
    for osm_var in origin_osm_vars:
        macro_means = df.groupby("origin_macrozone")[osm_var].mean().dropna()
        if macro_means.empty:
            continue
        rows.append(
            {
                "osm_variable": label_by_osm_var[osm_var],
                "macrozone_highest_mean": macro_means.idxmax(),
                "highest_mean_z": float(macro_means.max()),
                "macrozone_lowest_mean": macro_means.idxmin(),
                "lowest_mean_z": float(macro_means.min()),
                "macrozone_spread_z": float(macro_means.max() - macro_means.min()),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


osm_correlations = osm_correlation_table(lf_cards)
osm_correlations_display = (
    osm_correlations.assign(abs_spearman=lambda df: df["spearman_r"].abs())
    .sort_values(["abs_spearman", "geography_label"], ascending=[False, True])
    .drop(columns="abs_spearman")
    .head(20)
)
osm_macrozone_spread = osm_origin_macrozone_spread(lf_cards)

display(
    osm_correlations_display.style.format(
        {
            "n": fmt_int,
            "pearson_r": "{:+.2f}",
            "spearman_r": "{:+.2f}",
        }
    )
)

display(
    osm_macrozone_spread.style.format(
        {
            "highest_mean_z": "{:+.2f}",
            "lowest_mean_z": "{:+.2f}",
            "macrozone_spread_z": "{:.2f}",
        }
    )
)
```

**Finding descriptivo.** La matriz actual no permite construir todavia un bloque
OSM completo de urbanidad, comercio o finanzas. Lo disponible sirve para auditar
un subconjunto de equipamiento e infraestructura OSM en origen habitual y
actividad habitual. Por lo tanto, cualquier indice construido con estas columnas
debe nombrarse de forma acotada, por ejemplo `equipamiento urbano OSM disponible`
o `conectividad/equipamiento OSM`, no `urbanidad total`.

Si queremos probar la hipotesis mas amplia de accesibilidad digital o centralidad
urbana, el siguiente paso metodologico debiese ser enriquecer la matriz con
categorias OSM comerciales, de servicios y financieras, o declarar
explicitamente que ese componente queda fuera de esta version del EDA.

# Bloque 12 - Inventario OSM crudo: tags potencialmente no usados

## Pregunta

Que habia en el OSM crudo que no llego a la matriz actual de usuarios? Este
bloque no modifica ningun modelo ni reconstruye variables. Solo audita los
inventarios OSM ya materializados para saber si existen familias de tags que
podrian justificar una especificacion aumentada posterior.

La distincion metodologica es importante:

- los modelos anteriores siguen siendo la especificacion base con la matriz
  conocida;
- cualquier variable OSM adicional seria parte de una nueva especificacion
  `base + OSM ampliado`;
- por lo tanto, explorar OSM crudo no invalida los modelos anteriores, pero si
  obliga a reportar claramente que set de variables usa cada resultado.

```{python}
#| label: block12-osm-raw-inventory

        .when(pl.col("key").is_in(["landuse", "building", "place"]))
        .then(pl.lit("uso de suelo / estructura urbana"))

        .alias("macro_family")

)

display(
```

```{python}
def classify_osm_raw_tag(key: str, value: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if key == "shop" and value != "yes":
        return "Comercio / servicios", "densidad_comercial_servicios"
    if key == "amenity" and value in OSM_COMMERCIAL_AMENITIES:
        return "Comercio / servicios", "densidad_comercial_servicios"
    if key == "amenity" and value in OSM_FINANCIAL_AMENITIES:
        return "Servicios financieros", "densidad_financiera"
    if key == "amenity" and value in OSM_HEALTH_CARE_AMENITIES:
        return "Salud / cuidado", "equipamiento_actividad_urbana"
    if key == "amenity" and value in OSM_EDUCATION_AMENITIES:
        return "Educacion / equipamiento", "equipamiento_actividad_urbana"
    if key == "amenity" and value in OSM_CIVIC_AMENITIES:
        return "Servicios civicos", "equipamiento_actividad_urbana"
    if key == "amenity" and value in OSM_MOBILITY_AMENITIES:
        return "Movilidad / soporte urbano", "conectividad_transporte"
    if key in {"public_transport", "railway"}:
        return "Transporte publico", "conectividad_transporte"
    if key == "leisure":
        return "Espacio publico / deporte", "equipamiento_actividad_urbana"
    if key == "office" and value != "yes":
        return "Oficinas / actividad laboral", "densidad_comercial_servicios"
    if key == "landuse" and value in {"commercial", "retail", "industrial", "residential"}:
        return "Uso de suelo urbano", "contexto_urbano"
    if key == "landuse":
        return "Uso de suelo / otros", "contexto_urbano"
    return "Otros / revisar", "fuera_de_indice_inicial"


osm_tagvalue_candidates = (
    osm_tagvalue_screening
    .with_columns(
        pl.struct(["key", "value"]).map_elements(
            lambda s: classify_osm_raw_tag(s["key"], s["value"])[0],
            return_dtype=pl.String,
        ).alias("familia_interpretable"),
        pl.struct(["key", "value"]).map_elements(
            lambda s: classify_osm_raw_tag(s["key"], s["value"])[1],
            return_dtype=pl.String,
        ).alias("indice_candidato"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.when(
            (pl.col("passes_shortlist_screen"))
            & (pl.col("indice_candidato") != "fuera_de_indice_inicial")
            & (pl.col("n_objects_inventory") >= 100)
            & (pl.col("n_zonas_with_presence") >= 50)
        )
        .then(pl.lit("candidato_fuerte"))
        .when(
            (pl.col("passes_shortlist_screen"))
            & (pl.col("indice_candidato") != "fuera_de_indice_inicial")
        )
        .then(pl.lit("candidato_debil_o_contextual"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("no_priorizar"))
        .alias("prioridad_para_matriz_aumentada")
    )
)

osm_candidate_family_summary = (
    osm_tagvalue_candidates
    .group_by(["indice_candidato", "familia_interpretable"])
    .agg(
        pl.len().alias("n_tag_values_auditados"),
        pl.col("passes_shortlist_screen").sum().alias("n_tag_values_keep"),
        pl.col("n_objects_inventory").sum().alias("n_objects_sum"),
        pl.col("n_zonas_with_presence").max().alias("max_zonas_with_presence"),
        pl.col("pct_zonas_with_presence").median().alias("median_pct_zonas_with_presence"),
        (pl.col("prioridad_para_matriz_aumentada") == "candidato_fuerte").sum().alias("n_candidatos_fuertes"),
    )
    .sort(["indice_candidato", "n_objects_sum"], descending=[False, True])
)

osm_candidate_top = (
    osm_tagvalue_candidates
    .filter(pl.col("prioridad_para_matriz_aumentada") != "no_priorizar")
    .sort(["indice_candidato", "n_objects_inventory"], descending=[False, True])
    .select(
        [
            "indice_candidato",
            "familia_interpretable",
            "key",
            "value",
            "n_objects_inventory",
            "n_zonas_with_presence",
            "pct_zonas_with_presence",
            "screening_decision",
            "prioridad_para_matriz_aumentada",
        ]
    )
)

display(
    osm_candidate_family_summary.to_pandas().style.format(
        {
            "n_tag_values_auditados": fmt_int,
            "n_tag_values_keep": fmt_int,
            "n_objects_sum": fmt_int,
            "max_zonas_with_presence": fmt_int,
            "median_pct_zonas_with_presence": "{:.1f}%",
            "n_candidatos_fuertes": fmt_int,
        }
    )
)

display(
    osm_candidate_top.head(60).to_pandas().style.format(
        {
            "n_objects_inventory": fmt_int,
            "n_zonas_with_presence": fmt_int,
            "pct_zonas_with_presence": "{:.1f}%",
        }
    )
)
```

```{python}
def summarize_candidate_tags(index_name: str, max_tags: int = 12) -> str:
    rows = (
        osm_candidate_top
        .filter(pl.col("indice_candidato") == index_name)
        .sort("n_objects_inventory", descending=True)
        .head(max_tags)
        .select(["key", "value", "n_objects_inventory", "n_zonas_with_presence"])
        .to_dicts()
    )
    if not rows:
        return "Sin candidatos suficientes en inventario actual."
    return "; ".join(
        f"{r['key']}={r['value']} (n={r['n_objects_inventory']:,}, zonas={r['n_zonas_with_presence']:,})"
        for r in rows
    )
```

**Finding descriptivo.** El OSM crudo si contiene familias que no llegaron a la
matriz actual, en particular comercio/servicios (`shop=*`, restaurantes,
farmacias, oficinas) y servicios financieros (`amenity=bank`, `amenity=atm`).
Esto no invalida los modelos anteriores: esos modelos quedan como
especificacion base. Lo que si abre es una especificacion posterior
`base + OSM ampliado`, que deberia construirse de forma controlada con pocos
indices agregados y no con cientos de tags sueltos.

La decision metodologica recomendada es no usar estos tags todavia como hechos
explicativos. Primero habria que agregarlos por zona, estandarizarlos con el
mismo criterio de la matriz, revisar correlaciones con ingreso/educacion/
macrozona y solo despues probar si mejoran el EDA o el modelo de adopcion QR.

## Sub-bloque exploratorio: especificacion `base + OSM ampliado`

Este sub-bloque abre una especificacion exploratoria, pero todavia no cambia la
matriz base. La idea es separar tres decisiones que no conviene mezclar:

1. que familias OSM tienen sentido conceptual para adopcion QR;
2. en que geografia deben leerse: residencia, origen habitual o actividad
   habitual;
3. como transformarlas para que no se conviertan en cientos de tags sueltos.

La regla es simple: si se prueban estas variables mas adelante, deben entrar
como una especificacion nueva (`base + OSM ampliado`) y compararse contra la
base. No reemplazan los resultados anteriores.

forma consistente y auditadas contra ingreso, educacion y macrozona antes de
usar los resultados como evidencia descriptiva o predictiva.


## 12c. Infraestructura financiera fisica OSM

Partimos por el primer sub-bloque de OSM ampliado: infraestructura financiera
fisica. El objetivo no es medir bancarizacion ni acceso digital individual, sino
auditar si las tarjetas QR aparecen mas asociadas a zonas con presencia fisica
de bancos, cajeros o casas de cambio registradas en OSM.

Por ahora se prueba solo en dos geografias:

- `zona_hogar`: entorno residencial inferido de la tarjeta.
- `origin_zone_top1`: zona donde la tarjeta suele iniciar viajes.

```{python}
def load_zona777_geometries_lonlat(path: Path = ZONAS777_SHP) -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    """Carga zonas en lon/lat para joins con OSM crudo.

    El shapefile no trae CRS declarado, pero sus bounds estan en grados
    lon/lat. Por eso este bloque usa EPSG:4326 localmente y calcula areas en
    EPSG:32719 solo para densidades.
    """

    zones = gpd.read_file(path)
    zones = zones.set_crs("EPSG:4326", allow_override=True)
    # `ID` es un identificador interno de feature; viajes y modelos usan ZONA777.
    zones["zone_id"] = pd.to_numeric(zones["ZONA777"], errors="raise").astype(int)
    zones = zones.dissolve(
        by="zone_id",
        aggfunc={
            "COMUNA": "first",
            "MACROZONA": "first",
            "NMACROZONA": "first",
        },
    ).reset_index()
    return zones
```

### QA espacial antes de auditar OSM financiero

Antes de interpretar cualquier metrica OSM conviene validar que las coordenadas,
el CRS asumido y el `spatial join` esten funcionando. Esta celda revisa cuatro
cosas: rangos de coordenadas, transformacion ida/vuelta, cobertura del join y
posibles objetos OSM asignados a mas de una zona.

```{python}
def load_financial_osm_points_lonlat(osm_path: Path = OSM_AMENITY_RAW_PATH) -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    osm = gpd.read_parquet(osm_path)
    if osm.crs is None:
        osm = osm.set_crs("EPSG:4326", allow_override=True)
    else:
        osm = osm.to_crs("EPSG:4326")

    financial = osm.loc[osm["amenity"].isin(OSM_FINANCIAL_VALUES)].copy()
    financial = financial.dropna(subset=["geometry"]).copy()
    financial["osm_uid"] = financial["element"].astype(str) + "/" + financial["id"].astype(str)
    return financial


def spatial_join_qa_osm_financial(
    zones_path: Path = ZONAS777_SHP,
    osm_path: Path = OSM_AMENITY_RAW_PATH,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, gpd.GeoDataFrame, pd.DataFrame, gpd.GeoDataFrame, gpd.GeoDataFrame, gpd.GeoDataFrame]:
    zones_lonlat = load_zona777_geometries_lonlat(zones_path)
    zones_metric = zones_lonlat.to_crs("EPSG:32719")
    area_km2 = zones_metric.geometry.area / 1_000_000
    financial = load_financial_osm_points_lonlat(osm_path)

    zone_bounds = zones_lonlat.total_bounds
    point_bounds = financial.total_bounds if len(financial) else [np.nan, np.nan, np.nan, np.nan]
    point_bbox = financial.geometry.bounds
    points_inside_zone_bbox = (
        (point_bbox["maxx"] >= zone_bounds[0])
        & (point_bbox["minx"] <= zone_bounds[2])
        & (point_bbox["maxy"] >= zone_bounds[1])
        & (point_bbox["miny"] <= zone_bounds[3])
    )

    joined_raw = gpd.sjoin(
        financial[["osm_uid", "amenity", "name", "geometry"]],
        zones_lonlat[["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "geometry"]],
        how="left",
        predicate="intersects",
    )
    joined_matches = joined_raw.dropna(subset=["zone_id"]).copy()
    joined_unique = joined_matches["osm_uid"].nunique()
    unmatched = financial.loc[~financial["osm_uid"].isin(joined_matches["osm_uid"])].copy()
    multijoin_counts = (
        joined_matches.groupby("osm_uid")
        .agg(n_zone_matches=("zone_id", "nunique"), amenity=("amenity", "first"), name=("name", "first"))
        .query("n_zone_matches > 1")
        .sort_values("n_zone_matches", ascending=False)
        .reset_index()
    )

    reps = zones_lonlat[["zone_id", "geometry"]].copy()
    reps["geometry"] = reps.geometry.representative_point()
    reps_roundtrip = reps.to_crs("EPSG:32719").to_crs("EPSG:4326")
    max_roundtrip_lon_error = float(np.max(np.abs(reps_roundtrip.geometry.x.to_numpy() - reps.geometry.x.to_numpy())))
    max_roundtrip_lat_error = float(np.max(np.abs(reps_roundtrip.geometry.y.to_numpy() - reps.geometry.y.to_numpy())))

    qa_summary = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "check": "Zonas: CRS asumido para join",
                "value": str(zones_lonlat.crs),
                "lectura": "Debe ser EPSG:4326 porque los bounds estan en lon/lat.",
            },
            {
                "check": "Zonas: bounds lon/lat",
                "value": f"[{zone_bounds[0]:.3f}, {zone_bounds[1]:.3f}, {zone_bounds[2]:.3f}, {zone_bounds[3]:.3f}]",
                "lectura": "Debe lucir como Santiago en grados, no como metros UTM.",
            },
            {
                "check": "OSM financiero: bounds lon/lat",
                "value": f"[{point_bounds[0]:.3f}, {point_bounds[1]:.3f}, {point_bounds[2]:.3f}, {point_bounds[3]:.3f}]",
                "lectura": "Debe estar en el mismo rango de coordenadas que ZONA777.",
            },
            {
                "check": "OSM financiero: objetos crudos",
                "value": f"{len(financial):,}",
                "lectura": "Bancos, cajeros y casas de cambio antes del join.",
            },
            {
                "check": "OSM financiero: dentro del bbox de zonas",
                "value": f"{points_inside_zone_bbox.sum():,} ({points_inside_zone_bbox.mean():.1%})",
                "lectura": "Chequeo grueso antes del point-in-polygon.",
            },
            {
                "check": "Spatial join: objetos asignados a alguna zona",
                "value": f"{joined_unique:,} ({joined_unique / max(len(financial), 1):.1%})",
                "lectura": "Si cae fuerte, probablemente hay problema de CRS o cobertura territorial.",
            },
            {
                "check": "Spatial join: objetos sin zona",
                "value": f"{len(unmatched):,}",
                "lectura": "Puede ocurrir fuera de ZONA777; revisar si no es cero.",
            },
            {
                "check": "Spatial join: objetos con multiples zonas",
                "value": f"{len(multijoin_counts):,}",
                "lectura": "Suele pasar en bordes; luego se deduplica por osm_uid.",
            },
            {
                "check": "Roundtrip CRS max error lon",
                "value": f"{max_roundtrip_lon_error:.2e}",
                "lectura": "Transformar EPSG:4326 -> EPSG:32719 -> EPSG:4326 no debe mover puntos.",
            },
            {
                "check": "Roundtrip CRS max error lat",
                "value": f"{max_roundtrip_lat_error:.2e}",
                "lectura": "Transformar EPSG:4326 -> EPSG:32719 -> EPSG:4326 no debe mover puntos.",
            },
        ]
    )

    area_summary = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "metric": "area_km2",
                "min": area_km2.min(),
                "p01": area_km2.quantile(0.01),
                "p50": area_km2.quantile(0.50),
                "p99": area_km2.quantile(0.99),
                "max": area_km2.max(),
            }
        ]
    )

    return qa_summary, area_summary, unmatched, multijoin_counts, joined_raw, zones_lonlat, financial


(
    financial_spatial_qa,
    financial_area_qa,
    financial_unmatched_osm,
    financial_multijoin_osm,
    financial_spatial_join_raw,
    financial_zones_lonlat_qa,
    financial_points_lonlat_qa,
) = spatial_join_qa_osm_financial()

display(financial_spatial_qa.style.hide(axis="index"))
display(financial_area_qa.style.hide(axis="index").format("{:.3f}", subset=["min", "p01", "p50", "p99", "max"]))

if len(financial_unmatched_osm):
    display(
        financial_unmatched_osm[["osm_uid", "amenity", "name"]]
        .head(10)
        .style.hide(axis="index")
```

### Construccion del indice zonal

```{python}
def build_osm_financial_zone_index(
    osm_path: Path = OSM_AMENITY_RAW_PATH,
    zones_path: Path = ZONAS777_SHP,
) -> tuple[gpd.GeoDataFrame, gpd.GeoDataFrame]:
    zones_lonlat = load_zona777_geometries_lonlat(zones_path)
    zones_area = zones_lonlat.to_crs("EPSG:32719")
    zones_lonlat["area_km2"] = zones_area.geometry.area / 1_000_000

    financial = load_financial_osm_points_lonlat(osm_path)

    joined = gpd.sjoin(
        financial[["osm_uid", "amenity", "name", "geometry"]],
        zones_lonlat[["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "geometry"]],
        how="inner",
        predicate="intersects",
    )
    joined = joined.sort_values(["osm_uid", "zone_id"]).drop_duplicates("osm_uid")

    counts = (
        joined.groupby(["zone_id", "amenity"])
        .size()
        .unstack(fill_value=0)
        .rename(columns={value: f"n_{value}" for value in OSM_FINANCIAL_VALUES})
        .reset_index()
    )

    zone_index = zones_lonlat[["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "area_km2", "geometry"]].copy()
    zone_index = zone_index.merge(counts, on="zone_id", how="left")
    for value in OSM_FINANCIAL_VALUES:
        col = f"n_{value}"
        if col not in zone_index.columns:
            zone_index[col] = 0
        zone_index[col] = zone_index[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    count_cols = [f"n_{value}" for value in OSM_FINANCIAL_VALUES]
    zone_index["n_financial_points"] = zone_index[count_cols].sum(axis=1)
    zone_index["has_financial_osm"] = zone_index["n_financial_points"] > 0
    zone_index["financial_density_km2"] = zone_index["n_financial_points"] / zone_index["area_km2"].replace(0, np.nan)
    zone_index["financial_density_km2"] = zone_index["financial_density_km2"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    zone_index["financial_density_log1p"] = np.log1p(zone_index["financial_density_km2"])

    cap = zone_index["financial_density_log1p"].quantile(0.995)
    zone_index["financial_density_log1p_w"] = zone_index["financial_density_log1p"].clip(upper=cap)
    std = zone_index["financial_density_log1p_w"].std(ddof=0)
    if std and not np.isnan(std):
        zone_index["financial_index_z"] = (
            zone_index["financial_density_log1p_w"] - zone_index["financial_density_log1p_w"].mean()
        ) / std
    else:
        zone_index["financial_index_z"] = 0.0
    zone_index["financial_index_percentile"] = zone_index["financial_density_log1p_w"].rank(method="average", pct=True)

    return zone_index, joined


financial_zone_index_gdf, financial_osm_joined_gdf = build_osm_financial_zone_index()

financial_tag_coverage = (
```

```{python}
def plot_financial_osm_zone_map(financial_gdf: gpd.GeoDataFrame) -> None:
    plot_gdf = financial_gdf.copy()
```

```{python}
def add_financial_osm_features_to_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    zone_index: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    feature_cols = [
        "zone_id",
        "n_financial_points",
        "financial_density_km2",
        "financial_density_log1p",
        "financial_index_z",
        "financial_index_percentile",
        "has_financial_osm",
    ]
    zone_pdf = pd.DataFrame(zone_index[feature_cols].drop(columns="geometry", errors="ignore"))

    out = lf
    for prefix, _, zone_col, _ in OSM_FINANCIAL_GEOS:
        rename_map = {
            "zone_id": zone_col,
            "n_financial_points": f"{prefix}_fin_n_points",
            "financial_density_km2": f"{prefix}_fin_density_km2",
            "financial_density_log1p": f"{prefix}_fin_density_log1p",
            "financial_index_z": f"{prefix}_fin_index_z",
            "financial_index_percentile": f"{prefix}_fin_index_percentile",
            "has_financial_osm": f"{prefix}_fin_has_presence",
        }
        geo_pdf = zone_pdf.rename(columns=rename_map)
        out = out.join(pl.from_pandas(geo_pdf).lazy(), on=zone_col, how="left")
    return out


lf_cards_financial = add_financial_osm_features_to_lazyframe(lf_cards, financial_zone_index_gdf)


def financial_card_coverage_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    total_cards = int(lf.select(pl.len()).collect().item())
    for prefix, label, zone_col, _ in OSM_FINANCIAL_GEOS:
        n_col = f"{prefix}_fin_n_points"
        has_col = f"{prefix}_fin_has_presence"
        stats = (
            lf.select(
                [
                    pl.col(zone_col).is_not_null().sum().alias("n_with_zone"),
                    pl.col(n_col).is_not_null().sum().alias("n_with_financial_value"),
                    pl.col(has_col).cast(pl.Int8, strict=False).sum().alias("n_with_financial_presence"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").filter(pl.col(has_col) == True).mean().alias("qr_share_with_presence"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").filter(pl.col(has_col) == False).mean().alias("qr_share_without_presence"),
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_dicts()[0]
        )
        rows.append(
            {
                "geography": label,
                "zone_column": zone_col,
                "n_cards": total_cards,
                **stats,
                "share_with_zone": stats["n_with_zone"] / total_cards,
                "share_with_financial_value": stats["n_with_financial_value"] / total_cards,
                "share_with_financial_presence": stats["n_with_financial_presence"] / total_cards,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
```

#### Presencia, ausencia y missing

Antes de leer quintiles o indices continuos conviene separar tres estados. Esto
evita confundir una zona sin infraestructura financiera OSM con una zona que no
quedo cubierta por el indice.

```{python}
FINANCIAL_STATE_ORDER = [
    "Con presencia financiera OSM",
    "Sin presencia financiera OSM, zona cubierta",
    "Sin valor / missing",
]


def financial_presence_state_summary_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    lf_aug = add_payment_group(lf)
    global_qr = float(lf_aug.select(pl.col("is_qr").mean()).collect().item())

    for prefix, geo_label, zone_col, _ in OSM_FINANCIAL_GEOS:
        n_col = f"{prefix}_fin_n_points"
        has_col = f"{prefix}_fin_has_presence"

        state_expr = (
            pl.when(pl.col(n_col).is_null())
            .then(pl.lit("Sin valor / missing"))
            .when(pl.col(has_col).fill_null(False))
            .then(pl.lit("Con presencia financiera OSM"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("Sin presencia financiera OSM, zona cubierta"))
            .alias("financial_state")
        )

        state_df = (
            lf_aug.with_columns(state_expr)
            .group_by("financial_state")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    (pl.col("payment_group") == "BIP").sum().alias("n_bip"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").sum().alias("n_qr"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
                    pl.col(zone_col).is_not_null().mean().alias("share_with_zone"),
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        state_df["geography"] = geo_label
        state_df["zone_column"] = zone_col
        state_df["global_qr_share"] = global_qr
        rows.append(state_df)

    out = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    totals = out.groupby("geography")["n_cards"].transform("sum")
    out["card_share"] = out["n_cards"] / totals
    out["delta_pp"] = (out["qr_share"] - out["global_qr_share"]) * 100
    out["financial_state"] = pd.Categorical(
        out["financial_state"],
        categories=FINANCIAL_STATE_ORDER,
        ordered=True,
    )
    return out.sort_values(["geography", "financial_state"]).reset_index(drop=True)


financial_presence_state_summary = financial_presence_state_summary_for_lazyframe(lf_cards_financial)

display(
    financial_presence_state_summary[
        [
            "geography",
            "financial_state",
            "n_cards",
            "n_bip",
            "n_qr",
            "card_share",
            "qr_share",
            "delta_pp",
            "share_with_zone",
        ]
    ].style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": lambda x: fmt_int(x),
            "n_bip": lambda x: fmt_int(x),
            "n_qr": lambda x: fmt_int(x),
            "card_share": "{:.1%}",
            "qr_share": "{:.1%}",
            "delta_pp": "{:+.1f}",
            "share_with_zone": "{:.1%}",
        }
    )
```

```{python}
def plot_financial_presence_state_summary(summary_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    plot_df = summary_df.copy()
    plot_df["state_short"] = plot_df["financial_state"].map(
        {
            "Con presencia financiera OSM": "Con presencia\nfinanciera",
            "Sin presencia financiera OSM, zona cubierta": "Sin presencia,\nzona cubierta",
            "Sin valor / missing": "Sin valor /\nmissing",
        }
    )
    state_colors = {
        "Con presencia financiera OSM": PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
        "Sin presencia financiera OSM, zona cubierta": "#D9CDB8",
        "Sin valor / missing": "#B7B0A4",
    }

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.8, 5.4), sharey=True, facecolor=FIG_BG)
    global_qr = float(plot_df["global_qr_share"].dropna().iloc[0])

    for ax, (_, geo_label, _, _) in zip(axes, OSM_FINANCIAL_GEOS):
        geo_df = plot_df.loc[plot_df["geography"] == geo_label].copy()
        geo_df = geo_df.sort_values("financial_state")
        x = np.arange(len(geo_df))

        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        bars = ax.bar(
            x,
            geo_df["qr_share"],
            color=[state_colors[str(state)] for state in geo_df["financial_state"]],
            edgecolor="#F8F3E8",
            linewidth=1.4,
            width=0.62,
            zorder=3,
        )
        ax.axhline(global_qr, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2, zorder=2)
        ax.text(
            len(geo_df) - 0.05,
            global_qr,
            f"global {global_qr:.1%}",
            va="center",
            ha="right",
            fontsize=8.8,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
            fontweight="bold",
            bbox=dict(facecolor=AX_BG, edgecolor="none", pad=1.0),
            zorder=4,
        )

        for bar, (_, row) in zip(bars, geo_df.iterrows()):
            ax.text(
                bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
                row["qr_share"] + 0.004,
                f"{row['qr_share']:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=9,
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
                fontweight="bold",
            )
            ax.text(
                bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
                row["qr_share"] - 0.012,
                f"{row['card_share']:.1%} tarj.",
                ha="center",
                va="top",
                fontsize=8,
                color=MUTED_TEXT,
            )

        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(geo_df["state_short"], fontsize=8.8)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0, decimals=0))
        ax.set_title(geo_label, fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_ylim(0.11, 0.18)
        ax.set_xlabel("Estado de la zona en el indice financiero OSM")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Share QR dentro del estado")
    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Presencia financiera OSM y adopcion QR",
        "Separamos presencia, ausencia cubierta y missing antes de interpretar indices o quintiles.",
        y=0.96,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.035,
        "Nota: presencia = al menos un banco, cajero o casa de cambio OSM en la zona. Los porcentajes bajo cada barra muestran soporte relativo de tarjetas.",
        ha="center",
        fontsize=8.8,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    plt.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.97, top=0.78, bottom=0.24, wspace=0.16)
    plt.show()


plot_financial_presence_state_summary(financial_presence_state_summary)
```

**Finding descriptivo.** Esta celda no prueba causalidad ni acceso digital
individual. Solo verifica si la presencia fisica de bancos, cajeros o casas de
cambio en OSM separa grupos con mayor o menor adopcion QR. Si la brecha entre
"con presencia" y "sin presencia, zona cubierta" es pequena, el indice
financiero deberia leerse como una variable de contexto urbano acotada, no como
una senal fuerte por si sola.

```{python}
    ("res_age_share_25_44", "% poblacion 25-44 residencial"),
    ("res_age_share_60_mas", "% poblacion 60+ residencial"),
    ("res_prom_edad_z", "Edad promedio residencial z"),
]


def financial_correlation_audit_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    schema = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    available_vars = [(col, label) for col, label in FINANCIAL_CORRELATION_VARS if col in schema]
    select_cols = [col for col, _ in available_vars]
    select_cols += [f"{prefix}_fin_index_z" for prefix, _, _, _ in OSM_FINANCIAL_GEOS]

    df = lf.select([pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).alias(col) for col in select_cols]).collect().to_pandas()
    rows = []
    for prefix, geo_label, _, _ in OSM_FINANCIAL_GEOS:
        fin_col = f"{prefix}_fin_index_z"
        for col, label in available_vars:
            tmp = df[[fin_col, col]].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
            rows.append(
                {
                    "geography": geo_label,
                    "financial_metric": "Indice financiero OSM z",
                    "context_variable": label,
                    "n": len(tmp),
                    "pearson_r": tmp[fin_col].corr(tmp[col], method="pearson") if len(tmp) > 1 else np.nan,
                    "spearman_r": tmp[fin_col].corr(tmp[col], method="spearman") if len(tmp) > 1 else np.nan,
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def financial_macrozone_audit_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for prefix, geo_label, _, macro_prefix in OSM_FINANCIAL_GEOS:
        index_col = f"{prefix}_fin_index_z"
        has_col = f"{prefix}_fin_has_presence"
        macro_df = (
            lf.with_columns(territorial_macrozone_expr(macro_prefix).alias("macrozona"))
            .filter(pl.col("macrozona").is_not_null())
            .group_by("macrozona")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
                    pl.col(index_col).mean().alias("mean_fin_index_z"),
                    pl.col(index_col).median().alias("median_fin_index_z"),
                    pl.col(has_col).mean().alias("share_with_financial_presence"),
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        macro_df["geography"] = geo_label
        rows.append(macro_df)
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)


financial_correlation_audit = financial_correlation_audit_for_lazyframe(lf_cards_financial)
```

```{python}
def plot_financial_quintile_grid(summary_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.6), sharey=True, facecolor=FIG_BG)
    global_qr = float(summary_df["global_qr_share"].dropna().iloc[0])

    for ax, (_, geo_label, _, _) in zip(axes, OSM_FINANCIAL_GEOS):
        plot_df = summary_df.loc[summary_df["geography"] == geo_label].copy()
        plot_df["x"] = np.arange(len(plot_df))
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")
        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

        ymin = max(0.08, min(plot_df["qr_share"].min(), global_qr) - 0.035)
        ymax = min(0.24, max(plot_df["qr_share"].max(), global_qr) + 0.045)
        ax.set_ylim(ymin, ymax)

        bar_base = ymin
        bar_height = (ymax - ymin) * 0.10
        ax.bar(
            plot_df["x"],
            plot_df["card_share"] * bar_height / plot_df["card_share"].max(),
            bottom=bar_base,
            width=0.62,
            color="#d9cdb8",
            edgecolor="#c2b49e",
            alpha=0.55,
            zorder=1,
        )

        ax.plot(
            plot_df["x"],
            plot_df["qr_share"],
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            linewidth=2.4,
            marker="o",
            markersize=7,
            markeredgecolor="white",
            markeredgewidth=1,
            zorder=3,
        )
        ax.axhline(global_qr, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.1, zorder=2)
        ax.text(
            plot_df["x"].max() + 0.15,
            global_qr,
            f"global {global_qr:.1%}",
            va="center",
            ha="left",
            fontsize=9,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
            fontweight="bold",
        )

        for _, row in plot_df.iterrows():
            ax.text(
                row["x"],
                row["qr_share"] + 0.006,
                f"{row['qr_share']:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=9,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
                fontweight="bold",
            )
            ax.text(
                row["x"],
                row["qr_share"] - 0.011,
                f"n={fmt_int(row['n_cards'])}",
                ha="center",
                va="top",
                fontsize=7.5,
                color=MUTED_TEXT,
            )

        q1 = float(plot_df.iloc[0]["qr_share"])
        q5 = float(plot_df.iloc[-1]["qr_share"])
        diff = (q5 - q1) * 100
        diff_color = PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"] if diff >= 0 else PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"]
        ax.text(
            0.98,
            0.93,
            f"Q5 - Q1: {diff:+.1f} pp",
            transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha="right",
            va="center",
            fontsize=10,
            color=diff_color,
            fontweight="bold",
        )

        ax.set_xticks(plot_df["x"])
        ax.set_xticklabels(plot_df["financial_quintile"], fontsize=9)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0, decimals=0))
```

### Comparacion residencia vs origen habitual

```{python}
def financial_residence_origin_comparison_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    df = (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .select(
            [
                "payment_group",
                "is_qr",
                pl.col("res_fin_index_z").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
                pl.col("origin_fin_index_z").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
                pl.col("res_fin_has_presence").cast(pl.Boolean, strict=False),
                pl.col("origin_fin_has_presence").cast(pl.Boolean, strict=False),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    df = df.loc[df["payment_group"].isin(PAYMENT_ORDER)].dropna(
        subset=["res_fin_index_z", "origin_fin_index_z"]
    ).copy()
    df["origin_minus_residence_z"] = df["origin_fin_index_z"] - df["res_fin_index_z"]
    df["comparison"] = np.select(
        [
            df["origin_minus_residence_z"] > 0.10,
            df["origin_minus_residence_z"] < -0.10,
        ],
        [
            "origen > residencia",
            "residencia > origen",
        ],
        default="similar",
    )
    df["res_presence_label"] = np.where(df["res_fin_has_presence"], "residencia con infra.", "residencia sin infra.")
    df["origin_presence_label"] = np.where(df["origin_fin_has_presence"], "origen con infra.", "origen sin infra.")

    summary = (
        df.groupby("payment_group")
        .agg(
            n_cards=("is_qr", "size"),
            mean_origin_minus_residence_z=("origin_minus_residence_z", "mean"),
            median_origin_minus_residence_z=("origin_minus_residence_z", "median"),
            share_origin_gt_residence=("comparison", lambda s: (s == "origen > residencia").mean()),
            share_residence_gt_origin=("comparison", lambda s: (s == "residencia > origen").mean()),
            share_similar=("comparison", lambda s: (s == "similar").mean()),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    transition = (
        df.groupby(["res_presence_label", "origin_presence_label"], observed=False)
        .agg(n_cards=("is_qr", "size"), qr_share=("is_qr", "mean"))
        .reset_index()
    )
    transition["card_share"] = transition["n_cards"] / len(df)
    transition["delta_pp"] = (transition["qr_share"] - df["is_qr"].mean()) * 100
    return summary, transition
```

```{python}
def plot_financial_presence_transition(transition_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    order_y = ["residencia sin infra.", "residencia con infra."]
    order_x = ["origen sin infra.", "origen con infra."]
    pivot = (
        transition_df.pivot(index="res_presence_label", columns="origin_presence_label", values="delta_pp")
        .reindex(index=order_y, columns=order_x)
    )
    labels = (
        transition_df.assign(
            label=lambda df: df.apply(
                lambda r: f"{r['qr_share']:.1%}\n{fmt_int(r['n_cards'])} tarjetas",
                axis=1,
            )
        )
        .pivot(index="res_presence_label", columns="origin_presence_label", values="label")
        .reindex(index=order_y, columns=order_x)
    )

    vmax = max(1.0, np.nanmax(np.abs(pivot.to_numpy())))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.4, 5.2), facecolor=FIG_BG)
    sns.heatmap(
        pivot,
        annot=labels,
        fmt="",
        cmap="RdBu_r",
        center=0,
        vmin=-vmax,
        vmax=vmax,
        linewidths=2,
        linecolor=FIG_BG,
        cbar_kws={"label": "QR - global (pp)", "shrink": 0.75},
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
    ax.set_xlabel("Origen habitual")
    ax.set_ylabel("Residencia")
    ax.set_xticklabels(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
    ax.set_yticklabels(ax.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0)
    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Presencia financiera OSM: residencia vs origen habitual",
        "Cada celda muestra share QR y soporte; color = diferencia contra el share QR global.",
        y=0.96,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.03,
        "Nota: presencia = al menos un banco, cajero o casa de cambio OSM en la zona.",
        ha="center",
        fontsize=9,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    plt.subplots_adjust(left=0.20, right=0.93, top=0.78, bottom=0.18)
    plt.show()


plot_financial_presence_transition(financial_presence_transition)
```

**Finding descriptivo.** Este bloque debe leerse como una auditoria de una
hipotesis acotada: presencia fisica de infraestructura financiera registrada en
OSM, medida por zona de residencia y zona de origen habitual. Si los gradientes
por quintil son planos o pequenos, la evidencia descriptiva no apoyaria que esta
familia OSM, por si sola, explique grandes diferencias BIP/QR. Si aparecen
gradientes claros, el siguiente paso seria revisar mapas, macrozonas y
correlaciones para descartar que el patron este capturando centralidad,
ingreso, educacion o composicion territorial.


## 12d. Comercio y servicios cotidianos OSM

El segundo sub-bloque de OSM ampliado mira comercio y servicios cotidianos. La
pregunta es acotada: si QR se asocia a zonas con mayor densidad de comercio o
servicios registrados en OSM.

Esta familia no mide acceso digital, bancarizacion ni capacidad de pago. Se lee
como un proxy territorial de centralidad local o disponibilidad de servicios
cotidianos. Para no mezclar mecanismos, en este bloque no incluimos `office=*`;
si interesa actividad laboral/oficinas, conviene abrir un sub-bloque separado.

### Construccion y QA del indice zonal

```{python}
#| label: block12d-osm-commerce-zone-index
print("label: block12d-osm-commerce-zone-index")


def load_commerce_osm_objects_lonlat(
    amenity_path: Path = OSM_AMENITY_RAW_PATH,
    shop_path: Path = OSM_SHOP_RAW_PATH,
) -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    frames = []

    amenity = gpd.read_parquet(amenity_path)
    if amenity.crs is None:
        amenity = amenity.set_crs("EPSG:4326", allow_override=True)
    else:
        amenity = amenity.to_crs("EPSG:4326")
    amenity = amenity.loc[amenity["amenity"].isin(OSM_COMMERCE_AMENITY_VALUES)].copy()
    amenity["osm_key"] = "amenity"
    amenity["osm_value"] = amenity["amenity"].astype(str)
    amenity["tag_label"] = amenity["osm_value"].map(OSM_COMMERCE_AMENITY_LABELS).fillna(
        "amenity=" + amenity["osm_value"]
    )
    frames.append(amenity)

    shop = gpd.read_parquet(shop_path)
    if shop.crs is None:
        shop = shop.set_crs("EPSG:4326", allow_override=True)
    else:
        shop = shop.to_crs("EPSG:4326")
    shop_value = shop["shop"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    shop = shop.loc[shop["shop"].notna() & (shop_value != "") & (shop_value != "yes")].copy()
    shop["osm_key"] = "shop"
    shop["osm_value"] = shop["shop"].astype(str)
    shop["tag_label"] = "shop=" + shop["osm_value"]
    frames.append(shop)

    common_cols = ["element", "id", "osm_key", "osm_value", "tag_label", "name", "geometry"]
    commerce = pd.concat([frame[common_cols] for frame in frames], ignore_index=True)
    commerce = gpd.GeoDataFrame(commerce, geometry="geometry", crs="EPSG:4326")
    commerce = commerce.dropna(subset=["geometry"]).copy()
    commerce["osm_uid"] = commerce["element"].astype(str) + "/" + commerce["id"].astype(str)
    commerce["source_priority"] = np.where(commerce["osm_key"] == "shop", 1, 2)

    # Algunos objetos aparecen en osm_shop y osm_amenity; se cuentan una sola vez.
    commerce = (
        commerce.sort_values(["osm_uid", "source_priority", "osm_key", "osm_value"])
        .drop_duplicates("osm_uid")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    return commerce


def build_osm_commerce_zone_index(
    zones_path: Path = ZONAS777_SHP,
) -> tuple[gpd.GeoDataFrame, gpd.GeoDataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    zones_lonlat = load_zona777_geometries_lonlat(zones_path)
    zones_area = zones_lonlat.to_crs("EPSG:32719")
    zones_lonlat["area_km2"] = zones_area.geometry.area / 1_000_000
    commerce = load_commerce_osm_objects_lonlat()

    joined_raw = gpd.sjoin(
        commerce[["osm_uid", "osm_key", "osm_value", "tag_label", "name", "geometry"]],
        zones_lonlat[["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "geometry"]],
        how="left",
        predicate="intersects",
    )
    joined_matches = joined_raw.dropna(subset=["zone_id"]).copy()
    joined = joined_matches.sort_values(["osm_uid", "zone_id"]).drop_duplicates("osm_uid")
    joined["zone_id"] = joined["zone_id"].astype(int)

    source_counts = (
        joined.groupby(["zone_id", "osm_key"])
        .size()
        .unstack(fill_value=0)
        .rename(columns={"shop": "n_shop_objects", "amenity": "n_amenity_commerce_objects"})
        .reset_index()
    )

    zone_index = zones_lonlat[["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "area_km2", "geometry"]].copy()
    zone_index = zone_index.merge(source_counts, on="zone_id", how="left")
    for col in ["n_shop_objects", "n_amenity_commerce_objects"]:
        if col not in zone_index.columns:
            zone_index[col] = 0
        zone_index[col] = zone_index[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    zone_index["n_commerce_points"] = zone_index["n_shop_objects"] + zone_index["n_amenity_commerce_objects"]
    zone_index["has_commerce_osm"] = zone_index["n_commerce_points"] > 0
    zone_index["commerce_density_km2"] = zone_index["n_commerce_points"] / zone_index["area_km2"].replace(0, np.nan)
    zone_index["commerce_density_km2"] = zone_index["commerce_density_km2"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    zone_index["commerce_density_log1p"] = np.log1p(zone_index["commerce_density_km2"])

    cap = zone_index["commerce_density_log1p"].quantile(0.995)
    zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"] = zone_index["commerce_density_log1p"].clip(upper=cap)
    std = zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"].std(ddof=0)
    if std and not np.isnan(std):
        zone_index["commerce_index_z"] = (
            zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"] - zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"].mean()
        ) / std
    else:
        zone_index["commerce_index_z"] = 0.0
    zone_index["commerce_index_percentile"] = zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"].rank(method="average", pct=True)

    multijoin_counts = (
        joined_matches.groupby("osm_uid")
        .agg(n_zone_matches=("zone_id", "nunique"), osm_key=("osm_key", "first"), tag_label=("tag_label", "first"), name=("name", "first"))
        .query("n_zone_matches > 1")
        .sort_values("n_zone_matches", ascending=False)
        .reset_index()
    )
    unmatched = commerce.loc[~commerce["osm_uid"].isin(joined_matches["osm_uid"])].copy()

    return zone_index, joined, unmatched, multijoin_counts


commerce_zone_index_gdf, commerce_osm_joined_gdf, commerce_unmatched_osm, commerce_multijoin_osm = build_osm_commerce_zone_index()

commerce_spatial_qa = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "check": "OSM comercio/servicios: objetos crudos deduplicados",
            "value": fmt_int(len(load_commerce_osm_objects_lonlat())),
            "lectura": "Objetos shop=* o amenity de consumo cotidiano antes del join.",
        },
        {
            "check": "Spatial join: objetos asignados a alguna zona",
```

```{python}
#| label: block12d-osm-commerce-assignment-sensitivity
print("label: block12d-osm-commerce-assignment-sensitivity")


def build_osm_commerce_point_rule_index(
    zones_path: Path = ZONAS777_SHP,
) -> tuple[gpd.GeoDataFrame, gpd.GeoDataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    zones_lonlat = load_zona777_geometries_lonlat(zones_path)
    zones_area = zones_lonlat.to_crs("EPSG:32719")
    zones_lonlat["area_km2"] = zones_area.geometry.area / 1_000_000

    commerce = load_commerce_osm_objects_lonlat().copy()
    commerce["geometry"] = commerce.geometry.representative_point()

    joined_raw = gpd.sjoin(
        commerce[["osm_uid", "osm_key", "osm_value", "tag_label", "name", "geometry"]],
        zones_lonlat[["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "geometry"]],
        how="left",
        predicate="intersects",
    )
    joined_matches = joined_raw.dropna(subset=["zone_id"]).copy()
    joined = joined_matches.sort_values(["osm_uid", "zone_id"]).drop_duplicates("osm_uid")
    joined["zone_id"] = joined["zone_id"].astype(int)

    zone_counts = (
        joined.groupby("zone_id")
        .agg(n_commerce_points=("osm_uid", "nunique"))
        .reset_index()
    )

    zone_index = zones_lonlat[["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "area_km2", "geometry"]].copy()
    zone_index = zone_index.merge(zone_counts, on="zone_id", how="left")
    zone_index["n_commerce_points"] = zone_index["n_commerce_points"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    zone_index["has_commerce_osm"] = zone_index["n_commerce_points"] > 0
    zone_index["commerce_density_km2"] = zone_index["n_commerce_points"] / zone_index["area_km2"].replace(0, np.nan)
    zone_index["commerce_density_km2"] = zone_index["commerce_density_km2"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    zone_index["commerce_density_log1p"] = np.log1p(zone_index["commerce_density_km2"])

    cap = zone_index["commerce_density_log1p"].quantile(0.995)
    zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"] = zone_index["commerce_density_log1p"].clip(upper=cap)
    std = zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"].std(ddof=0)
    if std and not np.isnan(std):
        zone_index["commerce_index_z"] = (
            zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"] - zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"].mean()
        ) / std
    else:
        zone_index["commerce_index_z"] = 0.0
    zone_index["commerce_index_percentile"] = zone_index["commerce_density_log1p_w"].rank(method="average", pct=True)

    multijoin_counts = (
        joined_matches.groupby("osm_uid")
        .agg(n_zone_matches=("zone_id", "nunique"), osm_key=("osm_key", "first"), tag_label=("tag_label", "first"), name=("name", "first"))
        .query("n_zone_matches > 1")
        .sort_values("n_zone_matches", ascending=False)
        .reset_index()
    )
    return zone_index, joined, multijoin_counts


commerce_point_rule_zone_gdf, commerce_point_rule_joined_gdf, commerce_point_rule_multijoin = build_osm_commerce_point_rule_index()

commerce_current_assignment = (
    commerce_osm_joined_gdf[["osm_uid", "zone_id"]]

commerce_point_assignment = (

)
commerce_assignment_compare = commerce_current_assignment.merge(

commerce_assignment_compare["zone_changed"] = (

    & commerce_assignment_compare["zone_id_point_rule"].notna()

commerce_zone_rule_compare["abs_index_diff"] = (

commerce_zone_rule_compare["quintile_intersects"] = (

commerce_zone_rule_compare["quintile_changed"] = (

assignment_sensitivity_qa = pd.DataFrame(

            "lectura": "Correlacion alta implica que la decision espacial no cambia el ranking territorial.",

            "lectura": "Chequea si la regla alternativa reordena zonas de forma relevante.",

def add_commerce_assignment_sensitivity_indices_to_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    current_zone_index: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    point_zone_index: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    current_pdf = pd.DataFrame(
        current_zone_index[["zone_id", "commerce_index_z"]]
        .rename(columns={"commerce_index_z": "commerce_index_z_intersects"})
        .drop(columns="geometry", errors="ignore")
    )
    point_pdf = pd.DataFrame(
        point_zone_index[["zone_id", "commerce_index_z"]]
        .rename(columns={"commerce_index_z": "commerce_index_z_point_rule"})
        .drop(columns="geometry", errors="ignore")
    )

    out = lf
    for prefix, _, zone_col, _ in OSM_COMMERCE_GEOS:
        current_geo = current_pdf.rename(
            columns={
                "zone_id": zone_col,
                "commerce_index_z_intersects": f"{prefix}_commerce_index_z_intersects",
            }
        )
        point_geo = point_pdf.rename(
            columns={
                "zone_id": zone_col,
                "commerce_index_z_point_rule": f"{prefix}_commerce_index_z_point_rule",
            }
        )
        out = out.join(pl.from_pandas(current_geo).lazy(), on=zone_col, how="left")
        out = out.join(pl.from_pandas(point_geo).lazy(), on=zone_col, how="left")
    return out
```

```{python}
#| label: block12d-osm-commerce-map
print("label: block12d-osm-commerce-map")


def plot_commerce_osm_zone_map(commerce_gdf: gpd.GeoDataFrame) -> None:
    plot_gdf = commerce_gdf.copy().to_crs("EPSG:4326")
    no_presence = plot_gdf.loc[~plot_gdf["has_commerce_osm"]]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 7), facecolor=FIG_BG)
    for ax in axes:
        ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
        ax.axis("off")

    density_vmax = max(0.1, plot_gdf["commerce_density_km2"].quantile(0.98))
    plot_gdf.plot(
        column="commerce_density_km2",
        ax=axes[0],
        cmap="YlOrBr",
        linewidth=0.12,
        edgecolor="#f4efe4",
        vmin=0,
        vmax=density_vmax,
        legend=True,
        legend_kwds={"label": "Objetos por km2", "shrink": 0.72},
    )
    no_presence.plot(
        ax=axes[0],
        facecolor="none",
        edgecolor="#b8ad9a",
        linewidth=0.2,
        hatch="////",
        alpha=0.5,
    )
    axes[0].set_title("Densidad comercio/servicios OSM", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR)

    vmax = max(1.0, plot_gdf["commerce_index_z"].abs().quantile(0.98))
    plot_gdf.plot(
        column="commerce_index_z",
        ax=axes[1],
        cmap="RdBu_r",
        linewidth=0.12,
        edgecolor="#f4efe4",
        norm=TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax),
        legend=True,
        legend_kwds={"label": "Indice comercio z", "shrink": 0.72},
    )
    no_presence.plot(
        ax=axes[1],
        facecolor="none",
        edgecolor="#b8ad9a",
        linewidth=0.2,
        hatch="////",
        alpha=0.5,
    )
    axes[1].set_title("Indice transformado", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR)

    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Comercio y servicios cotidianos registrados en OSM",
        "Objetos shop=* y amenity de consumo cotidiano asignados a ZONA777. Achurado = sin presencia OSM de esta familia.",
        y=0.96,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.03,
        "Nota: el indice usa log1p(densidad), winsor p99.5 y z-score zonal; OSM puede tener cobertura incompleta.",
        ha="center",
        fontsize=9,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    plt.subplots_adjust(left=0.03, right=0.97, top=0.84, bottom=0.08, wspace=0.08)
    plt.show()
```

### Cruce con tarjetas: residencia y origen habitual

```{python}
#| label: block12d-osm-commerce-card-cross
print("label: block12d-osm-commerce-card-cross")


def add_commerce_osm_features_to_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    zone_index: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    feature_cols = [
        "zone_id",
        "n_commerce_points",
        "commerce_density_km2",
        "commerce_density_log1p",
        "commerce_index_z",
        "commerce_index_percentile",
        "has_commerce_osm",
    ]
    zone_pdf = pd.DataFrame(zone_index[feature_cols].drop(columns="geometry", errors="ignore"))

    out = lf
    for prefix, _, zone_col, _ in OSM_COMMERCE_GEOS:
        rename_map = {
            "zone_id": zone_col,
            "n_commerce_points": f"{prefix}_commerce_n_points",
            "commerce_density_km2": f"{prefix}_commerce_density_km2",
            "commerce_density_log1p": f"{prefix}_commerce_density_log1p",
            "commerce_index_z": f"{prefix}_commerce_index_z",
            "commerce_index_percentile": f"{prefix}_commerce_index_percentile",
            "has_commerce_osm": f"{prefix}_commerce_has_presence",
        }
        geo_pdf = zone_pdf.rename(columns=rename_map)
        out = out.join(pl.from_pandas(geo_pdf).lazy(), on=zone_col, how="left")
    return out


def add_residential_socio_context_to_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    schema_names = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    if "zona_hogar" not in schema_names:
        raise ValueError("Falta columna zona_hogar para unir contexto socio-demografico residencial.")

    out = lf.with_columns(pl.col("zona_hogar").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("_res_context_zona777"))

    eod_specs = [
        ("eod2012_ingreso_hogar_median_pct_rank", "res_eod2012_income_percentile"),
        ("eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy", "res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy"),
        ("eod2012_share_hogares_abc1_income_proxy", "res_eod2012_share_hogares_abc1_income_proxy"),
    ]
    missing_eod = [(src, dst) for src, dst in eod_specs if dst not in schema_names]
    if missing_eod:
        eod_lf = pl.scan_parquet(EOD2012_ZONA777_FEATURES_PATH)
        eod_schema = set(eod_lf.collect_schema().names())
        missing_sources = [src for src, _ in missing_eod if src not in eod_schema]
        if missing_sources:
            raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas en artefacto EOD 2012: {missing_sources}")
        out = out.join(
            eod_lf.select(
                [
                    pl.col("ZONA777").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("_res_context_zona777"),
                    *[pl.col(src).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).alias(dst) for src, dst in missing_eod],
                ]
            ),
            on="_res_context_zona777",
            how="left",
        )

    censo_specs = [
        ("share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro", "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro"),
    ]
    missing_censo = [(src, dst) for src, dst in censo_specs if dst not in schema_names]
    if missing_censo:
        censo_lf = pl.scan_parquet(CENSO2024_MICRODATA_ZONA777_FEATURES_PATH)
        censo_schema = set(censo_lf.collect_schema().names())
        missing_sources = [src for src, _ in missing_censo if src not in censo_schema]
        if missing_sources:
            raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas en artefacto Censo 2024: {missing_sources}")
        out = out.join(
            censo_lf.select(
                [
                    pl.col("ZONA777").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("_res_context_zona777"),
                    *[pl.col(src).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).alias(dst) for src, dst in missing_censo],
                ]
            ),
            on="_res_context_zona777",
            how="left",
        )

    return out.drop("_res_context_zona777")


lf_cards_commerce = add_residential_socio_context_to_lazyframe(
    add_commerce_osm_features_to_lazyframe(lf_cards, commerce_zone_index_gdf)
)


def commerce_card_coverage_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    total_cards = int(lf.select(pl.len()).collect().item())
    for prefix, label, zone_col, _ in OSM_COMMERCE_GEOS:
        n_col = f"{prefix}_commerce_n_points"
        has_col = f"{prefix}_commerce_has_presence"
        stats = (
            lf.select(
                [
                    pl.col(zone_col).is_not_null().sum().alias("n_with_zone"),
                    pl.col(n_col).is_not_null().sum().alias("n_with_commerce_value"),
                    pl.col(has_col).cast(pl.Int8, strict=False).sum().alias("n_with_commerce_presence"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").filter(pl.col(has_col) == True).mean().alias("qr_share_with_presence"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").filter(pl.col(has_col) == False).mean().alias("qr_share_without_presence"),
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_dicts()[0]
        )
        rows.append(
            {
                "geography": label,
                "zone_column": zone_col,
                "n_cards": total_cards,
                **stats,
                "share_with_zone": stats["n_with_zone"] / total_cards,
                "share_with_commerce_value": stats["n_with_commerce_value"] / total_cards,
                "share_with_commerce_presence": stats["n_with_commerce_presence"] / total_cards,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
```

```{python}
#| label: block12d-osm-commerce-state-summary
print("label: block12d-osm-commerce-state-summary")

COMMERCE_STATE_ORDER = [
    "Con comercio/servicios OSM",
    "Sin comercio/servicios OSM, zona cubierta",
    "Sin valor / missing",
]


def commerce_presence_state_summary_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    lf_aug = add_payment_group(lf)
    global_qr = float(lf_aug.select(pl.col("is_qr").mean()).collect().item())

    for prefix, geo_label, zone_col, _ in OSM_COMMERCE_GEOS:
        n_col = f"{prefix}_commerce_n_points"
        has_col = f"{prefix}_commerce_has_presence"
        state_expr = (
            pl.when(pl.col(n_col).is_null())
            .then(pl.lit("Sin valor / missing"))
            .when(pl.col(has_col).fill_null(False))
            .then(pl.lit("Con comercio/servicios OSM"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("Sin comercio/servicios OSM, zona cubierta"))
            .alias("commerce_state")
        )

        state_df = (
            lf_aug.with_columns(state_expr)
            .group_by("commerce_state")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    (pl.col("payment_group") == "BIP").sum().alias("n_bip"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").sum().alias("n_qr"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
                    pl.col(zone_col).is_not_null().mean().alias("share_with_zone"),
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        state_df["geography"] = geo_label
        state_df["zone_column"] = zone_col
        state_df["global_qr_share"] = global_qr
        rows.append(state_df)

    out = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    totals = out.groupby("geography")["n_cards"].transform("sum")
    out["card_share"] = out["n_cards"] / totals
    out["delta_pp"] = (out["qr_share"] - out["global_qr_share"]) * 100
    out["commerce_state"] = pd.Categorical(out["commerce_state"], categories=COMMERCE_STATE_ORDER, ordered=True)
    return out.sort_values(["geography", "commerce_state"]).reset_index(drop=True)
```

```{python}
    ("res_age_share_60_mas", "% poblacion 60+ residencial"),
    ("res_prom_edad_z", "Edad promedio residencial z"),
]


def commerce_correlation_audit_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    schema = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    available_vars = [(col, label) for col, label in COMMERCE_CORRELATION_VARS if col in schema]
    select_cols = [col for col, _ in available_vars]
    select_cols += [f"{prefix}_commerce_index_z" for prefix, _, _, _ in OSM_COMMERCE_GEOS]
    df = lf.select([pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).alias(col) for col in select_cols]).collect().to_pandas()

    rows = []
    for prefix, geo_label, _, _ in OSM_COMMERCE_GEOS:
        commerce_col = f"{prefix}_commerce_index_z"
        for col, label in available_vars:
            tmp = df[[commerce_col, col]].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
            rows.append(
                {
                    "geography": geo_label,
                    "commerce_metric": "Indice comercio/servicios OSM z",
                    "context_variable": label,
                    "n": len(tmp),
                    "pearson_r": tmp[commerce_col].corr(tmp[col], method="pearson") if len(tmp) > 1 else np.nan,
                    "spearman_r": tmp[commerce_col].corr(tmp[col], method="spearman") if len(tmp) > 1 else np.nan,
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def commerce_macrozone_audit_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for prefix, geo_label, _, macro_prefix in OSM_COMMERCE_GEOS:
        index_col = f"{prefix}_commerce_index_z"
        has_col = f"{prefix}_commerce_has_presence"
        macro_df = (
            lf.with_columns(territorial_macrozone_expr(macro_prefix).alias("macrozona"))
            .filter(pl.col("macrozona").is_not_null())
            .group_by("macrozona")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
                    pl.col(index_col).mean().alias("mean_commerce_index_z"),
                    pl.col(index_col).median().alias("median_commerce_index_z"),
                    pl.col(has_col).mean().alias("share_with_commerce_presence"),
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        macro_df["geography"] = geo_label
        rows.append(macro_df)
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
```
