### 13D) Capa 2: validez de medicion

Esta capa compara definiciones alternativas para separar problemas de escala de
problemas de medicion. En demanda, revisa si excluir solo el viaje actual cambia
respecto de excluir todos los viajes de la tarjeta en la misma celda. En oferta,
contrasta la oferta total agregada de la zona con la oferta tipica de un paradero
activo dentro de esa zona. Las escalas raw y percentil se comparan por correlacion
y cambios de quintil, no por diferencias absolutas porque sus unidades no coinciden.

```{python}
#| label: block13d-operational-measurement-validity
print("label: block13d-operational-measurement-validity")

op_exposure_lf = pl.scan_parquet(OP_CARD_EXPOSURE_PATH)
op_context_lf = pl.scan_parquet(OP_ZONE_CONTEXT_PATH)
op_cards_model_lf = lf_cards.select(["id_tarjeta"]).join(op_exposure_lf, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")


def op_corr(x: str, y: str):
    return pl.corr(pl.col(x), pl.col(y))


def op_spearman(x: str, y: str):
    return pl.corr(pl.col(x).rank(), pl.col(y).rank())


def op_pair_measurement_summary(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    *,
    comparison: str,
    unit: str,
    current_col: str,
    alternative_col: str,
    diff_threshold: float,
) -> dict:
    pair_lf = lf.filter(
        pl.col(current_col).is_not_null()
        & pl.col(alternative_col).is_not_null()
    )
    row = (
        pair_lf.select(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n"),
                pl.col(current_col).mean().alias("current_mean"),
                pl.col(alternative_col).mean().alias("alternative_mean"),
                (pl.col(current_col) - pl.col(alternative_col)).mean().alias("mean_current_minus_alternative"),
                (pl.col(current_col) - pl.col(alternative_col)).abs().quantile(0.50).alias("p50_abs_diff"),
                (pl.col(current_col) - pl.col(alternative_col)).abs().quantile(0.95).alias("p95_abs_diff"),
                ((pl.col(current_col) - pl.col(alternative_col)).abs() > diff_threshold)
                .mean()
                .alias("share_diff_gt_threshold"),
                op_corr(current_col, alternative_col).alias("pearson_r"),
                op_spearman(current_col, alternative_col).alias("spearman_r"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .row(0, named=True)
    )
    return {
        "comparison": comparison,
        "unit": unit,
        "n": row["n"],
        "current_mean": row["current_mean"],
        "alternative_mean": row["alternative_mean"],
        "mean_current_minus_alternative": row["mean_current_minus_alternative"],
        "p50_abs_diff": row["p50_abs_diff"],
        "p95_abs_diff": row["p95_abs_diff"],
        "share_diff_gt_threshold": row["share_diff_gt_threshold"],
        "pearson_r": row["pearson_r"],
        "spearman_r": row["spearman_r"],
    }


def op_scale_normalization_summary(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    *,
    comparison: str,
    unit: str,
    raw_col: str,
    normalized_col: str,
) -> dict:
    pair_lf = (
        lf.select([raw_col, normalized_col])
        .drop_nulls()
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col(raw_col).rank(method="average")
                    / pl.len()
                ).alias("_raw_rank"),
                (
                    pl.col(normalized_col).rank(method="average")
                    / pl.len()
                ).alias("_normalized_rank"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("_raw_rank") * 5)
                .ceil()
                .clip(lower_bound=1, upper_bound=5)
                .alias("_raw_quintile"),
                (pl.col("_normalized_rank") * 5)
                .ceil()
                .clip(lower_bound=1, upper_bound=5)
                .alias("_normalized_quintile"),
            ]
        )
    )
    row = (
        pair_lf.select(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n"),
                pl.col(raw_col).mean().alias("raw_mean"),
                pl.col(normalized_col).mean().alias("normalized_mean"),
                op_corr(raw_col, normalized_col).alias("pearson_r"),
                op_spearman(raw_col, normalized_col).alias("spearman_r"),
                (
                    pl.col("_raw_quintile")
                    != pl.col("_normalized_quintile")
                )
                .mean()
                .alias("share_change_quintile"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .row(0, named=True)
    )
    return {
        "comparison": comparison,
        "unit": unit,
        **row,
    }


op_measurement_rows = [
    op_pair_measurement_summary(
        op_cards_model_lf,
        comparison="Demanda viajes: leave-one-trip vs leave-one-card",
        unit="tarjeta matriz",
```

### 13E) Capa 3: plausibilidad descriptiva y estabilidad temporal

Esta capa revisa si las variables reconstruidas se comportan de forma coherente
antes de cruzarlas con adopcion QR. Los niveles de demanda se comparan dentro de
cada franja, porque las ventanas tienen distinta duracion. La estabilidad zonal
se evalua con correlaciones de rangos entre semanas adyacentes y entre semanas
equivalentes de 2024 y 2025.

```{python}
#| label: block13e-operational-descriptive-plausibility
print("label: block13e-operational-descriptive-plausibility")

op_context_pd = pl.read_parquet(OP_ZONE_CONTEXT_PATH).to_pandas()

op_plausibility_by_partition_franja = (
    op_context_pd.groupby(["partition", "franja_v2"], as_index=False)
    .agg(
        n_zones=("zone_id", "nunique"),
        demand_trips=("op_demand_trips_zone_franja_week", "sum"),
        demand_cards=("op_demand_cards_zone_franja_week", "sum"),
        demand_trips_p50=("op_demand_trips_zone_franja_week", "median"),
        typical_stop_supply_p50=("op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_mean", "median"),
        typical_stop_supply_p90=(
            "op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_mean",
            lambda values: values.quantile(0.90),
        ),
        service_directions_p50=("op_bus_service_directions_zone_franja_mean", "median"),
        active_stops_p50=("op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_mean", "median"),
    )
    .sort_values(["partition", "franja_v2"])
)

display(
    op_plausibility_by_partition_franja.style.format(
        {
            "n_zones": fmt_int,
            "demand_trips": fmt_int,
            "demand_cards": fmt_int,

            "typical_stop_supply_p50": "{:.1f}",
            "typical_stop_supply_p90": "{:.1f}",
            "service_directions_p50": "{:.1f}",
            "active_stops_p50": "{:.1f}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

op_week_volume = (
    op_context_pd.groupby("partition", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        demand_trips=("op_demand_trips_zone_franja_week", "sum"),
        demand_cards=("op_demand_cards_zone_franja_week", "sum"),
        mean_typical_stop_supply=("op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_mean", "mean"),

)

    lambda values: values / values.median()

display(
    op_week_volume[
        [
            "partition",

    .style.format(
        {
            "demand_trips": fmt_int,
            "demand_cards": fmt_int,
            "demand_vs_year_median": "{:.1%}",
            "mean_typical_stop_supply": "{:.1f}",
        }
    )
    .hide(axis="index")
)

op_stability_metrics = {
    "Demanda viajes": "op_demand_trips_zone_franja_week",
    "Demanda tarjetas": "op_demand_cards_zone_franja_week",
    "Oferta paradero tipico": "op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_mean",
    "Servicios-sentido": "op_bus_service_directions_zone_franja_mean",
}
op_partitions = sorted(op_context_pd["partition"].unique())
op_stability_rows = []

for metric_label, metric_col in op_stability_metrics.items():
    for franja, franja_df in op_context_pd.groupby("franja_v2"):
        metric_wide = franja_df.pivot(index="zone_id", columns="partition", values=metric_col)
        partition_pairs = []
        for year in ["2024", "2025"]:
            year_partitions = [partition for partition in op_partitions if partition.startswith(year)]
            partition_pairs.extend(
                ("Semanas adyacentes", year_partitions[idx], year_partitions[idx + 1])
                for idx in range(len(year_partitions) - 1)
            )
        partition_pairs.extend(
            ("Misma semana 2024 vs 2025", f"2024-W{week}", f"2025-W{week}")
            for week in [14, 15, 16, 17]
        )

        for comparison, partition_a, partition_b in partition_pairs:
            pair = metric_wide[[partition_a, partition_b]].dropna()
            spearman_r = pair[partition_a].rank().corr(pair[partition_b].rank())
            op_stability_rows.append(
                {
                    "metric": metric_label,
                    "franja_v2": franja,
                    "comparison": comparison,
                    "partition_a": partition_a,
                    "partition_b": partition_b,
                    "n_zones": len(pair),
                    "spearman_r": spearman_r,
                }
            )

op_stability_pairs = pd.DataFrame(op_stability_rows)

        min_spearman=("spearman_r", "min"),

print(
```

### 13F) Capa 4: señal descriptiva QR/BIP

Esta capa prueba si la adopcion QR cambia a traves de quintiles de exposicion
operacional a nivel tarjeta. La demanda raw conserva la definicion
leave-one-card-out. Su alternativa normalizada usa el percentil territorial de
la celda `semana x franja`; la capa 2 mostro que excluir la tarjeta no altera
materialmente ese ranking. La oferta se compara en escala raw, percentil
`semana x franja` y paradero-hora para viajes bus-like.

```{python}
#| label: block13f-operational-qr-signal
print("label: block13f-operational-qr-signal")

op_exposure_lf = pl.scan_parquet(OP_CARD_EXPOSURE_PATH)
op_card_signal_lf = (
    add_payment_group(lf_cards)
    .select(["id_tarjeta", "is_qr", "payment_group"])
    .join(op_exposure_lf, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
)

op_signal_specs = [
    {
        "metric": "Demanda observada",
        "scale": "Raw leave-one-card-out",
        "value_col": "op_demand_trips_excl_card_mean",
        "scope": "Todas las tarjetas",
        "bus_like_only": False,
    },
    {
        "metric": "Demanda observada",
        "scale": "Percentil semana-franja",
        "value_col": "op_demand_trips_zone_franja_week_percentile_mean",
        "scope": "Todas las tarjetas",
        "bus_like_only": False,
    },
    {
        "metric": "Oferta paradero tipico",
        "scale": "Raw buses/h",
        "value_col": "op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_mean",
        "scope": "Todas las tarjetas",
        "bus_like_only": False,
    },
    {
        "metric": "Oferta paradero tipico",
        "scale": "Percentil semana-franja",
        "value_col": "op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_percentile_mean",
        "scope": "Todas las tarjetas",
        "bus_like_only": False,
    },
    {
        "metric": "Oferta paradero-hora",
        "scale": "Raw buses/h",
        "value_col": "op_stop_bus_supply_buses_h_observed_mean",
        "scope": "Tarjetas con viajes bus-like matched",
        "bus_like_only": True,
    },
]

op_signal_detail_parts = []
for spec in op_signal_specs:
    metric_lf = op_card_signal_lf.filter(pl.col(spec["value_col"]).is_not_null())
    if spec["bus_like_only"]:
        metric_lf = metric_lf.filter(
            (pl.col("op_n_trips_bus_like") > 0)
            & (pl.col("op_stop_bus_supply_match_share") > 0)
        )

    metric_lf = (
        metric_lf.with_columns(
            (pl.col(spec["value_col"]).rank(method="average") / pl.len()).alias(
                "_card_metric_percentile"
            )
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("_card_metric_percentile") * 5)
            .ceil()
            .clip(1, 5)
            .cast(pl.Int8)
            .alias("_quintile_order")
        )
    )

    metric_detail = (
        metric_lf.group_by("_quintile_order")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("is_qr").sum().alias("n_qr"),
                pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
                pl.col(spec["value_col"]).median().alias("metric_median"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(spec["metric"]).alias("metric"),
                pl.lit(spec["scale"]).alias("scale"),
                pl.lit(spec["scope"]).alias("scope"),
                pl.concat_str([pl.lit("Q"), pl.col("_quintile_order")]).alias("quintile"),
            ]
        )
        .sort("_quintile_order")
        .select(
            [
                "metric",
                "scale",
                "scope",
                "_quintile_order",
                "quintile",
                "n_cards",
                "n_qr",
                "qr_share",
                "metric_median",
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    op_signal_detail_parts.append(metric_detail)

op_signal_detail = pd.concat(op_signal_detail_parts, ignore_index=True)

display(
    op_signal_detail.drop(columns="_quintile_order").style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "n_qr": fmt_int,
            "qr_share": "{:.1%}",
            "metric_median": "{:.3f}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

op_signal_summary_rows = []
for (metric, scale, scope), group in op_signal_detail.groupby(
    ["metric", "scale", "scope"],
    sort=False,
):
    group = group.sort_values("_quintile_order")
    first = group.iloc[0]
    last = group.iloc[-1]
    peak = group.loc[group["qr_share"].idxmax()]
    trough = group.loc[group["qr_share"].idxmin()]
    op_signal_summary_rows.append(
        {
            "metric": metric,
            "scale": scale,
            "scope": scope,
            "n_cards": int(group["n_cards"].sum()),
            "q1_qr_share": first["qr_share"],
            "q5_qr_share": last["qr_share"],
            "q5_minus_q1_pp": (last["qr_share"] - first["qr_share"]) * 100,
            "max_minus_min_pp": (peak["qr_share"] - trough["qr_share"]) * 100,
            "peak_quintile": peak["quintile"],
            "peak_qr_share": peak["qr_share"],
            "spearman_quintile_qr": group["_quintile_order"].corr(
                group["qr_share"],
                method="spearman",
            ),
        }
    )

op_signal_summary = pd.DataFrame(op_signal_summary_rows)
display(
    op_signal_summary.style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "q1_qr_share": "{:.1%}",
            "q5_qr_share": "{:.1%}",
            "q5_minus_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "max_minus_min_pp": "{:.2f}",
            "peak_qr_share": "{:.1%}",
            "spearman_quintile_qr": "{:+.3f}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

op_scale_pairs = [
    {
        "metric": "Demanda observada",
        "raw_col": "op_demand_trips_excl_card_mean",
        "normalized_col": "op_demand_trips_zone_franja_week_percentile_mean",
    },
    {
        "metric": "Oferta paradero tipico",
        "raw_col": "op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_mean",
        "normalized_col": "op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_percentile_mean",
    },
]

op_scale_sensitivity_rows = []
for pair_spec in op_scale_pairs:
    pair_lf = (
        op_card_signal_lf.drop_nulls([pair_spec["raw_col"], pair_spec["normalized_col"]])
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col(pair_spec["raw_col"]).rank(method="average") / pl.len()).alias(
                    "_raw_percentile"
                ),
                (pl.col(pair_spec["normalized_col"]).rank(method="average") / pl.len()).alias(
                    "_normalized_percentile"
                ),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("_raw_percentile") * 5)
                .ceil()
                .clip(1, 5)
                .cast(pl.Int8)
                .alias("_raw_quintile"),
                (pl.col("_normalized_percentile") * 5)
                .ceil()
                .clip(1, 5)
                .cast(pl.Int8)
                .alias("_normalized_quintile"),
            ]
        )
    )
    pair_row = pair_lf.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.corr(pl.col(pair_spec["raw_col"]), pl.col(pair_spec["normalized_col"])).alias(
                "pearson_raw_vs_normalized"
            ),
            pl.corr(
                pl.col(pair_spec["raw_col"]).rank(),
                pl.col(pair_spec["normalized_col"]).rank(),
            ).alias("spearman_raw_vs_normalized"),
            (pl.col("_raw_quintile") != pl.col("_normalized_quintile"))
            .mean()
            .alias("share_change_quintile"),
        ]
    ).collect().row(0, named=True)
    op_scale_sensitivity_rows.append({"metric": pair_spec["metric"], **pair_row})

op_scale_sensitivity = pd.DataFrame(op_scale_sensitivity_rows)
display(
    op_scale_sensitivity.style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "pearson_raw_vs_normalized": "{:+.3f}",
            "spearman_raw_vs_normalized": "{:+.3f}",
            "share_change_quintile": "{:.1%}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

### 13G) Capa 5: audit socio-territorial de oferta operacional

Esta capa revisa si el gradiente QR de la oferta zonal normalizada coincide con
composicion residencial, territorial, modal o de intensidad. El objetivo es
diagnostico: no interpreta los ajustes estratificados como efectos causales.

```{python}
#| label: block13g-operational-offer-socio-territorial-audit
print("label: block13g-operational-offer-socio-territorial-audit")

OP_OFFER_AUDIT_COL = "op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_percentile_mean"
OP_OFFER_MIN_ENDPOINT_N = 500

op_offer_audit_lf = (
    add_residential_socio_context_to_lazyframe(lf_cards)
    .with_columns(
        [
            territorial_macrozone_expr("home_macro_").alias("home_macrozone"),
            territorial_macrozone_expr("origin_top1_macro_").alias("origin_macrozone"),
        ]
    )
    .select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            "is_qr",
            "n_viajes",
            "home_macrozone",
            "origin_macrozone",
            pl.col("res_eod2012_income_percentile").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
            pl.col("res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
            pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
            pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
            pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
        ]
    )
    .join(
        pl.scan_parquet(OP_CARD_EXPOSURE_PATH).select(["id_tarjeta", OP_OFFER_AUDIT_COL]),
        on="id_tarjeta",
        how="inner",
    )
    .drop_nulls([OP_OFFER_AUDIT_COL])
)

op_offer_audit_lf = (
    op_offer_audit_lf.with_columns(
        [
            (pl.col(OP_OFFER_AUDIT_COL).rank(method="average") / pl.len()).alias("_offer_percentile"),
            (
                pl.col("res_eod2012_income_percentile").rank(method="average")
                / pl.col("res_eod2012_income_percentile").count()
            ).alias("_income_percentile"),
            (
                pl.col("res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro").rank(method="average")
                / pl.col("res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro").count()
            ).alias("_education_percentile"),
            (pl.col("n_viajes").rank(method="average") / pl.len()).alias("_trips_percentile"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        [
            (pl.col("_offer_percentile") * 5).ceil().clip(1, 5).cast(pl.Int8).alias("offer_quintile_order"),
            (pl.col("_income_percentile") * 5).ceil().clip(1, 5).cast(pl.Int8).alias("income_quintile"),
            (pl.col("_education_percentile") * 5)
            .ceil()
            .clip(1, 5)
            .cast(pl.Int8)
            .alias("education_quintile"),
            (pl.col("_trips_percentile") * 5).ceil().clip(1, 5).cast(pl.Int8).alias("trip_intensity_quintile"),
            pl.when(
                (pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus") >= pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro"))
                & (pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus") >= pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus"))
                & (pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus") >= 0.5)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("Solo bus dominante"))
            .when(
                (pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro") >= pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus"))
                & (pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro") >= pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus"))
                & (pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro") >= 0.5)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("Solo metro dominante"))
            .when(
                (pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus") >= pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus"))
                & (pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus") >= pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro"))
                & (pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus") >= 0.5)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("Metro+bus dominante"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("Mixto / otros"))
            .alias("modal_profile"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.concat_str([pl.lit("Q"), pl.col("offer_quintile_order")]).alias("offer_quintile")
    )
)

op_offer_context_by_quintile = (
    op_offer_audit_lf.group_by(["offer_quintile_order", "offer_quintile"])
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
            pl.col(OP_OFFER_AUDIT_COL).median().alias("median_offer_percentile"),
            pl.col("res_eod2012_income_percentile").median().alias("median_income_percentile"),
            pl.col("res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro")
            .median()
            .alias("median_university_plus"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_trips"),
            pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus").median().alias("median_solo_bus"),
            pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro").median().alias("median_solo_metro"),
            pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus").median().alias("median_metro_bus"),
        ]
    )
    .sort("offer_quintile_order")
    .drop("offer_quintile_order")
    .collect()
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    op_offer_context_by_quintile.style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "qr_share": "{:.1%}",
            "median_offer_percentile": "{:.3f}",
            "median_income_percentile": lambda value: f"p{value * 100:.0f}",
            "median_university_plus": "{:.1%}",
            "median_trips": "{:.0f}",
            "median_solo_bus": "{:.1%}",
            "median_solo_metro": "{:.1%}",
            "median_metro_bus": "{:.1%}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

OP_OFFER_CONTEXT_CORRELATIONS = [
    ("res_eod2012_income_percentile", "Ingreso residencial"),
    ("res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro", "Educacion universitaria+ residencial"),
    ("n_viajes", "Numero de viajes"),
    ("share_trips_solo_bus", "Share solo bus"),
    ("share_trips_solo_metro", "Share solo metro"),
    ("share_trips_metro_bus", "Share metro+bus"),
]

op_offer_correlation_rows = []
for context_col, context_label in OP_OFFER_CONTEXT_CORRELATIONS:
    correlation_row = (
        op_offer_audit_lf.drop_nulls([context_col])
        .select(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n"),
                pl.corr(pl.col(OP_OFFER_AUDIT_COL), pl.col(context_col)).alias("pearson_r"),
                pl.corr(
                    pl.col(OP_OFFER_AUDIT_COL).rank(),
                    pl.col(context_col).rank(),
                ).alias("spearman_r"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .row(0, named=True)
    )
    op_offer_correlation_rows.append(
        {
            "context_variable": context_label,
            **correlation_row,
        }
    )

op_offer_context_correlations = pd.DataFrame(op_offer_correlation_rows)
display(
    op_offer_context_correlations.style.format(
        {
            "n": fmt_int,
            "pearson_r": "{:+.3f}",
            "spearman_r": "{:+.3f}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

op_offer_macrozone_parts = []
for geography, macrozone_col in [
    ("Residencia", "home_macrozone"),
    ("Origen habitual", "origin_macrozone"),
]:
    macrozone_part = (
        op_offer_audit_lf.filter(pl.col("offer_quintile_order").is_in([1, 5]))
        .group_by(["offer_quintile_order", "offer_quintile", macrozone_col])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards").sum().over("offer_quintile_order")).alias(
                "card_share_within_quintile"
            )
        )
        .rename({macrozone_col: "macrozona"})
        .with_columns(pl.lit(geography).alias("geography"))
        .sort(["offer_quintile_order", "n_cards"], descending=[False, True])
        .drop("offer_quintile_order")
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    op_offer_macrozone_parts.append(macrozone_part)

op_offer_macrozone_endpoints = pd.concat(op_offer_macrozone_parts, ignore_index=True)
display(
    op_offer_macrozone_endpoints[
        [
            "geography",
            "offer_quintile",
            "macrozona",
            "n_cards",
            "card_share_within_quintile",
            "qr_share",
        ]
    ].style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "card_share_within_quintile": "{:.1%}",
            "qr_share": "{:.1%}",
        },
        na_rep="Sin macrozona",
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

OP_OFFER_STRATIFICATION_CONTROLS = [
    ("home_macrozone", "Macrozona residencial"),
    ("origin_macrozone", "Macrozona origen habitual"),
    ("income_quintile", "Quintil ingreso residencial"),
    ("education_quintile", "Quintil educacion universitaria+"),
    ("trip_intensity_quintile", "Quintil intensidad de viajes"),
    ("modal_profile", "Perfil modal dominante"),
]

op_offer_endpoint_global = (
    op_offer_audit_lf.filter(pl.col("offer_quintile_order").is_in([1, 5]))
    .group_by("offer_quintile_order")
    .agg(pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"))
    .sort("offer_quintile_order")
    .collect()
)
op_offer_unadjusted_q5_q1_pp = (
    op_offer_endpoint_global["qr_share"][1] - op_offer_endpoint_global["qr_share"][0]
) * 100

op_offer_stratified_rows = []
for control_col, control_label in OP_OFFER_STRATIFICATION_CONTROLS:
    endpoint_df = (
        op_offer_audit_lf.filter(pl.col("offer_quintile_order").is_in([1, 5]))
        .drop_nulls([control_col])
        .group_by([control_col, "offer_quintile_order"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    endpoint_total = endpoint_df["n_cards"].sum()
    endpoint_pivot = endpoint_df.pivot(
        index=control_col,
        columns="offer_quintile_order",
        values=["n_cards", "qr_share"],
    ).dropna()
    eligible = endpoint_pivot.loc[
        (endpoint_pivot[("n_cards", 1)] >= OP_OFFER_MIN_ENDPOINT_N)
        & (endpoint_pivot[("n_cards", 5)] >= OP_OFFER_MIN_ENDPOINT_N)
    ].copy()
    endpoint_weight = eligible[("n_cards", 1)] + eligible[("n_cards", 5)]
    endpoint_weight = endpoint_weight / endpoint_weight.sum()
    stratum_diff_pp = (eligible[("qr_share", 5)] - eligible[("qr_share", 1)]) * 100

    op_offer_stratified_rows.append(
        {
            "control": control_label,
            "n_strata_total": len(endpoint_pivot),
            "n_strata_used": len(eligible),
            "endpoint_coverage": (
                eligible[("n_cards", 1)].sum() + eligible[("n_cards", 5)].sum()
            )
            / endpoint_total,
            "unadjusted_q5_q1_pp": op_offer_unadjusted_q5_q1_pp,
            "weighted_within_strata_q5_q1_pp": (stratum_diff_pp * endpoint_weight).sum(),
            "min_stratum_q5_q1_pp": stratum_diff_pp.min(),
            "max_stratum_q5_q1_pp": stratum_diff_pp.max(),
            "share_positive_strata": (stratum_diff_pp > 0).mean(),
        }
    )

op_offer_stratified_audit = pd.DataFrame(op_offer_stratified_rows)
display(
    op_offer_stratified_audit.style.format(
        {
            "n_strata_total": fmt_int,
            "n_strata_used": fmt_int,
            "endpoint_coverage": "{:.1%}",
            "unadjusted_q5_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "weighted_within_strata_q5_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "min_stratum_q5_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "max_stratum_q5_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "share_positive_strata": "{:.1%}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

### 13H) Oferta bus pendiente: diversidad, extension y headway

Este subbloque completa las dimensiones de oferta bus que ya fueron construidas,
pero que todavia no recibieron una auditoria propia. La primera celda revisa solo
soporte y distribucion. No interpreta señal QR/BIP.

- `Servicios-sentido zonales` mide diversidad operacional en el entorno de origen.
- `Paraderos activos zonales` mide extension espacial de la oferta dentro de la zona.
- `Servicios-sentido en paradero` mide alternativas disponibles en el punto-hora observado.
- `Headway combinado en paradero` es el intervalo teorico agregado; un valor mayor
  significa menor intensidad de oferta.

```{python}
#| label: block13h-operational-bus-dimensions-coverage
print("label: block13h-operational-bus-dimensions-coverage")

OP_BUS_DIMENSION_REQUIRED_COLUMNS = {
    "op_bus_service_directions_zone_franja_percentile_mean",
    "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_percentile_mean",
    "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_density_percentile_mean",
    "op_stop_bus_supply_buses_h_observed_percentile_mean",
}
op_bus_dimension_schema = set(pl.read_parquet_schema(OP_CARD_EXPOSURE_PATH))
op_bus_dimension_missing_columns = sorted(
    OP_BUS_DIMENSION_REQUIRED_COLUMNS - op_bus_dimension_schema
)
if op_bus_dimension_missing_columns:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "El artefacto operacional debe regenerarse antes de correr 13H. "
        "Ejecuta `python scripts/audits/build_operational_offer_demand_exposure.py --force`. "
        f"Columnas faltantes: {op_bus_dimension_missing_columns}"
    )

OP_BUS_DIMENSION_SPECS = [
    {
        "family": "Diversidad zonal",
        "scale": "Raw",
        "scope": "Todas las tarjetas",
        "column": "op_bus_service_directions_zone_franja_mean",
    },
    {
        "family": "Diversidad zonal",
        "scale": "Percentil semana-franja",
        "scope": "Todas las tarjetas",
        "column": "op_bus_service_directions_zone_franja_percentile_mean",
    },
    {
        "family": "Paraderos activos zonales",
        "scale": "Raw",
        "scope": "Todas las tarjetas",
        "column": "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_mean",
    },
    {
        "family": "Paraderos activos zonales",
        "scale": "Percentil semana-franja",
        "scope": "Todas las tarjetas",
        "column": "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_percentile_mean",
    },
    {
        "family": "Densidad paraderos activos zonales",
        "scale": "Raw por km2",
        "scope": "Tarjetas con viajes en zonas con geometria ZONA777",
        "eligibility": "zone_geometry",
        "column": "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_density_km2_mean",
    },
    {
        "family": "Densidad paraderos activos zonales",
        "scale": "Percentil semana-franja",
        "scope": "Tarjetas con viajes en zonas con geometria ZONA777",
        "eligibility": "zone_geometry",
        "column": "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_density_percentile_mean",
    },
    {
        "family": "Oferta paradero-hora",
        "scale": "Percentil semana-franja",
        "scope": "Viajes bus-like matched",
        "column": "op_stop_bus_supply_buses_h_observed_percentile_mean",
    },
    {
        "family": "Diversidad paradero-hora",
        "scale": "Raw",
        "scope": "Viajes bus-like matched",
        "column": "op_stop_bus_service_directions_observed_mean",
    },
    {
        "family": "Headway combinado paradero-hora",
        "scale": "Minutos; mayor es peor oferta",
        "scope": "Viajes bus-like matched",
        "column": "op_stop_bus_headway_min_observed_mean",
    },
]

op_bus_dimension_lf = (
    add_payment_group(lf_cards)
    .select(["id_tarjeta", "is_qr", "payment_group"])
    .join(pl.scan_parquet(OP_CARD_EXPOSURE_PATH), on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
)

op_bus_dimension_rows = []
for spec in OP_BUS_DIMENSION_SPECS:
    value = pl.col(spec["column"])
    valid = value.is_not_null() & value.is_finite()
    if spec.get("eligibility") == "zone_geometry":
        eligible = (
            pl.col("op_n_trips_with_bus_stops_density_context").fill_null(0) > 0
        )
    elif spec["scope"] == "Viajes bus-like matched":
        eligible = pl.col("op_n_trips_bus_like").fill_null(0) > 0
    else:
        eligible = pl.col("id_tarjeta").is_not_null()

    row = (
        op_bus_dimension_lf.select(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards_total"),
                eligible.sum().alias("n_cards_eligible"),
                (eligible & valid).sum().alias("n_cards_valid"),
                pl.when(eligible).then(valid).otherwise(None).mean().alias("share_valid_among_eligible"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).quantile(0.01).alias("p01"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).quantile(0.10).alias("p10"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).quantile(0.50).alias("p50"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).quantile(0.90).alias("p90"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).quantile(0.99).alias("p99"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).min().alias("minimum"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).max().alias("maximum"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).n_unique().alias("n_unique"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .row(0, named=True)
    )
    op_bus_dimension_rows.append(
        {
            "family": spec["family"],
            "scale": spec["scale"],
            "scope": spec["scope"],
            **row,
        }
    )

op_bus_dimension_coverage = pd.DataFrame(op_bus_dimension_rows)
display(
    op_bus_dimension_coverage.style.format(
        {
            "n_cards_total": fmt_int,
            "n_cards_eligible": fmt_int,
            "n_cards_valid": fmt_int,
            "share_valid_among_eligible": "{:.3%}",
            "p01": "{:.3f}",
            "p10": "{:.3f}",
            "p50": "{:.3f}",
            "p90": "{:.3f}",
            "p99": "{:.3f}",
            "minimum": "{:.3f}",
            "maximum": "{:.3f}",
            "n_unique": fmt_int,
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

op_bus_dimension_coverage_by_payment_parts = []
for spec in OP_BUS_DIMENSION_SPECS:
    value = pl.col(spec["column"])
    valid = value.is_not_null() & value.is_finite()
    if spec.get("eligibility") == "zone_geometry":
        eligible = (
            pl.col("op_n_trips_with_bus_stops_density_context").fill_null(0) > 0
        )
    elif spec["scope"] == "Viajes bus-like matched":
        eligible = pl.col("op_n_trips_bus_like").fill_null(0) > 0
    else:
        eligible = pl.col("id_tarjeta").is_not_null()

    part = (
        op_bus_dimension_lf.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                eligible.sum().alias("n_cards_eligible"),
                (eligible & valid).sum().alias("n_cards_valid"),
                pl.when(eligible).then(valid).otherwise(None).mean().alias("share_valid_among_eligible"),
                pl.when(eligible & valid).then(value).otherwise(None).median().alias("median_value"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(spec["family"]).alias("family"),
                pl.lit(spec["scale"]).alias("scale"),
                pl.lit(spec["scope"]).alias("scope"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "family",
                "scale",
                "scope",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                "n_cards_eligible",
                "n_cards_valid",
                "share_valid_among_eligible",
                "median_value",
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    op_bus_dimension_coverage_by_payment_parts.append(part)

op_bus_dimension_coverage_by_payment = pd.concat(
    op_bus_dimension_coverage_by_payment_parts,
    ignore_index=True,
).sort_values(["family", "scale", "payment_group"])

display(
    op_bus_dimension_coverage_by_payment.style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "n_cards_eligible": fmt_int,
            "n_cards_valid": fmt_int,
            "share_valid_among_eligible": "{:.3%}",
            "median_value": "{:.3f}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

La siguiente celda revisa la plausibilidad temporal, los extremos territoriales y
la redundancia entre dimensiones antes de cruzarlas con QR/BIP. La lectura se
mantiene separada por escala:

- zona-semana-franja para frecuencia tipica, diversidad y paraderos activos;
- tarjeta con viajes bus-like matched para frecuencia, diversidad y headway en
  paradero-hora.

El `headway zonal implicito` se calcula como `60 / frecuencia tipica` solo para
facilitar la lectura temporal. No reemplaza el headway observado en paradero-hora.

```{python}
#| label: block13h-operational-bus-dimensions-plausibility
print("label: block13h-operational-bus-dimensions-plausibility")

OP_BUS_ZONE_AUDIT_SPECS = [
    {
        "metric": "Frecuencia tipica zonal",
        "column": "op_bus_supply_typical_stop_buses_h_zone_franja_mean",
        "expected": "Mayor valor = mayor intensidad de oferta",
    },
    {
        "metric": "Diversidad zonal",
        "column": "op_bus_service_directions_zone_franja_mean",
        "expected": "Mayor valor = mas servicios-sentido",
    },
    {
        "metric": "Paraderos activos zonales",
        "column": "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_mean",
        "expected": "Mayor valor = mayor extension de oferta activa",
    },
]

OP_BUS_ZONE_FREQ_COL = OP_BUS_ZONE_AUDIT_SPECS[0]["column"]
OP_BUS_ZONE_DIVERSITY_COL = OP_BUS_ZONE_AUDIT_SPECS[1]["column"]
OP_BUS_ZONE_STOPS_COL = OP_BUS_ZONE_AUDIT_SPECS[2]["column"]
OP_BUS_ZONE_STOPS_DENSITY_COL = (
    "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_density_km2"
)
OP_BUS_ZONE_STOPS_DENSITY_PERCENTILE_COL = (
    "op_bus_stops_with_supply_zone_franja_density_percentile"
)
OP_BUS_ZONE_HEADWAY_COL = "_op_bus_typical_stop_headway_min"

op_bus_zone_audit_lf = pl.scan_parquet(OP_ZONE_CONTEXT_PATH).with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_FREQ_COL) > 0)
    .then(pl.lit(60.0) / pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_FREQ_COL))
    .otherwise(None)
    .alias(OP_BUS_ZONE_HEADWAY_COL)
)

op_bus_week_franja_plausibility = (
    op_bus_zone_audit_lf.group_by(["partition", "franja_v2"])
    .agg(
        [
            pl.col("zone_id").n_unique().alias("n_zones"),
            pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_FREQ_COL).median().alias("frequency_p50"),
            pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_FREQ_COL).quantile(0.90).alias("frequency_p90"),

            pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_DIVERSITY_COL).quantile(0.90).alias("diversity_p90"),
            pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_STOPS_COL).median().alias("active_stops_p50"),
            pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_STOPS_COL).quantile(0.90).alias("active_stops_p90"),
            pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_HEADWAY_COL).median().alias("implied_headway_p50"),
            pl.col(OP_BUS_ZONE_HEADWAY_COL).quantile(0.90).alias("implied_headway_p90"),
        ]
    )
    .sort(["partition", "franja_v2"])
    .collect()
    .to_pandas()
)

def op_week_range_text(series: pd.Series, digits: int = 1) -> str:
    valid = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce").dropna()
    return (
        f"{valid.median():.{digits}f} "
        f"[{valid.min():.{digits}f}, {valid.max():.{digits}f}]"
    )


op_bus_franja_order = ["LAB_PM", "LAB_PT", "LAB_VALLE", "NO_LAB"]
op_bus_franja_plausibility_rows = []
for franja in op_bus_franja_order:

    op_bus_franja_plausibility_rows.append(

            "frequency_p50": op_week_range_text(group["frequency_p50"]),
            "frequency_p90": op_week_range_text(group["frequency_p90"]),
            "diversity_p50": op_week_range_text(group["diversity_p50"]),
            "diversity_p90": op_week_range_text(group["diversity_p90"]),
            "active_stops_p50": op_week_range_text(group["active_stops_p50"]),
            "active_stops_p90": op_week_range_text(group["active_stops_p90"]),
            "implied_headway_p50": op_week_range_text(
                group["implied_headway_p50"],
                digits=2,
            ),
            "implied_headway_p90": op_week_range_text(
                group["implied_headway_p90"],
                digits=2,
            ),
        }
    )

op_bus_franja_plausibility_summary = pd.DataFrame(
    op_bus_franja_plausibility_rows
)
display(
    op_bus_franja_plausibility_summary.style.format(

            "n_weeks": fmt_int,
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)


def op_redundancy_label(spearman_r: float) -> str:
    absolute_r = abs(spearman_r)
    if absolute_r >= 0.95:
        return "Casi deterministica"
    if absolute_r >= 0.85:
        return "Muy alta"
    if absolute_r >= 0.70:
        return "Alta"
    if absolute_r >= 0.50:
        return "Moderada"
    return "Baja"


def op_pair_redundancy(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    *,
    scale: str,
    metric_x: str,
    column_x: str,
    metric_y: str,
    column_y: str,
    expected_relation: str,
) -> dict:
    valid_pair = (
        pl.col(column_x).is_not_null()
        & pl.col(column_x).is_finite()
        & pl.col(column_y).is_not_null()
        & pl.col(column_y).is_finite()
    )
    row = (
        lf.filter(valid_pair)
        .select(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n"),
                op_corr(column_x, column_y).alias("pearson_r"),
                op_spearman(column_x, column_y).alias("spearman_r"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .row(0, named=True)
    )
    return {
        "scale": scale,
        "metric_x": metric_x,
        "metric_y": metric_y,
        "n": row["n"],
        "pearson_r": row["pearson_r"],
        "spearman_r": row["spearman_r"],
        "redundancy_level": op_redundancy_label(row["spearman_r"]),
        "expected_relation": expected_relation,
    }


op_bus_redundancy_rows = [
    op_pair_redundancy(
        op_bus_zone_audit_lf,
        scale="Zona-semana-franja",
        metric_x="Frecuencia tipica zonal",
        column_x=OP_BUS_ZONE_FREQ_COL,
        metric_y="Diversidad zonal",
        column_y=OP_BUS_ZONE_DIVERSITY_COL,

op_bus_dimension_redundancy = pd.DataFrame(op_bus_redundancy_rows)

op_bus_zone_extreme_source = op_bus_zone_audit_lf.collect().to_pandas()
op_bus_zone_geometry = gpd.read_file(ZONAS777_SHP)

    by="zone_id",

op_bus_zone_geometry_metric = op_bus_zone_geometry.to_crs("EPSG:32719")

op_bus_zone_extreme_source["has_zona777_geometry"] = (

op_bus_zone_geometry_coverage = (

if op_bus_zone_geometry_coverage < 0.98:

op_bus_geometry_support = pd.DataFrame(

op_bus_active_stops_area_audit = pd.DataFrame(

]

op_bus_zone_extreme_parts = []
for spec in op_bus_zone_extreme_specs:
    metric_source = op_bus_zone_extreme_source.dropna(subset=[spec["column"]]).copy()
    metric_source["within_cell_percentile"] = metric_source.groupby(
        ["partition", "franja_v2"]
    )[spec["column"]].rank(
        method="average",
        pct=True,
    )
    for extreme, mask, ascending in [
        ("Bajo", metric_source["within_cell_percentile"] <= 0.005, True),
        ("Alto", metric_source["within_cell_percentile"] >= 0.995, False),
    ]:
        flagged = metric_source.loc[mask].copy()
        recurrent = (
            flagged.groupby("zone_id", as_index=False)
            .agg(
                n_extreme_cells=("zone_id", "size"),
                n_weeks_extreme=("partition", "nunique"),
                n_franjas_extreme=("franja_v2", "nunique"),
            )
        )
        example = (
            flagged.sort_values("within_cell_percentile", ascending=ascending)
            .drop_duplicates("zone_id")
            [
                [
                    "zone_id",
                    "partition",
                    "franja_v2",
                    "COMUNA",
                    "MACROZONA",
                    spec["column"],
                    "within_cell_percentile",
                ]
            ]
            .rename(columns={spec["column"]: "example_value"})
        )
        selected = (
            recurrent.merge(example, on="zone_id", how="left")
            .assign(
                metric=spec["metric"],
                extreme=extreme,
                expected_reading=spec["expected"],
            )
            .sort_values(
                ["n_extreme_cells", "within_cell_percentile"],
                ascending=[False, ascending],
            )
            .head(2)
        )
        op_bus_zone_extreme_parts.append(selected)

op_bus_zone_extremes = (
    pd.concat(op_bus_zone_extreme_parts, ignore_index=True)
    [
        [
            "metric",
            "extreme",
            "zone_id",
            "COMUNA",
            "MACROZONA",
            "n_extreme_cells",
            "n_weeks_extreme",
            "n_franjas_extreme",
            "partition",
            "franja_v2",
            "example_value",
            "within_cell_percentile",
            "expected_reading",
        ]
    ]
)
op_bus_zone_extremes[["COMUNA", "MACROZONA"]] = op_bus_zone_extremes[

].fillna("Sin geometria en shapefile ZONA777")

display(
    op_bus_zone_extremes.style.format(

            "n_franjas_extreme": fmt_int,
            "example_value": "{:.3f}",
            "within_cell_percentile": "{:.2%}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

### 13I) Demanda bus especifica y presion observada

Este subbloque cambia la unidad de demanda: ya no usa todos los viajes de origen,
sino cada etapa de subida cuyo modo es bus o zona paga (`1` o `3`). Una misma
cadena de viaje puede aportar mas de una subida bus. La primera etapa bus se
conserva solo como sensibilidad comparable con los bloques anteriores.

La presion observada se calcula en el mismo punto y hora que la demanda. El
cociente se interpreta como subidas o tarjetas por pasada bus programada
equivalente. En zona, el denominador suma frecuencias de distintos paraderos y
representa pasadas bus-paradero programadas, no vehiculos unicos. No mide
ocupacion, capacidad, congestion, espera real ni el servicio efectivamente
abordado.

La exposicion principal pondera por subida observada: una celda visitada varias
veces pesa mas. Se materializa ademas una sensibilidad con igual peso por
tarjeta-celda.

```{python}
#| label: block13i-operational-bus-demand-definitions
print("label: block13i-operational-bus-demand-definitions")

)

OP_BUS_13I_REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS = {

}
op_bus_13i_missing = [
    name
    for name, path in OP_BUS_13I_REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS.items()
    if not path.exists()
]
if op_bus_13i_missing:
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "Faltan artefactos 13I. Ejecuta "
        "`python scripts/audits/build_operational_bus_demand_pressure.py --force`. "
        f"Faltantes: {op_bus_13i_missing}"
    )

op_bus_13i_input_audit = json.loads(
    OP_BUS_DEMAND_PRESSURE_INPUT_AUDIT_PATH.read_text()
)
op_bus_13i_summary = json.loads(
```

```{python}
def op_bus_13i_relation_summary(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    *,
    scale: str,
    demand_col: str,
    supply_col: str,
    pressure_col: str,
) -> dict:
    valid = lf.drop_nulls([demand_col, supply_col, pressure_col])
    return (
        valid.select(
            [
                pl.lit(scale).alias("scale"),
                pl.len().alias("n"),
                pl.corr(demand_col, supply_col).alias(
                    "pearson_demand_supply"
                ),
                pl.corr(
                    pl.col(demand_col).rank(),
                    pl.col(supply_col).rank(),
                ).alias("spearman_demand_supply"),
                pl.corr(demand_col, pressure_col).alias(
                    "pearson_demand_pressure"
                ),
                pl.corr(
                    pl.col(demand_col).rank(),
                    pl.col(pressure_col).rank(),
                ).alias("spearman_demand_pressure"),
                pl.col(pressure_col).quantile(0.50).alias("pressure_p50"),
                pl.col(pressure_col).quantile(0.99).alias("pressure_p99"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .row(0, named=True)
    )


op_bus_13i_relations = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        op_bus_13i_relation_summary(
            op_bus_13i_stop_lf,
            scale="Paradero-hora",
            demand_col="op_bus_demand_boardings_stop_hour",
            supply_col="op_bus_supply_buses_h_stop_hour",
            pressure_col=(
                "op_bus_pressure_boardings_per_scheduled_passage_stop_hour"
            ),
        ),
        op_bus_13i_relation_summary(
            op_bus_13i_zone_lf,
            scale="Zona-hora",
            demand_col="op_bus_demand_boardings_zone_hour",
            supply_col="op_bus_supply_buses_h_zone_hour",
            pressure_col=(
                "op_bus_pressure_boardings_per_scheduled_passage_zone_hour"
            ),
        ),
    ]
)

def op_bus_13i_weighting_summary(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    *,
    family: str,
    scale: str,
    boarding_weighted_col: str,
    cell_weighted_col: str,
) -> dict:
    pair = (
        lf.select([boarding_weighted_col, cell_weighted_col])
        .drop_nulls()
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col(boarding_weighted_col).rank(method="average")
                    / pl.len()
                ).alias("_boarding_rank"),
                (
                    pl.col(cell_weighted_col).rank(method="average")
                    / pl.len()
                ).alias("_cell_rank"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("_boarding_rank") * 5)
                .ceil()
                .clip(lower_bound=1, upper_bound=5)
                .alias("_boarding_quintile"),
                (pl.col("_cell_rank") * 5)
                .ceil()
                .clip(lower_bound=1, upper_bound=5)
                .alias("_cell_quintile"),
            ]
        )
    )
    row = (
        pair.select(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.corr(
                    boarding_weighted_col,
                    cell_weighted_col,
                ).alias("pearson_r"),
                pl.corr(
                    pl.col(boarding_weighted_col).rank(),
                    pl.col(cell_weighted_col).rank(),
                ).alias("spearman_r"),
                (
                    pl.col(boarding_weighted_col)
                    - pl.col(cell_weighted_col)
                )
                .abs()
                .quantile(0.50)
                .alias("p50_abs_diff"),
                (
                    pl.col(boarding_weighted_col)
                    - pl.col(cell_weighted_col)
                )
                .abs()
                .quantile(0.95)
                .alias("p95_abs_diff"),
                (
                    pl.col("_boarding_quintile")
                    != pl.col("_cell_quintile")
                )
                .mean()
                .alias("share_change_quintile"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .row(0, named=True)
    )
    return {"family": family, "scale": scale, **row}


op_bus_13i_weighting = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        op_bus_13i_weighting_summary(
            op_bus_13i_card_lf,
            family="Demanda externa",
            scale="Paradero-hora",
            boarding_weighted_col=(
                "op_bus_demand_boardings_excl_card_stop_hour_"
                "boarding_weighted_mean"
            ),
            cell_weighted_col=(
                "op_bus_demand_boardings_excl_card_stop_hour_"
                "cell_weighted_mean"
            ),
        ),
        op_bus_13i_weighting_summary(
            op_bus_13i_card_lf,
            family="Demanda externa",
            scale="Zona-hora",
            boarding_weighted_col=(
                "op_bus_demand_boardings_excl_card_zone_hour_"
                "boarding_weighted_mean"
            ),
            cell_weighted_col=(
                "op_bus_demand_boardings_excl_card_zone_hour_"
                "cell_weighted_mean"
            ),
        ),
        op_bus_13i_weighting_summary(
            op_bus_13i_card_lf,
            family="Presion observada",
            scale="Paradero-hora",
            boarding_weighted_col=(
                "op_bus_pressure_boardings_per_scheduled_passage_"
                "excl_card_stop_hour_boarding_weighted_mean"
            ),
            cell_weighted_col=(
                "op_bus_pressure_boardings_per_scheduled_passage_"
                "excl_card_stop_hour_cell_weighted_mean"
            ),
        ),
        op_bus_13i_weighting_summary(
            op_bus_13i_card_lf,
            family="Presion observada",
            scale="Zona-hora",
            boarding_weighted_col=(
                "op_bus_pressure_boardings_per_scheduled_passage_"
                "excl_card_zone_hour_boarding_weighted_mean"
            ),
            cell_weighted_col=(
                "op_bus_pressure_boardings_per_scheduled_passage_"
                "excl_card_zone_hour_cell_weighted_mean"
            ),
        ),
    ]
)
display(
    op_bus_13i_weighting.style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "pearson_r": "{:+.3f}",
            "spearman_r": "{:+.3f}",
            "p50_abs_diff": "{:.3f}",
            "p95_abs_diff": "{:.3f}",
            "share_change_quintile": "{:.1%}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

**Lectura previa a QR.** Si los cierres y patrones de 13I son plausibles, la
demanda externa por subida puede avanzar como familia propia. La presion solo
avanza si no es una copia casi deterministica de demanda u oferta y si sus
extremos se explican por combinaciones observables de ambas. La sensibilidad de
ponderacion debe mostrar cuanto cambia el ranking al pasar de peso por subida a
igual peso por tarjeta-celda. Los paraderos sin zona se mantienen fuera del
denominador zonal y se reportan por separado. La comparacion QR, la robustez
anual y el control socio-territorial se realizan despues de este audit de
medicion.

### 13J) Extremos y estabilidad de las variables operacionales bus

Este bloque consolida la auditoria previa a QR en las dos escalas defendibles:

- `ZONA777 x semana x franja` para intensidad media por paradero activo,
  diversidad, densidad de paraderos, demanda bus y relacion demanda-oferta;
- `paradero x hora del dia x semana x franja` para la oferta, demanda y
  relacion demanda-oferta observadas donde existen subidas bus.

La segunda escala esta condicionada a celdas con demanda observada. Por tanto,
no describe todos los paraderos programados de la red. Los valores extremos se
definen dentro de cada semana-franja y la estabilidad compara tanto semanas
adyacentes como la misma semana entre 2024 y 2025.

**Lectura previa a QR.** La estabilidad alta no convierte una variable en
causal ni garantiza utilidad predictiva. Este bloque solo decide si los niveles,
extremos y rankings son suficientemente coherentes para avanzar. La oferta y la
demanda siguen siendo dimensiones principales; la relacion demanda-oferta se
mantiene como medida derivada complementaria.

### 13K) Gradientes QR/BIP de las variables operacionales bus

Este bloque pregunta si las tarjetas clasificadas como QR aparecen con mayor o
menor frecuencia en los quintiles de oferta, demanda y relacion
demanda-oferta. Los quintiles tienen igual numero de tarjetas dentro de cada
corte y los intervalos agrupan la incertidumbre por zona modal de origen.

La unidad longitudinal es `tarjeta x ano x franja`. Para el resultado pooled,
los promedios se ponderan por los viajes o subidas que soportan cada variable.
`is_qr` sigue siendo la clasificacion global de la tarjeta en la matriz final:
los cortes 2024/2025 describen la estabilidad temporal del perfil operacional,
no una adopcion QR contemporanea a cada semana.

```{python}
def op_bus_13k_scope_frame(specs, scope_columns):
    return collapse_metrics_scope(
        op_bus_13k_exposure_lf,
        metric_specs=specs,
        scope_columns=scope_columns,
    ).join(
        op_bus_13k_cards_lf,
        on="id_tarjeta",
        how="inner",
        validate="m:1",
    ).collect().lazy()


def op_bus_13k_metric_gradient(spec, scope_columns, scope_lf):
    metric_lf = scope_lf.select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            *scope_columns,
            "is_qr",
            "origin_zone_top1",
            pl.col(spec["metric_col"]).alias("metric_value"),
            pl.col(spec["support_col"]).alias("metric_support"),
        ]
    )
    detail, summary = gradient_tables(
        metric_lf,
        scope_columns=scope_columns,
    )
    metadata = {
        "family": spec["family"],
        "scale": spec["scale"],
        "metric": spec["metric"],
    }
    return detail.assign(**metadata), summary.assign(**metadata)
```

**Criterio de lectura.** Un gradiente descriptivo avanza si conserva signo y
orden aproximado entre anos, franjas y escalas. La oferta, la demanda y la
relacion demanda-oferta se evaluan por separado. Un gradiente zonal que no
aparece en paradero-hora se interpreta primero como contexto o composicion
territorial; no como experiencia individual ni efecto causal. El control
socio-territorial conjunto se realiza despues de esta comparacion cruda.

### 13L) Metro: insumos, versiones y mapeo de estaciones

Este bloque cierra el contrato de insumos para construir variables metro. No
materializa todavia oferta, demanda ni presion metro; solo fija el universo,
las versiones GTFS disponibles, el soporte de etapas observadas y el criterio de
mapeo estacion-ZONA777 que usara 13M.

```{python}
#| label: block13l-operational-metro-source-inventory
print("label: block13l-operational-metro-source-inventory")

import re
import unicodedata
from datetime import date

OP_METRO_GTFS_ROOT = PROJECT_ROOT / "config" / "GTFS"
OP_METRO_GRAPH_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "01_processing" / "metro_graphs"
OP_METRO_HEADWAYS_MASTER_PATH = OP_METRO_GTFS_ROOT / "metro_headways_master.parquet"
OP_METRO_GRAPH_MANIFEST_PATH = OP_METRO_GRAPH_DIR / "manifest_graphs.parquet"
OP_METRO_MODE_CODE = "2"
OP_METROTREN_MODE_CODE = "4"

OP_METRO_STATION_ALIASES = {
    "AVENIDA MATTA": "MATTA",
    "CAL Y CANTO": "PUENTE CAL Y CANTO",
    "MONS EYZAGUIRRE": "MONSENOR EYZAGUIRRE",
    "PARQUE OHIGGINS": "PARQUE O HIGGINS",
    "PLAZA MAIPU": "PLAZA DE MAIPU",
    "RONDIZONNI": "RONDIZZONI",
    "U L A": "UNION LATINOAMERICANA",
    "ULA": "UNION LATINOAMERICANA",
    "UNION": "UNION LATINOAMERICANA",
    "UNION LATINO AMERICANA": "UNION LATINOAMERICANA",
}


def op_metro_normalize_station_name(value: object) -> str | None:
    """Canonical station name shared by GTFS and observed Metro stage labels."""

    if value is None or pd.isna(value):
        return None
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(value))
    text = "".join(char for char in text if not unicodedata.combining(char))
    text = text.upper()
    text = re.sub(r"\bDIRECCION\b.*$", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    text = re.sub(r"(?:\s+L\d[A-Z]?)+$", "", text).strip()
    return OP_METRO_STATION_ALIASES.get(text, text)


def op_metro_week_date_range(partition: str) -> tuple[date, date]:
    year, week = partition.split("-W")
    start = date.fromisocalendar(int(year), int(week), 1)
    end = date.fromisocalendar(int(year), int(week), 7)
    return start, end


def op_metro_assigned_gtfs(partition: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    start, end = op_metro_week_date_range(partition)
    if partition.startswith("2024-"):
        return "GTFS_20240210", "Feed local vigente para semanas 2024."
    if end < date(2025, 4, 12):
        return "GTFS_20250412", "Proxy anticipado: no hay feed local 2025 previo."
    if start < date(2025, 5, 17):
        return "GTFS_20250412", "Feed local mas cercano para abril 2025."
    if start < date(2025, 11, 8):
        return "GTFS_20250517", "Feed local posterior disponible."
    return "GTFS_20251108", "Feed local posterior disponible."


def op_metro_route_tables(gtfs_version: str) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    gtfs_dir = OP_METRO_GTFS_ROOT / gtfs_version
    routes = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "routes.txt", dtype=str)
    trips = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "trips.txt", dtype=str, usecols=["route_id", "trip_id"])
    stop_times = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "stop_times.txt", dtype=str, usecols=["trip_id", "stop_id"])
    stops = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "stops.txt", dtype=str)
    metro_routes = routes[
        routes["agency_id"].eq("M") & routes["route_type"].astype(str).eq("1")
    ].copy()
    metro_trip_ids = trips.loc[trips["route_id"].isin(metro_routes["route_id"]), "trip_id"]
    metro_stop_ids = stop_times.loc[stop_times["trip_id"].isin(metro_trip_ids), "stop_id"].drop_duplicates()
    metro_stops = stops.loc[stops["stop_id"].isin(metro_stop_ids)].copy()
    metro_stops["station_canon"] = metro_stops["stop_name"].map(op_metro_normalize_station_name)
    return metro_routes, metro_stops


gtfs_versions = sorted(
    path.name
    for path in OP_METRO_GTFS_ROOT.glob("GTFS_*")
    if path.is_dir()
)

inventory_rows = []
for gtfs_version in gtfs_versions:
    metro_routes, metro_stops = op_metro_route_tables(gtfs_version)
    graph_path = OP_METRO_GRAPH_DIR / f"metro_graph_{gtfs_version}.gpickle"
    edges_path = OP_METRO_GRAPH_DIR / f"metro_edges_{gtfs_version}.parquet"
    inventory_rows.append(
        {
            "gtfs_version": gtfs_version,
            "n_metro_route_variants": len(metro_routes),
            "n_metro_base_lines": metro_routes["route_short_name"].nunique(),
            "n_gtfs_stop_rows": len(metro_stops),
            "n_canonical_stations": metro_stops["station_canon"].nunique(),
            "has_graph": graph_path.exists(),
            "has_edges": edges_path.exists(),
            "has_headways_master": OP_METRO_HEADWAYS_MASTER_PATH.exists(),
        }
    )

op_metro_13l_gtfs_inventory = pd.DataFrame(inventory_rows)
display(
    op_metro_13l_gtfs_inventory.style.format(
        {
            "n_metro_route_variants": fmt_int,
            "n_metro_base_lines": fmt_int,
            "n_gtfs_stop_rows": fmt_int,
            "n_canonical_stations": fmt_int,
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

op_metro_13l_week_assignment = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "partition": partition,
            "week_start": op_metro_week_date_range(partition)[0].isoformat(),
            "week_end": op_metro_week_date_range(partition)[1].isoformat(),
            "assigned_gtfs": op_metro_assigned_gtfs(partition)[0],
            "assignment_note": op_metro_assigned_gtfs(partition)[1],
        }
        for partition in TRIP_WEEKS_AVAILABLE
    ]
)
display(op_metro_13l_week_assignment.style.hide(axis="index"))

if OP_METRO_HEADWAYS_MASTER_PATH.exists():
    op_metro_headways_master = pd.read_parquet(OP_METRO_HEADWAYS_MASTER_PATH)
    op_metro_13l_headways_summary = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "artifact": "metro_headways_master.parquet",
                "n_rows": len(op_metro_headways_master),
                "n_lines": op_metro_headways_master["linea"].nunique(),
                "valid_from_min": str(op_metro_headways_master["valid_from"].min()),
                "valid_to_max": str(op_metro_headways_master["valid_to"].max()),
                "use_in_13m": "validacion de oferta; no reemplaza GTFS para semanas sin vigencia directa",
            }
        ]
    )
else:
    op_metro_13l_headways_summary = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "artifact": "metro_headways_master.parquet",
```

```{python}
#| label: block13l-operational-metro-stage-support
print("label: block13l-operational-metro-stage-support")

OP_METRO_STAGE_RANGE = range(1, 7)


def op_metro_trip_path(partition: str) -> Path:
    return PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp" / f"viajes_con_te_calculado_{partition}.parquet"


def op_non_empty_expr(column: str) -> pl.Expr:
    return pl.col(column).is_not_null() & (pl.col(column).cast(pl.Utf8).str.strip_chars() != "")


def op_stage_mode_expr(stage: int, mode_code: str) -> pl.Expr:
    return pl.col(f"tipo_transporte_{stage}").cast(pl.Utf8).eq(mode_code)


def op_stage_support_for_partition(partition: str, mode_code: str, mode_label: str) -> dict:
    path = op_metro_trip_path(partition)
    lf = pl.scan_parquet(path)
    schema_names = set(lf.collect_schema().names())

    stage_exprs = []
    station_support = []
    time_support = []
    zone_support = []
    for stage in OP_METRO_STAGE_RANGE:
        type_col = f"tipo_transporte_{stage}"
        station_col = f"paradero_subida_{stage}"
        time_col = f"tiempo_subida_{stage}"
        zone_col = f"zona_subida_{stage}"
        if type_col not in schema_names:
            continue
        stage_expr = op_stage_mode_expr(stage, mode_code)
        stage_exprs.append((stage, stage_expr))
        if station_col in schema_names:
            station_support.append((stage_expr & op_non_empty_expr(station_col)).cast(pl.Int64))
        if time_col in schema_names:
            time_support.append((stage_expr & op_non_empty_expr(time_col)).cast(pl.Int64))
        if zone_col in schema_names:
            zone_support.append((stage_expr & op_non_empty_expr(zone_col)).cast(pl.Int64))

    any_mode = pl.any_horizontal([expr for _, expr in stage_exprs])
    first_stage = op_stage_mode_expr(1, mode_code)
    stage_count_exprs = [
        expr.cast(pl.Int64).sum().alias(f"stage_{stage}_n")
        for stage, expr in stage_exprs
    ]

    metrics = lf.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_trips_total"),
            pl.col("id_tarjeta").n_unique().alias("n_cards_total"),
            any_mode.cast(pl.Int64).sum().alias("n_trips_any_stage"),
            pl.when(any_mode).then(pl.col("id_tarjeta")).otherwise(None).n_unique().alias("n_cards_any_stage"),
            first_stage.cast(pl.Int64).sum().alias("n_trips_first_stage"),
            pl.when(first_stage).then(pl.col("id_tarjeta")).otherwise(None).n_unique().alias("n_cards_first_stage"),
            (first_stage & op_non_empty_expr("paradero_subida_1")).cast(pl.Int64).sum().alias("n_first_stage_station"),
            (first_stage & op_non_empty_expr("tiempo_subida_1")).cast(pl.Int64).sum().alias("n_first_stage_time"),
            (first_stage & op_non_empty_expr("zona_subida_1")).cast(pl.Int64).sum().alias("n_first_stage_zone"),
            sum(expr for _, expr in stage_exprs).cast(pl.Int64).sum().alias("n_mode_stage_events"),
            sum(station_support).alias("n_mode_stage_events_with_station"),
            sum(time_support).alias("n_mode_stage_events_with_time"),
            sum(zone_support).alias("n_mode_stage_events_with_zone"),
            *stage_count_exprs,
        ]
    ).collect().to_pandas().iloc[0].to_dict()
    metrics.update({"partition": partition, "mode_code": mode_code, "mode_label": mode_label})
    return metrics


support_rows = []
for partition in TRIP_WEEKS_AVAILABLE:
    support_rows.append(op_stage_support_for_partition(partition, OP_METRO_MODE_CODE, "Metro estricto"))
    support_rows.append(op_stage_support_for_partition(partition, OP_METROTREN_MODE_CODE, "MetroTren / ferroviario"))

op_metro_13l_stage_support = pd.DataFrame(support_rows)
for col in [
    "first_stage_station_share",
    "first_stage_time_share",
    "first_stage_zone_share",
    "any_stage_station_share",
    "any_stage_time_share",
    "any_stage_zone_share",
]:
    numerator = {
        "first_stage_station_share": "n_first_stage_station",
        "first_stage_time_share": "n_first_stage_time",
        "first_stage_zone_share": "n_first_stage_zone",
        "any_stage_station_share": "n_mode_stage_events_with_station",
        "any_stage_time_share": "n_mode_stage_events_with_time",
        "any_stage_zone_share": "n_mode_stage_events_with_zone",
    }[col]
    denominator = "n_trips_first_stage" if col.startswith("first_stage") else "n_mode_stage_events"
    op_metro_13l_stage_support[col] = (
        op_metro_13l_stage_support[numerator] / op_metro_13l_stage_support[denominator].replace(0, np.nan)
    )

display(
    op_metro_13l_stage_support[
        [
            "partition",
            "mode_label",
            "n_trips_any_stage",
            "n_trips_first_stage",
            "n_cards_first_stage",
            "first_stage_station_share",
            "first_stage_time_share",
            "first_stage_zone_share",
            "any_stage_zone_share",
        ]
    ]
    .style.format(
        {
            "n_trips_any_stage": fmt_int,
            "n_trips_first_stage": fmt_int,
            "n_cards_first_stage": fmt_int,
            "first_stage_station_share": "{:.2%}",
            "first_stage_time_share": "{:.2%}",
            "first_stage_zone_share": "{:.2%}",
            "any_stage_zone_share": "{:.2%}",
        }
    )
    .hide(axis="index")
)

stage_position_rows = []
for _, row in op_metro_13l_stage_support.iterrows():
    total_events = row["n_mode_stage_events"]
    for stage in OP_METRO_STAGE_RANGE:
        n_events = row.get(f"stage_{stage}_n", 0)
        stage_position_rows.append(
            {
                "partition": row["partition"],
                "mode_label": row["mode_label"],
                "stage_position": stage,
                "n_events": n_events,
                "share_events": n_events / total_events if total_events else np.nan,
            }
        )

op_metro_13l_stage_position_summary = pd.DataFrame(stage_position_rows)
display(
    op_metro_13l_stage_position_summary.groupby(["mode_label", "stage_position"], as_index=False)
    .agg(n_events=("n_events", "sum"), share_events=("share_events", "mean"))
    .style.format({"n_events": fmt_int, "share_events": "{:.2%}"})
    .hide(axis="index")
)
```

```{python}
#| label: block13l-operational-metro-station-mapping
print("label: block13l-operational-metro-station-mapping")


def op_metro_unique_station_names_for_mode(mode_code: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for partition in TRIP_WEEKS_AVAILABLE:
        lf = pl.scan_parquet(op_metro_trip_path(partition))
        schema_names = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
        for stage in OP_METRO_STAGE_RANGE:
            type_col = f"tipo_transporte_{stage}"
            station_col = f"paradero_subida_{stage}"
            if type_col not in schema_names or station_col not in schema_names:
                continue
            grouped = (
                lf.filter(op_stage_mode_expr(stage, mode_code) & op_non_empty_expr(station_col))
                .group_by(station_col)
                .agg(pl.len().alias("n_stage_events"))
                .with_columns(
                    [
                        pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
                        pl.lit(stage).alias("stage_position"),
                    ]
                )
                .collect()
                .rename({station_col: "station_observed"})
                .to_pandas()
            )
            rows.append(grouped)
    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["station_observed", "station_canon", "n_stage_events"])
    stations = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    stations["station_canon"] = stations["station_observed"].map(op_metro_normalize_station_name)
    return (
        stations.groupby(["station_observed", "station_canon"], as_index=False)
        .agg(n_stage_events=("n_stage_events", "sum"))
        .sort_values("n_stage_events", ascending=False)
    )


def op_metro_gtfs_station_union() -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for gtfs_version in gtfs_versions:
        _, metro_stops = op_metro_route_tables(gtfs_version)
        rows.append(
            metro_stops[["station_canon", "stop_name"]]
            .drop_duplicates()
            .assign(gtfs_version=gtfs_version)
        )
    union = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    return (
        union.groupby("station_canon", as_index=False)
        .agg(
            n_gtfs_versions=("gtfs_version", "nunique"),
            example_gtfs_stop_name=("stop_name", "first"),
        )
        .sort_values("station_canon")
    )


op_metro_13l_gtfs_station_union = op_metro_gtfs_station_union()
op_metro_13l_observed_metro_stations = op_metro_unique_station_names_for_mode(OP_METRO_MODE_CODE)
op_metro_13l_observed_train_stations = op_metro_unique_station_names_for_mode(OP_METROTREN_MODE_CODE)

def op_station_match_summary(observed: pd.DataFrame, mode_label: str) -> dict:
    matched = observed["station_canon"].isin(op_metro_13l_gtfs_station_union["station_canon"])
    return {
        "mode_label": mode_label,
        "n_observed_station_labels": observed["station_observed"].nunique(),
        "n_observed_canonical_stations": observed["station_canon"].nunique(),
        "n_matched_canonical_stations": observed.loc[matched, "station_canon"].nunique(),
        "n_unmatched_canonical_stations": observed.loc[~matched, "station_canon"].nunique(),
        "matched_stage_event_share": observed.loc[matched, "n_stage_events"].sum()
        / observed["n_stage_events"].sum(),
    }


op_metro_13l_station_match_summary = pd.DataFrame(

def op_metro_gtfs_station_points(gtfs_version: str = "GTFS_20250412") -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    metro_routes, _ = op_metro_route_tables(gtfs_version)
    gtfs_dir = OP_METRO_GTFS_ROOT / gtfs_version
    trips = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "trips.txt", dtype=str, usecols=["route_id", "trip_id"])
    stop_times = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "stop_times.txt", dtype=str, usecols=["trip_id", "stop_id"])
    stops = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "stops.txt", dtype=str)
    metro_trips = trips.loc[trips["route_id"].isin(metro_routes["route_id"])].copy()
    metro_stop_lines = (
        stop_times.merge(metro_trips, on="trip_id", how="inner")
        .merge(metro_routes[["route_id", "route_short_name"]], on="route_id", how="left")
        .merge(stops[["stop_id", "stop_name", "stop_lat", "stop_lon"]], on="stop_id", how="left")
    )
    metro_stop_lines["station_canon"] = metro_stop_lines["stop_name"].map(op_metro_normalize_station_name)
    metro_stop_lines["stop_lat"] = pd.to_numeric(metro_stop_lines["stop_lat"], errors="coerce")
    metro_stop_lines["stop_lon"] = pd.to_numeric(metro_stop_lines["stop_lon"], errors="coerce")
    station_points = (
        metro_stop_lines.dropna(subset=["station_canon", "stop_lat", "stop_lon"])
        .groupby("station_canon", as_index=False)
        .agg(
            stop_lat=("stop_lat", "mean"),
            stop_lon=("stop_lon", "mean"),
            n_gtfs_stop_rows=("stop_id", "nunique"),
            n_lines=("route_short_name", "nunique"),
            lines=("route_short_name", lambda values: ", ".join(sorted(set(values)))),
        )
    )
    return gpd.GeoDataFrame(
        station_points,
        geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(station_points["stop_lon"], station_points["stop_lat"]),
        crs="EPSG:4326",
    )


def op_metro_observed_station_zone_mapping() -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for partition in TRIP_WEEKS_AVAILABLE:
        grouped = (
            pl.scan_parquet(op_metro_trip_path(partition))
            .filter(op_stage_mode_expr(1, OP_METRO_MODE_CODE) & op_non_empty_expr("paradero_subida_1") & op_non_empty_expr("zona_subida_1"))
            .group_by(["paradero_subida_1", "zona_subida_1"])
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_stage1_metro_entries"),
                    pl.col("id_tarjeta").n_unique().alias("n_cards"),
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        grouped["partition"] = partition
        rows.append(grouped)
    observed = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    observed["station_canon"] = observed["paradero_subida_1"].map(op_metro_normalize_station_name)
    observed["zone_id"] = pd.to_numeric(observed["zona_subida_1"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    collapsed = (
        observed.dropna(subset=["station_canon", "zone_id"])
        .groupby(["station_canon", "zone_id"], as_index=False)
        .agg(n_stage1_metro_entries=("n_stage1_metro_entries", "sum"), n_cards=("n_cards", "sum"))
        .sort_values(["station_canon", "n_stage1_metro_entries"], ascending=[True, False])
    )
    collapsed["station_total"] = collapsed.groupby("station_canon")["n_stage1_metro_entries"].transform("sum")
    modal = collapsed.groupby("station_canon", as_index=False).head(1).copy()
    modal["observed_zone_modal_share"] = modal["n_stage1_metro_entries"] / modal["station_total"]
    return modal


op_metro_13l_station_points = op_metro_gtfs_station_points("GTFS_20250412")
zona777_lonlat = load_zona777_geometries_lonlat()[["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "geometry"]]

op_metro_13l_observed_modal_zone = op_metro_observed_station_zone_mapping()
op_metro_13l_station_zone_review = op_metro_13l_station_zone_geometry.merge(
    op_metro_13l_observed_modal_zone[
        ["station_canon", "zone_id", "observed_zone_modal_share", "n_stage1_metro_entries"]
    ].rename(columns={"zone_id": "observed_modal_zone_id"}),
    on="station_canon",
    how="left",
)
op_metro_13l_station_zone_review["geometry_observed_same"] = (
    op_metro_13l_station_zone_review["geometry_zone_id"].astype("Int64")
    == op_metro_13l_station_zone_review["observed_modal_zone_id"].astype("Int64")

both_zone_mask = (
    op_metro_13l_station_zone_review["geometry_zone_id"].notna()

op_metro_13l_station_zone_summary = pd.DataFrame(

        {

            "observed_modal_share_p50": "{:.2%}",
            "observed_modal_share_min": "{:.2%}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")

display(
```

**Cierre 13L.** Metro queda listo para 13M con un criterio reproducible:
modo Metro estricto, primera etapa como demanda principal, nombres de estaciones
canonicos, geometria GTFS como mapeo principal a ZONA777 y uso documentado de
versiones GTFS por semana. 13M debe construir variables; 13L solo fija el
contrato de insumos y caveats.

### 13M) Metro: definiciones, sanidad y cobertura

13M construye los contextos base de Metro necesarios antes de auditar
plausibilidad y gradientes: oferta programada por estacion/franja desde GTFS,
demanda observada de primera etapa Metro, relacion demanda-oferta observada y
soporte por tarjeta. No se interpreta ningun cociente como ocupacion,
congestion, capacidad ni espera real.
