```{python}
#| label: block13m-operational-metro-context-build
print("label: block13m-operational-metro-context-build")

OP_METRO_LAB_PM_HOURS = [6, 7, 8]
OP_METRO_LAB_PT_HOURS = [18, 19]


def op_metro_seconds(value: str) -> int:
    hour, minute, second = [int(part) for part in str(value).split(":")]
    return hour * 3600 + minute * 60 + second


def op_metro_service_id_for_date_expr(timestamp_col: str) -> pl.Expr:
    weekday = pl.col(timestamp_col).dt.weekday()
    return (
        pl.when(weekday <= 5)
        .then(pl.lit("L"))
        .when(weekday == 6)
        .then(pl.lit("S"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("D"))
    )


def op_metro_franja_for_service_hour(service_id: str, hour: int) -> str:
    if service_id != "L":
        return "NO_LAB"
    if hour in OP_METRO_LAB_PM_HOURS:
        return "LAB_PM"
    if hour in OP_METRO_LAB_PT_HOURS:
        return "LAB_PT"
    return "LAB_VALLE"


def op_metro_week_service_day_counts(partition: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    start, _ = op_metro_week_date_range(partition)
    counts = {"L": 0, "S": 0, "D": 0}
    for offset in range(7):
        day = start + pd.Timedelta(days=offset)
        if day.weekday() < 5:
            counts["L"] += 1
        elif day.weekday() == 5:
            counts["S"] += 1
        else:
            counts["D"] += 1
    return counts


def op_metro_frequency_rows_by_hour(gtfs_version: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    gtfs_dir = OP_METRO_GTFS_ROOT / gtfs_version
    routes = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "routes.txt", dtype=str)
    trips = pd.read_csv(
        gtfs_dir / "trips.txt",
        dtype=str,
        usecols=["route_id", "trip_id", "service_id", "direction_id"],
    )
    stop_times = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "stop_times.txt", dtype=str, usecols=["trip_id", "stop_id"])
    stops = pd.read_csv(gtfs_dir / "stops.txt", dtype=str, usecols=["stop_id", "stop_name"])
    frequencies = pd.read_csv(
        gtfs_dir / "frequencies.txt",
        dtype=str,
        usecols=["trip_id", "start_time", "end_time", "headway_secs"],
    )
    metro_routes = routes[
        routes["agency_id"].eq("M") & routes["route_type"].astype(str).eq("1")
    ][["route_id", "route_short_name"]].copy()
    metro_trip_stations = (
        trips.merge(metro_routes, on="route_id", how="inner")
        .merge(stop_times, on="trip_id", how="inner")
        .merge(stops, on="stop_id", how="left")
    )
    metro_trip_stations["station_canon"] = metro_trip_stations["stop_name"].map(
        op_metro_normalize_station_name
    )
    metro_trip_stations = metro_trip_stations.dropna(subset=["station_canon"]).drop_duplicates(
        ["trip_id", "station_canon", "route_id", "direction_id", "service_id"]
    )
    freq = frequencies.merge(metro_trip_stations, on="trip_id", how="inner")
    freq["start_sec"] = freq["start_time"].map(op_metro_seconds)
    freq["end_sec"] = freq["end_time"].map(op_metro_seconds)
    freq["headway_secs"] = pd.to_numeric(freq["headway_secs"], errors="coerce")

    rows = []
    for row in freq.itertuples(index=False):
        for hour in range(24):
            hour_start = hour * 3600
            hour_end = (hour + 1) * 3600
            overlap = max(0, min(row.end_sec, hour_end) - max(row.start_sec, hour_start))
            if overlap <= 0 or not np.isfinite(row.headway_secs) or row.headway_secs <= 0:
                continue
            rows.append(
                {
                    "gtfs_version": gtfs_version,
                    "station_canon": row.station_canon,
                    "service_id": row.service_id,
                    "hour_of_day": hour,
                    "franja_v2": op_metro_franja_for_service_hour(row.service_id, hour),
                    "route_id": row.route_id,
                    "line": row.route_short_name,
                    "direction_id": row.direction_id,
                    "train_h_contribution": overlap / row.headway_secs,
                }
            )
    hourly = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if hourly.empty:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No se pudieron derivar frecuencias Metro para {gtfs_version}.")
    return (
        hourly.groupby(
            ["gtfs_version", "station_canon", "service_id", "hour_of_day", "franja_v2"],
            as_index=False,
        )
        .agg(
            op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour=("train_h_contribution", "sum"),
            n_route_variants=("route_id", "nunique"),
            n_lines=("line", "nunique"),
            lines=("line", lambda values: ", ".join(sorted(set(values)))),
        )
    )


def op_metro_station_franja_supply(station_hour_supply: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return (
        station_hour_supply.groupby(
            ["gtfs_version", "station_canon", "service_id", "franja_v2"],
            as_index=False,
        )
        .agg(
            op_metro_supply_typical_station_trains_h=(
                "op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour",
                "mean",
            ),
            op_metro_supply_scheduled_station_passages_day_franja=(
                "op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour",
                "sum",
            ),
            n_active_hours=("hour_of_day", "nunique"),
            n_lines=("n_lines", "max"),
            lines=("lines", "first"),
        )
    )


op_metro_13m_station_hour_supply = pd.concat(
    [op_metro_frequency_rows_by_hour(gtfs_version) for gtfs_version in gtfs_versions],
    ignore_index=True,
)
op_metro_13m_station_franja_supply = op_metro_station_franja_supply(
    op_metro_13m_station_hour_supply
)

op_metro_13m_station_zone = op_metro_13l_station_zone_review[

op_metro_13m_station_zone.to_parquet(OP_METRO_STATION_ZONE_PATH, index=False)


def op_metro_first_stage_events_lf(partition: str) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return (
        pl.scan_parquet(op_metro_trip_path(partition))
        .filter(op_stage_mode_expr(1, OP_METRO_MODE_CODE))
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("pk_viaje").cast(pl.UInt64).alias("trip_id"),
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8),
                pl.col("paradero_subida_1").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("station_observed"),
                pl.col("zona_subida_1").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("observed_zone_id"),
                pl.col("tiempo_subida_1")
                .cast(pl.Utf8)
                .str.to_datetime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", strict=False)
                .alias("entry_timestamp"),
                pl.col("tipodia").cast(pl.Int8, strict=False),
            ]
        )
        .drop_nulls(["id_tarjeta", "station_observed", "entry_timestamp"])
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
                pl.col("entry_timestamp").dt.truncate("1h").alias("hour_start"),
                pl.col("entry_timestamp").dt.hour().alias("hour_of_day"),
                op_metro_service_id_for_date_expr("entry_timestamp").alias("service_id"),
            ]
        )
    )


op_metro_13m_event_parts = [
    add_franja_v2(op_metro_first_stage_events_lf(partition), timestamp_col="entry_timestamp")
    .drop(["_ts_local", "_is_laboral", "_hora"])

]
op_metro_13m_station_name_map_pl = pl.from_pandas(

op_metro_13m_events = pl.concat(op_metro_13m_event_parts, how="diagonal_relaxed").join(

op_metro_13m_station_zone_pl = pl.from_pandas(

op_metro_13m_week_assignment_pl = pl.from_pandas(

op_metro_13m_station_hour_supply_pl = pl.from_pandas(op_metro_13m_station_hour_supply).lazy()

op_metro_13m_station_hour_context = (
    op_metro_13m_events.group_by(
```

```{python}
        pl.col("zone_id").is_not_null().mean().alias("station_hour_zone_share"),
        pl.col("op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour")
        .is_not_null()
        .mean()
        .alias("station_hour_supply_match_share"),
        (
            pl.when(pl.col("op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour").is_not_null())
            .then(pl.col("op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour"))
            .otherwise(0)
            .sum()
            / pl.col("op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour").sum()
        ).alias("station_hour_supply_entry_match_share"),
        pl.col("op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour")
        .sum()
        .alias("n_station_hour_entries"),
    ]
).collect().row(0, named=True)

op_metro_13m_zone_checks = op_metro_13m_zone_lf.select(
    [
        pl.len().alias("n_zone_franja_rows"),
        pl.struct(["partition", "zone_id", "franja_v2"])

        .alias("zone_franja_duplicates"),

        pl.col("op_metro_demand_entries_zone_franja_week")

).collect().row(0, named=True)

op_metro_13m_percentile_bad = []
for path in [OP_METRO_STATION_HOUR_CONTEXT_PATH, OP_METRO_ZONE_FRANJA_CONTEXT_PATH]:
    schema_cols = set(pl.read_parquet_schema(path))
    selected = [col for col in op_metro_13m_percentile_cols if col in schema_cols]
    if not selected:
        continue
    row = (
        pl.scan_parquet(path)
        .select(
            [
                *[pl.col(col).min().alias(f"{col}__min") for col in selected],
                *[pl.col(col).max().alias(f"{col}__max") for col in selected],
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .row(0, named=True)
    )
    op_metro_13m_percentile_bad.extend(
        [
            (metric, value)
            for metric, value in row.items()
            if value is not None
            and (
                (metric.endswith("__min") and value < 0)
                or (metric.endswith("__max") and value > 1)
            )
        ]
    )

op_metro_13m_station_card_entries_close = (
```

**Cierre 13M.** Quedan materializados los contextos Metro base y su soporte:
estacion-hora, ZONA777-semana-franja y tarjeta con primera etapa Metro. Las
variables son descriptivas y programadas; no miden espera, ocupacion,
congestion, capacidad ni linea efectivamente abordada. 13N debe auditar
plausibilidad, extremos, estabilidad y sensibilidad raw-versus-percentil.

### 13N) Metro: plausibilidad, extremos y estabilidad

Este bloque audita si las variables Metro materializadas en 13M se comportan
como dimensiones operacionales plausibles antes de mirar gradientes QR/BIP. Se
mantienen dos escalas:

- `ZONA777 x semana x franja`, para oferta, presencia espacial, demanda y
  relacion demanda-oferta zonal;
- `estacion x hora del dia x semana x franja`, condicionado a estaciones-hora
  con entradas Metro observadas.

La escala estacion-hora no es inventario completo de toda la oferta programada:
describe los puntos y horas donde hay demanda observada. La relacion
demanda-oferta sigue siendo una medida derivada de actividad por pasada
tren-estacion programada equivalente, no ocupacion ni congestion.

```{python}
#| label: block13n-operational-metro-plausibility-definitions

import importlib
import sys

if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from scripts.audits import audit_operational_bus_extremes_stability

def op_metro_aggregate_station_hour_week(
    source: pl.LazyFrame | pl.DataFrame,
) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    lf = source.lazy() if isinstance(source, pl.DataFrame) else source
    demand_col = "op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour"
    supply_col = "op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour"
    pressure_col = (
        "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_"
        "station_hour"
    )

    return (
        lf.with_columns(
            [
                pl.col("hour_start").dt.date().alias("_service_date"),
                pl.col(supply_col).is_not_null().alias("_has_matched_supply"),
                pl.when(pl.col(supply_col).is_not_null())
                .then(pl.col(demand_col))
                .otherwise(None)
                .alias("_matched_entries"),
            ]
        )
        .group_by(
            [
                "partition",
                "station_canon",
                "zone_id",
                "COMUNA",
                "MACROZONA",
                "hour_of_day",
                "franja_v2",
            ]
        )
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_observed_station_hour_cells"),
                pl.col("_service_date")
                .n_unique()
                .alias("n_observed_days"),
                pl.col("_has_matched_supply")
                .sum()
                .alias("n_supply_matched_cells"),
                pl.col(demand_col)
                .sum()
                .alias("op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour_week"),
                pl.col(demand_col)
                .mean()
                .alias("op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour_week_mean"),
                pl.col("op_metro_demand_trips_station_hour")
                .sum()
                .alias("op_metro_demand_trips_station_hour_week"),
                pl.col("op_metro_demand_cards_station_hour")
                .mean()
                .alias("op_metro_demand_cards_station_hour_week_mean"),
                pl.col(supply_col)
                .mean()
                .alias("op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour_week_mean"),
                pl.col(supply_col).sum().alias("_matched_supply_sum"),
                pl.col("_matched_entries")
                .sum()
                .alias("_matched_entries_sum"),
                pl.col("n_lines")
                .max()
                .alias("op_metro_n_lines_station_hour_week"),
                pl.col("op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour_percentile")
                .mean()
                .alias("op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour_percentile_mean"),
                pl.col("op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour_percentile")
                .mean()
                .alias("op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour_percentile_mean"),
                pl.col(f"{pressure_col}_percentile")
                .mean()
                .alias(f"{pressure_col}_percentile_mean"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col("n_supply_matched_cells")
                    / pl.col("n_observed_station_hour_cells")
                ).alias("op_metro_supply_match_share_station_hour_week"),
                pl.when(pl.col("_matched_supply_sum") > 0)
                .then(
                    pl.col("_matched_entries_sum")
                    / pl.col("_matched_supply_sum")
                )
                .otherwise(None)
                .alias(
                    "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_"
                    "station_passage_station_hour_week"
                ),
            ]
        )
        .drop(["_matched_supply_sum", "_matched_entries_sum"])
        .sort(["partition", "franja_v2", "station_canon", "hour_of_day"])
    )

op_metro_13n_support = pd.DataFrame(
    [
```

**Lectura previa a 13O.** 13N decide si las variables Metro tienen soporte,
extremos interpretables y rankings suficientemente estables para estudiar
gradientes QR/BIP. La presion sigue siendo una relacion observada
demanda-oferta: complementa, pero no reemplaza, las variables separadas de
oferta y demanda.

### 13O) Gradientes QR/BIP de las variables operacionales Metro

Este bloque pregunta si las tarjetas clasificadas como QR aparecen con mayor o
menor frecuencia en los quintiles de oferta, presencia espacial, demanda y
relacion demanda-oferta Metro. La unidad longitudinal es `tarjeta x ano x
franja`, construida solo sobre viajes cuya primera etapa es Metro.

La especificacion principal usa percentiles calculados dentro de
`semana x franja`. Los niveles raw quedan como sensibilidad, porque 13N mostro
que la normalizacion reordena con fuerza la oferta Metro. Como en bus, `is_qr`
es una clasificacion global de tarjeta; los cortes por ano describen estabilidad
del perfil operacional, no adopcion QR contemporanea.

```{python}
#| label: block13o-operational-metro-qr-gradient-definitions
print("label: block13o-operational-metro-qr-gradient-definitions")

import importlib
import sys

if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from scripts.audits import audit_operational_bus_qr_gradients
from scripts.audits.build_operational_offer_demand_exposure import (
    add_franja_v2,
    percentile_within_groups,
)

audit_operational_bus_qr_gradients = importlib.reload(
    audit_operational_bus_qr_gradients
)
collapse_metrics_scope = (
    audit_operational_bus_qr_gradients.collapse_metrics_scope
)
gradient_tables = audit_operational_bus_qr_gradients.gradient_tables

OP_METRO_QR_GRADIENT_EXPOSURE_PATH = (
    OP_DIR
    / "operational_metro_qr_gradient_exposure_year_franja.parquet"
)


def op_metro_13o_station_observed_map_lf() -> pl.LazyFrame:
    observed = (
        pl.concat(
            [
                pl.scan_parquet(op_metro_trip_path(partition))
                .filter(pl.col("tipo_transporte_1").cast(pl.Utf8).eq(OP_METRO_MODE_CODE))
                .select(pl.col("paradero_subida_1").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("station_observed"))
                .drop_nulls(["station_observed"])
                for partition in TRIP_WEEKS_AVAILABLE
            ],
            how="diagonal_relaxed",
        )
        .unique()
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    observed["station_canon"] = observed["station_observed"].map(
        op_metro_normalize_station_name
    )
    return pl.from_pandas(
        observed.dropna(subset=["station_canon"]).drop_duplicates()
    ).lazy()


def op_metro_13o_first_stage_events_lf() -> pl.LazyFrame:
    parts = []
    for partition in TRIP_WEEKS_AVAILABLE:
        events = (
            pl.scan_parquet(op_metro_trip_path(partition))
            .filter(pl.col("tipo_transporte_1").cast(pl.Utf8).eq(OP_METRO_MODE_CODE))
            .select(
                [
                    pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8),
                    pl.col("pk_viaje").cast(pl.UInt64).alias("trip_id"),
                    pl.col("paradero_subida_1").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("station_observed"),
                    pl.col("tiempo_subida_1")
                    .cast(pl.Utf8)
                    .str.to_datetime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", strict=False)
                    .alias("entry_timestamp"),
                    pl.col("tipodia").cast(pl.Int8, strict=False),
                ]
            )
            .drop_nulls(["id_tarjeta", "station_observed", "entry_timestamp"])
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
                    pl.lit(int(partition[:4])).cast(pl.Int16).alias("year"),
                    pl.col("entry_timestamp").dt.truncate("1h").alias("hour_start"),
                ]
            )
        )
        parts.append(
            add_franja_v2(events, timestamp_col="entry_timestamp")
            .drop(["_ts_local", "_is_laboral", "_hora"])
        )
    return pl.concat(parts, how="diagonal_relaxed")


def op_metro_13o_weighted_mean_expr(
    value_col: str,
    *,
    weight_col: str = "n_entries",
    alias: str,
) -> pl.Expr:
    weighted_sum = (
        pl.when(pl.col(value_col).is_not_null())
        .then(pl.col(value_col) * pl.col(weight_col))
        .otherwise(0)
        .sum()
    )
    support_sum = (
        pl.when(pl.col(value_col).is_not_null())
        .then(pl.col(weight_col))
        .otherwise(0)
        .sum()
    )
    return pl.when(support_sum > 0).then(weighted_sum / support_sum).otherwise(None).alias(alias)


def op_metro_13o_metric_support_expr(
    value_col: str,
    *,
    weight_col: str = "n_entries",
    alias: str,
) -> pl.Expr:
    return (
        pl.when(pl.col(value_col).is_not_null())
        .then(pl.col(weight_col))
        .otherwise(0)
        .sum()
        .alias(alias)
    )


def op_metro_13o_build_exposure_lf() -> pl.LazyFrame:
    station_observed_map_lf = op_metro_13o_station_observed_map_lf()
    station_zone_lf = pl.scan_parquet(OP_METRO_STATION_ZONE_PATH).select(
        ["station_canon", "zone_id"]
    )
    station_context_lf = (
        pl.scan_parquet(OP_METRO_STATION_HOUR_CONTEXT_PATH)
        .with_columns(
            percentile_within_groups(
                "n_lines",
                ["partition", "franja_v2"],
            ).alias("op_metro_n_lines_station_hour_percentile")
        )
        .select(
            [
                "partition",
                "station_canon",
                "hour_start",
                "franja_v2",
                "op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour",
                "op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour",
                "n_lines",
                "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_station_hour",
                "op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour_percentile",
                "op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour_percentile",
                "op_metro_n_lines_station_hour_percentile",
                "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_station_hour_percentile",
            ]
        )
    )
    zone_context_lf = (
        pl.scan_parquet(OP_METRO_ZONE_FRANJA_CONTEXT_PATH)
        .with_columns(
            [
                percentile_within_groups(
                    "op_metro_n_stations_zone",
                    ["partition", "franja_v2"],
                ).alias("op_metro_n_stations_zone_percentile"),
                percentile_within_groups(
                    "op_metro_n_lines_zone",
                    ["partition", "franja_v2"],
                ).alias("op_metro_n_lines_zone_percentile"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "partition",
                "zone_id",
                "franja_v2",
                "op_metro_supply_typical_station_trains_h_zone_franja",
                "op_metro_n_stations_zone",
                "op_metro_station_density_km2",
                "op_metro_n_lines_zone",
                "op_metro_demand_entries_zone_franja_week",
                "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_zone_franja_week",
                "op_metro_supply_typical_station_trains_h_zone_franja_percentile",
                "op_metro_n_stations_zone_percentile",
                "op_metro_station_density_km2_percentile",
                "op_metro_n_lines_zone_percentile",
                "op_metro_demand_entries_zone_franja_week_percentile",
                "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_zone_franja_week_percentile",
            ]
        )
    )
    event_cells_lf = (
        op_metro_13o_first_stage_events_lf()
        .join(station_observed_map_lf, on="station_observed", how="left")
        .join(station_zone_lf, on="station_canon", how="left")
        .group_by(
            [
                "id_tarjeta",
                "year",
                "franja_v2",
                "partition",
                "station_canon",
                "hour_start",
                "zone_id",
            ]
        )
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_entries"),
                pl.col("trip_id").n_unique().alias("n_trips"),
            ]
        )
    )
    joined_lf = (
        event_cells_lf
        .join(
            station_context_lf,
            on=["partition", "station_canon", "hour_start", "franja_v2"],
            how="left",
        )
        .join(
            zone_context_lf,
            on=["partition", "zone_id", "franja_v2"],
            how="left",
        )
    )
    metric_pairs = [
        (
            "op_metro_supply_typical_station_trains_h_zone_franja_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_supply_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_supply_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_n_stations_zone_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_station_count_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_station_count_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_station_density_km2_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_density_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_density_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_n_lines_zone_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_lines_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_lines_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_demand_entries_zone_franja_week_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_demand_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_demand_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_zone_franja_week_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_pressure_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_pressure_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_station_supply_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_station_supply_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_n_lines_station_hour_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_station_lines_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_station_lines_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_station_demand_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_station_demand_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_station_hour_percentile",
            "op_qr_metro_station_pressure_percentile_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_station_pressure_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_supply_typical_station_trains_h_zone_franja",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_supply_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_supply_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_n_stations_zone",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_station_count_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_station_count_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_station_density_km2",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_density_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_density_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_n_lines_zone",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_lines_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_lines_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_demand_entries_zone_franja_week",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_demand_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_demand_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_zone_franja_week",
            "op_qr_metro_zone_pressure_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_zone_pressure_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_supply_trains_h_station_hour",
            "op_qr_metro_station_supply_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_station_supply_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "n_lines",
            "op_qr_metro_station_lines_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_station_lines_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_demand_entries_station_hour",
            "op_qr_metro_station_demand_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_station_demand_raw_events",
        ),
        (
            "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_station_hour",
            "op_qr_metro_station_pressure_raw_mean",
            "op_qr_metro_n_station_pressure_raw_events",
        ),
    ]
    return (
        joined_lf.group_by(["id_tarjeta", "year", "franja_v2"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.col("n_entries").sum().alias("op_qr_metro_n_first_stage_entries"),
                pl.col("n_trips").sum().alias("op_qr_metro_n_first_stage_trips"),
                pl.col("partition").n_unique().alias("op_qr_metro_n_weeks"),
                pl.col("station_canon").n_unique().alias("op_qr_metro_n_unique_stations"),
                pl.col("zone_id").n_unique().alias("op_qr_metro_n_unique_zones"),
                *[
                    op_metro_13o_metric_support_expr(value_col, alias=support_alias)
                    for value_col, _, support_alias in metric_pairs
                ],
                *[
                    op_metro_13o_weighted_mean_expr(value_col, alias=metric_alias)
                    for value_col, metric_alias, _ in metric_pairs
                ],
            ]
        )
        .sort(["id_tarjeta", "year", "franja_v2"])
    )


if not OP_METRO_QR_GRADIENT_EXPOSURE_PATH.exists():

def op_metro_13o_scope_frame(specs, scope_columns):
    return collapse_metrics_scope(
        op_metro_13o_exposure_lf,
        metric_specs=specs,
        scope_columns=scope_columns,
    ).join(
        op_metro_13o_cards_lf,
        on="id_tarjeta",
        how="inner",
        validate="m:1",
    ).collect().lazy()


def op_metro_13o_metric_gradient(spec, scope_columns, scope_lf):
    metric_lf = scope_lf.select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            *scope_columns,
            "is_qr",
            "origin_zone_top1",
            pl.col(spec["metric_col"]).alias("metric_value"),
            pl.col(spec["support_col"]).alias("metric_support"),
        ]
    )
    detail, summary = gradient_tables(
        metric_lf,
        scope_columns=scope_columns,
    )
    metadata = {
        "family": spec["family"],
        "scale": spec["scale"],
        "metric": spec["metric"],
    }
    return detail.assign(**metadata), summary.assign(**metadata)


op_metro_13o_support = op_metro_13o_exposure_lf.select(
    [
        pl.len().alias("n_card_year_franja_rows"),
        pl.col("id_tarjeta").n_unique().alias("n_cards"),
        pl.col("year").n_unique().alias("n_years"),
        pl.col("franja_v2").n_unique().alias("n_franjas"),
        pl.col("op_qr_metro_n_first_stage_entries")
        .sum()
        .alias("n_first_stage_entries"),
        pl.col("op_qr_metro_n_zone_supply_events")
        .gt(0)
        .mean()
        .alias("zone_supply_support"),
        pl.col("op_qr_metro_n_station_supply_events")
        .gt(0)
        .mean()
        .alias("station_supply_support"),
        pl.col("op_qr_metro_n_station_pressure_events")
        .gt(0)

        .alias("station_pressure_support"),
    ]
).collect().to_pandas()

        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

```{python}
)
fig.tight_layout()
```


**Criterio de cierre 13O.** Un gradiente Metro avanza a 13P si conserva signo
aproximado entre anos y franjas, tiene soporte suficiente y no depende
exclusivamente de la especificacion raw. Como en bus, esta comparacion sigue
siendo descriptiva: el siguiente filtro es el ajuste socio-territorial conjunto.

### 13P) Auditoria socio-territorial conjunta bus/Metro

Este bloque pregunta cuanto de los gradientes QR/BIP de oferta, demanda y
relacion demanda-oferta sobrevive al comparar tarjetas dentro de estratos
socio-territoriales simples. No reemplaza el screening modelistico de 13Q:
solo separa senales que siguen apareciendo dentro de grupos comparables de
senales que parecen dominadas por composicion territorial, educativa, de ingreso
o de perfil modal.

La unidad sigue siendo tarjeta. Las exposiciones bus y Metro se colapsan desde
`tarjeta x ano x franja` a un promedio ponderado por el soporte de cada metrica.
Los quintiles de cada variable se recalculan dentro de cada estrato auditado.

```{python}
def op_13p_socio_thresholds(cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> dict[str, float]:
    return cards_lf.select(
        [
            pl.col("res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z")
            .quantile(1 / 3)
            .alias("education_q33"),
            pl.col("res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z")
            .quantile(2 / 3)
            .alias("education_q67"),
            pl.col("res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z")
            .quantile(1 / 3)
            .alias("income_de_q33"),
            pl.col("res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z")
            .quantile(2 / 3)
            .alias("income_de_q67"),
        ]
    ).collect().to_dicts()[0]


def op_13p_tertile_expr(column: str, low: float, high: float) -> pl.Expr:
    return (
        pl.when(pl.col(column).is_null())
        .then(pl.lit(None))
        .when(pl.col(column) <= low)
        .then(pl.lit("Bajo"))
        .when(pl.col(column) <= high)
        .then(pl.lit("Medio"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("Alto"))
    )


def op_13p_cards_lf() -> pl.LazyFrame:
    macro_columns = [
        f"{prefix}{suffix}"
        for _, _, _, prefix in TERRITORIAL_GEOGRAPHIES
        for suffix, _ in MACROZONE_LEVELS
    ]
    cards = pl.scan_parquet(MATRIX_PATH).select(
        [
            pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8),
            "is_qr",
            "origin_zone_top1",
            "zona_hogar",
            "n_viajes",
            "share_trips_solo_bus",
            "share_trips_solo_metro",
            "share_trips_metro_bus",
            "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z",
            "res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z",
            *macro_columns,
        ]
    )
    thresholds = op_13p_socio_thresholds(cards)
    return cards.with_columns(
        [
            territorial_macrozone_expr("home_macro_").alias("home_macrozone"),
            territorial_macrozone_expr("origin_top1_macro_").alias("origin_macrozone"),
            op_13p_tertile_expr(
                "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z",
                thresholds["education_q33"],
                thresholds["education_q67"],
            ).alias("education_tertile"),
            op_13p_tertile_expr(
                "res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z",
                thresholds["income_de_q33"],
                thresholds["income_de_q67"],
            ).alias("income_de_tertile"),
            pl.when(pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus") >= 0.80)
            .then(pl.lit("Solo bus alto"))
            .when(pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro") >= 0.80)
            .then(pl.lit("Solo metro alto"))
            .when(pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus") >= 0.20)
            .then(pl.lit("Metro+bus relevante"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("Mixto / otros"))
            .alias("modal_profile"),
        ]
    )


def op_13p_scope_frame(
    exposure_path: Path,
    specs: list[dict[str, str]],
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    exposure_lf = pl.scan_parquet(exposure_path).with_columns(
        pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8)
    )
    return (
        collapse_metrics_scope(
            exposure_lf,
            metric_specs=specs,
            scope_columns=[],
        )
        .join(
            cards_lf,
            on="id_tarjeta",
            how="inner",
            validate="m:1",
        )
        .collect()
        .lazy()
    )


def op_13p_metric_lf(
    spec: dict[str, str],
    scope_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    scope_columns: list[str] | None = None,
) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    scope_columns = scope_columns or []
    metric_lf = scope_lf.select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            *scope_columns,
            "is_qr",
            "origin_zone_top1",
            pl.col(spec["metric_col"]).alias("metric_value"),
            pl.col(spec["support_col"]).alias("metric_support"),
        ]
    ).filter(pl.col("metric_support") > 0)
    if scope_columns:
        metric_lf = metric_lf.drop_nulls(scope_columns)
    return metric_lf


def op_13p_metric_gradient(
    spec: dict[str, str],
    scope_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    scope_columns: list[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    scope_columns = scope_columns or []
    detail, summary = gradient_tables(
        op_13p_metric_lf(spec, scope_lf, scope_columns),
        scope_columns=scope_columns,
    )
    metadata = {
        "mode": spec["mode"],
        "family": spec["family"],
        "scale": spec["scale"],
        "metric": spec["metric"],
    }
    return detail.assign(**metadata), summary.assign(**metadata)
```

```{python}
def op_13p_metric_coverage_rows(
    specs: list[dict[str, str]],
    scope_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    *,
    scope_universe: str,
    matrix_n_cards: int,
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    rows = []
    for spec in specs:
        supported = (
            pl.col(spec["support_col"]).gt(0)
            & pl.col(spec["metric_col"]).is_not_null()
        )
        row = scope_lf.select(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards_scope"),
                supported.sum().alias("n_cards_supported"),
                supported.mean().alias("support_share"),
                pl.when(supported).then(pl.col("is_qr")).otherwise(None).mean().alias("qr_share_supported"),
                pl.when(supported).then(pl.col(spec["support_col"])).otherwise(None).median().alias("median_metric_support"),
                pl.col("home_macrozone").is_not_null().mean().alias("home_macrozone_share"),
                pl.col("origin_macrozone").is_not_null().mean().alias("origin_macrozone_share"),
                pl.col("education_tertile").is_not_null().mean().alias("education_tertile_share"),
                pl.col("income_de_tertile").is_not_null().mean().alias("income_de_tertile_share"),
                pl.col("modal_profile").is_not_null().mean().alias("modal_profile_share"),
            ]
        ).collect().to_pandas().iloc[0].to_dict()
        row.update(
            {
                "mode": spec["mode"],
                "family": spec["family"],
                "scale": spec["scale"],
                "metric": spec["metric"],
                "scope_universe": scope_universe,
                "matrix_support_share": (
                    row["n_cards_supported"] / matrix_n_cards
                    if matrix_n_cards
                    else np.nan
                ),
            }
        )
        rows.append(row)
    return rows
```

```{python}
#| label: block13p-operational-socio-territorial-attenuation
print("label: block13p-operational-socio-territorial-attenuation")


def op_13p_weighted_adjustment(
    crude_row: pd.Series,
    stratum_summary: pd.DataFrame,
    adjustment_dimension: str,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    valid = stratum_summary.dropna(subset=["q5_minus_q1_pp", "n_cards"]).copy()
    if valid.empty:
        adjusted = np.nan
        retained = np.nan
        same_sign_share = np.nan
        min_stratum = np.nan
        max_stratum = np.nan
        n_strata = 0
    else:
        weights = valid["n_cards"].astype(float).to_numpy()
        adjusted = np.average(valid["q5_minus_q1_pp"], weights=weights)
        crude_value = crude_row["q5_minus_q1_pp"]
        retained = adjusted / crude_value if abs(crude_value) >= 0.50 else np.nan
        crude_sign = np.sign(crude_value)
        same_sign = np.sign(valid["q5_minus_q1_pp"]) == crude_sign
        same_sign_share = np.average(same_sign.astype(float), weights=weights)
        min_stratum = valid["q5_minus_q1_pp"].min()
        max_stratum = valid["q5_minus_q1_pp"].max()
        n_strata = len(valid)

    crude_value = crude_row["q5_minus_q1_pp"]
    return {
        "mode": crude_row["mode"],
        "family": crude_row["family"],
        "scale": crude_row["scale"],
        "metric": crude_row["metric"],
        "adjustment_dimension": adjustment_dimension,
        "n_cards_crude": crude_row["n_cards"],
        "crude_q5_q1_pp": crude_value,
        "weighted_adjusted_q5_q1_pp": adjusted,
        "delta_vs_crude_pp": adjusted - crude_value if pd.notna(adjusted) else np.nan,
        "retained_share": retained,
        "same_sign_weighted_share": same_sign_share,
        "sign_flip": bool(
            pd.notna(adjusted)
            and abs(crude_value) >= 0.50
            and np.sign(adjusted) != np.sign(crude_value)
        ),
        "n_strata": n_strata,
        "min_stratum_q5_q1_pp": min_stratum,
        "max_stratum_q5_q1_pp": max_stratum,
    }


op_13p_crude_parts = []
op_13p_adjustment_rows = []
for specs, scope_lf in [
    (OP_13P_BUS_SPECS, op_13p_bus_scope_lf),
    (OP_13P_METRO_SPECS, op_13p_metro_scope_lf),
]:
    for spec in specs:
        _, crude_summary = op_13p_metric_gradient(spec, scope_lf)
        crude_row = crude_summary.iloc[0]
        op_13p_crude_parts.append(crude_summary)
        for stratum_col, stratum_label in OP_13P_STRATA:
            _, stratum_summary = op_13p_metric_gradient(
                spec,
                scope_lf,
                [stratum_col],
            )
            op_13p_adjustment_rows.append(
                op_13p_weighted_adjustment(
                    crude_row,
                    stratum_summary,
                    stratum_label,
                )
            )

op_13p_crude_summary = pd.concat(op_13p_crude_parts, ignore_index=True)
op_13p_adjustment_summary = pd.DataFrame(op_13p_adjustment_rows)

display(
    op_13p_crude_summary[
        [
            "mode",

            "scale",

            "n_cards",
            "q1_qr_share",
            "q5_qr_share",
            "q5_minus_q1_pp",
            "q5_minus_q1_ci_low_pp",
            "q5_minus_q1_ci_high_pp",
            "spearman_quintile_qr",
        ]
    ].style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "q1_qr_share": "{:.1%}",
            "q5_qr_share": "{:.1%}",
            "q5_minus_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "q5_minus_q1_ci_low_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "q5_minus_q1_ci_high_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "spearman_quintile_qr": "{:+.3f}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

display(

        [
            "mode",
            "family",
            "metric",
            "adjustment_dimension",
            "crude_q5_q1_pp",
            "weighted_adjusted_q5_q1_pp",
            "delta_vs_crude_pp",
            "retained_share",
            "same_sign_weighted_share",
            "sign_flip",
            "n_strata",
        ]
    ]
    .sort_values(["mode", "family", "metric", "adjustment_dimension"])
    .style.format(

            "crude_q5_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "weighted_adjusted_q5_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "delta_vs_crude_pp": "{:+.2f}",
```

```{python}
#| label: block13p-operational-socio-territorial-decision
print("label: block13p-operational-socio-territorial-decision")

op_13p_critical_adjustments = op_13p_adjustment_summary[
    op_13p_adjustment_summary["adjustment_dimension"].isin(OP_13P_CRITICAL_STRATA)
].copy()
op_13p_decision_base = (
    op_13p_critical_adjustments.assign(
        abs_retained_share=lambda frame: frame["retained_share"].abs(),
        abs_adjusted_q5_q1_pp=lambda frame: frame["weighted_adjusted_q5_q1_pp"].abs(),
    )
    .groupby(["mode", "family", "scale", "metric"], as_index=False)
    .agg(
        min_abs_retained_share=("abs_retained_share", "min"),
        min_abs_adjusted_q5_q1_pp=("abs_adjusted_q5_q1_pp", "min"),
        max_abs_delta_vs_crude_pp=("delta_vs_crude_pp", lambda values: values.abs().max()),
        min_same_sign_weighted_share=("same_sign_weighted_share", "min"),
        any_sign_flip=("sign_flip", "max"),
    )
    .merge(
        op_13p_crude_summary[
            ["mode", "family", "scale", "metric", "n_cards", "q5_minus_q1_pp"]
        ].rename(columns={"q5_minus_q1_pp": "crude_q5_q1_pp"}),
        on=["mode", "family", "scale", "metric"],
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
)


def op_13p_decision(row: pd.Series) -> str:
    if abs(row["crude_q5_q1_pp"]) < 0.50:
        return "Descriptiva / senal QR debil"
    if bool(row["any_sign_flip"]):
        return "Sensibilidad por composicion"
    if (
        row["min_abs_retained_share"] >= 0.50
        and row["min_same_sign_weighted_share"] >= 0.70
    ):
        return "Avanza a 13Q"
    return "Avanza a 13Q como sensibilidad"


op_13p_decision_base["decision_13q"] = op_13p_decision_base.apply(
    op_13p_decision,
    axis=1,
)
op_13p_decision_base["lectura"] = np.select(
    [
        op_13p_decision_base["decision_13q"].eq("Avanza a 13Q"),
        op_13p_decision_base["decision_13q"].eq("Avanza a 13Q como sensibilidad"),
        op_13p_decision_base["decision_13q"].eq("Sensibilidad por composicion"),
    ],
    [
        "El gradiente conserva signo y magnitud razonable dentro de estratos criticos.",
        "La senal existe, pero queda atenuada; no debe entrar como candidata principal sin 13Q.",
        "La senal cruda depende fuertemente de composicion socio-territorial.",
    ],
    default="La senal cruda es pequena antes de ajustar.",
)
op_13p_decision_table = op_13p_decision_base.sort_values(
    ["decision_13q", "mode", "family", "metric"]
)
display(
    op_13p_decision_table[
        [
            "mode",
            "family",
            "scale",
            "metric",
            "n_cards",
            "crude_q5_q1_pp",
            "min_abs_retained_share",
            "min_same_sign_weighted_share",
            "any_sign_flip",
            "decision_13q",
            "lectura",
        ]
    ].style.format(
        {
            "n_cards": fmt_int,
            "crude_q5_q1_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "min_abs_retained_share": "{:.2f}",
            "min_same_sign_weighted_share": "{:.1%}",
        }
    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

**Criterio de cierre 13P.** Si un gradiente desaparece o revierte dentro de
macrozona, educacion o ingreso, se interpreta primero como composicion. Si se
mantiene dentro de esos estratos, avanza a 13Q para verificar aporte
incremental en modelos. En ningun caso 13P convierte oferta, demanda o presion
en efectos causales.

### 13Q) Screening modelistico operacional conjunto

Este bloque toma las variables que 13P dejo como principales y de sensibilidad.
La pregunta no es causal ni sustituye los modelos discretos finales: solo mide
si cada variable operacional aporta senal incremental para distinguir QR/BIP
despues de controles socio-territoriales, intensidad de uso y perfil modal.

La evaluacion principal es un logit binario de screening con holdout
estratificado. Cada variable se evalua dentro de su universo con soporte; los
bundles se evaluan sobre la interseccion de soporte de sus variables.

```{python}
#| label: block13q-operational-model-frame
print("label: block13q-operational-model-frame")


def op_13q_unique_columns(candidates: list[dict[str, str]], key: str, scope: str) -> list[str]:
    return list(
        dict.fromkeys(
            candidate[key]
            for candidate in candidates
            if candidate["source_scope"] == scope
        )
    )


def op_13q_collect_model_frame() -> pd.DataFrame:
    base_cols = [
        "id_tarjeta",
        "is_qr",
        "n_viajes",
        "share_trips_solo_bus",
        "share_trips_solo_metro",
        "share_trips_metro_bus",
        "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z",
        "res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z",
        "home_macrozone",
        "origin_macrozone",
        "modal_profile",
    ]
    base = op_13p_cards.select(base_cols).collect().to_pandas()
    base["log1p_n_viajes"] = np.log1p(base["n_viajes"].astype(float))

    bus_cols = [
        "id_tarjeta",
        *op_13q_unique_columns(OP_13Q_CANDIDATES, "metric_col", "bus"),
        *op_13q_unique_columns(OP_13Q_CANDIDATES, "support_col", "bus"),
    ]
    metro_cols = [
        "id_tarjeta",
        *op_13q_unique_columns(OP_13Q_CANDIDATES, "metric_col", "metro"),
        *op_13q_unique_columns(OP_13Q_CANDIDATES, "support_col", "metro"),
    ]
    bus = op_13p_bus_scope_lf.select(bus_cols).collect().to_pandas()
    metro = op_13p_metro_scope_lf.select(metro_cols).collect().to_pandas()

    frame = (
        base.merge(bus, on="id_tarjeta", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
        .merge(metro, on="id_tarjeta", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
        .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    )
    for candidate in OP_13Q_CANDIDATES:
        supported = (
            frame[candidate["metric_col"]].notna()
            & frame[candidate["support_col"]].fillna(0).gt(0)
        )
        frame[candidate["model_col"]] = np.where(
            supported,
            frame[candidate["metric_col"]],
            np.nan,
        )
        frame[f'{candidate["model_col"]}_supported'] = supported.astype(int)
    return frame


op_13q_model_frame = op_13q_collect_model_frame()
op_13q_support_rows = []
for candidate in OP_13Q_CANDIDATES:
    supported = op_13q_model_frame[f'{candidate["model_col"]}_supported'].eq(1)
    op_13q_support_rows.append(
        {
            **{
                key: candidate[key]
                for key in [
                    "role_13q",
                    "mode",
                    "family",
                    "scale",
                    "metric",
                    "model_col",
                ]
            },
            "n_cards_supported": int(supported.sum()),
            "matrix_support_share": supported.mean(),
            "qr_share_supported": op_13q_model_frame.loc[supported, "is_qr"].mean(),
            "metric_p50": op_13q_model_frame.loc[supported, candidate["model_col"]].median(),
            "metric_p90": op_13q_model_frame.loc[supported, candidate["model_col"]].quantile(0.90),
        }
    )
op_13q_support = pd.DataFrame(op_13q_support_rows)

    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

```{python}
#| label: block13q-operational-individual-model-screening
print("label: block13q-operational-individual-model-screening")


def op_13q_stratified_sample(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    n: int = OP_13Q_MODEL_SAMPLE_N,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if len(df) <= n:
        return df.sample(frac=1.0, random_state=OP_13Q_MODEL_SEED).reset_index(drop=True)
    parts = []
    for value, group in df.groupby("is_qr", observed=False):
        frac = len(group) / len(df)
        group_n = min(len(group), max(1, int(round(n * frac))))
        parts.append(
            group.sample(
                n=group_n,
                random_state=OP_13Q_MODEL_SEED,
                replace=False,
            )
        )
    return (
        pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)
        .sample(frac=1.0, random_state=OP_13Q_MODEL_SEED)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )


def op_13q_prepare_design(
    train_df: pd.DataFrame,
    test_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    numeric_cols: list[str],
    categorical_cols: list[str],
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, list[str]]:
    x_train_num = train_df[numeric_cols].astype(float).copy()
    x_test_num = test_df[numeric_cols].astype(float).copy()
    medians = x_train_num.median()
    x_train_num = x_train_num.fillna(medians)
    x_test_num = x_test_num.fillna(medians)
    means = x_train_num.mean()
    stds = x_train_num.std(ddof=0).replace(0, 1)
    x_train_num = (x_train_num - means) / stds
    x_test_num = (x_test_num - means) / stds

    train_cat_parts = []
    test_cat_parts = []
    for col in categorical_cols:
        train_cat = pd.get_dummies(
            train_df[col].astype("string").fillna("missing"),
            prefix=col,
        )
        test_cat = pd.get_dummies(
            test_df[col].astype("string").fillna("missing"),
            prefix=col,
        ).reindex(columns=train_cat.columns, fill_value=0)
        train_cat_parts.append(train_cat)
        test_cat_parts.append(test_cat)

    x_train = pd.concat(
        [x_train_num.reset_index(drop=True), *[part.reset_index(drop=True) for part in train_cat_parts]],
        axis=1,
    )
    x_test = pd.concat(
        [x_test_num.reset_index(drop=True), *[part.reset_index(drop=True) for part in test_cat_parts]],
        axis=1,
    )
    return x_train, x_test, x_train.columns.tolist()


def op_13q_fit_screen(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    candidate_cols: list[str],
    screen_label: str,
    role_13q: str,
    mode: str,
    family: str,
    expected_sign: int | None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    required_candidate = frame[candidate_cols].notna().all(axis=1)
    model_df = frame.loc[required_candidate].copy()
    if len(model_df) < OP_13Q_MODEL_MIN_N or model_df["is_qr"].nunique() < 2:
        return {
            "screen_label": screen_label,
            "role_13q": role_13q,
            "mode": mode,
            "family": family,
            "n_obs": len(model_df),
            "screen_status": "sin soporte suficiente",
        }

    sample_df = op_13q_stratified_sample(model_df)
    y = sample_df["is_qr"].astype(int)
    train_df, test_df, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        sample_df,
        y,
        test_size=0.35,
        random_state=OP_13Q_MODEL_SEED,
        stratify=y,
    )
    x_train_base, x_test_base, _ = op_13q_prepare_design(
        train_df,
        test_df,
        numeric_cols=OP_13Q_BASE_NUMERIC_COLS,
        categorical_cols=OP_13Q_BASE_CATEGORICAL_COLS,
    )
    x_train_full, x_test_full, full_features = op_13q_prepare_design(
        train_df,
        test_df,
        numeric_cols=[*OP_13Q_BASE_NUMERIC_COLS, *candidate_cols],
        categorical_cols=OP_13Q_BASE_CATEGORICAL_COLS,
    )
    base_model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=800, solver="lbfgs")
    full_model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=800, solver="lbfgs")
    base_model.fit(x_train_base, y_train)
    full_model.fit(x_train_full, y_train)

    base_pred = base_model.predict_proba(x_test_base)[:, 1]
    full_pred = full_model.predict_proba(x_test_full)[:, 1]
    coef_by_feature = dict(zip(full_features, full_model.coef_[0]))
    candidate_coefs = [coef_by_feature.get(col, np.nan) for col in candidate_cols]
    first_coef = candidate_coefs[0] if len(candidate_coefs) == 1 else np.nan
    max_abs_coef = np.nanmax(np.abs(candidate_coefs)) if candidate_coefs else np.nan
    coef_sign_aligned = (
        np.sign(first_coef) == expected_sign
        if len(candidate_coefs) == 1 and expected_sign is not None and pd.notna(first_coef)
        else np.nan
    )
    return {
        "screen_label": screen_label,
        "role_13q": role_13q,
        "mode": mode,
        "family": family,
        "n_obs": len(model_df),
        "n_sample": len(sample_df),
        "n_test": len(test_df),
        "qr_share_model": y.mean(),
        "base_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, base_pred),
        "candidate_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, full_pred),
        "delta_auc_bps": (roc_auc_score(y_test, full_pred) - roc_auc_score(y_test, base_pred)) * 10_000,
        "base_log_loss": log_loss(y_test, base_pred),
        "candidate_log_loss": log_loss(y_test, full_pred),
        "log_loss_gain_bps": (log_loss(y_test, base_pred) - log_loss(y_test, full_pred)) * 10_000,
        "candidate_coef_std": first_coef,
        "max_abs_candidate_coef_std": max_abs_coef,
        "coef_sign_aligned": coef_sign_aligned,
        "screen_status": "ok",
    }


op_13q_individual_screen = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        op_13q_fit_screen(
            op_13q_model_frame,
            candidate_cols=[candidate["model_col"]],
            screen_label=candidate["metric"],
            role_13q=candidate["role_13q"],
            mode=candidate["mode"],
            family=candidate["family"],
            expected_sign=candidate["expected_sign"],
        )
        for candidate in OP_13Q_CANDIDATES
    ]
)
display(
    op_13q_individual_screen[
        [
            "role_13q",
            "mode",
            "family",
            "screen_label",
            "screen_status",
            "n_obs",
            "n_test",
            "qr_share_model",
            "base_auc",
            "candidate_auc",
            "delta_auc_bps",
            "log_loss_gain_bps",
            "candidate_coef_std",
            "coef_sign_aligned",
        ]
    ].style.format(
        {
            "n_obs": fmt_int,
            "n_test": fmt_int,
            "qr_share_model": "{:.1%}",
            "base_auc": "{:.4f}",
            "candidate_auc": "{:.4f}",
            "delta_auc_bps": "{:+.2f}",
            "log_loss_gain_bps": "{:+.2f}",
            "candidate_coef_std": "{:+.3f}",
        },
        na_rep="NA",
    ).hide(axis="index")
)
```

```{python}
#| label: block13q-operational-bundle-model-screening
print("label: block13q-operational-bundle-model-screening")

op_13q_main_cols = [
    candidate["model_col"]
    for candidate in OP_13Q_CANDIDATES
    if candidate["role_13q"] == "principal"
]
op_13q_sensitivity_cols = [

    if candidate["role_13q"] == "sensibilidad"
]
```

```{python}
#| label: block13q-operational-final-decision
print("label: block13q-operational-final-decision")


def op_13q_model_decision(row: pd.Series) -> str:
    if row.get("screen_status") != "ok":
        return "No modelar por soporte"
    if row["role_13q"] == "principal":
        if row["log_loss_gain_bps"] > 0 and bool(row["coef_sign_aligned"]):
            return "Principal para 13Q final"
        return "Principal descriptiva; revisar especificacion"
    if row["role_13q"] == "sensibilidad":
        if row["log_loss_gain_bps"] > 0 and (
            pd.isna(row["coef_sign_aligned"]) or bool(row["coef_sign_aligned"])
        ):
            return "Sensibilidad modelistica"
        return "Sensibilidad descriptiva"
    return "Descriptiva"


op_13q_final_decision = (
    op_13q_candidate_table.merge(
        op_13q_individual_screen[
            [
                "screen_label",
                "n_obs",
                "delta_auc_bps",
                "log_loss_gain_bps",
                "candidate_coef_std",
                "coef_sign_aligned",
                "screen_status",
            ]
        ],
        left_on="metric",
        right_on="screen_label",
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
)
op_13q_final_decision["decision"] = op_13q_final_decision.apply(
    op_13q_model_decision,
    axis=1,
)
display(
    op_13q_final_decision[
        [
            "role_13q",
            "mode",
            "family",
            "scale",

            "n_obs",
            "delta_auc_bps",

        ]

            "log_loss_gain_bps": "{:+.2f}",
            "candidate_coef_std": "{:+.3f}",
        },

            "criterio": "Medicion defendible pero senal chica, atenuada o menos estable.",
            "uso": "Evaluar en especificaciones alternativas; no mezclar automaticamente con principales.",
        },
        {

            "criterio": "Senal cruda nula, revertida por estratos o dominada por composicion.",
            "uso": "Mantener para interpretacion territorial, no como predictor operacional principal.",
```

**Criterio de cierre 13Q.** Las variables principales y de sensibilidad solo
pasan a la etapa de modelos finales si agregan senal incremental sin contradecir
la lectura de 13P. La decision final no debe basarse solo en AUC/log-loss:
tambien requiere definicion defendible, soporte, estabilidad y coherencia con
el marco conceptual de oferta, demanda y presion observada.

### 13R) Sintesis visual operacional QR/BIP

#### 13R.1) Distribuciones QR vs BIP

```{python}
#| label: block13r-operational-payment-distributions
print("label: block13r-operational-payment-distributions")

OP_13R_ECDF_GRID = np.linspace(0, 1, 201)
OP_13R_TITLE_Y = 0.995
OP_13R_LEGEND_Y = 0.915
OP_13R_PANEL_TOP = 0.84


def op_13r_candidate_distribution_specs() -> pd.DataFrame:
    return (
        op_13q_candidate_table[
            [
                "variable_id",
                "role_13q",
                "mode",
                "family",
                "scale",
                "metric",
                "model_col",
            ]
        ]
        .copy()
        .assign(
            panel_label=lambda df: df["mode"] + " - " + df["metric"],
            role_label=lambda df: df["role_13q"].str.replace("_", " ", regex=False),
        )
    )


def op_13r_ecdf_rows(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    specs: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    grid: np.ndarray = OP_13R_ECDF_GRID,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    ecdf_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    summary_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []

    for spec in specs.to_dict("records"):
        payment_values: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
        for payment_group, is_qr_value in [("BIP", 0), ("QR", 1)]:
            values = (
                frame.loc[
                    frame["is_qr"].eq(is_qr_value) & frame[spec["model_col"]].notna(),
                    spec["model_col"],
                ]
                .astype(float)
                .to_numpy()
            )
            values = np.sort(values[np.isfinite(values)])
            payment_values[payment_group] = values
            if values.size == 0:
                continue
            ecdf = np.searchsorted(values, grid, side="right") / values.size
            ecdf_rows.extend(
                {
                    **spec,
                    "payment_group": payment_group,
                    "x_percentile": float(x),
                    "ecdf": float(y),
                }
                for x, y in zip(grid, ecdf)
            )

        bip = payment_values.get("BIP", np.array([]))
        qr = payment_values.get("QR", np.array([]))
        if bip.size > 0 and qr.size > 0:
            bip_ecdf = np.searchsorted(bip, grid, side="right") / bip.size
            qr_ecdf = np.searchsorted(qr, grid, side="right") / qr.size
            summary_rows.append(
                {
                    **spec,
                    "n_bip": int(bip.size),
                    "n_qr": int(qr.size),
                    "p50_bip": float(np.quantile(bip, 0.50)),
                    "p50_qr": float(np.quantile(qr, 0.50)),
                    "p90_bip": float(np.quantile(bip, 0.90)),
                    "p90_qr": float(np.quantile(qr, 0.90)),
                    "p50_qr_minus_bip": float(np.quantile(qr, 0.50) - np.quantile(bip, 0.50)),
                    "max_abs_ecdf_diff": float(np.max(np.abs(qr_ecdf - bip_ecdf))),
                }
            )

    return pd.DataFrame(ecdf_rows), pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)


def plot_13r_payment_ecdfs(ecdf_df: pd.DataFrame, specs: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    n_panels = len(specs)
    n_cols = 3
    n_rows = int(np.ceil(n_panels / n_cols))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        n_rows,
        n_cols,
        figsize=(16.5, 4.1 * n_rows),
        sharex=True,
        sharey=True,
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
    )
    axes_flat = np.array(axes).reshape(-1)

    for ax, spec in zip(axes_flat, specs.to_dict("records")):
        panel = ecdf_df[ecdf_df["variable_id"].eq(spec["variable_id"])]
        for payment_group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            payment_panel = panel[panel["payment_group"].eq(payment_group)]
            ax.plot(
                payment_panel["x_percentile"],
                payment_panel["ecdf"],
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
                linewidth=2.1,
                label=payment_group,
            )
        ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.45)
        ax.set_title(
            f"{spec['mode']} | {spec['metric']}\n{spec['role_label']} - {spec['scale']}",
            fontsize=10.5,
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            loc="left",
        )
        ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
        ax.set_xlabel("Percentil operacional promedio")
        ax.set_ylabel("Fraccion acumulada de tarjetas")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    for ax in axes_flat[n_panels:]:
        ax.axis("off")

    handles = [
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group], linewidth=2.4, label=group)
        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER
    ]
    fig.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="upper center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, OP_13R_LEGEND_Y),
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Distribuciones operacionales por medio de pago",
        "ECDF sobre percentiles semana-franja. Si la curva QR queda mas abajo/derecha que BIP, QR observa valores operacionales mayores.",
        y=OP_13R_TITLE_Y,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.06,
        right=0.98,
        top=OP_13R_PANEL_TOP,
        bottom=0.07,
        hspace=0.52,
        wspace=0.18,
    )
    plt.show()


op_13r_distribution_specs = op_13r_candidate_distribution_specs()
op_13r_payment_ecdf, op_13r_payment_distribution_summary = op_13r_ecdf_rows(
    op_13q_model_frame,
    op_13r_distribution_specs,
)

display(
    op_13r_payment_distribution_summary[
        [
            "role_13q",
            "mode",
            "family",
            "scale",
            "metric",
            "n_bip",
            "n_qr",
            "p50_bip",
            "p50_qr",
            "p50_qr_minus_bip",
            "max_abs_ecdf_diff",
        ]
    ]
    .sort_values(["role_13q", "mode", "metric"])
    .style.format(
        {
            "n_bip": fmt_int,
            "n_qr": fmt_int,
            "p50_bip": "{:.3f}",
            "p50_qr": "{:.3f}",
            "p50_qr_minus_bip": "{:+.3f}",
            "max_abs_ecdf_diff": "{:.3f}",

)
plot_13r_payment_ecdfs(op_13r_payment_ecdf, op_13r_distribution_specs)
```

**Lectura 13R.1.** Esta figura no selecciona variables: muestra si las
tarjetas QR y BIP se ubican en partes distintas de la distribucion operacional.
Las diferencias deben leerse junto con soporte, estratos socio-territoriales y
