```{python}
def interannual_14c_augmented_osm_specs() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    specs = []
    for source_name, source_family, col_template, label_template, note in [
        (
            "lf_cards_financial",
            "OSM financiero",
            "{prefix}_fin_index_z",
            "Infraestructura financiera OSM - {geo_label} (z)",
            "Bancos, cajeros y casas de cambio OSM; no mide bancarizacion individual.",
        ),
        (
            "lf_cards_commerce",
            "OSM comercio/servicios",
            "{prefix}_commerce_index_z",
            "Comercio y servicios OSM - {geo_label} (z)",
            "Comercio/servicios cotidianos OSM; proxy de centralidad urbana.",
        ),
    ]:
        for prefix, geo_label, geography_key, zone_col in [
            ("res", "residencia", "residence", "zona_hogar"),
            ("origin", "origen habitual", "origin_trip", "origin_zone_top1"),
        ]:
            specs.append(
                {
                    "source_name": source_name,
                    "geography_key": geography_key,
                    "zone_col": zone_col,
                    "source_column": col_template.format(prefix=prefix),
                    "family": source_family,
                    "variable_label": label_template.format(geo_label=geo_label),
                    "feature_note": note,
                    "aggregation": "median",
                }
            )

    activity_components = [
        ("educacion_escolar", "Escuelas"),
        ("educacion_superior", "Educacion superior"),
        ("salud_general", "Salud general"),
        ("civico_barrial", "Civico barrial"),
        ("espacio_publico", "Parques"),
        ("juegos_infantiles", "Juegos infantiles"),
        ("deportivo_barrial", "Deportivo barrial"),
    ]
    for prefix, geo_label, geography_key, zone_col in [
        ("res", "residencia", "residence", "zona_hogar"),
        ("origin", "origen habitual", "origin_trip", "origin_zone_top1"),
    ]:
        for component, component_label in activity_components:
            specs.append(
                {
                    "source_name": "lf_cards_activity",
                    "geography_key": geography_key,
                    "zone_col": zone_col,
                    "source_column": f"{prefix}_activity_{component}_index_z",
                    "family": "OSM equipamiento/actividad urbana",
                    "variable_label": f"{component_label} OSM - {geo_label} (z)",
                    "feature_note": "Objetos urbanos OSM no comerciales; indice log1p densidad, winsor y z-score.",
                    "aggregation": "median",
                }
            )
    return specs


def interannual_14c_collect_lazy_feature_values(
    specs: list[dict[str, str]],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    spec_df = pd.DataFrame(specs)
    if spec_df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    group_cols = ["source_name", "geography_key", "zone_col"]
    for _, group_specs in spec_df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False):
        source_name = group_specs["source_name"].iloc[0]
        geography_key = group_specs["geography_key"].iloc[0]
        zone_col = group_specs["zone_col"].iloc[0]
        lf_source = globals().get(source_name)
        if not isinstance(lf_source, pl.LazyFrame):
            continue

        schema_names = set(lf_source.collect_schema().names())
        if zone_col not in schema_names:
            continue
        available_specs = group_specs.loc[group_specs["source_column"].isin(schema_names)].copy()
        if available_specs.empty:
            continue

        agg_exprs = []
        for spec in available_specs.to_dict("records"):
            col = spec["source_column"]
            aggregation = spec.get("aggregation", "median")
            expr = pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
            if aggregation == "mean":
                agg_exprs.append(expr.mean().alias(col))
            else:
                agg_exprs.append(expr.median().alias(col))

        zone_values = (
            lf_source
            .filter(pl.col(zone_col).is_not_null())
            .with_columns(pl.col(zone_col).cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zone_id"))
            .group_by("zone_id")
            .agg(agg_exprs)
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        )

        for spec in available_specs.to_dict("records"):
            col = spec["source_column"]
            one = zone_values[["zone_id", col]].rename(columns={col: "feature_value"}).copy()
            for key in [
                "source_name",
                "geography_key",
                "zone_col",
                "source_column",
                "family",
                "variable_label",
                "feature_note",
                "aggregation",
            ]:
                one[key] = spec[key]
            rows.append(one)

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)


def interannual_14c_collect_operational_origin_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    required = ["op_13q_model_frame", "op_13q_candidate_table"]
    if any(name not in globals() for name in required):
        return pd.DataFrame()

    candidates = op_13q_candidate_table.copy()
    model_cols = [col for col in candidates["model_col"].tolist() if col in op_13q_model_frame.columns]
    if not model_cols:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    if "op_13p_cards" in globals() and isinstance(op_13p_cards, pl.LazyFrame):
        zone_lookup = (
            op_13p_cards
            .select(["id_tarjeta", "origin_zone_top1"])
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
    else:
        zone_lookup = (
            lf_cards
            .select(["id_tarjeta", "origin_zone_top1"])
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )

    zone_lookup["id_tarjeta"] = zone_lookup["id_tarjeta"].astype(str)
    model_df = op_13q_model_frame[["id_tarjeta", *model_cols]].copy()
    model_df["id_tarjeta"] = model_df["id_tarjeta"].astype(str)
    model_df = (
        model_df
        .merge(zone_lookup, on="id_tarjeta", how="left", validate="m:1")
        .dropna(subset=["origin_zone_top1"])
        .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    )
    model_df["zone_id"] = pd.to_numeric(model_df["origin_zone_top1"], errors="coerce")
    model_df = model_df.dropna(subset=["zone_id"]).copy()
    model_df["zone_id"] = model_df["zone_id"].astype(int)

    zone_values = model_df.groupby("zone_id", as_index=False)[model_cols].mean(numeric_only=True)
    rows = []
    candidate_lookup = candidates.set_index("model_col").to_dict("index")
    for col in model_cols:
        spec = candidate_lookup[col]
        one = zone_values[["zone_id", col]].rename(columns={col: "feature_value"}).copy()
        one["source_name"] = "op_13q_model_frame"
        one["geography_key"] = "origin_trip"
        one["zone_col"] = "origin_zone_top1"
        one["source_column"] = col
        one["family"] = f"Operacional {spec['mode']} - {spec['family']}"
        one["variable_label"] = f"{spec['mode']} | {spec['metric']} ({spec['scale']})"
        one["feature_note"] = "Percentil operacional promedio por tarjeta, agregado por zona de origen habitual."
        one["aggregation"] = "mean"
        rows.append(one)
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True) if rows else pd.DataFrame()


def interannual_14c_safe_spearman(x: pd.Series, y: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = x.notna() & y.notna()
    if valid.sum() < 3:
        return np.nan
    xv = x.loc[valid].astype(float)
    yv = y.loc[valid].astype(float)
    if xv.nunique(dropna=True) < 2 or yv.nunique(dropna=True) < 2:
        return np.nan
    return float(xv.corr(yv, method="spearman"))


def interannual_14c_weighted_pearson(
    x: pd.Series,
    y: pd.Series,
    w: pd.Series,
) -> float:
    valid = x.notna() & y.notna() & w.notna() & w.gt(0)
    if valid.sum() < 3:
        return np.nan
    xv = x.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    yv = y.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    wv = w.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    if np.unique(xv).size < 2 or np.unique(yv).size < 2:
        return np.nan
    x_mean = np.average(xv, weights=wv)
    y_mean = np.average(yv, weights=wv)
    cov = np.average((xv - x_mean) * (yv - y_mean), weights=wv)
    x_var = np.average((xv - x_mean) ** 2, weights=wv)
    y_var = np.average((yv - y_mean) ** 2, weights=wv)
    if x_var <= 0 or y_var <= 0:
        return np.nan
    return float(cov / np.sqrt(x_var * y_var))


def interannual_14c_partial_spearman(
    x: pd.Series,
    y: pd.Series,
    control: pd.Series,
) -> float:
    valid = x.notna() & y.notna() & control.notna()
    if valid.sum() < 5:
        return np.nan
    tmp = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "x": x.loc[valid].astype(float),
            "y": y.loc[valid].astype(float),
            "control": control.loc[valid].astype(float),
        }
    )
    if (
        tmp["x"].nunique(dropna=True) < 2
        or tmp["y"].nunique(dropna=True) < 2
        or tmp["control"].nunique(dropna=True) < 2
    ):
        return np.nan

    x_rank = tmp["x"].rank(method="average").to_numpy()
    y_rank = tmp["y"].rank(method="average").to_numpy()
    control_rank = tmp["control"].rank(method="average").to_numpy()
    design = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(tmp)), control_rank])
    x_beta = np.linalg.lstsq(design, x_rank, rcond=None)[0]
    y_beta = np.linalg.lstsq(design, y_rank, rcond=None)[0]
    x_resid = x_rank - design @ x_beta
    y_resid = y_rank - design @ y_beta
    if np.isclose(x_resid.var(), 0) or np.isclose(y_resid.var(), 0):
        return np.nan
    return float(np.corrcoef(x_resid, y_resid)[0, 1])


def interannual_14c_q5_q1_delta_pp(
    feature: pd.Series,
    delta_pp: pd.Series,
) -> float:
    valid = feature.notna() & delta_pp.notna()
    if valid.sum() < 10:
        return np.nan
    tmp = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "feature": feature.loc[valid].astype(float),
            "delta_pp": delta_pp.loc[valid].astype(float),
        }
    )
    if tmp["feature"].nunique(dropna=True) < 2:
        return np.nan
    tmp["feature_quintile"] = pd.qcut(
        tmp["feature"].rank(method="first"),
        q=5,
        labels=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    ).astype(int)
    q1_delta = tmp.loc[tmp["feature_quintile"].eq(1), "delta_pp"].mean()
    q5_delta = tmp.loc[tmp["feature_quintile"].eq(5), "delta_pp"].mean()
    return float(q5_delta - q1_delta)


def interannual_14c_signal_hint(row: pd.Series) -> str:
    signals = {
        "Nivel 2024": abs(row["spearman_level_2024"]) if pd.notna(row["spearman_level_2024"]) else np.nan,
        "Delta bruto": abs(row["spearman_delta_pp"]) if pd.notna(row["spearman_delta_pp"]) else np.nan,
        "Delta zonal - global": abs(row["spearman_delta_relative_pp"]) if pd.notna(row["spearman_delta_relative_pp"]) else np.nan,
        "Delta controlando nivel 2024": (
            abs(row["partial_corr_delta_controlando_share_2024"])
            if pd.notna(row["partial_corr_delta_controlando_share_2024"])
            else np.nan
        ),
    }
    valid = {key: value for key, value in signals.items() if pd.notna(value)}
    if not valid:
        return "Sin senal evaluable"
    strongest = max(valid, key=valid.get)
    if valid[strongest] < 0.10:
        return "Senal baja"
    if strongest == "Nivel 2024":
        return "Mas nivel inicial que cambio"
    if strongest == "Delta controlando nivel 2024":
        return "Cambio no explicado solo por nivel 2024"
    if strongest == "Delta bruto":
        return "Candidato para delta bruto"
    return "Candidato para crecimiento vs global"


def interannual_14c_screen_feature_values(
    feature_values: pd.DataFrame,
    relative_frames: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    if feature_values.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    metadata_cols = [
        "geography_key",
        "source_name",
        "zone_col",
        "source_column",
        "family",
        "variable_label",
        "feature_note",
        "aggregation",
    ]

    for geography_key, outcome_df in relative_frames.items():
        supported = (
            outcome_df.loc[
                outcome_df["has_delta_support"],
                [
                    "zone_id",
                    "geography",
                    "unit",
                    "support_min",
                    "qr_share_2024",
                    "delta_pp",
                    "delta_relative_pp",
                ],
            ]
            .copy()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        )
        geo_features = feature_values.loc[feature_values["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)].copy()
        if supported.empty or geo_features.empty:
            continue

        n_supported_zones = len(supported)
        for metadata, values in geo_features.groupby(metadata_cols, dropna=False):
            spec = dict(zip(metadata_cols, metadata))
            values = values[["zone_id", "feature_value"]].drop_duplicates("zone_id")
            tmp = supported.merge(values, on="zone_id", how="left")
            valid = tmp["feature_value"].notna()
            n_valid = int(valid.sum())
            coverage = n_valid / n_supported_zones if n_supported_zones else np.nan

            rows.append(
                {
                    **spec,
                    "geography": tmp["geography"].iloc[0],
                    "unit": tmp["unit"].iloc[0],
                    "n_zones_supported": n_supported_zones,
                    "n_zones_with_feature": n_valid,
                    "coverage_zones": coverage,
                    "feature_p10": tmp.loc[valid, "feature_value"].quantile(0.10) if n_valid else np.nan,
                    "feature_p50": tmp.loc[valid, "feature_value"].median() if n_valid else np.nan,
                    "feature_p90": tmp.loc[valid, "feature_value"].quantile(0.90) if n_valid else np.nan,
                    "spearman_level_2024": interannual_14c_safe_spearman(
                        tmp["feature_value"],
                        tmp["qr_share_2024"],
                    ),
                    "spearman_delta_pp": interannual_14c_safe_spearman(
                        tmp["feature_value"],
                        tmp["delta_pp"],
                    ),
                    "spearman_delta_relative_pp": interannual_14c_safe_spearman(
                        tmp["feature_value"],
                        tmp["delta_relative_pp"],
                    ),
                    "weighted_pearson_delta_pp": interannual_14c_weighted_pearson(
                        tmp["feature_value"],
                        tmp["delta_pp"],
                        tmp["support_min"],
                    ),
                    "weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp": interannual_14c_weighted_pearson(
                        tmp["feature_value"],
                        tmp["delta_relative_pp"],
                        tmp["support_min"],
                    ),
                    "partial_corr_delta_controlando_share_2024": interannual_14c_partial_spearman(
                        tmp["feature_value"],
                        tmp["delta_pp"],
                        tmp["qr_share_2024"],
                    ),
                    "q5_q1_delta_pp": interannual_14c_q5_q1_delta_pp(
                        tmp["feature_value"],
                        tmp["delta_pp"],
                    ),
                }
            )

    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if out.empty:
        return out
    out["max_abs_spearman_change"] = out[
        [
            "spearman_delta_pp",
            "spearman_delta_relative_pp",
            "partial_corr_delta_controlando_share_2024",
        ]
    ].abs().max(axis=1)
    out["signal_hint"] = out.apply(interannual_14c_signal_hint, axis=1)
    out["rank_change_signal"] = (
        out.groupby("geography_key")["max_abs_spearman_change"]
        .rank(method="first", ascending=False)
        .astype(int)
    )
    out["geography_order"] = out["geography_key"].map(
        {"residence": 0, "origin_trip": 1}
    ).fillna(99)
    return out.sort_values(
        ["geography_order", "rank_change_signal", "family", "variable_label"]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


interannual_14c_feature_values = pd.concat(
    [
        interannual_14c_collect_lazy_feature_values(
            [
                *interannual_14c_base_feature_specs(),
                *interannual_14c_augmented_osm_specs(),
            ]
        ),
        interannual_14c_collect_operational_origin_features(),
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)

interannual_14c_screening = interannual_14c_screen_feature_values(

)

```

**Como leer 14C.** La columna `spearman_level_2024` indica si la variable se
parece al mapa inicial de QR. Las columnas de delta indican si se parece al
cambio interanual. Si una variable tiene correlacion alta con nivel 2024 pero
baja con los deltas, su mensaje es de persistencia espacial, no necesariamente
de crecimiento. `partial_corr_delta_controlando_share_2024` pregunta si la
variable sigue asociada al cambio despues de descontar el nivel QR inicial.
`q5_q1_delta_pp` traduce el mismo screening a una escala directa: cuanto mas
crecieron, en promedio, las zonas del quintil alto de la variable frente a las
del quintil bajo. Si una variable aparece en estas columnas, es candidata para
graficarla en el siguiente sub-bloque.

## 14D) Gradientes interanuales por quintil de variables candidatas

Este sub-bloque toma un conjunto corto de variables candidatas desde 14C y
grafica su forma por quintiles. La pregunta es si el gradiente observado es
solo un gradiente de nivel inicial, o si tambien ordena el crecimiento
2025-2024.

La figura muestra, para cada variable:

- izquierda: `share QR 2024` y `share QR 2025` promedio por quintil zonal;
- derecha: `delta 2025-2024` promedio por quintil zonal;
- linea punteada: delta global de la geografia correspondiente.

```{python}
def interannual_14d_candidate_screening_table(
    screening_df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidate_specs: list[dict[str, object]],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    specs = pd.DataFrame(candidate_specs)
    out = specs.merge(
        screening_df,
        on=["geography_key", "source_column"],
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
    return out.sort_values("plot_order").reset_index(drop=True)


def interannual_14d_candidate_quintiles(
    candidate_specs: list[dict[str, object]],
    feature_values: pd.DataFrame,
    relative_frames: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for spec in candidate_specs:
        geography_key = spec["geography_key"]
        source_column = spec["source_column"]
        features = feature_values.loc[
            feature_values["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)
            & feature_values["source_column"].eq(source_column),
            ["zone_id", "feature_value"],
        ].drop_duplicates("zone_id")
        if features.empty or geography_key not in relative_frames:
            continue

        outcomes = relative_frames[geography_key].loc[
            relative_frames[geography_key]["has_delta_support"],
            [
                "zone_id",
                "geography",
                "unit",
                "support_min",
                "qr_share_2024",
                "qr_share_2025",
                "delta_pp",
                "global_delta_pp",
            ],
        ].copy()
        data = (
            outcomes
            .merge(features, on="zone_id", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            .dropna(subset=["feature_value", "qr_share_2024", "qr_share_2025", "delta_pp"])
        )
        if len(data) < 10 or data["feature_value"].nunique(dropna=True) < 2:
            continue

        data["feature_quintile"] = pd.qcut(
            data["feature_value"].rank(method="first"),
            q=5,
            labels=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
        ).astype(int)
        grouped = (
            data.groupby("feature_quintile", observed=True)
            .agg(
                n_zones=("zone_id", "size"),
                support_min_sum=("support_min", "sum"),
                feature_median=("feature_value", "median"),
                qr_share_2024=("qr_share_2024", "mean"),
                qr_share_2025=("qr_share_2025", "mean"),
                delta_pp=("delta_pp", "mean"),
                global_delta_pp=("global_delta_pp", "first"),
            )
            .reset_index()
        )
        for row in grouped.to_dict("records"):
            rows.append(
                {
                    **spec,
                    "geography": data["geography"].iloc[0],
                    "unit": data["unit"].iloc[0],
                    **row,
                }
            )

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    out["quintile_label"] = out["feature_quintile"].map(
        {
            1: "Q1\nmenor",
            2: "Q2",
            3: "Q3",
            4: "Q4",
            5: "Q5\nmayor",
        }
    )
    return out.sort_values(["plot_order", "feature_quintile"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def plot_interannual_14d_candidate_quintiles(
    quintile_df: pd.DataFrame,
    screening_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:
    if quintile_df.empty:

        return

        quintile_df[["plot_order", "plot_group", "plot_label", "geography_key", "source_column"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("plot_order")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    n_rows = len(candidate_order)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        n_rows,
        2,
        figsize=(16.8, max(4.8, 2.55 * n_rows)),

    if n_rows == 1:
        axes = np.array([axes])

    level_values = quintile_df[["qr_share_2024", "qr_share_2025"]].to_numpy().ravel()
    level_min = max(0.0, float(np.nanmin(level_values)) - 0.015)
    level_max = min(0.40, float(np.nanmax(level_values)) + 0.020)
    delta_min = min(0.0, float(quintile_df["delta_pp"].min()) - 0.45)
    delta_max = float(quintile_df["delta_pp"].max()) + 0.55
    screening_lookup = screening_df.set_index(["geography_key", "source_column"]).to_dict("index")

    for row_idx, candidate in candidate_order.iterrows():
        panel = quintile_df.loc[
            quintile_df["plot_order"].eq(candidate["plot_order"])
        ].sort_values("feature_quintile")
        x = panel["feature_quintile"].astype(int).to_numpy()
        x_labels = panel["quintile_label"].tolist()
        key = (candidate["geography_key"], candidate["source_column"])
        screen = screening_lookup.get(key, {})
        title = f"{candidate['plot_group']} | {candidate['plot_label']}"
        title = "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(title, width=56))

        ax = axes[row_idx, 0]
        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        ax.plot(
            x,
            panel["qr_share_2024"],
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],

        ax.plot(
            x,
            panel["qr_share_2025"],
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            marker="o",
            linewidth=2.0,
            markersize=4.8,
            label="2025",
            zorder=3,
        )
        ax.set_title(title, loc="left", fontsize=10.6, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=8)
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels, fontsize=8.8)
        ax.set_ylim(level_min, level_max)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0, decimals=0))
        ax.set_ylabel("Share QR")
        if row_idx == n_rows - 1:
            ax.set_xlabel("Quintil de la variable")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")

        ax = axes[row_idx, 1]
        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        ax.axhline(
            panel["global_delta_pp"].iloc[0],
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
            linestyle="--",
            linewidth=1.1,
            alpha=0.85,
            zorder=1,
        )
        ax.plot(
            x,
            panel["delta_pp"],
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            marker="o",
            linewidth=2.0,
            markersize=4.8,
            zorder=3,
        )
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels, fontsize=8.8)
        ax.set_ylim(delta_min, delta_max)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value:+.1f}"))
        ax.set_ylabel("Delta pp")
        if row_idx == n_rows - 1:
            ax.set_xlabel("Quintil de la variable")
        q5_q1 = screen.get("q5_q1_delta_pp", np.nan)
        partial = screen.get("partial_corr_delta_controlando_share_2024", np.nan)
        ax.text(
            0.98,
            0.92,
            f"Q5-Q1 {q5_q1:+.2f} pp\npartial {partial:+.2f}",
            transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha="right",
            va="top",
            fontsize=8.6,
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            bbox=dict(facecolor=AX_BG, edgecolor="none", pad=1.5, alpha=0.86),
        )
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")

    handles = [
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], marker="o", linewidth=2.0, label="Share QR 2024"),
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], marker="o", linewidth=2.0, label="Share QR 2025 / delta"),
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=MUTED_TEXT, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.1, label="Delta global de la geografia"),
    ]
    fig.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="upper center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.935),
        ncol=3,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=9.2,
    )
    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Gradientes interanuales QR por quintil de variables candidatas",
        "Promedios simples por ZONA777 con soporte comparable. Izquierda: niveles QR; derecha: cambio 2025-2024 en puntos porcentuales.",
        y=0.992,
        subtitle_gap=0.045,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.018,
        "Nota: quintiles calculados dentro de cada variable y geografia. Las variables OSM son proxies territoriales con posible cobertura incompleta.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.8,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.065,
        right=0.985,
        top=0.900,
        bottom=0.050,
        hspace=0.66,
        wspace=0.16,
    )
    plt.show()

```

**Como leer 14D.** Si las lineas 2024 y 2025 estan separadas pero son casi
paralelas, la variable ordena principalmente el nivel QR. Si la curva de delta
sube o baja con claridad frente a la linea global, la variable tambien ordena
el crecimiento interanual. El control de carga BIP se incluye para verificar si
el patron de crecimiento QR aparece donde el acceso fisico a carga BIP es peor;
si su gradiente es plano o pequeno, refuerza la lectura de que esa no es la
explicacion principal.

## 14E) Perfil top/bottom de crecimiento relativo QR

Este sub-bloque cambia la pregunta. En vez de mirar una variable a la vez por
quintiles, compara dos grupos de zonas:

- **Bottom 20%**: zonas con menor `delta zonal - global`.
- **Top 20%**: zonas con mayor `delta zonal - global`.

La lectura es descriptiva: si una variable tiene mayor mediana en el top 20%,
esa variable caracteriza a las zonas que crecieron mas que la tendencia global
de su geografia. No implica causalidad ni controla simultaneamente por otras
variables.

```{python}
def interannual_14e_top_bottom_zones(
    relative_frames: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
    *,
    n_quantiles: int = INTERANNUAL_14E_GROWTH_QUANTILES,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for geography_key, frame in relative_frames.items():
        supported = (
            frame.loc[frame["has_delta_support"]]
            .copy()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            .dropna(subset=["delta_relative_pp"])
        )
        if len(supported) < n_quantiles * 2:
            continue
        supported["growth_relative_quintile"] = pd.qcut(
            supported["delta_relative_pp"].rank(method="first"),
            q=n_quantiles,
            labels=range(1, n_quantiles + 1),
        ).astype(int)
        supported["growth_group"] = np.select(
            [
                supported["growth_relative_quintile"].eq(1),
                supported["growth_relative_quintile"].eq(n_quantiles),
            ],
            ["Bottom 20%", "Top 20%"],
            default="Middle 60%",
        )
        supported["growth_group_order"] = supported["growth_group"].map(
            {"Bottom 20%": 0, "Middle 60%": 1, "Top 20%": 2}
        )
        rows.append(
            supported.loc[
                supported["growth_group"].isin(["Bottom 20%", "Top 20%"]),
                [
                    "geography_key",
                    "geography",
                    "unit",
                    "zone_id",
                    "support_min",
                    "qr_share_2024",
                    "qr_share_2025",
                    "delta_pp",
                    "global_delta_pp",
                    "delta_relative_pp",
                    "growth_relative_quintile",
                    "growth_group",
                    "growth_group_order",
                ],
            ]
        )
    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True).sort_values(
        ["geography_key", "growth_group_order", "delta_relative_pp"]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


def interannual_14e_group_summary(top_bottom_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if top_bottom_df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    out = (
        top_bottom_df.groupby(
            ["geography_key", "geography", "unit", "growth_group", "growth_group_order"],
            as_index=False,
            observed=True,
        )
        .agg(
            n_zones=("zone_id", "size"),
            support_min_median=("support_min", "median"),
            qr_share_2024_mean=("qr_share_2024", "mean"),
            qr_share_2025_mean=("qr_share_2025", "mean"),
            delta_pp_mean=("delta_pp", "mean"),
            delta_relative_pp_mean=("delta_relative_pp", "mean"),
            delta_relative_pp_median=("delta_relative_pp", "median"),
        )
    )
    return out.sort_values(["geography_key", "growth_group_order"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def interannual_14e_feature_profile(
    top_bottom_df: pd.DataFrame,
    feature_values: pd.DataFrame,
    feature_specs: list[dict[str, object]],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    if top_bottom_df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    for spec in feature_specs:
        features = feature_values.loc[
            feature_values["geography_key"].eq(spec["geography_key"])
            & feature_values["source_column"].eq(spec["source_column"]),
            ["zone_id", "feature_value"],
        ].drop_duplicates("zone_id")
        if features.empty:
            continue

        data = (
            top_bottom_df.loc[top_bottom_df["geography_key"].eq(spec["geography_key"])]
            .merge(features, on="zone_id", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        )
        group_stats = data.dropna(subset=["feature_value"]).groupby(
            "growth_group",
            observed=True,
        )
        medians = group_stats["feature_value"].median().to_dict()
        counts = group_stats["feature_value"].size().to_dict()
        feature_distribution = features["feature_value"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
        feature_iqr = (
            feature_distribution.quantile(0.75) - feature_distribution.quantile(0.25)
            if len(feature_distribution)
            else np.nan
        )
        bottom = medians.get("Bottom 20%", np.nan)
        top = medians.get("Top 20%", np.nan)
        raw_diff = top - bottom if pd.notna(top) and pd.notna(bottom) else np.nan
        rows.append(
            {
                **spec,
                "geography": data["geography"].dropna().iloc[0] if data["geography"].notna().any() else np.nan,
                "n_bottom_zones": int(counts.get("Bottom 20%", 0)),
                "n_top_zones": int(counts.get("Top 20%", 0)),
                "bottom_median": bottom,
                "top_median": top,
                "top_minus_bottom": raw_diff,
                "feature_iqr": feature_iqr,
                "top_minus_bottom_iqr": (
                    raw_diff / feature_iqr
                    if pd.notna(raw_diff) and pd.notna(feature_iqr) and feature_iqr > 0
                    else np.nan
                ),
                "profile_hint": (
                    "Mayor en top 20%"
                    if pd.notna(top) and pd.notna(bottom) and top > bottom
                    else "Menor en top 20%"
                    if pd.notna(top) and pd.notna(bottom) and top < bottom
                    else "Sin diferencia evaluable"
                ),
            }
        )

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    out["geography_order"] = out["geography_key"].map(
        {"residence": 0, "origin_trip": 1}
    ).fillna(99)
    return out.sort_values(["geography_order", "feature_order"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def format_interannual_14e_raw_diff(value: float, scale_hint: str) -> str:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return ""
    if scale_hint == "metros":
        return f"{value:+.0f} m"
    if scale_hint == "puntos/km2":
        return f"{value:+.2f} p/km2"
    if scale_hint == "z":
        return f"{value:+.2f} z"
    if scale_hint == "percentil promedio":
        return f"{value:+.2f} pctil"
    return f"{value:+.2f}"


def plot_interannual_14e_top_bottom_profile(profile_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    if profile_df.empty:
        display(pd.DataFrame({"status": ["Sin perfil top/bottom para graficar."]}))
        return

    plot_df = profile_df.dropna(subset=["top_minus_bottom_iqr"]).copy()
    if plot_df.empty:
        display(pd.DataFrame({"status": ["Sin diferencias normalizables para graficar."]}))
        return

    plot_df["raw_diff_label"] = plot_df.apply(
        lambda row: format_interannual_14e_raw_diff(
            row["top_minus_bottom"],
            row["scale_hint"],
        ),
        axis=1,
    )
    geographies = (
        plot_df[["geography_order", "geography"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("geography_order")["geography"]
        .tolist()
    )
    max_rows = int(plot_df.groupby("geography", observed=True).size().max())
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        len(geographies),
        figsize=(17.2, max(5.8, 0.58 * max_rows + 2.4)),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
        sharex=True,
    )
    if len(geographies) == 1:
        axes = np.array([axes])

    x_max = float(np.nanmax(np.abs(plot_df["top_minus_bottom_iqr"])))
    x_lim = max(0.55, x_max + 0.18)

    for ax, geography in zip(axes, geographies):
        panel = (
            plot_df.loc[plot_df["geography"].eq(geography)]
            .sort_values("top_minus_bottom_iqr", ascending=True)
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )
        y = np.arange(len(panel))
        values = panel["top_minus_bottom_iqr"].to_numpy()
        colors = np.where(values >= 0, PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"])

        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        ax.axvline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.85, zorder=1)
        for y_pos, value, color in zip(y, values, colors):
            ax.plot([0, value], [y_pos, y_pos], color=color, linewidth=2.0, alpha=0.82, zorder=2)
        ax.scatter(values, y, color=colors, s=58, zorder=3, edgecolor=AX_BG, linewidth=0.8)

        for y_pos, value, label in zip(y, values, panel["raw_diff_label"]):
            offset = 0.035 if value >= 0 else -0.035
            ax.text(
                value + offset,
                y_pos,
                label,
                ha="left" if value >= 0 else "right",
                va="center",
                fontsize=8.8,
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
            )

        labels = [
            "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(label, width=34))
            for label in panel["variable_label"].tolist()
        ]
        ax.set_yticks(y)
        ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=9.0)
        ax.set_xlim(-x_lim, x_lim)
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value:+.1f}"))
        ax.set_title(
            f"{geography}",
            loc="left",
            fontsize=11.4,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=10,
        )
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    fig.supxlabel(
        "Diferencia de mediana top-bottom normalizada por IQR de cada variable: izquierda = menos en top; derecha = mas en top",
        y=0.075,
        fontsize=10.2,
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
    )
    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Perfil de variables en zonas con mayor crecimiento relativo QR",
        (
            "Puntos = mediana del top 20% menos mediana del bottom 20% de delta zonal - global. "
            "Etiquetas muestran la diferencia en la unidad original."
        ),
        y=0.985,
        subtitle_gap=0.045,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.025,
        "Nota: top/bottom se define dentro de cada geografia. Valores positivos indican que las zonas de mayor crecimiento relativo tienen mas de esa variable.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.8,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.205,
        right=0.980,
        top=0.815,
        bottom=0.145,
        wspace=0.36,
    )
    plt.show()
```

## 14F) Scatter diagnóstico de señales candidatas

Este sub-bloque revisa si las señales seleccionadas se observan como relación
zona a zona, no solo como contraste entre extremos. Cada punto es una ZONA777
con soporte comparable 2024-2025. El eje Y usa `delta zonal - delta global`:
valores positivos indican que la zona creció más que la tendencia global de su
geografía.

La lectura sigue siendo descriptiva. El color permite ver si la asociación está
concentrada en macrozonas específicas, y el tamaño del punto muestra el soporte
relativo dentro de cada panel.

```{python}
def clean_interannual_14f_macrozone(value: object) -> str:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "Sin macrozona"
    label = str(value).strip()
    if not label:
        return "Sin macrozona"
    return label.title()


def build_interannual_14f_scatter_data(
    specs: list[dict[str, object]],
    relative_frames: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
    feature_values: pd.DataFrame,
    geometries: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    metadata_cols = [
        col
        for col in ["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA"]
        if col in geometries.columns
    ]
    metadata = geometries[metadata_cols].drop_duplicates("zone_id").copy()
    rows = []

    for spec in specs:
        geography_key = spec["geography_key"]
        if geography_key not in relative_frames:
            continue
        outcome = relative_frames[geography_key]
        supported = (
            outcome.loc[
                outcome["has_delta_support"],
                [
                    "zone_id",
                    "geography",
                    "unit",
                    "support_min",
                    "qr_share_2024",
                    "qr_share_2025",
                    "delta_pp",
                    "global_delta_pp",
                    "delta_relative_pp",
                    "relative_position",
                ],
            ]
            .copy()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        )
        features = (
            feature_values.loc[
                feature_values["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)
                & feature_values["source_column"].eq(spec["source_column"]),
                ["zone_id", "feature_value"],
            ]
            .drop_duplicates("zone_id")
            .copy()
        )
        if supported.empty or features.empty:
            continue

        data = (
            supported.merge(features, on="zone_id", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
            .merge(metadata, on="zone_id", how="left")
            .dropna(subset=["feature_value", "delta_relative_pp"])
        )
        if data.empty:
            continue
        macro_source = (
            data["MACROZONA"]
            if "MACROZONA" in data.columns
            else pd.Series(np.nan, index=data.index)
        )
        if "NMACROZONA" in data.columns:
            macro_source = macro_source.fillna(data["NMACROZONA"])
        data["macrozone_label"] = macro_source.apply(clean_interannual_14f_macrozone)
        for key, value in spec.items():
            data[key] = value
        rows.append(data)

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    out = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    out["macrozone_order"] = out["macrozone_label"].map(
        {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(INTERANNUAL_14F_MACROZONE_ORDER)}
    ).fillna(99)
    return out.sort_values(["plot_order", "macrozone_order", "zone_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def interannual_14f_scatter_summary(scatter_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    if scatter_df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    for keys, group in scatter_df.groupby(
        ["plot_order", "plot_group", "plot_label", "geography", "source_column", "why_plot"],
        observed=True,
        dropna=False,
    ):
        plot_order, plot_group, plot_label, geography, source_column, why_plot = keys
        rows.append(
            {
                "plot_order": plot_order,
                "plot_group": plot_group,
                "plot_label": plot_label,
                "geography": geography,
                "source_column": source_column,
                "n_zones": len(group),
                "feature_p10": group["feature_value"].quantile(0.10),
                "feature_p90": group["feature_value"].quantile(0.90),
                "spearman_delta_relative_pp": interannual_14c_safe_spearman(
                    group["feature_value"],
                    group["delta_relative_pp"],
                ),
                "weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp": interannual_14c_weighted_pearson(
                    group["feature_value"],
                    group["delta_relative_pp"],
                    group["support_min"],
                ),
                "why_plot": why_plot,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("plot_order").reset_index(drop=True)


def plot_interannual_14f_candidate_scatters(
    scatter_df: pd.DataFrame,
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:
    if scatter_df.empty:
        display(pd.DataFrame({"status": ["Sin datos para graficar scatters 14F."]}))
        return

    order = (
        scatter_df[
            ["plot_order", "plot_group", "plot_label", "geography", "x_label"]
        ]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("plot_order")
        .to_dict("records")
    )
    n_panels = len(order)
    n_cols = 3
    n_rows = int(np.ceil(n_panels / n_cols))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        n_rows,
        n_cols,
        figsize=(18.0, 5.2 * n_rows),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
        squeeze=False,
    )
    axes_flat = axes.ravel()
    summary_lookup = summary_df.set_index("plot_order").to_dict("index")
    y_abs = max(
        3.0,
        float(np.nanquantile(np.abs(scatter_df["delta_relative_pp"]), 0.995)) + 0.4,
    )
    y_abs = min(max(y_abs, 3.0), 8.5)
    legend_macrozones = [
        label
        for label in INTERANNUAL_14F_MACROZONE_ORDER
        if label in set(scatter_df["macrozone_label"])
    ]

    for ax, panel_spec in zip(axes_flat, order):
        panel = scatter_df.loc[
            scatter_df["plot_order"].eq(panel_spec["plot_order"])
        ].copy()
        summary = summary_lookup.get(panel_spec["plot_order"], {})
        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        ax.axhline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.1, zorder=1)

        support_log = np.log1p(panel["support_min"].astype(float))
        support_span = support_log.max() - support_log.min()
        if support_span > 0:
            sizes = 20 + 78 * (support_log - support_log.min()) / support_span
        else:
            sizes = pd.Series(46, index=panel.index)

        for macrozone in legend_macrozones:
            sub = panel.loc[panel["macrozone_label"].eq(macrozone)]
            if sub.empty:
                continue
            ax.scatter(
                sub["feature_value"],
                sub["delta_relative_pp"],
                s=sizes.loc[sub.index],
                color=INTERANNUAL_14F_MACROZONE_COLORS.get(macrozone, "#9CA3AF"),
                alpha=0.68,
                edgecolor="white",
                linewidth=0.40,
                label=macrozone,
                zorder=3,
            )

        fit_data = panel.dropna(subset=["feature_value", "delta_relative_pp", "support_min"])
        if fit_data["feature_value"].nunique(dropna=True) >= 2 and len(fit_data) >= 5:
            x = fit_data["feature_value"].astype(float).to_numpy()
            y = fit_data["delta_relative_pp"].astype(float).to_numpy()
            w = np.sqrt(fit_data["support_min"].astype(float).to_numpy())
            coef = np.polyfit(x, y, deg=1, w=w)
            xx = np.linspace(np.nanmin(x), np.nanmax(x), 100)
            ax.plot(
                xx,
                coef[0] * xx + coef[1],
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
                linewidth=1.35,
                alpha=0.82,
                zorder=4,
            )

        rho = summary.get("spearman_delta_relative_pp", np.nan)
        wp = summary.get("weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp", np.nan)
        ax.text(
            0.02,
            0.97,
            f"rho {rho:+.2f}\npearson pond. {wp:+.2f}",
            transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha="left",
            va="top",
            fontsize=8.6,
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            bbox=dict(facecolor=AX_BG, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.86, pad=1.8),
        )
        title = f"{panel_spec['plot_group']} | {panel_spec['plot_label']}"
        ax.set_title(
            "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(title, width=44)),
            loc="left",
            fontsize=11.0,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=10,
        )
        ax.set_xlabel(panel_spec["x_label"])
        ax.set_ylabel("Delta zonal - global (pp)")
        ax.set_ylim(-y_abs, y_abs)
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    for ax in axes_flat[n_panels:]:
        ax.set_axis_off()

    macro_handles = [
        plt.Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            marker="o",
            linestyle="",
            markersize=7,
            markerfacecolor=INTERANNUAL_14F_MACROZONE_COLORS.get(label, "#9CA3AF"),
            markeredgecolor="white",
            label=label,
        )
        for label in legend_macrozones
    ]
    fit_handle = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=TEXT_COLOR, linewidth=1.35, label="Ajuste lineal ponderado")
    zero_handle = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=MUTED_TEXT, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.1, label="Crecimiento igual al global")
    fig.legend(
        handles=[*macro_handles, fit_handle, zero_handle],
        loc="upper center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.905),
        ncol=min(5, len(macro_handles) + 2),
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=8.9,
    )
    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Relacion zona a zona entre variables candidatas y crecimiento relativo QR",
        "Cada punto es una ZONA777 con soporte comparable. Color = macrozona; tamaño = soporte minimo 2024/2025 dentro del panel.",
        y=0.985,
        subtitle_gap=0.045,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.022,
        "Nota: el eje Y resta el delta global de cada geografia; los ajustes son guias descriptivas ponderadas por soporte, no modelos causales.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.8,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.060,
        right=0.985,
        top=0.830,
        bottom=0.095,
        hspace=0.45,
        wspace=0.28,
    )
    plt.show()
```

**Como leer 14F.** Cada punto es una zona. Si la nube sube de izquierda a
derecha, las zonas con mayor valor de la variable tienden a crecer más que la
tendencia global QR. Si los colores se agrupan por macrozona, parte de la señal
puede estar capturando estructura territorial amplia. El tamaño ayuda a no leer
zonas de bajo soporte igual que zonas con muchas observaciones.

## 14G) Mapa tipológico de crecimiento relativo QR

Este sub-bloque vuelve al mapa, pero evita una escala continua. Clasifica las
zonas con soporte comparable en tres grupos dentro de cada geografía:

- **Bottom 20%**: menor crecimiento relativo (`delta zonal - delta global`).
- **Middle 60%**: zonas cerca de la tendencia relativa central.
- **Top 20%**: mayor crecimiento relativo.
- **Sin soporte**: zonas sin soporte comparable 2024-2025.

La tabla por macrozona calcula los porcentajes sobre zonas con soporte
comparable, no sobre todas las zonas geométricas.

```{python}
def clean_interannual_14g_macrozone(value: object) -> str:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "Sin macrozona"
    label = str(value).strip()
    if not label:
        return "Sin macrozona"
    return label.title()


def build_interannual_14g_typology_maps(
    relative_frames: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
    geometries: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    n_quantiles: int = 5,
) -> dict[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame]:
    out = {}
    metadata_cols = [
        col
        for col in ["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "geometry"]
        if col in geometries.columns
    ]
    geometry_base = geometries[metadata_cols].drop_duplicates("zone_id").copy()

    for geography_key, frame in relative_frames.items():
        supported = (
            frame.loc[frame["has_delta_support"]]
            .copy()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            .dropna(subset=["delta_relative_pp"])
        )
        if len(supported) >= n_quantiles:
            supported["growth_relative_quintile"] = pd.qcut(
                supported["delta_relative_pp"].rank(method="first"),
                q=n_quantiles,
                labels=range(1, n_quantiles + 1),
            ).astype(int)
            supported["growth_typology"] = np.select(
                [
                    supported["growth_relative_quintile"].eq(1),
                    supported["growth_relative_quintile"].eq(n_quantiles),
                ],
                ["Bottom 20%", "Top 20%"],
                default="Middle 60%",
            )
        else:
            supported["growth_relative_quintile"] = np.nan
            supported["growth_typology"] = "Sin soporte"

        cols = [
            "zone_id",
            "geography",
            "unit",
            "support_min",
            "qr_share_2024",
            "qr_share_2025",
            "delta_pp",
            "global_delta_pp",
            "delta_relative_pp",
            "has_delta_support",
            "growth_relative_quintile",
            "growth_typology",
        ]
        gdf = geometry_base.merge(
            supported[[col for col in cols if col in supported.columns]],
            on="zone_id",
            how="left",
        )
        geography_label = frame["geography"].dropna().iloc[0] if frame["geography"].notna().any() else geography_key
        unit_label = frame["unit"].dropna().iloc[0] if frame["unit"].notna().any() else ""
        gdf["geography_key"] = geography_key
        gdf["geography"] = gdf["geography"].fillna(geography_label)
        gdf["unit"] = gdf["unit"].fillna(unit_label)
        gdf["has_delta_support"] = gdf["has_delta_support"].eq(True)
        gdf.loc[~gdf["has_delta_support"], "growth_typology"] = "Sin soporte"
        gdf["growth_typology"] = gdf["growth_typology"].fillna("Sin soporte")
        gdf["growth_typology_order"] = gdf["growth_typology"].map(
            {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(INTERANNUAL_14G_TYPOLOGY_ORDER)}
        ).fillna(99)
        macro_source = (
            gdf["MACROZONA"]
            if "MACROZONA" in gdf.columns
            else pd.Series(np.nan, index=gdf.index)
        )
        if "NMACROZONA" in gdf.columns:
            macro_source = macro_source.fillna(gdf["NMACROZONA"])
        gdf["macrozone_label"] = macro_source.apply(clean_interannual_14g_macrozone)
        out[geography_key] = gdf
    return out


def summarize_interannual_14g_macrozone(
    typology_maps: dict[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for _, gdf in typology_maps.items():
        supported = gdf.loc[gdf["has_delta_support"]].copy()
        if supported.empty:
            continue
        geography = supported["geography"].iloc[0]
        for macrozone, group in supported.groupby("macrozone_label", dropna=False):
            n_supported = len(group)
            n_top = int(group["growth_typology"].eq("Top 20%").sum())
            n_bottom = int(group["growth_typology"].eq("Bottom 20%").sum())
            n_middle = int(group["growth_typology"].eq("Middle 60%").sum())
            rows.append(
                {
                    "geography": geography,
                    "macrozone": macrozone,
                    "n_supported_zones": n_supported,
                    "n_top_20": n_top,
                    "share_top_20": n_top / n_supported if n_supported else np.nan,
                    "n_middle_60": n_middle,
                    "share_middle_60": n_middle / n_supported if n_supported else np.nan,
                    "n_bottom_20": n_bottom,
                    "share_bottom_20": n_bottom / n_supported if n_supported else np.nan,
                    "median_delta_relative_pp": group["delta_relative_pp"].median(),
                    "mean_delta_relative_pp": group["delta_relative_pp"].mean(),
                }
            )
    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    out["geography_order"] = out["geography"].map(
        {"Residencia": 0, "Origen de viaje": 1}
    ).fillna(99)
    out["macrozone_order"] = out["macrozone"].map(
        {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(INTERANNUAL_14G_MACROZONE_ORDER)}
    ).fillna(99)
    return out.sort_values(["geography_order", "macrozone_order", "macrozone"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def plot_interannual_14g_typology_maps(
    typology_maps: dict[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame],
) -> None:
    if not typology_maps:
        display(pd.DataFrame({"status": ["Sin mapas tipológicos para graficar."]}))
        return

    n_cols = len(typology_maps)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        n_cols,
        figsize=(16.4, 8.4),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
        squeeze=False,
    )
    axes_flat = axes.ravel()

    for ax, (_, gdf) in zip(axes_flat, typology_maps.items()):
        ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
        for category in ["Sin soporte", "Middle 60%", "Bottom 20%", "Top 20%"]:
            sub = gdf.loc[gdf["growth_typology"].eq(category)].copy()
            if sub.empty:
                continue
            plot_kwargs = {
                "ax": ax,
                "color": INTERANNUAL_14G_TYPOLOGY_COLORS[category],
                "edgecolor": "#F8F3E8",
                "linewidth": 0.06,
                "zorder": 1 if category == "Sin soporte" else 2,
            }
            if category == "Sin soporte":
                plot_kwargs.update({"edgecolor": "#CFC6B8", "hatch": "////"})
            sub.plot(**plot_kwargs)

        supported = gdf.loc[gdf["has_delta_support"]].copy()
        geography = gdf["geography"].dropna().iloc[0]
        unit = gdf["unit"].dropna().iloc[0]
        counts = supported["growth_typology"].value_counts().to_dict()
        ax.set_title(
            f"{geography}\nTop {fmt_int(counts.get('Top 20%', 0))} | Bottom {fmt_int(counts.get('Bottom 20%', 0))}",
            loc="left",
            fontsize=12.8,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=10,
        )
        ax.text(
            0.0,
            -0.050,
            f"Unidad: {unit}. Clasificación por quintiles de delta zonal - global.",
            transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha="left",
            va="top",
            fontsize=9.0,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
        )
        ax.set_axis_off()

    handles = [
        Patch(
            facecolor=INTERANNUAL_14G_TYPOLOGY_COLORS[category],
            edgecolor="#8E877A" if category == "Sin soporte" else "none",
            hatch="////" if category == "Sin soporte" else None,
            label=INTERANNUAL_14G_TYPOLOGY_LABELS[category],
        )
        for category in ["Top 20%", "Middle 60%", "Bottom 20%", "Sin soporte"]
    ]
    fig.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="upper center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.855),
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=9.8,
    )
    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Tipología territorial del crecimiento relativo QR",
        "Top/bottom se calcula dentro de cada geografía usando delta zonal - delta global entre 2024 y 2025.",
        y=0.982,
        subtitle_gap=0.040,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.025,
        "Nota: el mapa muestra posición relativa de crecimiento, no nivel absoluto QR ni causalidad.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=9.0,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.030,
        right=0.985,
        top=0.705,
        bottom=0.140,
        wspace=0.115,
    )
    plt.show()


interannual_14g_typology_maps = build_interannual_14g_typology_maps(
    interannual_14b_relative,
    interannual_14a_geometries,
)
interannual_14g_macrozone_summary = summarize_interannual_14g_macrozone(
    interannual_14g_typology_maps
)

display(
    interannual_14g_macrozone_summary[
        [
            "geography",
            "macrozone",
            "n_supported_zones",
            "n_top_20",
            "share_top_20",
            "n_bottom_20",
            "share_bottom_20",
            "median_delta_relative_pp",
            "mean_delta_relative_pp",
        ]
    ].style.format(
        {
            "n_supported_zones": fmt_int,
            "n_top_20": fmt_int,
            "share_top_20": "{:.1%}",
            "n_bottom_20": fmt_int,
            "share_bottom_20": "{:.1%}",
            "median_delta_relative_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "mean_delta_relative_pp": "{:+.2f}",
        },
        na_rep="",
    ).hide(axis="index")
)

plot_interannual_14g_typology_maps(interannual_14g_typology_maps)
```

**Como leer 14G.** Rojo identifica zonas que crecieron más que la tendencia
global de su geografía; azul identifica las que crecieron menos. La tabla por
macrozona no muestra participación de viajes o tarjetas, sino proporción de
zonas soportadas dentro de cada macrozona que caen en el top o bottom 20%.

## 14H) Mapas bivariados: crecimiento relativo y señales candidatas

Este sub-bloque cruza el crecimiento relativo QR con una variable candidata por
geografia. La pregunta no es si la variable "explica" causalmente el cambio,
sino donde coinciden espacialmente dos cosas:

- mayor o menor crecimiento relativo QR (`delta zonal - delta global`);
- mayor o menor intensidad de una señal territorial ya revisada.

Para no sobrecargar la lectura, se grafican dos señales: educación
universitaria+ en residencia y presencia operacional Metro en origen de viaje.
El crecimiento se clasifica igual que en 14G: bottom 20%, middle 60% y top 20%.
La variable candidata se clasifica en terciles dentro de la misma geografia.

```{python}
#| label: block14h-interannual-bivariate-candidate-maps
print("label: block14h-interannual-bivariate-candidate-maps")

INTERANNUAL_14H_SPECS = [
    {
        "panel_order": 1,
        "geography_key": "residence",
        "feature_column": "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z",
        "feature_label": "Educacion universitaria+ residencial",
        "panel_title": "Residencia | Educacion universitaria+",
        "unit_note": "Tarjetas QR/BIP agrupadas por zona_hogar.",
    },
    {
        "panel_order": 2,
        "geography_key": "origin_trip",
        "feature_column": "op13q_metro_station_count",
        "feature_label": "Numero de estaciones Metro",
        "panel_title": "Origen de viaje | Numero de estaciones Metro",
        "unit_note": "Viajes iniciados en la zona; variable operacional heredada desde origen habitual.",
    },
]

INTERANNUAL_14H_GROWTH_ORDER = [
    "Bajo crecimiento",
    "Cerca tendencia",
    "Alto crecimiento",
]
INTERANNUAL_14H_FEATURE_ORDER = [
    "Baja variable",
    "Variable media",
    "Alta variable",
]
INTERANNUAL_14H_COLOR_GRID = {
    ("Bajo crecimiento", "Baja variable"): "#D9D2C6",
    ("Bajo crecimiento", "Variable media"): "#91B0BD",
    ("Bajo crecimiento", "Alta variable"): "#1E5B66",
    ("Cerca tendencia", "Baja variable"): "#E9D6C5",
    ("Cerca tendencia", "Variable media"): "#D3C2B3",
    ("Cerca tendencia", "Alta variable"): "#7C8E88",
    ("Alto crecimiento", "Baja variable"): "#E7A07B",
    ("Alto crecimiento", "Variable media"): "#D86243",
    ("Alto crecimiento", "Alta variable"): "#8F302D",
}
INTERANNUAL_14H_NO_DATA_COLOR = "#EFE8DB"


def build_interannual_14h_bivariate_maps(
    specs: list[dict[str, object]],
    relative_frames: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
    feature_values: pd.DataFrame,
    geometries: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
) -> tuple[dict[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame], pd.DataFrame]:
    metadata_cols = [
        col
        for col in ["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA", "geometry"]
        if col in geometries.columns
    ]
    geometry_base = geometries[metadata_cols].drop_duplicates("zone_id").copy()
    mappable_zone_ids = set(geometry_base["zone_id"])
    maps = {}
    summary_rows = []

    for spec in specs:
        geography_key = spec["geography_key"]
        feature_column = spec["feature_column"]
        if geography_key not in relative_frames:
            continue

        outcomes = (
            relative_frames[geography_key]
            .loc[
                relative_frames[geography_key]["has_delta_support"],
                [
                    "zone_id",
                    "geography",
                    "unit",
                    "support_min",
                    "qr_share_2024",
                    "qr_share_2025",
                    "delta_pp",
                    "global_delta_pp",
                    "delta_relative_pp",
                ],
            ]
            .copy()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            .dropna(subset=["delta_relative_pp"])
        )
        features = (
            feature_values.loc[
                feature_values["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)
                & feature_values["source_column"].eq(feature_column),
                ["zone_id", "feature_value"],
            ]
            .drop_duplicates("zone_id")
            .copy()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            .dropna(subset=["feature_value"])
        )
        data = outcomes.merge(features, on="zone_id", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
        data = data.loc[data["zone_id"].isin(mappable_zone_ids)].copy()

        if len(data) >= 10 and data["feature_value"].nunique(dropna=True) >= 2:
            data["growth_relative_quintile"] = pd.qcut(
                data["delta_relative_pp"].rank(method="first"),
                q=5,
                labels=range(1, 6),
            ).astype(int)
            data["growth_group"] = np.select(
                [
                    data["growth_relative_quintile"].eq(1),
                    data["growth_relative_quintile"].eq(5),
                ],
                ["Bajo crecimiento", "Alto crecimiento"],
                default="Cerca tendencia",
            )
            data["feature_tercile"] = pd.qcut(
                data["feature_value"].rank(method="first"),
                q=3,
                labels=range(1, 4),
            ).astype(int)
            data["feature_group"] = data["feature_tercile"].map(
                {
                    1: "Baja variable",
                    2: "Variable media",
                    3: "Alta variable",
                }
            )
            data["bivariate_class"] = data.apply(
                lambda row: f"{row['growth_group']} | {row['feature_group']}",
                axis=1,
            )
        else:
            data["growth_relative_quintile"] = np.nan
            data["growth_group"] = np.nan
            data["feature_tercile"] = np.nan
            data["feature_group"] = np.nan
            data["bivariate_class"] = "Sin soporte/dato"

        gdf = geometry_base.merge(
            data[
                [
                    "zone_id",
                    "geography",
                    "unit",
                    "support_min",
                    "qr_share_2024",
                    "qr_share_2025",
                    "delta_pp",
                    "global_delta_pp",
                    "delta_relative_pp",
                    "feature_value",
                    "growth_relative_quintile",
                    "growth_group",
                    "feature_tercile",
                    "feature_group",
                    "bivariate_class",
                ]
            ],
            on="zone_id",
            how="left",
        )
        geography_label = (
            outcomes["geography"].dropna().iloc[0]
            if outcomes["geography"].notna().any()
            else str(geography_key)
        )
        unit_label = (
            outcomes["unit"].dropna().iloc[0]
            if outcomes["unit"].notna().any()
            else ""
        )
        gdf["geography_key"] = geography_key
        gdf["panel_order"] = spec["panel_order"]
        gdf["feature_label"] = spec["feature_label"]
        gdf["panel_title"] = spec["panel_title"]
        gdf["unit_note"] = spec["unit_note"]
        gdf["geography"] = gdf["geography"].fillna(geography_label)
        gdf["unit"] = gdf["unit"].fillna(unit_label)
        gdf["bivariate_class"] = gdf["bivariate_class"].fillna("Sin soporte/dato")
        maps[str(spec["panel_order"])] = gdf

        if not data.empty:
            grouped = (
                data.groupby(["growth_group", "feature_group"], observed=True)
                .agg(
                    n_zones=("zone_id", "size"),
                    median_delta_relative_pp=("delta_relative_pp", "median"),
                    median_feature_value=("feature_value", "median"),
                    median_support_min=("support_min", "median"),
                )
                .reset_index()
            )
            n_supported = len(data)
            for _, row in grouped.iterrows():
                summary_rows.append(
                    {
                        "panel_order": spec["panel_order"],
                        "geography": geography_label,
                        "feature_label": spec["feature_label"],
                        "growth_group": row["growth_group"],
                        "feature_group": row["feature_group"],
                        "n_zones": int(row["n_zones"]),
                        "share_zones": row["n_zones"] / n_supported if n_supported else np.nan,
                        "median_delta_relative_pp": row["median_delta_relative_pp"],
                        "median_feature_value": row["median_feature_value"],
                        "median_support_min": row["median_support_min"],
                    }
                )

    summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
    if not summary.empty:
        summary["growth_order"] = summary["growth_group"].map(
            {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(INTERANNUAL_14H_GROWTH_ORDER)}
        )
        summary["feature_order"] = summary["feature_group"].map(
            {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(INTERANNUAL_14H_FEATURE_ORDER)}
        )
        summary = summary.sort_values(
            ["panel_order", "growth_order", "feature_order"]
        ).reset_index(drop=True)

    return maps, summary


def plot_interannual_14h_bivariate_maps(
    bivariate_maps: dict[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame],
) -> None:
    if not bivariate_maps:
        display(pd.DataFrame({"status": ["Sin mapas bivariados para graficar."]}))
        return

    ordered_maps = [
        gdf
        for _, gdf in sorted(
            bivariate_maps.items(),
            key=lambda item: int(item[0]),
        )
    ]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        len(ordered_maps),
        figsize=(16.6, 8.8),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
        squeeze=False,
    )
    axes_flat = axes.ravel()

    for ax, gdf in zip(axes_flat, ordered_maps):
        ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
        no_data = gdf.loc[gdf["bivariate_class"].eq("Sin soporte/dato")].copy()
        if not no_data.empty:
            no_data.plot(
                ax=ax,
                color=INTERANNUAL_14H_NO_DATA_COLOR,
                edgecolor="#CFC6B8",
                hatch="////",
                linewidth=0.06,
                zorder=1,
            )

        for growth_group in INTERANNUAL_14H_GROWTH_ORDER:
            for feature_group in INTERANNUAL_14H_FEATURE_ORDER:
                key = f"{growth_group} | {feature_group}"
                sub = gdf.loc[gdf["bivariate_class"].eq(key)].copy()
                if sub.empty:
                    continue
                sub.plot(
                    ax=ax,
                    color=INTERANNUAL_14H_COLOR_GRID[(growth_group, feature_group)],
                    edgecolor="#F8F3E8",
                    linewidth=0.06,
                    zorder=2,
                )

        panel_title = gdf["panel_title"].dropna().iloc[0]
        supported = gdf.loc[~gdf["bivariate_class"].eq("Sin soporte/dato")]
        high_high = supported.loc[
            supported["growth_group"].eq("Alto crecimiento")
            & supported["feature_group"].eq("Alta variable")
        ]
        ax.set_title(
            f"{panel_title}\nAlto crecimiento + alta variable: {fmt_int(len(high_high))} zonas",
            loc="left",
            fontsize=12.0,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=10,
        )
        ax.set_axis_off()

    legend_ax = fig.add_axes([0.365, 0.062, 0.270, 0.135])
    legend_ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    for y_idx, growth_group in enumerate(INTERANNUAL_14H_GROWTH_ORDER):
        for x_idx, feature_group in enumerate(INTERANNUAL_14H_FEATURE_ORDER):
            y_plot = y_idx
            legend_ax.add_patch(
                Rectangle(
                    (x_idx, y_plot),
                    1,
                    1,
                    facecolor=INTERANNUAL_14H_COLOR_GRID[(growth_group, feature_group)],
                    edgecolor=FIG_BG,
                    linewidth=1.0,
                )
            )
    legend_ax.set_xlim(0, 3)
    legend_ax.set_ylim(0, 3)
    legend_ax.set_xticks([0.5, 1.5, 2.5])
    legend_ax.set_xticklabels(["Baja", "Media", "Alta"], fontsize=8.2)
    legend_ax.set_yticks([0.5, 1.5, 2.5])
    legend_ax.set_yticklabels(["Bajo", "Cerca", "Alto"], fontsize=8.2)
    legend_ax.set_xlabel("Variable candidata", fontsize=8.8, labelpad=4, color=TEXT_COLOR)
    legend_ax.set_ylabel("Crecimiento relativo QR", fontsize=8.8, labelpad=4, color=TEXT_COLOR)
    legend_ax.tick_params(length=0, colors=TEXT_COLOR)
    for spine in legend_ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    no_data_handle = Patch(
        facecolor=INTERANNUAL_14H_NO_DATA_COLOR,
        edgecolor="#8E877A",
        hatch="////",
        label=f"Sin soporte comparable o dato de variable (< {fmt_int(INTERANNUAL_MAP_MIN_N)}/año)",
    )
    fig.legend(
        handles=[no_data_handle],
        loc="center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.222),
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=9.0,
    )
    add_figure_title(
        fig,
        "Mapas bivariados de crecimiento relativo QR y señales candidatas",
        "Color cruza crecimiento relativo QR 2025-2024 con terciles de la variable candidata dentro de cada geografia.",
        y=0.982,
        subtitle_gap=0.040,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.030,
        "Nota: los mapas muestran co-localizacion descriptiva; no prueban causalidad ni reemplazan los scatters/correlaciones previas.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.8,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.030,
        right=0.985,
        top=0.790,
        bottom=0.255,
        wspace=0.105,
    )
    plt.show()


interannual_14h_bivariate_maps, interannual_14h_summary = build_interannual_14h_bivariate_maps(

display(
```
